title: Finance & CTMS Systems Specialist (PST/EST/CST Timezone)
description:
Finance & CTMS Systems Specialist

Company: UniTriTeam
Client: Rovia Clinical Research
Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

UniTriTeam is seeking a Finance & CTMS Systems Specialist to support Rovia Clinical Research with complex financial, data, and system-related activities within its Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS).

This role is ideal for someone who combines a strong finance or accounting foundation with excellent systems and data aptitude. The successful candidate should be comfortable working with structured data, reconciling historical financial activity, performing data imports and mapping, and learning complex system workflows.

Prior clinical research or CTMS experience is helpful but not required. We can train the right candidate on clinical research terminology and workflows. However, this is not an entry-level data-entry position. The individual must come in with strong analytical, financial, and systems skills and be comfortable independently working through complex data.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Reconciliation & CTMS Accounting

  • Tie historical sponsor payments to corresponding activities, visits, and financial records within the CTMS.
  • Research and reconcile discrepancies between historical payment records and CTMS activity.
  • Recreate fixed-budget invoices within the CTMS based on historical financial and study information.
  • Review financial data for accuracy and completeness before and after system entry or import.
  • Support ongoing payment, invoicing, and reconciliation activities as needed.

CTMS Data Imports & System Configuration

  • Prepare and import patient accounts into the CTMS.
  • Import trial builds and assist with configuring and fine-tuning study settings.
  • Import historical patient visit activity and ensure visits are appropriately associated with patients and trial builds.
  • Perform data mapping and validation before imports.
  • Review imported information and troubleshoot data inconsistencies or system issues.
  • Maintain accuracy and data integrity across CTMS records.

Data Analysis & Quality Control

  • Work with large and potentially incomplete historical datasets to determine how information should be mapped into the CTMS.
  • Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent information and determine appropriate next steps.
  • Perform reconciliation and quality-control checks to confirm that imported data matches source records.
  • Document processes, mapping decisions, and exceptions to create repeatable workflows.
  • Escalate discrepancies that require additional financial, operational, or clinical input.

Qualifications

Required

  • Professional experience in finance, accounting, bookkeeping, financial operations, or a similar field.
  • Strong experience working with systems and structured datasets.
  • Experience performing financial reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort manipulating and validating data.
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to learn new software platforms and workflows quickly.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently through complex assignments rather than relying on highly prescriptive instructions.
  • Comfortable working in an environment where historical data may require investigation, interpretation, and cleanup.

Preferred

  • Experience with CTMS, clinical research technology, healthcare systems, ERP/accounting platforms, or other complex operational systems.
  • Experience with data imports, data mapping, migrations, or system implementations.
  • Experience with accounts receivable, invoicing, payment reconciliation, or revenue accounting.
  • Familiarity with clinical research site operations, sponsor payments, patient visits, or clinical trial budgets.
  • Experience supporting system conversions or historical data cleanup projects.

What We’re Looking For

The strongest candidate will be someone who naturally approaches a problem by asking:

“How do these transactions, records, and activities tie together — and how do I make sure the system accurately reflects what happened?”

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Analytical and naturally curious
  • Comfortable digging into discrepancies
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Strong with numbers and systems
  • Able to recognize patterns in data
  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar terminology and workflows
  • Willing to take ownership of a problem through resolution

Clinical research knowledge can be taught. Financial aptitude, systems thinking, and the ability to reconcile complex data are the foundation we need this person to bring to the role.

Initial Areas of Focus

The initial priorities for this position will include:

  • Tying historical sponsor payments to CTMS activity
  • Recreating fixed-budget invoices within the CTMS
  • Importing patient accounts
  • Importing and configuring trial builds
  • Importing historical patient visit activity
  • Reconciling imported financial and operational data
  • Identifying and resolving historical data discrepancies
  • Establishing repeatable processes and documentation for future CTMS financial and data work

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the individual's ability to quickly become proficient in Rovia's CTMS environment, independently manage increasingly complex finance and data assignments, maintain a high degree of data accuracy, and reduce the amount of manual oversight required to complete financial reconciliation and historical data migration work.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer
Join Us in Securing the Nation’s FutureAre you ready to make a real impact? At the forefront of national security, Roke are a trusted partner delivering mission-critical solutions that protect the UK and its interests.
As a Data Engineer, you’ll be actively involved in development of mission critical technical solutions that focus on data services for our National Security customers.
This is your opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects in AI, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Big Data, and Digital Transformation—helping to shape the future of national security.
Your MissionAs our next Data Engineer, you’ll be managing and developing data pipelines that transform raw data into valuable insights for Roke’s National Security customers, enabling downstream analytics and reporting. You’ll be working with diverse data sources (batch, streaming, real-time and unstructured), applying distributed compute techniques to handle large datasets.
What You’ll Do• Data pipeline development - Data ingestion and pipeline orchestration design and tooling.• Database schema design / database modelling• Data integration - Integrating and enriching data from various sources, ensuring data consistency and quality.• ETL processing design and coding - Extract transform and load processing such as NiFI.• Create code that is open by default and easy for others to reuse• Maintain and develop existing architectural components including Data Ingest and Data Stores• Work as part of an operational team investigating and diagnosing problem identified with integrated (enriched) data.• Explain the difference between user needs and the desires of the user• Data security - Implementing data security measures to protect sensitive information.• Be able to help the scrum team decompose user requests and key results into epics and stories.• Writing clean, secure code following a test-driven approach• Create code that is open by default and easy for others to reuse• Monitor and maintain - Monitor data systems for performance issues and make any necessary updates.
What You’ll BringWe’re looking for individuals with a blend of analytical thinking, stakeholder engagement, and a passion for national security. Ideal candidates will have knowledge in some of the following:• ETL processing languages such as Python• Apache Spark / NiFi / Kafka• Relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra)• AWS and data-related services• Palantir Foundry
Why Join Us?• Purpose-Driven Work: Contribute to projects that protect lives and national interests.• Innovation at the Core: Work with leading-edge technologies in AI, Cyber, and Cloud.• Career Growth: Be part of a growing business with clear progression paths and investment in your development.• Culture of Excellence: Join a team of experts who are passionate, collaborative, and mission-focused.• Flexible Working: Hybrid model with time spent at our state-of-the-art offices, working remotely and possibly at client sites.
Built on over a 60-year heritage, Roke offers specialist knowledge in sensors, communications, cyber, and AI and ML. We change the way organisations think and act – through dynamic insights from the analysis of multiple layers of data. We take care of the innovative, technical work that keeps everyone safe – that’s our mission, passion, and motivation.
We have secured long term work, across the full spectrum, on the latest framework with the client, which provides the springboard for our ongoing growth and development in this domain, so join us on what will be an incredible growth journey.
Where You’ll Work – WokingWoking - You’ll find our Woking site in a modern building on the outskirts of London. Rated excellent for sustainability by BREEAM & Fitwel certified – you’ll feel better for visiting. This site provides key links to our customers in London, is a 5-minute walk from the train station, has secure parking nearby and dedicated cycle storage.
There is an expectation that a proportion of your time may be spent working on client sites in the London area.
ClearanceDue to the nature of this role, we require you to be eligible and willing to achieve DV clearance.

title: Director of Legal
description:
Who We Are

Formerra is a preeminent distributor of engineered materials, connecting the world’s leading polymer producers with thousands of OEMs and brand owners across healthcare, consumer, industrial, and mobility markets. Powered by technical and commercial expertise, it brings a distinctive combination of portfolio depth, supply chain strength, industry knowledge, service, leading ecommerce capabilities, and ingenuity. The experienced Formerra team helps customers across multiple industries to design, select, process, and develop products in new and better ways – driving improved performance, productivity, reliability, and sustainability. To learn more, visit .

Formerra leads in the market with the following key capabilities:

  • Problem-solving mindset, based on ingenuity and backed by a skilled and experienced commercial team that brings differentiated insights across markets including healthcare, consumer, industrial and mobility
  • Expansive material portfolio, including engineering thermoplastics and traditional polymers across leading material brands
  • Integrated, long-standing relationships with leading, global suppliers
  • Unparalleled and highly specialized technical, processing, and design support
  • Regulatory-compliant material support and expertise

Position Overview:

The Director of Legal serves as the company's primary in-house legal advisor and is a senior individual contributor responsible for providing practical, business-oriented legal guidance across the organization. The role partners closely with executive leadership and functional and commercial leaders to identify and manage legal, regulatory, compliance, contractual, employment, and enterprise risks while enabling the company's strategic and operational objectives.

The Director of Legal retains internal ownership and accountability for legal matters supported by external counsel, ensuring outside legal advice is appropriately translated into practical business recommendations and actions.

This position does not have direct reports and requires a high degree of independence, judgment, prioritization, executive presence, and cross-functional influence.

Key Responsibilities

Legal Strategy & Executive Counsel

  • Serve as the company's primary internal legal advisor and trusted legal partner to executive and functional leadership.
  • Provide practical, commercially focused legal advice that balances business objectives, legal requirements, risk, and speed of execution.
  • Proactively identify emerging legal and regulatory risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Translate complex legal requirements and external legal advice into clear, actionable guidance for business leaders.
  • Support leadership in establishing appropriate legal risk tolerances and escalation protocols.
  • Provide legal perspective on new business models, markets, products, services, partnerships, and geographic expansion.

Commercial Contracts & Transactions

  • Lead the review, drafting, negotiation, and interpretation of commercial agreements, including:
    • Customer and supplier agreements
    • Distribution agreements
    • Master service agreements
    • Vendor and procurement agreements
    • Confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements
    • Consulting and professional services agreements
    • Technology, software, SaaS, and licensing agreements
    • Logistics and warehousing agreements
    • Real estate and lease agreements
    • Other strategic agreements
  • Identify material contractual risks and provide practical recommendations regarding risk acceptance, negotiation, or mitigation.
  • Develop and maintain standard contract templates, legal terms, negotiation playbooks, and approval guidelines.
  • Manage contract review and escalation standards based on risk and complexity.
  • Partner with business teams to improve contract lifecycle management and contracting efficiency.
  • Support legal due diligence associated with acquisitions, divestitures, investments, strategic partnerships, and other corporate transactions as needed.

Compliance & Ethics

  • Provide legal oversight and guidance regarding the company's compliance and ethics framework, including review, update, and training on appropriate policies, procedures, controls, and training.
  • Partner with appropriate business functions to identify legal and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Monitor relevant regulatory developments and assess potential impact on company operations.
  • Support or oversee legally sensitive internal investigations and advise leadership regarding corrective actions and remediation where appropriate.
  • Partner with business leaders to promote ethical decision-making and appropriate risk awareness.
  • Engage specialized compliance or regulatory counsel when necessary.

Regulatory Matters

  • Identify and monitor regulatory developments that may affect the company's existing or new operations, products, services, customers, suppliers, or geographic markets.
  • Partner with functional leaders to ensure relevant regulatory requirements are understood and incorporated into business processes, including providing legal guidance regarding licensing, registrations, reporting obligations, certifications, and other regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate legal responses to regulatory inquiries, audits, inspections, investigations, and requests for information.
  • Engage and manage specialized regulatory counsel when subject-matter or jurisdiction-specific expertise (e.g., tariffs, environmental regulations, employment, etc.) is required.
  • Escalate significant regulatory risks and developments to leadership.

Employment & Labor Law

  • Serve as the primary in-house legal partner to Human Resources on employment-related legal matters.
  • Review significant employment policies, handbooks, agreements, and other HR documentation from a legal perspective.
  • Advise HR and leadership regarding complex or high-risk employee relations matters, including risk associated with significant organizational changes.
  • Manage external employment counsel for litigation, agency charges, complex employment matters, and jurisdiction-specific requirements.

Corporate Governance

  • Provide legal guidance regarding operating company and subsidiary corporate governance requirements and practices.
  • Maintain or oversee appropriate corporate legal records and documentation.
  • Support corporate entity management, including subsidiaries and affiliated entities.
  • Coordinate with private equity sponsor and external corporate counsel on specialized governance matters as appropriate.

Litigation, Claims & Dispute Management

  • Serve as the internal owner of actual and threatened litigation, claims, disputes, subpoenas, and other legal proceedings.
  • Select, engage, and actively manage external litigation counsel, as needed.
  • Coordinate internal discovery, document preservation, litigation holds, and information gathering.
  • Partner with Finance and leadership regarding potential financial exposure and litigation reserves.
  • Participate in settlement strategy and dispute resolution efforts.

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Identify significant legal, regulatory, contractual, and reputational risks across the organization.
  • Partner with Finance, HR, IT, Operations, Commercial, and other functions to integrate legal considerations into enterprise risk management.
  • Advise on insurance-related legal matters and significant claims where appropriate.
  • Provide legal support for crisis management and significant incident response.
  • Recommend practical mitigation strategies that appropriately balance risk and business objectives.

Outside Counsel & Legal Operations

  • Manage the company's external counsel strategy.
  • Determine when external legal expertise or additional legal capacity is appropriate.
  • Define scope, expected outcomes, staffing, budget, and communication expectations for external legal engagements.
  • Actively manage outside counsel rather than functioning solely as a conduit between counsel and the business.
  • Monitor external legal spend and identify opportunities to improve value and cost effectiveness.
  • Develop scalable legal processes, templates, tools, playbooks, and self-service resources.

Qualifications:

  • Required
    • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from accredited law school required.
    • 8-10+ years of progressive legal experience in manufacturing, distribution, plastics, chemicals, or related industry.

  • Preferred

    • In-house corporate experience.
    • Experience working with private equity sponsors and portfolio companies.

Core Competencies & Skills

  • Demonstrated experience operating as a broad-based corporate or commercial legal advisor.
  • Significant experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial agreements.
  • Strong working knowledge across multiple corporate legal disciplines, with the ability to identify when specialized expertise is required.
  • Experience advising senior executives and business leaders on complex and sensitive matters.
  • Demonstrated experience selecting, directing, and managing outside counsel.
  • Experience managing legal matters across multiple jurisdictions preferred.
  • Technology proficient (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, with some experience using Ai / Co-Pilot to assist in identifying efficiencies to processes)

Disclaimers:

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.
  • It is the policy of Formerra that all employees are employed at the will of Formerra for an indefinite period and are subject to termination at any time, for any reason, with or without cause or notice. At the same time, employees may terminate their employment at any time and for any reason.
  • Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, pregnancy, genetic information, creed, citizenship status, marital status or any other consideration prohibited by law or contract.
  • NOTICE: Formerra is committed to ensuring a fair and legitimate recruitment process. We want to alert job applicants to the potential risk of recruitment scams and encourage caution when responding to unsolicited job postings or communications. title: Legal & Compliance Specialist - Hybrid
description:
We are a passionate and dynamic team of attorneys and legal professionals. Our culture is one of teamwork and collegiality with a commitment to delivering excellent legal and compliance services.

We are looking to add a Legal and Compliance Specialist to the Office of General Counsel located in Quincy. The position is a hybrid of in-person and remote working (Tuesday through Thursday in the office and Monday & Friday from home). The Legal and Compliance Specialist will provide support to the Office of General Counsel by assisting with regulatory compliance activities, policy governance, regulatory monitoring, filings, audits, and legal research. This role emphasizes accuracy, consistency, discretion, and adherence to applicable legal and regulatory requirements within a highly regulated insurance environment.
  • Under the direction of the Director of Compliance, draft, update, and maintain compliance‑related policies and procedures in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal governance standards.
  • Maintain compliance calendars, including annual certifications, periodic reviews, training cycles, and regulatory deadlines.
  • Oversee, under direction of the Deputy General Counsel, appropriate intellectual property filings.
  • Provide administrative and project support to the Legal Department, including scheduling, reporting, document management, and special projects as assigned.
  • Support the administration of legal and compliance requirements, under the direction of the Director of Compliance, across the organization, ensuring that all activities are conducted in compliance with applicable policy, legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Work independently and collaboratively on projects involving regulatory filings, audits, regulatory change management, state‑by‑state legal research, contract review, and vendor oversight.
  • Support corporate compliance responsibilities related to privacy, conflicts of interest, records retention, artificial intelligence, and information security risks, including working with business units on annual certification processes.
  • Assist the General Counsel, Deputy General Counsel, and Director of Compliance in the execution of compliance initiatives and regulatory obligations.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assist in ensuring the company remains current and compliant with applicable laws and regulations.
  • Assist business units with compliance related inquiries.
  • Coordinate business unit responses to regulatory inquiries, complaints and non‑financial regulatory audits, including market conduct examinations.
  • Assist, under direction, with the company’s disclosures related to market conduct examinations and regulatory reviews.
  • Respond to internal compliance‑related inquiries from employees, as appropriate.
  • Collect, track, and assist with the review of conflict of interest disclosures.
  • Prepare compliance‑related presentations, training materials, and supporting documentation.
  • Stay informed of insurance industry compliance trends and assist in recommending updates to internal processes, controls, and documentation.
  • Prepare and submit applicable business filings with state governmental agencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Paralegal certificate is preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in a legal, compliance, or regulatory support role, preferably within the insurance or financial services industry.
  • Working knowledge of regulatory compliance frameworks, including policy governance, training administration, regulatory filings, audits, and examination support.
  • Experience drafting, maintaining, and organizing compliance policies, procedures, and related documentation.
  • Strong research, writing and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize legal and regulatory requirements clearly for internal stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and document management systems commonly used in legal and compliance environments.
  • Strong critical thinking skills
  • Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and capable of managing multiple concurrent obligations.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to operate effectively within established legal and regulatory frameworks.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively across legal, compliance, and business teams.
  • Adaptable and responsive to evolving regulatory requirements and organizational priorities.

Our current reasonable and good faith estimate of the annual salary range for this position is approximately $75,000.00 - $95,000.00 based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, educational background and certifications, performance and qualifications, market demand for the role and other organizational needs.

title: Direct Bill Supervisor
description:
Direct Bill Supervisor

Patriot Growth Insurance Services | Remote | Full-Time

Why This Role Matters

The Direct Bill Supervisor plays a critical leadership role in ensuring the accurate, timely, and efficient recording, reconciliation, and reporting of direct bill revenue across Patriot's growing network of agencies. As the primary escalation point for a centralized team of Direct Bill Accountants, you will help drive consistency, operational excellence, and financial accuracy while supporting the successful collection and reconciliation of direct bill commissions.
Working closely with the Direct Bill Operations Senior Manager, Regional Direct Bill Accountants, agency accounting teams, and insurance carriers, you will lead a team responsible for commission posting, reconciliation, and reporting activities. Your leadership will help ensure cash received is accurately reconciled each month, minimizing accruals, supporting timely producer compensation, and providing meaningful financial reporting across the organization.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Direct Bill Accountants, providing coaching, training, and day-to-day support to ensure high performance and professional growth.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex reconciliation issues, carrier challenges, and unresolved direct bill exceptions.
  • Review and approve monthly reconciliations prepared by direct bill accountants, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with established accounting guidelines.
  • Monitor team productivity, quality, and service levels, identifying opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies.
  • Partner with the Direct Bill Operations Senior Manager to manage workloads, staffing priorities, and the consistent application of direct bill policies and procedures.
  • Support agency onboarding activities, banking transitions, carrier consolidations, and other operational initiatives that impact direct bill processing.
  • Guide team members in the use of commission posting platforms, agency management systems, and reconciliation tools to ensure accurate revenue recognition.
  • Collaborate with carriers, client service teams, and agency personnel to resolve escalated issues quickly and effectively.
  • Assist in the development of training programs, process documentation, and best practices that support a scalable direct bill operation.

Who You Are

  • A people-focused leader who enjoys developing talent and helping team members succeed.
  • A collaborative partner who builds strong relationships across accounting, operations, carrier partners, and agency teams.
  • A detail-oriented professional who values accuracy and accountability in financial processes.
  • A proactive problem solver who can identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
  • An organized multitasker who can balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong communicator who can explain complex financial and operational concepts clearly and confidently.
  • A technology-minded professional who embraces systems, process improvements, and data-driven decision-making.

What You Bring

Day One:

  • Strong knowledge of the insurance brokerage industry, direct bill processes, and industry regulations.
  • Experience with insurance agency management systems, preferably EPIC and BenefitPoint.
  • Proficiency with accounting software, financial management systems, and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including data filtering, pivot tables, formulas, and large-volume data analysis.
  • Proven experience leading, coaching, mentoring, or supervising a team.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to analyze financial data and generate meaningful reports.
  • High aptitude for technology, software adoption, and system utilization.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and uphold ethical standards when handling sensitive information.

Valuable Additions:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Three to five years of experience in direct billing, accounts receivable management, or a related role within the insurance brokerage industry.
  • Prior supervisory or team lead experience within an accounting, finance, or insurance operations environment.
  • Experience with Ascend, Comulate, or similar commission processing platforms.
  • Experience supporting agency onboarding, carrier consolidations, process standardization, or operational transformation initiatives.

Real Benefits for Real Life

title: Software Development Engineer II, AFX
description:
The AWS Field Experience (AFX) team builds go-to-market tooling that gives the AWS sales and marketing organization superpowers — helping them focus on customers instead of manual processes. As a Software Development Engineer II on AFX, you will design and deliver distributed systems, data pipelines, and LLM-powered automation that operate at AWS scale. Large language models are redefining how we support go-to-market functions, and this is your chance to help shape that transformation. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, writing high-quality code, contributing to system design, and collaborating with partners across the AWS partner business, enterprise support, and solutions architecture teams.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build distributed services and APIs that power go-to-market tooling for one of the largest field sales organizations in the world, covering the full lifecycle from design through deployment and operations.
- Develop and optimize data pipelines that synchronize account data across systems at scale, improving data quality and coverage for the AWS field organization.
- Implement LLM-powered workflows and automation that reduce manual effort for the sales field and generate actionable insights from complex business data.
- Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback that raises engineering standards, and mentor other engineers through documentation, training, and pairing sessions.
- Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, while collaborating with stakeholders across the AWS partner business, enterprise support, and solutions architects to ensure your solutions meet real customer needs.

A day in the life
You start by reviewing pull requests from teammates, offering detailed feedback that helps everyone grow. Mid-morning, you dig into a feature that connects account data across systems, writing code and pairing with a colleague to work through a tricky integration. After lunch, you join a design discussion with solutions architects about how an LLM-powered workflow can reduce manual steps for the field team. Later, you investigate an operational alert, trace it to its root cause, and ship a lasting fix. You move between focused coding and cross-team collaboration with partners in enterprise support and the partner business.

About the team
The AFX teams sits within AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services and build the infrastructure that supports the sales field and AWS customers at massive scale. Our closest partners span the AWS partner business, enterprise support, and solutions architecture organizations. We are investing heavily in LLM-driven tooling and large-scale data processing to redefine how go-to-market teams operate. If you want to build systems that directly shape how AWS engages with its customers worldwide, this is the team for you.

About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

title: Hospital Based Bilingual Patient Advocate-Spanish (Tuesday to Saturday 8 AM to 4:30)
description:
Make a real difference in patients’ lives—join Elevate Patient Financial Solutions as a Hospital Based Bilingual Patient Advocate and help guide individuals through their healthcare financial journey. This full-time position is located 100% onsite at a hospital in Phoenix, AZ, with a schedule of Tuesday through Saturday 8 AM to 4:30 PM..

Bring your passion for helping others and grow with a company that values your impact. In 2024, our Advocates helped over 823,000 patients secure the Medicaid coverage they needed. Elevate’s mission is to make a difference. Are you ready to be the difference?

As a Hospital Based Bilingual Patient Advocate, you play a vital role in guiding uninsured hospital patients through the complex landscape of medical and disability assistance. This onsite, hospital-based role places you at the heart of patient financial advocacy—meeting individuals face-to-face, right in their hospital rooms, to guide them through the process of identifying eligibility and applying for financial assistance. Your presence and empathy make a real difference during some of life’s most vulnerable moments.

Job Summary

The purpose of this position is to connect uninsured hospital patients to programs that will cover their medical expenses. As a Patient Advocate, you will play a critical role in assisting uninsured hospital patients by evaluating their eligibility for various federal, state, and county medical or disability assistance programs through bed-side visits and in-person interactions. Your primary objective will be to guide patients face-to-face through the application process, ensuring thorough completion and follow-up. This role is crucial in ensuring that uninsured patients are promptly identified and assisted, with the goal of meeting our benchmark that 98% of patients are screened at bedside.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Screen uninsured hospital patients at bedside in an effort to determine if patient is a viable candidate for federal, state, and/or county medical or disability assistance.
  • Complete the appropriate applications and following through until approved.
  • Detailed, accurate and timely documentation in both Elevate PFS and hospital systems on all cases worked.
  • Provide exceptional customer service skills at all times.
  • Maintain assigned work queue of patient accounts.
  • Collaborate in person and through verbal/written correspondence with hospital staff, case managers, social workers, financial counselors.
  • Answer incoming telephone calls, make out-bound calls, and track all paperwork necessary to submit enrollment and renewal for prospective Medicaid patients.
  • Maintain structured and timely contact with the applicant and responsible government agency, by phone whenever possible or as structured via the daily work queue.
  • Assist the applicant with gathering any additional reports or records, meeting appointment dates and times and arrange transportation if warranted.
  • Conduct in-person community visits as needed to acquire documentation.
  • As per established protocols, inform the client in a timely manner of all approvals and denials of coverage.
  • Attend ongoing required training to remain informed about current rules and regulations related to governmental programs, and apply updated knowledge when working with patients and cases.
  • Regular and timely attendance.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities.
  • Some college coursework preferred
  • Prior hospital experience preferred
  • Adaptability when dealing with constantly changing processes, computer systems and government programs
  • Professional experience working with state and federal programs
  • Critical thinking skills
  • Ability to maneuver throughout the hospital and patients’ rooms throughout scheduled work shift.
  • Proficient experience utilizing Microsoft Office Suite with emphasis on Excel and Outlook
  • Effectively communicate both orally and written, to a variety of individuals

Comprised of both engineers and materials scientists, the JTC provides advanced testing and forensic capabilities to solve the most technically challenging problems related to structures, construction materials, and manufactured components. After half a century and more than 175,000 assignments, JTC engineers and materials scientists have successfully completed investigative, testing, and repair projects involving virtually every type of construction material, structural system, and architectural component.

WJE is a global firm of engineers, architects, and materials scientists committed to helping solve, repair, and avoid problems in the built world since 1956.

Responsibilities:

Materials Engineering Interns Assist Project Teams with:

  • Performing hands-on forensic investigations, condition assessments, and construction observations, which may include surveying, documenting distress, field testing and instrumentation, collecting data and materials samples, laboratory testing, and preparing site visit reports

  • Analyzing field data and performing research and review of modern and historic materials, construction documents, governing codes, and design guidelines to facilitate analysis, problem-solving, and repair design

  • Developing and implementing specialized laboratory or field-testing programs associated with existing construction, materials performance evaluation, applied research, and new product development

  • Drafting and preparation of conceptual, preliminary, and final client deliverables, including structural and architectural construction documents, specifications, and written reports

Structural Testing and Instrumentation Interns Assist Project Teams with:

  • Applying various testing methods, instrumentation systems, and data collection and management tools for investigations and evaluations within the laboratory and out in the field

  • On-site investigations, condition assessments, and construction observations, which may include surveying, documenting distress, field testing, collecting data and materials samples, and preparing site visit reports

  • Completing structural analysis of concrete, steel, wood, masonry, and other structural systems to support investigations

  • Drafting and preparation of conceptual, preliminary, and final client deliverables, including structural and architectural construction documents, specifications, and written reports

Qualifications:

  • Current student with excellent academic standing in junior or senior year of a bachelor’s or in a graduate program in civil engineering, structural engineering, materials engineering, or a related field

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and adapt to changing demands, while maintaining a high standard of excellence and exceptional attention to detail

  • Effective verbal, graphical, and written communication skills

  • Demonstrated leadership skills, integrity, and work ethic

  • Enthusiasm for solving problems and curiosity about how things work

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This position requires visual acuity and listening ability. Individuals must have the dexterity to be able to operate office and field equipment such as computers, printers, fax/copy machines, telephone/voice mail systems, and other office and field equipment. Requirements may also include:

  • Ability to attend meetings at various office, field, and construction sites

  • Ability to perform inspections of buildings and other structures, both visually and with instruments

  • Ability to lift and carry materials and equipment up to 50 lbs.

  • Ability to perform work in the temperature extremes presented by work in the outdoors

  • Ability to read construction drawings, diagrams, printed materials, and computer screens

  • Ability to record data clearly and write passages for reports, letters, etc.

  • Ability to travel

  • Ability to safely work at heights

  • Ability to safely use and/or operate ladders, scaffolds, lifts, and other access equipment

  • Ability to understand and appreciate safety training specific to numerous workplace and construction hazards

  • Ability to safely work in a variety of occupationally hazardous locations

  • Medically fit to utilize respiratory protection devices and other forms of Personal Protective Equipment

  • Ability to drive and safely operate a motor vehicle

Culture, Compensation, and Benefits:

Wiss, Janney, Elstner Associates, Inc. (WJE) is a global firm of engineers, architects, and materials scientists. Clients worldwide seek our expertise to solve the most significant, interesting, and challenging problems in the built world. Our applied experience from more than 175,000 projects combined with unparalleled laboratory and testing capabilities have made WJE a leader in providing innovative yet practical solutions to the clients we serve.

Working at WJE is a team endeavor characterized by a culture of trust and personal responsibility. We encourage open communication, continuous learning, innovative thinking, ongoing mentoring, and free-flowing collaboration. We seek highly talented and hard-working individuals who want to be challenged, who want hands-on work, who want to set a higher standard, and who want to be mentored by the industry’s most accomplished experts. People with outstanding Character, unwavering Commitment to our core and culture, strong Expertise, and genuine Enthusiasm for their work.

title: Senior Sales Engineer - Northeast
description:
About Doppel

Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection and Human Risk Management, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale.

Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges.

The Role

At Doppel, we’re redefining how organizations protect their identities online — and technical excellence is at the heart of everything we do. We’re looking for a Senior Sales Engineer located in Northern California to serve as the technical linchpin of our sales process: combining deep product expertise with strategic sales acumen to help customers understand, adopt, and succeed with Doppel.

You’ll work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to uncover customer pain points, design tailored solutions, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business value. From discovery and demos to proposals and implementations, you’ll ensure every customer interaction is grounded in trust, clarity, and impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Sales: Collaborate with Account Executives to strategize deals, design solutions, deliver technical presentations, and address customer questions throughout the sales cycle.
  • Lead Technical Discovery: Understand customer environments, workflows, and challenges to recommend Doppel solutions that deliver measurable value.
  • Design and Demonstrate Solutions: Conduct compelling product demos and proofs of concept that connect technical capabilities to business outcomes.
  • Manage RFPs/RFIs: Own the technical components of requests for proposals and information, ensuring accurate, timely, and customer-aligned responses.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to share customer feedback and influence roadmap priorities.
  • Support Implementations: Ensure technical success criteria are clearly defined pre-sale and supported through post-sale handoffs.
  • Track Market Trends: Stay current on industry developments and competitor offerings to strengthen Doppel’s positioning and support sales strategy.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in technical sales, pre-sales, or solutions engineering, ideally in SaaS, cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or digital risk protection.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field - or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proficiency in automation technologies and a strong understanding of modern software architecture.
  • Excellent communication skills - you can translate technical language into business impact for non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical skills for evaluating customer workflows and presenting ROI-driven recommendations.
    Hands-on experience with prototyping, proofs of concept, and post-sale implementation support.
  • Mission-focused, team-oriented, and customer-obsessed mindset.

Must be located in the Northeast, US

Bonus Points For:

  • Certifications such as OSCP, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or similar.
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, SPIN).
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales quotas or successfully delivering integration projects on time and within budget.

Why Join Doppel

  • $200,000-$250,000 OTE + bonus + meaningful equity.
  • Health, dental, vision, 401(k), and generous parental leave.
  • Flexible PTO and a flexible, remote-first culture.
  • Fast-growing company where your impact is immediate and visible.
  • A culture that values technical excellence, transparency, and collaboration.
Salary Range
$140,000—$175,000 USD

title: Senior Manager - Frontend
description:
Who We Are

Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at or follow us on LinkedIn.

Role Summary

Ontic is hiring a Senior Manager, Frontend to lead frontend teams and major frontend engineering function. This leader will be accountable for delivery, technical direction, organizational effectiveness, and the growth of technical leaders.

The role requires deep hands-on knowledge of modern frontend technologies and architectures, coupled with strong people leadership. You will shape scalable frontend systems, establish engineering practices that improve quality and velocity, and ensure teams deliver secure, performant, accessible, and maintainable user experiences.

You will partner closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Engineering leadership to align frontend strategy, technical investments, and delivery plans with business priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Frontend Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Define and evolve the frontend technical strategy, architecture, and engineering standards across teams.

  • Guide architectural decisions involving React, TypeScript, component architecture, state management, frontend platform capabilities, design systems, API integrations, and application structure.

  • Ensure frontend systems are scalable, secure, performant, accessible, maintainable, and consistent across product areas.

  • Lead technical design and architecture reviews for significant frontend initiatives.

  • Identify and drive solutions for systemic technical risks, architectural inconsistencies, technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and developer productivity challenges.

  • Evaluate emerging frontend technologies, frameworks, and tools, and make pragmatic adoption decisions based on business and engineering value.

Engineering Delivery & Execution

  • Lead planning and execution across multiple frontend teams, pods, or strategic initiatives.

  • Establish clear delivery plans, milestones, operating rhythms, and accountability mechanisms.

  • Balance delivery commitments, team capacity, technical investment, and organizational priorities.

  • Proactively identify risks, remove roadblocks, manage dependencies, and communicate trade-offs to stakeholders.

  • Improve predictability, quality, and execution consistency through strong engineering practices, metrics, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner with Product and Design to translate product strategy into feasible, high-quality technical execution plans.

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Build, lead, and develop high-performing frontend engineering teams.

  • Coach emerging technical leaders to strengthen leadership capability across the organization.

  • Own goal setting, performance reviews, career development, feedback, recognition, and performance management across teams.

  • Drive structured hiring, onboarding, team design, capacity planning, and succession planning.

  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented engineering culture.

  • Create opportunities for engineers to build deep frontend expertise, technical ownership, and leadership skills.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication

  • Build strong partnerships with Product, Design, Security, Platform, and business stakeholders.

  • Communicate priorities, technical direction, delivery status, risks, and decisions clearly across teams and leadership levels.

  • Facilitate effective technical and organizational discussions, resolve disagreements constructively, and drive alignment on shared outcomes.

  • Connect frontend technology decisions to customer experience, business value, engineering health, and organizational goals.

  • Promote a culture of transparent communication, constructive feedback, and continuous learning.

Frontend Quality, Reliability & Developer Experience

  • Establish and evolve standards for accessibility, performance, reliability, testing, observability, and frontend security.

  • Drive improvements in Core Web Vitals, browser compatibility, responsiveness, error monitoring, and production reliability.

  • Promote scalable testing strategies across unit, integration, end-to-end, and visual regression testing.

  • Improve frontend developer experience through shared tooling, CI/CD, documentation, reusable frameworks, and automation.

  • Partner with Design and Platform teams to strengthen the design system and shared frontend capabilities.

Qualifications and Experience

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial frontend engineering experience and 3+ years leading engineering teams.

  • Deep expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React, and modern frontend development practices.

  • Strong experience designing and evolving frontend architectures for large-scale, customer-facing SaaS applications.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of component systems, design systems, state management, frontend build tooling, API integration patterns, and browser performance.

  • Experience leading multiple teams, a major engineering function, or a complex product area with significant frontend scope.

  • Proven ability to hire, coach, develop, and retain senior technical talent.

  • Strong experience with cross-team planning, delivery management, resource planning, and stakeholder alignment.

  • Experience establishing engineering standards for accessibility, testing, observability, performance, reliability, and security.

  • Ability to balance hands-on technical judgment with people leadership and business priorities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good to Have

  • Experience building or scaling a design system, shared component library, or frontend platform.

  • Experience with micro-frontends, modular frontend architectures, or large multi-application frontend ecosystems.

  • Experience with frontend performance monitoring, error tracking, analytics, and observability tools.

  • Familiarity with cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging, and progressive delivery practices.

  • Experience leading frontend modernization, migration, or platform adoption initiatives.

  • Familiarity with frontend security practices, including authentication, authorization, secure data handling, and browser security considerations.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and quality.

What Success Looks Like

30 Days

  • Develop a clear understanding of the frontend organization, teams, technical landscape, delivery priorities, and key stakeholders.

  • Build trusted partnerships across Engineering, Product, Design, Platform, and Security.

  • Assess team health, leadership capability, talent needs, delivery risks, and frontend engineering maturity.

  • Deliver an initial meaningful frontend contribution, such as resolving a priority bug, production issue, or high-impact technical blocker.

60 Days

  • Establish clear team operating rhythms, delivery accountability, performance expectations, and stakeholder communication.

  • Align teams on frontend technical priorities, architecture standards, and quality expectations.

  • Begin coaching engineers and emerging technical leaders while addressing high-impact delivery blockers, technical risks, and organizational gaps.

  • Lead delivery of a scoped frontend feature, customer experience improvement, or engineering effectiveness initiative.

90 Days

  • Drive predictable execution across frontend teams and strategic initiatives.

  • Strengthen frontend architecture, engineering standards, shared capabilities, and developer experience.

  • Improve team effectiveness through clear goals, feedback, talent development, and leadership growth, while establishing a roadmap that balances business priorities with long-term frontend health.

  • Deliver an approved technical design and execution plan for a high-impact frontend initiative, with clear ownership, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

Ontic Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive Salary

  • Medical Benefits

  • Internet Reimbursement

  • Home Office Stipend

  • Continued Education Stipend

  • Festive & Achievement Celebrations

  • Dynamic Office Environment

title: PEP BOYS – Automotive Assistant & Service Managers
description:

Competitive Weekly Pay + Weekly Incentive Compensation | Full-Time | Career Growth Opportunities

If you have automotive experience, strong customer service skills, and are ready to take the next step in your career, we want to hear from you. As part of the Mavis family, you'll join the nation's largest automotive service organization, with more than 4,000 locations and opportunities to grow your career.

As an Assistant Manager, you'll support the Store Manager with the day-to-day operations of the location while developing the skills needed to become a future Mavis leader.

Responsibilities include:

  • Supporting efficient, safe, and effective store operations
  • Scheduling and coordinating Mechanics and Technicians
  • Managing outside orders and service workflow
  • Ensuring quality and timely completion of customer vehicles
  • Helping enforce company policies, procedures, and safety standards
  • Supporting the team in delivering an excellent customer experience

About the Service Manager Position

As a Service Manager, you'll combine automotive knowledge, customer service, and sales skills to help customers make informed decisions about their vehicles while keeping the service operation running efficiently.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assisting customers with tire selections and automotive service needs
  • Recommending necessary undercar repairs and maintenance
  • Coordinating the workflow of Mechanics and Technicians
  • Staging and monitoring vehicle repair and maintenance work
  • Communicating repair recommendations and services clearly to customers
  • Supporting sales initiatives while delivering excellent customer service
  • Ensuring repairs and services are completed accurately and on time

Why Join Team Mavis?

At Mavis, we know great leaders drive great teams. We offer:

  • Competitive weekly pay
  • Weekly incentive compensation
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match
  • Paid vacation, PTO, and holidays
  • Life insurance
  • On-the-job training and development
  • A stable, team-oriented work environment
  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement

Qualifications

To be eligible for an Automotive Assistant Manager or Service Manager position, you must:

title: Director Online Platforms & Activation, Lund
description:
Job Title

Director Online Platforms & Activation, Lund

Job Description

Digital is where most of our customers meet Axis first. This role decides what they find, and what happens next. We are looking for a Director Online Platforms & Activation to lead a newly established function within Global Marketing — bringing together our digital channels, global campaign activation, marketing automation and nurturing, and performance analysis under one direction. You will drive our global digital marketing strategy further and build the capability that turns marketing investment into measurable demand. This is a permanent, full-time position based on site at our headquarters in Lund, Sweden.


Who is your future team?
You will lead a team of around ten people covering axis.com, our logged in partner experience, our global social media channels, digital growth and performance, marketing automation and digital communication, and global campaign activation.

The function is newly formed as part of a broader effort to bring the marketing value chain closer together. Capabilities that previously sat across several teams are now gathered in one place — which means you will have genuine influence over how the team is structured, how it works, and where it invests.

You will report to the Director, Global Marketing, and be part of the Global Marketing leadership team.

This is a build role as much as a run role. The foundation exists; the shape is still open.


What you'll do here as Director Online Platforms & Activation
Your job is to make our digital presence work harder — as a channel for demand, a platform for partners and customers, and a source of insight that improves everything else we do.

  • Drive our global digital marketing strategy further. Set the agenda for how Axis grows digitally — which channels, which capabilities, and which investments matter next — and take the wider organization with you.

  • Set the direction for our online platforms. Own the strategy and development of axis.com and My Axis — the logged-in portal where partners and end customers find product and support information, tools, training, and everyday self-service — ensuring they serve both commercial and self-service needs across a global partner and end-customer base.

  • Drive global campaign activation and performance. Lead how global campaigns reach the market digitally, advise other functions and markets on activation choices, and take responsibility for analyzing what worked and what didn't.

  • Shape how we communicate digitally with partners and customers. Digital marketing is more than campaign activation. You will shape our email and newsletter communication, our marketing automation and our nurturing flows — setting the standard for how Axis talks to partners and end customers digitally in the future.

  • Build a measurement and insight capability. Establish the analytics, dashboards, and feedback loops that let marketing make decisions based on evidence rather than assumption.

  • Lead our approach to generative engine optimization (GEO) and AI-driven discovery. As search and discovery shift, you will shape how Axis stays visible and relevant — and act as the business owner in complex, cross-functional change projects involving AI.

  • Set direction for the marketing technology stack in close partnership with our System Governance & IT organization, ensuring the tools support the way we want to work rather than the other way around.

  • Own our global social channels and how they contribute to awareness, engagement, and pipeline.

  • Work as one global digital team. Partner closely with the Demand Generation and Digital teams in our three head regions, so that global strategy and regional execution reinforce each other — aligning priorities, sharing what works, and building one common way of working across the globe.

  • Develop the team. Shape the structure, fill open roles, and build an environment where testing, learning, and adjusting is the normal way of working.

You will work closely with Solution & End Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Brand & Awareness, Marcom, and with the Demand Generation and Digital teams in our three head regions — as well as with IT, HR and Sales, where a close dialogue keeps you current on market dynamics and on what our partners and customers actually need.

Who are we looking for?
You are a digital leader who is comfortable at both ends: the creative ambition of a campaign and the discipline of the numbers behind it. You have led teams through change before, and you know that structure matters less than clarity and trust.

You are curious about technology without needing to be the most technical person in the room. You form your own view but stay genuinely open to being wrong — and you would rather run a small test than win a long argument.

You listen properly, you pay attention to how people are doing, and you build teams where people can disagree well. You are pragmatic, collaborative, and more interested in solving the problem than in owning it.


We'd love to hear that you have/are:

  • 10+ years of experience in digital marketing — including campaign activation, marketing automation, lead nurturing and email/newsletter communication — with a documented track record of driving campaigns against commercial targets and analyzing their performance.

  • Several years of experience leading and developing teams, including through periods of change or organizational build-up.

  • Experience working in a complex B2B environment, with an understanding of indirect and multi-tier business models.

  • Fluent in English.


Bonus points for:

  • Working knowledge of generative engine optimization (GEO), AI-driven search, or comparable emerging discovery models.

  • Experience acting as a business-side owner in technology or platform change projects.

  • Familiarity with global organizations where central functions and regional teams share responsibility.

  • Comfortable with marketing technology stacks and the trade-offs involved in choosing and integrating them.

Physical demands and travel: This role is based at our Lund headquarters. Travel is limited, typically less than 10% of the time, primarily to meet colleagues in our head regions.

What Axis has to offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.

Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal “fika” chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle.

To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:

Life at Axis blog

Engineering at Axis blog

Innovation at Axis

Ready to Act?

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

We go through applications continuously so don’t wait – send in your application today!

In case of questions, please contact Amanda Bjurstam, our recruiter, at Amanda.Bjurstam@axis.com

Type of Employment

Permanent Employment

Posting End Date

2026-09-29

Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments. Notice will be provided before we take any action.

About Axis Communications

We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.

With around 6000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. Together, we thrive in our friendly, open, and collaborative culture and inspire each other to think beyond the expected. United by our commitment to inclusion, diversity, and sustainability, we consistently seek to develop our skills and way of working.

Let´s create a smarter, safer world

title: PA - Philly - PT Clinical Instructor
description:
About Abby Care: Powering the future of care at home for all of America.


Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.

The Opportunity:

As a Clinical Instructor, you will serve as a core nursing professional guiding students to become certified Home Health Aides (HHAs), equipping them with essential skills and tools to deliver best-in-class care. Reporting to the clinical leadership team, you will lead the creation and execution of clinical skill training classes, partner directly with students during facility placements, and collaborate across teams to elevate our instructional curriculum.

A true player-coach, you are equally comfortable leading hands-on clinical instruction and collaborating on curriculum design. Data-driven and deeply empathetic, you have a passion for mentoring adults, a commitment to upholding clinical compliance, and the drive to deliver high-quality health outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

This is a Part-Time Hybrid opportunity based in Philadelphia, PA.

What you’ll work on:

  • Create and implement skill training classes: Design the structural framework for clinical sessions and execute hands-on training for students following their online instruction.

  • Collaborate with HHA students: Accompany, mentor, and support students during the in-person training components within long-term care facilities.

  • Develop additional learning modules: Partner with the broader clinical team to brainstorm, design, and launch supplemental modules that enhance student medical knowledge and clinical skills.

What success looks like:

Over your first 12 months, success in this role means successfully launching structured clinical training sessions that thoroughly prepare cohorts of HHA and CNA students to deliver top-tier, compassionate home care. You will have built strong collaborative relationships with partner long-term care facilities to seamlessly guide students through their in-person clinical components. Furthermore, you will have partnered with the clinical team to expand and enrich our curriculum with new learning modules that measurably boost student skill attainment and medical knowledge.

What you’ll have:

Required Qualifications:

  • Valid and current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Pennsylvania.

  • Valid Driver's License in the state of PA.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to teach or mentor others.

  • Flexibility and availability to work select weekends as needed for clinical sessions.

  • Must reside or be willing to permanently relocate to the Greater Philadelphia Metropolitan Area area.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bilingual proficiency in Spanish and English.

Our Values

  1. Families First
    Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?”

  2. Urgency with Precision
    Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand.

  3. Relentlessly Resourceful
    As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity.

  4. Purpose with Positivity
    We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve.

  5. Driven to Redefine What’s Possible
    We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care.

Automated Decision Tools

Abby Care may use automated decision tools to help match and rank candidate work experience, education and skills found in online profiles, resumes and job applications against job requirements. We believe that these tools help ensure objective, data-based decisions during the hiring process, however, all Abby Care hiring decisions involve final human review and input. If you have questions or would like to request an alternative process, contact talent@abbycare.org.

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.


About the team
Intern Community:

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:

Opportunities:

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.
