title: Director, Schillings Communications
description:
Schillings handles high stakes opportunities and threats for an international clientele: successful individuals, businesses and high-profile organisations across the world.

We support our clients to achieve their goals by developing winning strategies to protect their freedom to operate, and are the first port of call in a crisis, defending our clients from attacks on their reputations, privacy and security. Schillings’ offer is unique to the market, combining strategic communications with law, intelligence & investigations, digital resilience and security.

Schillings is a collaborative and welcoming place to work, with a positive culture, strong values and a developed service ethic. We require commitment, diligence, curiosity, agility and professionalism, and in return provide competitive packages, stimulating challenges and interesting work. We are committed to sharing learning and creating development opportunities so you can progress your career with us. Our people’s career trajectories and average longevity at Schillings underline this.

Join us and become part of our story.

Schillings Communications

Founded in 2023 to help clients navigate the new terrain of scrutiny, Schillings Communications’ work spans agenda-setting campaigns and public policy, to crisis management and long-term senior counsel. We advise global corporates, internationally influential principals and family offices through geopolitical and generational change. We proactively shape narratives and engage stakeholders to build and protect our clients’ interests.

Schillings Communications’ clients have featured on the front and back pages, while Founding Partners Victoria O’Byrne and George Pascoe-Watson were recognised as leaders in the PR Week Power Book 2026 and Spear’s 500 index for reputation management.

Job Title: Director, Strategic Communications

Reporting to: Partners

Job Purpose: Schillings are looking for an experienced Director to join our Strategic Communications business, adding breadth and depth to our multidisciplinary skillset. Schillings Communications provides senior counsel during high-stakes situations, rather than steady-state PR. Under the guidance of the Partners leading the practice, you will work collaboratively with experts across Schillings to proactively devise and execute communications strategies that protect our clients’ reputations and enable clients to deliver their objectives.

The Schillings Communications business, established in 2023, is on a trajectory from start up to critical mass and you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of the practice from day one. You will work alongside our digital resilience, legal, intelligence, investigations, and security practices to offer clients world-class counsel, using your skills in a uniquely collaborative environment to provide holistic solutions to complex client needs.

Role Accountabilities:

The Director will be expected to deliver high-quality client outcomes, build trusted senior relationships, manage profitable and well-run matters, contribute to practice growth, and raise standards across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Senior communications counsel: Acts as senior expert in strategic communications, in dealing with complex client problems, advising on complex, high-stakes client situations and providing clear, practical and commercially aware counsel.
  • Client and stakeholder management: builds trusted senior relationships with clients and Schillings partners, manages demanding stakeholder environments, anticipating needs and ensuring the highest standard of client care and communication.
  • Client engagement management: Owns the effective delivery of client matters, acting as project lead Directors ensure work is well scoped, commercially controlled and delivered by high-performing teams to achieve excellent client outcomes.
  • Commercial ownership: (1) Manages budgets, profitability, resource allocation, time management, risk and billing discipline, exercising sound judgement to identify and address potential issues. (2) Commercially aware of client’s business interests.
  • Practice growth: Supports partners in developing the business by strengthening operations, identifying opportunities for growth (of existing client relationships, mandates or new business development initiatives) and fostering effective collaboration across disciplines.
  • People leadership and standards: Develops the skills and experience of junior colleagues, delegates effectively and role models high standards, accountability and excellence across client work and team delivery.
  • Firm contribution: Acts as an ambassador for Schillings and its values, contributing positively to the firm’s culture, reputation and strategic objectives and guiding others to do the same. Actively participating in complementary external events.
  • Multidisciplinary delivery: works confidently with experts from across the business with a clear understanding of how legal, investigations, security and diplomacy, digital resilience and strategic communications capabilities can be combined to provide holistic solutions that solve complex client problems
  • Technical ability: Excellent in the tradecraft of strategic communications, demonstrating strong strategic and critical thinking skills. Confidently navigates ambiguity, thinking through concepts and analysing risks to problem solve at speed. Develops creative solutions to client issues.

Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Required:

  • 12+ years of relevant experience working agency side, or alternatively in a high profile/dynamic business or public sector organisation. Ideally has a blend of consultancy and in-house experience.
  • Experience of strategic communications and high-profile crisis work for demanding and exacting clients or stakeholders. Strong judgement assessing client situations to offer a strategic and tactical response to clients and partners.
  • Demonstrable ability to build trusted senior client relationships, manage demanding stakeholders, anticipate client needs and provide clear, confident counsel in high-stakes situations.
  • Strong understanding of the media landscape, digital channels and the role of communications in shaping and protecting reputation.
  • An inspiring people manager, project manager and communicator who delegates effectively and is strongly results focused. Able to work effectively across disciplines and contribute to a unified, multidisciplinary client offer.
  • Commercially minded, entrepreneurial and showing a high degree of personal initiative and drive to grow the business and deliver for clients. Evidence of contributing to client growth, whether through expanding existing relationships, developing mandates or supporting new business opportunities.
  • Collaborative with proven ability to set, maintain and role model high standards, building accountability, quality and excellence across client work and team delivery.

Life at Schillings

Given our bold and innovative business strategy, it is not surprising that Schillings has a very strong culture. The atmosphere is highly collaborative and focused on excellence. We have worked hard over the years to develop a coaching culture. Schillings has adopted a set of values to put at the heart of this and they reflect the intention and tenor of our ambitious plans. They are: ‘Innovative; Bold; United; and Excellent’. Our client list speaks for the outstanding results that have been delivered over many years and the task now is to grow without losing any of the commitment to delivering for clients or our service ethos. Finding people who share our values and can thrive in this environment is key to our success.

It takes a unique mix of people to create something truly great. We appreciate that diversity of thought, background and culture creates the best environment to truly innovate, solve problems and achieve our goals. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds – if you are driven and want to achieve your best then we will give you the platform and support to succeed.

Please let us know if there are any extenuating circumstances we should consider, or any adjustments we may need to make to our selection process, when making your application.

Find our candidate privacy notice here, Candidate Privacy Notice (schillingspartners.com)

title: Pharmacy Stock Clerk
description:
We provide meaningful careers that connect people with purpose.

We are united by a common purpose of providing the best and safest care; and by our shared values of Care, Truth, Participation, Compassion and Dignity.

Netcare invites you to be part of our journey.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Stock Clerk is responsible for optimal inventory administration throughout the hospital by being actively involved in the maintenance, movement and the accuracy of stock levels. This individual will apply their understanding of stock and their eye for detail to identify possible discrepancies, balance stock levels against the system and effectively resolve any differences. The Stock Clerk will further be responsible to maintain good working relationships, fulfil work requests and ensure the overall neatness and cleanliness of their respective are of responsibility.

The incumbent will be required to work in various areas of the hospital and to multitask effectively based upon periods of peak activity in the business. This individual will not be allocated to work only in one division of the business but will provide the required assistance to different hospital divisions in line with the Netcare strategy of Person-centred Health and care.
The support provided will depend on hospital requirements and therefore the individual may need to adhere to work requests that may change continuously based on business demand and to adhere to variations in working hours to increase business productivity.

KEY WORK OUTPUT AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

DISRUPTIVE INNOVATION

Stock control administration

  • Reconcile physical stock against the SAP system.
  • Replenish consumable stock throughout the hospital on days identified by management.
  • Generate the material requirement planning (MRP) for all storage locations as per the replenishment roster.
  • Issue, pick and pack replenishment inventory for storage locations or cost centers.
  • Deliver and unpack inventory in assigned storage locations.
  • Capturing of stock and consumable transfers between storage locations or cost centre
  • Monitor and identify any expired and damaged stock in the wards.
  • Identify excess and slow-moving stock in the storage locations allocated to the incumbent and return the inventory to pharmacy where applicable.
  • Review the stock days on the storage location (SLOC) report and adjust stock quantities to material requirement planning (MRP) levels.
  • Review the error log report and ensure that all error logs are cleared.
  • Liaise with Nursing staff in the wards to ensure that all billings are up to date before updating replenishment stock requested.
  • Identify stock shortages and communicate with the Unit Managers regarding these shortages.
  • Manage out of stock and back-order items.
  • Ensure that all relevant stakeholders receive all out of stock letters.
  • Ensure manual charge sheets are available during Mobil and Mobit down time.
  • Ensure neat packing of stock onto shelves and consider the principles of FEFO (First Expiry First Out) and FIFO (First in First Out) where applicable to maintain stock rotation
  • Prepare and sequence all stock books for assigned units.
  • Investigate and report inventory discrepancies, theft and losses to the Unit Manager and Pharmacy Manager.
  • Assist with the packing of stock in preparation for theatre cases.
  • Follow up on outstanding GRV’s
  • Investigate open purchase orders as well as back orders
  • Ordering hospital stores stock on the preferred procurement system as required
  • Verifying prices on the procurement system
  • Receiving and checking stock with the designated person upon delivery
  • Unpacking of stock in hospital stores
  • Ensuring that the invoices or delivery notes are confirmed, signed and delivered to relevant department for Good Receipting
  • Keep hospital stores secure at all times by ensuring the non-entrance of unauthorized personnel
  • Keep up to date with evolving changes on SAP and OrderCo

Stock take

  • Take part in all aspects of cyclical and rotation count processes in all storage locations including Hospital stores as per the schedule prepared by management, including but not limited to the following;
    • Generating and updating of stock books
    • Work on Un-binned items report
    • Preparing stock take checks following the relevant stock take checklists

Risk and compliance administration

  • Adhere to pharmacy standard operating procedures to ensure compliant, improved controls, and sound processes.
  • Ensure full compliance to statutory regulations, policies, procedures, best practice, professional standards as well as the Netcare strategy.
  • Assist in the communication of inventory policies internally.

Administration

  • Assist with any ad hoc duties assigned by the Stock Coordinator or Stock Controller and assist Nursing employees and Unit Managers with stock queries.
  • General office administration to ensure job efficiency including but not limited to filing, printing, faxing and other general administration queries.
  • Handle all routine administration queries and work requests that may not be included in this role profile and resolves these efficiently and effectively within the required turnaround times.
  • Maintain the cold chain for refrigerated stock.
  • Assist with the general housekeeping in the Pharmacy and/or Hospital stores to maintain a professional environment.
  • Participate in monthly meetings

TRANSFORMATION OF OUR SOCIETY

Personal and professional development

  • Active involvement in own professional development to maintain a satisfactory level of skill and knowledge.

Build and maintain stakeholder relationships

  • Work effectively and co-operatively with others to establish and maintain good working relationships that are mutually beneficial.
  • Actively participate as a member of a team to achieve goals and does not function independently.
  • Establish and service relationships with all internal and external stakeholders, including management and colleagues to improve service delivery.
  • Demonstrate personal commitment to internal and external stakeholders by fulfilling responsibilities, involving others, gaining support for ideas generated and removing obstacles to team accomplishments.
  • Establish and consolidate good interpersonal relationships by listening to others and objectively considering their ideas and opinions even when they conflict with their own ideas.

SKILLS PROFILE

EDUCATION

Essential

  • Grade 12 or equivalent NQF 4 certificate
  • Basic stores and stock control certificate (BSSC).

WORK EXPERIENCE

Preferred

  • Previous experience in stock management.
  • 6 months to one year experience working in similar role
  • Knowledge and experience of a pharmaceutical stock control system.

KNOWLEDGE

Preferred

  • An intermediate level of Computer Literacy and proficiency in MS Office applications.
  • Superior interpersonal skills (developing and maintaining positive relationships; communicating clearly and effectively with people at all levels with verbal and nonverbal communication; working with others to identify, define and solve problems).
  • Demonstrates excellent organisational skills: organised and structured with an exceptional attention to detail.
  • Multi-tasking ability and the ability to handle stressful situations and difficult stakeholders (internal and external) appropriately.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • In the event of any physical or psychological limitation that may impair the employee’s ability to perform the required job function, the employee must consult the employer for reasonable accommodation.

SKILLS

Continuous Improvement

Personal Work Ethic

  • Operate multiple tablet presses simultaneously as production demands require.
  • Verify materials against batch records and Bills of Materials (BOM).

  • Maintain continual machine operation to maximize production output.
  • Monitor tablet quality and ensure compliance with established in-process specifications for weight, thickness, hardness, appearance, and friability.
  • Serves as the primary floor leader in Compression/Blending in the absence of a supervisor.
  • Maintains a strong commitment to safety, quality, productivity, and compliance.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, accountability, and ownership of department performance.

Troubleshoot and correct issues related to:

  • Weight variation, Hardness, Thickness, Capping, Picking and sticking, mechanical malfunctions
  • Perform advanced diagnostics on compression equipment.
  • Work closely with Maintenance to resolve equipment issues and improve machine reliability.
  • Conduct routine preventive maintenance and basic equipment repairs.
  • Inspect, install, maintain, and safely handle compression tooling.
  • Maintain equipment, maintenance logs and records.

  • Demonstrated experience operating and troubleshooting multiple compression platforms.
  • Previous experience leading, training, or mentoring operators preferred.

  • Perform repetitive motions (grasping, pushing, pulling)
  • Ability to bend, stop, and reach regularly
  • Comfortable working around machinery, noise, and chemical products (with PPE)
  • Ability to communicate effectively (verbal and written)

Work Environment:

  • May work in indoor manufacturing environments that can be warm or hot due to equipment, machinery, or production processes.
  • May work with tablets or powdered materials, where airborne particulates may be present within applicable OSHA‑permitted exposure limits using established safety controls.

title: Director, Financial Crime Office (Deputy CAMLO), Regulatory Relations, Complaints Management and Compliance Testing
description:
About KOHO

We’re on a mission to make financial services better for every Canadian. That means no hidden fees, no predatory interest rates - just financial products designed to help our users spend smart, save more, and build real wealth. We’re a performance organization with a strong heart: we care deeply about outcomes, and everything ties back to our mission - to financially empower a generation of Canadians.

At KOHO, we’re not your average 9-5. We believe real impact comes from people who are trusted, empowered, and supported to do their best work - without sacrificing their lives to do it. We prioritize work-life integration, not just work-life balance. That means asynchronous collaboration, flexible hours, and a remote-first setup built around autonomy and high trust.

KOHO is entering its next chapter - leaner, smarter, more AI-integrated. We’re building for impact, not bureaucracy. If you thrive in environments that value clarity, ownership, and bold thinking, you’ll fit right in.

About The Role

We’re looking for an accomplished Director to lead four connected pillars of KOHO’s Compliance function: the Financial Crime Office, Regulatory Relations, Complaints Management, and second-line Compliance Testing. Reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer, you will own how KOHO detects and disrupts financial crime, how we show up in front of our regulators, how we resolve customer complaints fairly, and how we independently test that our compliance controls actually work.

It is a broad mandate, and deliberately so — these are the areas where evidence matters most. You will bring the discipline, documentation quality, and executive presence to make KOHO’s control environment demonstrably effective, while keeping the customer experience in view.

What You’ll Be Doing

Financial Crime Office (Deputy Chief AML Officer)

  • Lead KOHO’s AML/ATF and sanctions compliance program in accordance with the PCMLTFA and its regulations, and own the enterprise money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions risk assessment.

  • Oversee transaction monitoring, alert and case management, enhanced due diligence, sanctions screening, and suspicious transaction reporting, including the quality and timeliness of regulatory reporting to FINTRAC.

  • Direct KYC and customer risk rating standards, and partner with the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) to close typology gaps between fraud and financial crime detection.

  • Own the two-year AML effectiveness review, resulting remediation, and financial crime training.

Regulatory Relations

  • Serve as the central point of coordination for regulators, owning the cadence, quality, and consistency of KOHO’s regulatory correspondence and submissions.

  • Lead the end-to-end management of regulatory examinations, reviews, and information requests, including planning, evidence collection, response quality control, and issue tracking.

  • Own the regulatory findings and commitments register, driving remediation to validated closure.

  • Maintain the inventory of regulatory filings and the record of regulatory engagement, and prepare executives and subject matter experts for regulatory meetings.

Complaints Management

  • Own KOHO’s enterprise complaints management program, including policy, procedures, escalation pathways, and service standards.

  • Oversee handling of escalated and designated complaints, ensuring fair, timely, well-reasoned outcomes and clear written responses to customers.

  • Manage case flow with the external complaints body and oversee reporting to the FCAC and other applicable authorities.

  • Deliver complaints reporting and root cause analysis, converting complaint themes into product, process, and disclosure improvements that advance fair treatment of customers.

Compliance Testing

  • Own the design and delivery of KOHO’s independent Compliance Testing Program, including methodology, quality standards, and reporting.

  • Develop the annual risk-based testing plan, scoped and prioritized from the regulatory obligations inventory and known risk concentrations; Collaborate with Operational Risk Management (ORM) on the selection of compliance controls.

  • Maintain a quality assurance process over testing outputs, including work performed by co-source or business process outsourcing partners, and report results and thematic conclusions into senior management and/or Board-level reporting.

Team Leadership and Industry Engagement

  • Lead, coach, and develop a multi-disciplinary team across financial crime, testing, and complaints, building bench strength and clear career paths.

  • Partner with Compliance Advisory and Privacy, Operational Risk, Internal Audit, Legal, and FIU to ensure integrated risk oversight.

  • Represent KOHO externally in industry associations, peer forums, and financial crime intelligence networks, staying ahead of emerging typologies, fraud trends, and regulatory developments.

  • Prepare and present decision-ready reporting to senior management and applicable Board-level committees.

AI, Automation and Innovation

  • Apply AI, machine learning, RPA, and advanced analytics to transaction monitoring tuning, alert triage, complaints classification, and compliance testing.

  • Lead the development of automated testing scripts, intelligent workflows, and advanced reporting to increase coverage.

  • Evaluate and implement emerging RegTech and financial crime technology, and maintain model governance and tuning documentation for detection systems.

Who You Are

  • You have 10+ years of experience across AML and financial crime, compliance testing or audit, regulatory relations, or complaints within financial services.

  • You have deep working knowledge of Canadian consumer protection, AML, retail banking or payments, and privacy legislation.

  • You have direct experience managing regulatory examinations or information requests, and you’re composed under that kind of scrutiny.

  • You bring rigour to evidence and documentation — you believe a control that cannot be demonstrated has not been performed — and you deliver unwelcome findings constructively.

  • You’ve worked in regulated fintech, neobank, or direct-to-consumer financial institutions, you’re passionate about empowering financial wellness, and a relevant designation (CAMS, CFE, CIA, CPA, CRCM, or equivalent) is an asset.

The budgeted salary range for this role is $190,000-230,000 CAD / year.

At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members.

Description de poste en français

À propos du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une directrice ou d’un directeur chevronné pour diriger quatre piliers interconnectés de la fonction Conformité de KOHO : le Bureau de la criminalité financière, les relations avec les organismes de réglementation, la gestion des plaintes et les tests de conformité de deuxième ligne. Relevant de la cheffe ou du chef de la conformité, vous serez responsable de la façon dont KOHO détecte et perturbe les activités criminelles financières, interagit avec les organismes de réglementation, traite équitablement les plaintes des clients et vérifie de façon indépendante l’efficacité réelle de ses contrôles de conformité.

Il s’agit volontairement d’un mandat vaste : ce sont les domaines où les faits et les preuves sont les plus importants. Vous apporterez la rigueur, la qualité documentaire et la présence exécutive nécessaires pour démontrer l’efficacité de l’environnement de contrôle de KOHO, tout en gardant l’expérience client au cœur de vos décisions.

Ce que vous ferez

Bureau de la criminalité financière

  • Diriger le programme de KOHO en matière de lutte contre le blanchiment d’argent et le financement des activités terroristes (LBA/FT), ainsi que de conformité aux sanctions, conformément à la Loi sur le recyclage des produits de la criminalité et le financement des activités terroristes (LRPCFAT) et à ses règlements. Être responsable de l’évaluation à l’échelle de l’entreprise des risques liés au blanchiment d’argent, au financement des activités terroristes et aux sanctions.

  • Superviser la surveillance des transactions, la gestion des alertes et des dossiers, les mesures de vigilance renforcées, le filtrage des sanctions et la déclaration des opérations douteuses, notamment la qualité et la ponctualité des déclarations réglementaires auprès du Centre d’analyse des opérations et déclarations financières du Canada (CANAFE).

  • Diriger les normes relatives à la connaissance du client (KYC) et à l’évaluation du niveau de risque des clients, et collaborer avec l’Unité du renseignement financier (URF) afin de combler les écarts entre la détection de la fraude et celle des activités criminelles financières.

  • Être responsable de l’examen biennal de l’efficacité du programme de LBA/FT, du suivi des mesures correctives qui en découlent et de la formation en matière de criminalité financière.

Relations avec les organismes de réglementation

  • Agir comme point de coordination central auprès des organismes de réglementation et être responsable de la fréquence, de la qualité et de la cohérence de la correspondance et des déclarations réglementaires de KOHO.

  • Diriger la gestion de bout en bout des examens réglementaires, des évaluations et des demandes de renseignements, notamment la planification, la collecte des éléments probants, le contrôle de la qualité des réponses et le suivi des enjeux.

  • Être responsable du registre des constats réglementaires et des engagements, et piloter les mesures correctives jusqu’à leur résolution confirmée.

  • Tenir à jour l’inventaire des déclarations réglementaires et le registre des interactions avec les organismes de réglementation, et préparer la direction ainsi que les spécialistes concernés aux rencontres réglementaires.

Gestion des plaintes

  • Être responsable du programme de gestion des plaintes à l’échelle de KOHO, notamment des politiques, des procédures, des mécanismes d’escalade et des normes de service.

  • Superviser le traitement des plaintes transmises à un niveau supérieur et des plaintes désignées, en veillant à ce que les décisions soient équitables, rendues en temps opportun et bien motivées, et que les réponses écrites aux clients soient claires.

  • Gérer le cheminement des dossiers auprès de l’organisme externe de traitement des plaintes et superviser les déclarations à l’Agence de la consommation en matière financière du Canada (ACFC) ainsi qu’aux autres autorités compétentes.

  • Produire les rapports sur les plaintes et les analyses des causes profondes, et transformer les tendances observées en améliorations aux produits, aux processus et aux communications, afin de favoriser un traitement équitable des clients.

Tests de conformité

  • Être responsable de la conception et de la réalisation du programme indépendant de tests de conformité de KOHO, notamment de la méthodologie, des normes de qualité et de la production de rapports.

  • Élaborer le plan annuel de tests fondé sur les risques, en établissant sa portée et ses priorités à partir de l’inventaire des obligations réglementaires et des concentrations de risques connues. Collaborer avec la gestion des risques opérationnels (GRO) à la sélection des contrôles de conformité.

  • Maintenir un processus d’assurance qualité pour les résultats des tests, y compris les travaux réalisés par des partenaires de co-impartition ou d’impartition de processus opérationnels, et présenter les résultats ainsi que les conclusions thématiques à la haute direction ou dans les rapports destinés au conseil d’administration.

Leadership d’équipe et rayonnement dans le secteur

  • Diriger, accompagner et faire progresser une équipe multidisciplinaire en criminalité financière, en tests de conformité et en gestion des plaintes, en développant la relève et des parcours professionnels clairs.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes Services-conseils en conformité et Protection des renseignements personnels, Risques opérationnels, Audit interne, Affaires juridiques et URF afin d’assurer une surveillance intégrée des risques.

  • Représenter KOHO auprès d’associations sectorielles, de groupes de pairs et de réseaux de renseignement sur la criminalité financière, et demeurer au fait des nouvelles typologies, des tendances en matière de fraude et de l’évolution de la réglementation.

  • Préparer et présenter des rapports axés sur la prise de décision à la haute direction et aux comités pertinents du conseil d’administration.

Intelligence artificielle, automatisation et innovation

  • Utiliser l’intelligence artificielle, l’apprentissage automatique, l’automatisation robotisée des processus (ARP) et l’analytique avancée pour optimiser le paramétrage de la surveillance des transactions, le triage des alertes, la classification des plaintes et les tests de conformité.

  • Diriger l’élaboration de scripts automatisés de tests, de flux de travail intelligents et de rapports avancés afin d’accroître la couverture des contrôles.

  • Évaluer et mettre en œuvre des solutions émergentes de technologie réglementaire et de technologie de lutte contre la criminalité financière, et maintenir la documentation relative à la gouvernance des modèles et au paramétrage des systèmes de détection.

Profil recherché

  • Vous possédez au moins 10 ans d’expérience dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants au sein des services financiers : lutte contre le blanchiment d’argent et la criminalité financière, tests de conformité ou audit, relations avec les organismes de réglementation ou gestion des plaintes.

  • Vous avez une connaissance approfondie de la protection des consommateurs au Canada, de la lutte contre le blanchiment d’argent, des services bancaires de détail ou des paiements, ainsi que des lois relatives à la protection des renseignements personnels.

  • Vous avez de l’expérience directe dans la gestion d’examens réglementaires ou de demandes de renseignements, et vous demeurez calme et posé sous ce type de pression.

  • Vous faites preuve de rigueur dans la gestion des éléments probants et de la documentation — pour vous, un contrôle qui ne peut pas être démontré n’a pas été exécuté — et vous savez communiquer les constats défavorables de façon constructive.

  • Vous avez travaillé dans une entreprise de technologie financière réglementée, une néobanque ou une institution financière s’adressant directement aux consommateurs. Vous avez à cœur de favoriser la santé financière et une certification pertinente — CAMS, CFE, CIA, CPA, CRCM ou équivalent — constitue un atout.

KOHO is for builders.

If you’re energized by challenge, motivated by mission, and want to be part of a team that punches above its weight - we want to hear from you.

The KOHO culture is one of collaboration, creativity, and diverse perspectives. We are committed to building and fostering an inclusive, accessible environment for everyone. If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding accessibility needs, please contact peopleaccessibility@koho.ca and the People and Culture team will be happy to help.

title: Product Program Manager
description:
Fortreum is a trusted leader in cloud and cybersecurity services, ranked among the Top 5 FedRAMP Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO). With the addition of Kovr.AI, we have expanded our capabilities to include advanced cyber risk quantification and analytics, enabling organizations to better understand, measure, and communicate risk. Together, we deliver independent, third-party, vendor-agnostic regulatory assessment and advisory services, alongside advanced cybersecurity offensive and compliance technical solutions. Our comprehensive service portfolio spans regulatory compliance frameworks including FedRAMP, CMMC, FISMA, SOC, PCI, ISO, and HIPAA.

Working with Fortune 500 companies and leading cloud service providers, we’ve built our reputation on service-delivery excellence and an unwavering commitment to client success. Our continued rapid growth creates exceptional opportunities for driven professionals to make their mark in the cybersecurity industry—guided by our core values: quality above all, a customer-driven mindset, autonomy, and personal accountability.

The Opportunity

On our team, you will play a pivotal role in driving delivery and execution across Fortreum’s Kovr AI Platform—our AI-native compliance automation solution. As a Program Manager, you will bridge engineering, product, delivery, and business teams, owning end-to-end project plans that keep complex technical initiatives on track. You will translate product roadmaps into executable delivery schedules, manage risk and dependencies across cross-functional workstreams, and ensure our AI solutions are delivered on time and to the standard our federal and enterprise customers expect. This is a hands-on, PM opportunity to build the product management function from the ground up inside a fast-moving startup-within-a-company environment.

Key Responsibilities

Specifically, you would be responsible for:

  • Own end-to-end execution of technical project plans, translating product roadmaps into scheduled, resourced delivery milestones

  • Coordinate cross-functionally across Engineering, Sales, Delivery and the Program Management Office (PMO) to keep initiatives moving and unblock dependencies

  • Establish and run core project management processes (status reporting, sprint/iteration planning, risk registers) appropriate for a fast-scaling AI startup

  • Translate complex technical concepts—system architecture, APIs, AI/ML capabilities—for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Track and report on project health, timelines, and delivery commitments across concurrent workstreams

  • Coordinate customer success and onboarding activities tied to product releases and deployments

  • Identify and mitigate delivery risks across cloud, AI/ML, and compliance-related workstreams

  • Drive continuous improvement of project management tooling, processes, and team rituals in coordination with the PMO

  • Support planning and execution to ensure products meet both technical excellence standards and market needs

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field

  • Strong technical background in AI/ML with the ability to engage deeply with engineering teams on architecture, APIs, and system design

  • A strong advocate for customer needs, with demonstrated experience in the creation of Product Feature Requests

  • Demonstrated experience managing technical projects or programs from planning through delivery

  • Demonstrated experience working with an account team to identify risks and escalation paths, and in identifying areas for growth and expansion

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences

  • Experience with SaaS products and developer-focused tools

  • Experience with agile development methodologies and project/product analytics tools such as Jira and Linear

  • Active Top Secret clearance

  • Local and able to go onsite in DC metro area to include MD/VA

Preferred Skills

  • Previous experience managing the deployment of a software product within air-gapped environments

  • Understanding of AI model deployment, scalability, and infrastructure challenges

  • Previous experience as a first or early technical program/project management hire at a startup

  • Familiarity with federal compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53/171, FedRAMP, CMMC) and related artifacts (SSPs, POA&Ms)

Posted Salary Range

$155,000 - $180,000 annual salary


What Fortreum Offers

We offer a competitive compensation package, where you will be rewarded based on your performance/outcomes and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our benefits package includes medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401K plan with a 4% match, company paid short-term disability, company paid long-term disability, company paid AD&D and life insurance, flex time off, annual bonuses, training stipends, certification reimbursements, access to over 30,000 free online training courses, personal cell phone allowance, new hire and annual home office stipend, spot awards and eleven paid holidays.

An Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Senior Product Designer at Zip, you’ll work on real, customer-facing features across a wide product surface area for procurement, which at its essence is managing the process of helping companies buy what they need. You’ll be collaborating with experienced designers, PMs, and engineers who care deeply about craft, collaboration, and building consumer-grade experiences for complex enterprise workflows. You’ll have direct access to our users for UX Research and testing, and the features you design will be immediately used by our users. You’ll work with a tight-knit team that values open communication and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for designers who are eager to learn, take ownership early, and grow quickly by working on high-impact problems used by some of the world’s leading companies.

Please note, we are looking for someone who will be able to come into our NYC office on a hybrid basis (3 days / week).

You will

  • Contribute to the design of product features from concept to launch

  • Partner closely with engineers, and with PM and go-to-market stakeholders to brainstorm, define, and implement new features and offerings.

  • Collaborate closely with our product and customer-facing teams to participate in UX Research and design thoughtful solutions

  • Iterate quickly on designs based on user feedback

  • Participate in regular design reviews with the broader design team.

Qualifications

  • 3-5+ years professional design experience working at a startup or similarly resource-restricted organization shipping great designs at a fast pace

  • Experience shipping at least one full product or significant feature end to end as the lead designer.

  • Experience iterating with engineers and other team members on both visual and UX designs to get the experience and details just right

  • Great presentation, collaboration and communication skills

  • Empathetic champion for your work’s audience and customers

  • Strong visual design skills without sacrificing usability

  • Understanding of the technical constraints of building web applications.

  • You build with AI tools in your own workflow, prototyping with Claude, Figma Make, Cursor, or whatever gets your ideas into something clickable fastest.

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 100% health, vision & dental coverage options

  • 🍽️ Catered breakfast, lunch, & dinner

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership

  • 🚍 Monthly commuter benefit

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Home office stipend

  • 🛜 Phone/internet reimbursement

  • 🏠 Hybrid model + 5 flexible remote days per quarter

  • 🍼 Paid parental leave

  • 🐣 Fertility benefits

  • 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 🤖 Unlimited AI token usage

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Barcelona Varmkundsförsäljning
description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till varmkundsförsäljning till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 150 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
  • Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
  • Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
  • Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

  • Ersättning av flygbiljett.
  • Stöd vid letande utav boende.
  • Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
  • Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
  • Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

title: Senior Post Producer
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around 4 days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Senior Post Producer do at WPP Production?

You’ll play a central role in delivering high-quality post-production projects across edit, grade, VFX, motion, and sound. As a Senior Post Producer you will bridge hands-on production and leadership, managing key projects, supporting producers, and maintaining strong relationships with clients, agencies, and creative partners. You’ll ensure projects run smoothly, budgets are met, and the creative standard remains high across everything that leaves the studio. You’ll be someone who thrives on collaboration, solves problems calmly under pressure, and takes pride in delivering work that looks, sounds, and feels exceptional. The ideal candidate will have experience working with a global technology brand or demonstrate a strong drive and ambition to contribute to a high-calibre account.

Responsibilities

Production

  • Lead multiple post-production projects from brief to final delivery, managing timelines, budgets and workflows.
  • Oversee offline, online, grade, VFX, motion graphics and audio, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.
  • Own production workflows, tracking progress, risks and budgets and keeping the Executive Producer informed.

title: Senior IT-informationssäkerhetsspecialist
description:
Vi söker nu 1–2 erfarna IT-informationssäkerhetsspecialister till ett kvalificerat uppdrag inom samhällsviktig offentlig verksamhet. Rollen passar dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av informationssäkerhet och cybersäkerhet och som är van att genomföra analyser, identifiera krav och granska lösningar i komplexa miljöer.

Uppdraget har särskilt fokus på hur en statlig säker behandlingsmiljö kan utvecklas och organiseras i linje med kraven inom det europeiska hälsodataområdet, EHDS.

Om uppdraget

Som IT-informationssäkerhetsspecialist kommer du att analysera hur en säker statlig behandlingsmiljö kan utformas och tillhandahållas. Du bidrar med specialistkompetens inom cybersäkerhet, informationssäkerhet och dataskydd och arbetar både i projekt och som stöd till linjeorganisationens säkerhetsarbete.

Rollen innebär att förstå verksamhetens faktiska behov, identifiera säkerhetskrav, analysera risker och föreslå ändamålsenliga lösningar. Du behöver kunna arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du samarbetar nära med team, beställare och andra intressenter.

Arbetsuppgifter

  • Genomföra analyser inom informationssäkerhet och cybersäkerhet
  • Identifiera och dokumentera säkerhetskrav
  • Granska lösningar ur ett informations- och cybersäkerhetsperspektiv
  • Bidra med specialistkompetens inom cybersäkerhet och dataskydd
  • Analysera hur en statlig säker behandlingsmiljö kan utvecklas och organiseras
  • Bidra till framtagning av lösningsförslag och rekommendationer
  • Stödja projekt och uppdrag i säkerhetsrelaterade frågor
  • Ge stöd till linjeorganisationens löpande säkerhetsarbete
  • Samverka med verksamhet, tekniska specialister och andra intressenter
  • Kommunicera komplexa säkerhetsfrågor på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt

Obligatoriska krav

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Examen från universitet, högskola eller yrkeshögskola, alternativt minst 6 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom rollen om relevant utbildning saknas
  • Minst 4 års yrkeserfarenhet av informationssäkerhet inom organisationer med samhällsviktig verksamhet
  • Minst 2 års sådan erfarenhet förvärvad under de senaste 5 åren
  • Förmåga att kommunicera tydligt, korrekt och professionellt på svenska i tal och skrift
  • Kompetens motsvarande minst nivå 3, med hög generalistkompetens eller mycket hög specialistkompetens inom området
  • Erfarenhet av större uppdrag och förmåga att arbeta med mycket stor självständighet

Meriterande

Det är särskilt meriterande om du har:

  • Minst 1 års erfarenhet av cybersäkerhetsarbete inom myndighet och/eller vård- och omsorgssektorn
  • Certifiering inom exempelvis CISA, CISM, CISSP eller motsvarande
  • Erfarenhet av säkerhetsramverk och cyberskyddsmetoder såsom NIST CSF, CIS Controls/CIS18 eller COBIT
  • Erfarenhet av samordnad och säker statlig IT-drift

Personliga egenskaper

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är ansvarstagande, analytisk och självgående. Du trivs med att samarbeta med olika typer av människor och kan arbeta effektivt i flera olika konstellationer.

Du har en pedagogisk och kommunikativ förmåga och kan förklara komplexa säkerhetsfrågor på ett enkelt och kärnfullt sätt. Samtidigt kan du lyfta blicken och sätta enskilda frågor i ett större verksamhets- och säkerhetsperspektiv.

Uppdragsinformation

  • Antal konsulter: 1–2
  • Omfattning: 100 %
  • Plats: Kalmar
  • Arbetsform: Hybrid
  • Distansarbete: möjlighet till distansarbete efter överenskommelse, i nuläget upp till 3 dagar per vecka
  • Resor mellan verksamhetens kontor kan förekomma

Sista ansökningsdag: 16 september 2026

Om Soros Consulting

Soros Consulting arbetar med kvalificerad konsultförmedling inom IT, teknik och verksamhetsutveckling. Vi matchar erfarna specialister med uppdrag där deras kompetens skapar tydliga resultat. Vårt fokus är kvalitet, långsiktighet och att skapa goda förutsättningar både för konsulter och uppdragsgivare genom tydlighet, professionalism och hållbara relationer.

Tveka inte på att skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

The Royal Society of Chemistry (RSC) hasa great opportunityfor a Software Development Team Lead to join us on a permanent full-time basis.

As a Software Development Team Leader for the Royal Society of Chemistry, you will shape the software architecture and the fine-grained detail of configuration and implementation throughout the software development lifecycle for performance,securityand maintainability of the applications we build.

You will play a key role within our DevOps function, acting as a hands-on technical leader while managing a team of cross-functional engineers. You will guide agile teams through implementation,prioritiseand assign backlog work, and ensure high-quality, reliable delivery of solutions, including responsibility for technical changes and releases.

In addition to your technical leadership, you will line manage and mentor a small group of developers, fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture and supporting their professional growth.

At the RSC we embrace flexibility and offer hybrid working, which means our teams come together when they need to collaborate. Although this role is contractually based at our Cambridge office, you will also be able to work from home within the UK, with the expectation that you will attend our offices and travel as needed for your role. At Amazon, we strive to be Earth’s most customer-centric company where people can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Every day we solve complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity.
IT Service Desk (SD) is the centralized IT support organization within OTS Global IT Delivery located across America, Europe/Prague, India. The team utilizes an omni-channel contact center to provide efficient, streamline IT support to Worldwide (WW) Operations (Ops) associates and internal/external support for Amazon Lockers. Overall, SD plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon sites globally and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.


Key job responsibilities
Effective Communication Skills: Demonstrating proficiency in clear and concise communication. This role needs interaction with Amazon Internal customers it includes APAC/EMEA/AMER Operation /IT team/Customer support.
2. Adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs) is fundamental to maintaining consistency and efficiency in daily operations.
3. Basic Knowledge on IT Troubleshooting on end user devices: Competence in resolving issues on various client devices, including desktops, laptops, printers, and scanners.
4. Basic Understanding and troubleshooting skills on Various Operating system specifically on Windows and Linux
5. We have a 5-day work week but given the 7 days a week operation, the 2 scheduled days off will vary based on shift patterns and business needs including night shifts.
6. Adherence to OTS Service Desk Goals: Meeting targets for Response and Resolution SLA, CSAT, and effectively managing incidents.
7. This role will be working from Bangalore (BLR18) Corporate office.

title: Club Photographer
description:
Fulham Football Club is looking for a Club Photographer to support all club departments with photography and content.

This role will offer full-time support to the content and marketing teams as well as the broader organisation, delivering high-quality photography across men’s and women’s first teams, Academy, marketing and fan engagement events, as well as commercial activities. The successful will be responsible for expressing the Club’s brand and narrative through visual documentation.

The Club Photographer will be responsible for the preparation of shoots – including logistics concerning staging, subjects and location scouting – as well as editing and retouching of imagery, and management of assets. Where necessary, the role will also lead on liaision with outsourced agencies for additional photographic support.

Responsibilities

The Club Photographer must:
  • Have an excellent can-do attitude
  • Be a good communicator
  • Have excellent creative skills
  • Be willing to work as part of a team
  • Be able to prioritise work and meet deadlines
  • Have strong organisational and planning skills
  • Have excellent time keeping
  • Take initiative when working alone
  • Be proactive
  • Experience working with all Microsoft applications, Adobe Creative Cloud and photo editing programmes
  • Ability to deal with high profile individuals
  • Able to work flexibly in line with football season demands
  • Knowledge of the football industry would be advantageous

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:
  • Cover select Men’s, Women’s, and academy training sessions and matches
  • Working predominantly with the Communications and Marketing departments on photo requirements.
  • Possess essential photographic equipment
  • Ensuring photos meet the Club’s brief in terms of images captured, tone and brand style.
  • Working matchdays across all teams
  • Liaising with other departments across the Club regularly on their requirements
  • Proactively contributing to editorial and content planning meetings
  • Preparing for shoots and developing comprehensive briefs
  • Edit and grade imagery as appropriate, at times needs to work under tight turnarounds
  • Management of photography – in-house or external – to ensure imagery is catalogued and readily accessible for departments and players

This role requires a commitment to working flexibility in line with the football calendar – i.e. matches on Saturday, Sunday, midweek evenings & various club events throughout the season. This role will also require a level of independent working at times.

Benefits

We expect to close applications on 22 September, but if we receive a high level of interest, we may close the vacancy sooner. To avoid disappointment, please submit your application at the earliest opportunity.

title: IT Support Technician
description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.

About the role

As a valued member of our IT Helpdesk team consisting currently of 5 colleagues, you will play a central role in ensuring smooth and effective IT Support at ESS. Your primary responsibilities will include resolving incidents and service requests, either registered in our ticket system or reported directly by users visiting the IT Helpdesk. Collaborating closely with your colleagues you will tackle a variety of tasks such as installations, installations and maintenance of laptops and workstations, support of equipment, systems and applications.

To thrive as an IT Support technician at ESS, you bring a natural flair for service and enjoy delivering quality and long-term solutions. You are equally comfortable working independently or as part of a team, and you appreciate and understand the importance of structured processes and thorough documentation. You value the opportunity to learn new things and enjoy working in a fast-paced organisation. Your responsiveness to user inquiries and enthusiasm for interacting with people will be key to your success in this role.

This is a full-time permanent position with a 6 months' probationary period based at the ESS Campus in Lund, Sweden.

Day-to-day, you will:

  • Support users directly at the physical IT service desk, remotely or by phone
  • Manage and resolve service requests and incidents registered in case management system
  • Deploy and configure laptops and mobile devices and manage replacements
  • Install and configure workstations used across the ESS site
  • Diagnose and resolve computer hardware and software problems
  • Troubleshoot operating-system and driver issues
  • Troubleshoot user account, password, permissions and accesses
  • Troubleshoot basic network-related problems
  • Troubleshoot basic issues with meeting rooms equipment and connections
  • Troubleshoot printers and connection issues
  • Handle IT assets, equipment inventories and lifecycle management
  • Collaborate with your team and other functions to solve issues

About you:

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience in IT Support and IT service desk, or a comparable technical support function or equivalent education
  • Experience providing IT Support to users in a larger company
  • Practical experience with installations, configurations, diagnosing and resolving issues with Windows- and macOS based laptops and workstations, peripherals and connectivity issues. Practical experience with Linux is an advantage
  • Experience in advanced hardware troubleshooting of laptops and workstations
  • Experience supporting specialized workstations like scientific workstations is an advantage
  • Strong knowledge in Mac OS, Windows, iOS and preferably Linux distributions as an administrator or power user
  • Experience with meeting room support and troubleshooting (Crestron- and Poly control systems)
  • Experience with Microsoft Active Directory, and Microsoft 365
  • Experience contributing to knowledge bases and technical documentation
  • Ability to communicate technical matters clearly to users with different levels of technical knowledge

To apply:

If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “apply” and follow the instructions, latest by October 4, 2026. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website.

Certain roles at ESS require enhanced security screening processes, which will be performed as part of the recruitment and onboarding process.

For more information regarding the ESS recruitment process, please contact Louise Jönegård - Recruiter at mailto:louise.jonegard@ess.eu For further information regarding the position, please contact Anette Smedberg-Haukka – Group leader IT Helpdesk & Support – via mailto:anette.smedberghaukka@ess.eu

For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nerusha Naicker on mailto:erusha.Naicker@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at mailto:marc.kickulies@ess.eu

We look forward to receiving your application soon!

title: (PM) Project Manager
description:
About Overwatch Mission Critical
Overwatch is a service-disabled Veteran-owned small business (SDVOB) certified through the National Veterans Business Development Council (NVBDC), offering construction professional services, talent acquisition, and general contractor services for the mission-critical infrastructure industry.
Our mission is the construction and management of state-of-the-art data centers with the precision and reliability this industry demands. From high-end engineers to seasoned professionals, we deploy the people you need to get your data center off the ground. At Overwatch, it's more than a job — it's purpose.

Project Execution
  • Oversee daily construction activities for hyperscale data center development including sitework, structural, electrical, and mechanical scopes.
  • Ensure construction activities align with project schedule, budget, and technical specifications.
  • Coordinate with general contractors, subcontractors, and vendors to maintain project milestones and deliverables.

Contractor & Vendor Coordination Act as the primary on-site liaison between contractors, engineers, and project stakeholders.
  • Manage contractor performance and ensure adherence to contractual obligations and construction standards.
  • Facilitate coordination meetings and track progress across all active construction workstreams.

Schedule & Budget Management
  • Monitor project schedules and assist in resolving schedule impacts or delays.
  • Review contractor reports, change orders, and construction progress updates.
  • Support project cost tracking and ensure construction activities remain aligned with budget expectations.

Quality & Compliance Ensure construction activities meet the team's mission-critical quality standards and design specifications.
  • Coordinate with QA/QC and commissioning teams to support system readiness and operational requirements.
  • Maintain compliance with local regulations, safety standards, and environmental requirements.

Site Leadership Maintain strong on-site leadership presence and foster collaboration between all project stakeholders.
  • Identify risks, escalate issues, and develop solutions to maintain construction progress.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to site safety programs.

Driver’s License Requirement
For roles that require on-site presence or travel between work locations as an essential function of the position, candidates must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license appropriate for the role and be eligible to operate a motor vehicle in accordance with applicable laws.

Communication Skills
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively in a professional work environment, including preparing written reports and documentation, conveying information clearly to team members, clients, and stakeholders, and responding appropriately to verbal and written communications related to job duties.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment
This position operates primarily in an active data center construction environment, encompassing both indoor and outdoor work settings. The role requires the physical ability to perform essential job functions safely and effectively in a dynamic environment that includes ongoing construction activity and evolving site conditions.

The work environment includes areas and temporary structures owned, leased, or controlled by third parties over which Overwatch may have limited or no control. Because the project remains under construction, certain areas of the site — including access routes, staging zones, and temporary structures — may not yet be fully ADA-compliant until construction is complete or those third-party areas are finalized.

Physical Requirements
  • Must be able to walk, stand, stoop, twist, bend, and climb stairs or ladders for extended periods while navigating uneven, unpaved, or obstructed terrain.
  • Must be able to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds on an occasional basis.
  • Must be able to drive between job sites and access all areas of an active construction zone, including raised platforms, scaffolding, and confined spaces.
  • Must be able to tolerate exposure to outdoor weather conditions, dust, and construction-related noise, vibrations, and odors.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively with contractors, engineers, and site personnel, and maintain situational awareness in high-activity environments.
  • Personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hats, safety vests, hearing protection, and steel-toe boots, is required.
  • Must have sufficient visual acuity to read drawings, specifications, and safety signage, and to observe site activity.

Work Environment
Work is performed primarily in and around active construction areas, which may include unfinished buildings, temporary field offices, staging areas, and partially completed infrastructure. These locations may contain uneven surfaces, limited accessibility, and other conditions typical of construction projects prior to final completion. Overwatch does not control and cannot modify accessibility conditions within areas, facilities, or temporary structures owned or managed by third parties.

Reasonable Accommodation
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position, provided such accommodations do not create safety hazards, impede essential mobility within active work zones, or require modification of facilities not owned or controlled by Overwatch.

Benefits
Overwatch Construction offers a competitive salary and benefits package, including health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, 401(k) retirement plan and paid time off.

OVERWATCH is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. OVERWATCH considers candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

title: Property Lead, Playfly Max (Louisiana State University)
description:
DIRECTOR, PLAYFLY MAX (LOUISIANA STATE UNIVERSITY)

Baton Rouge, LA

Onsite

THE RUNDOWN

Playfly Sports is looking for a Director, Playfly Max to join our team in Baton Rouge, LA. The Director, Playfly Max will be responsible for generating NIL revenues on behalf of the university to meet and exceed individual and team goals for Playfly. The person in this role will work on-site with the staff and university athletics, and the Playfly MMR staff to pitch and close commercial NIL partnership agreements, develop, lead and execute specialty revenue concepts and revenue-driving events, and develop comprehensive revenue strategies to support university NIL.

WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH

· Partner with athletics department to develop and execute a revenue plan to meet and exceed NIL revenue goals for Playfly Max

· Manage profit and loss & budget reports to maintain and exceed EBITDA budget

· Prospect, meet and close a significant number of new and renewal high level NIL partnership deals.

· Identify potential sponsors through networking with university stakeholders & business partners and researching local, regional & national companies

· Work with Playfly Sports Properties leadership and university Athletics to create sales inventory, revenue projections and overall revenue strategy for the university project assets

· Conceptualize, plan, and execute revenue generating events and strategize other incremental revenue generation opportunities

· Manage sponsorship collections and third party NIL student-athlete payments

· Develop sales presentations for new NIL marketing partners by incorporating research, category dynamics and an understanding of partner’s marketing goals

· Create sales proposals and draft/negotiate contracts with NIL sponsors

· Draft/negotiate contracts with student-athletes on behalf of various sponsors

· Develop key marketing objectives with clients via thorough needs assessment and a collaborative sales process

· Entertain and cultivate sponsors in non-game related settings

· Prepare end-of-year recaps for sponsors

· Represent Playfly Max, the university, and Playfly Sports Properties in a professional manner

· Research sports sponsorship and the NIL industry and stay current with relevant market trends and conditions

· Build strong understanding of all Playfly business units and offerings in order to leverage new business areas, leads, and categories

· Other job-related duties as assigned

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

· Bachelor’s degree required

· 5-7 years of relevant direct sales/revenue generation experience in the sports multi-media environment, event planning, non-sports multi-media, or fundraising environment, or similar industry with transferrable applicable skills

· 5 years of experience in a sales and revenue generation role preferred

· Proven ability in managing, meeting & exceeding budget & revenue goals

· Familiarity with KORE or similar CRM system

· Strong experience and understanding of integrated and “conceptual” sales

· Ability to generate and present ideas and concepts succinctly and provide creative solutions to prospects/clients

· Ability to develop and manage individual project P&L’s to a desired positive net outcome

· Outstanding verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills

· Demonstrated professional sales presentation skills

· Must be driven and coachable to execute the Playfly Sports Properties revenue model and to understand the distinctive relationship with university Athletics.

TRAVEL, LIFTING, PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

· Must be available for game days and evening athletic events and other special events

· Must be available to travel as needed for client presentations

· Must be able to work nights and weekends around sporting and other special events

WHAT WE DO

Playfly Sports is the full-service, leading sports marketing and media company that enables brands to engage with sports fans on a local, regional, and national level through scaled linear, digital, and experiential assets. Playfly Sports drives outcome-based solutions into 90-million households via more than 7,800 live U.S. broadcasts of MLB, NBA, and NHL games; and influences sports fans of all ages through the management of college and high school multimedia rights, uniform branding, and high-profile sports sponsorship platforms. Playfly Sports has the unique ability to partner, innovate, and advance the aspirations of athletes, brands, academic institutions, and sports fans across the U.S. Playfly Sports is Powered by Partnership. Visit Playfly Sports online at playfly.com

WHAT WE STAND FOR

At Playfly, we know that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company is a more innovative and successful one, but more importantly, we believe it’s just the right thing to do. Through conversations, company initiatives, community events and partnerships, policy changes, data analysis, workshops, and support groups, we are dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. We are here for the long haul and to do the meaningful work that creates true institutional change within our workplace, with our partners, and in the communities we serve.

EEOC & DIVERSITY STATEMENT

Playfly Sports affirms that inequality is detrimental to our associates, our clients, and the communities we serve. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Playfly Sports is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance.

ACCOMMODATIONS

Playfly Sports is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals, and as part of this commitment, Playfly Sports will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact recruiting@playfly.com.
