title: planner TTIS
description:
Voordat een pakketje op de deur ploft, heeft het al een hele reis doorgemaakt. Als Planner zorg jij er op de locatie in Oirschot voor dat de dagelijkse planning vlekkeloos verloopt en onze talenten vol energie aan het werk gaan. Met jouw daadkracht, sterke communicatie en flexibele instelling maak jij direct impact bij een grote logistieke speler. Lees snel verder!

Naast werkplezier, krijg je ook dit van ons

Bij ons krijg je het beste van twee werelden: de power en tools van een grote marktleider, maar met de vrijheid van een eigen ondernemer. Geen strak keurslijf, maar juist alle ruimte om je eigen koers te varen en je werkweek flexibel in te delen. Samen met een team vol ambitie gaan we voor de beste resultaten. Heb jij het lef om te knallen? Dan zetten wij daar natuurlijk een pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden tegenover waar je écht blij van wordt. Werk met plezier!

  • Lekker loon en fijne extra’s: je start met een bruto basissalaris tussen de € 2.850,- en € 3.300,- per maand, afgestemd op wat jij aan ervaring meebrengt. Bovenop je loon krijg je elke maand een Benefit Budget van 12,347% (dat is zo’n € 352,- tot € 407,- extra per maand). Jij bent de baas over dit budget: laat het direct uitbetalen voor wat extra cash, spaar het op voor later, of ruil het in voor extra vakantiedagen. Je kunt het zelfs slim inzetten voor je sportabonnement of het aflossen van je studieschuld. Hoe fijn is dat?

  • Onkosten? Fixen we!: Maandelijks ontvang je een onkostenvergoeding à € 61,- netto bovenop je bruto salaris;

  • Tijd voor jezelf: Op je verjaardag ben je natuurlijk vrij; dat is ons cadeautje aan jou! Verder heb je naast de standaard 25 vakantiedagen de mogelijkheid om tot vijf weken extra verlof bij te kopen. Heb je grotere plannen? Dan kun je elke drie jaar een sabbatical opnemen om je batterij weer helemaal op te laden;

  • Een vliegende start: Vergeet saaie inwerkperiodes! Naast de training on-the-job stomen we je klaar met ons prijswinnende onboardingprogramma: de StartUp. Je leert razendsnel onze merken en strategie kennen, zodat we samen een stevige fundering leggen voor jouw Karriere;

  • Reis op jouw manier: Pak een leasefiets of stap relaxed de trein in met een NS Business Card (die je ook privé mag gebruiken!). Ga je liever met je eigen auto of motor? Dan krijg je van ons een reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per kilometer;

  • Bouwen aan je toekomst: Bij Tempo-Team investeer je in jezelf. Ontdek je groeikansen via onze trainingen en krijg direct inzicht in je positie met de Arbeidsmarktwaarde Scan. Inclusief coaching, zodat jij altijd de controle houdt over je volgende stap;

Dit zit in jouw DNA

Als Planner ben jij communicatief ijzersterk, houd je het hoofd koel in een hectische dynamiek en schakel je razendsnel tussen verschillende partijen. Ervaring in bijvoorbeeld de horeca of een andere snelle omgeving helpt jou om makkelijk beslissingen te nemen en doortastend te handelen. Jij brengt structuur, durft je uit te spreken en kijkt actief naar oplossingen om het verzuim laag te houden en de planning op orde te krijgen.

  • HBO of MBO 4 met HBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Een aanstelling van bij voorkeur 32 uur per week (meer uren zijn bespreekbaar);

  • In het bezit van een rijbewijs B en eigen vervoer voor de locatie Oirschot;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Aan de slag!

In de rol van Planner ben jij de motor achter de dagelijkse personeelsplanning bij DPD in Oirschot. Waar de accountspecialist de forecast opstelt, duik jij vol energie in de operationele uitvoering van vandaag en morgen. Hoe verliep het gisteren en hoe zorgen we dat de planning voor vandaag en komende week als een bus staat? Je schakelt continu met flexkrachten, vast personeel, teamleiders van de klant én concurrenten om de bezetting optimaal te houden. Dankzij jouw communicatieve instelling zorg je niet alleen dat alle plekken bezet zijn, maar ook dat het ziekteverzuim daalt en uitzendkrachten zich gehoord voelen.

Dit zijn jouw voornaamste taken als Planner:

  • Opstellen, bewaken en bijsturen van de dagelijkse planning op basis van de forecast;

  • Fungeren als eerste aanspreekpunt voor uitzendkrachten, teamleiders en externe partijen;

  • Actief schakelen en communiceren over wijzigingen in de planning;

  • Begeleiden van de onboarding van nieuwe medewerkers en verwerken van administratieve taken;

  • Verlagen en beheersen van het ziekteverzuim door nauw contact te onderhouden met de talenten.

Dit is jouw team!

Je maakt als Planner onderdeel uit van Tempo-Team Performance Management en werkt nauw samen met het dedicated accountteam bij DPD. Daarnaast word je ondersteund door een landelijk team van collega's en jouw manager, waardoor je er nooit alleen voor staat. In deze dynamische omgeving is geen dag hetzelfde, maar dankzij de korte lijnen en de onderlinge hulp is een vraag zo gesteld en sta je samen sterk. Dat betekent veel afwisseling, een gezonde dosis energie én een team dat klaarstaat om samen successen te vieren.

De kracht van Tempo-Team

Voor Tempo-Team Performance Management zijn we voor deze uitdagende rol op zoek naar een inhouse planner. In deze rol verzorg jij de planning voor de locatie van DPD in Oirschot en zorg je ervoor dat onze talenten tevreden aan het werk kunnen. Hoe tof is dat! DPD heeft het slim bekeken. Zij hebben Tempo-Team Performance Management in de arm genomen om te zorgen dat alles goed wordt geregeld. Laat dat inderdaad maar aan ons over! Binnen onze organisatie staat persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal. Samen met jouw manager ben je hier actief over in gesprek, waardoor je hierin mooie stappen kunt zetten.

Grijp deze kans

Denk je nu: dit is mijn baan? Solliciteer direct! Waarom wachten als je ook nu de stap naar meer werkplezier kunt zetten? We maken het je niet te moeilijk: solliciteer via de website en laat van je horen.

Heb je toch nog een brandende vraag voordat je op verzenden drukt? Onze Talent Acquisition Specialist Kelvin Silvius helpt je graag verder! Je kunt bellen of appen naar M +31 (0)6 27 45 42 02 of een mailtje sturen naar kelvin.silvius@randstadgroep.nl. Tot snel!

title: Data Center Technician III, Global Server Operations

As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

Sport inspires us. Innovation drives us. Come Win With Us at DICK’S Sporting Goods as part of a team that redefines what’s possible.

title: Solutions Architect, National Security Solutions Architecture Team
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Solutions Architect to join our National Security team supporting National Security Space and Sensor customers.

As a Solutions Architect on the AWS National Security Team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to IC customers—you are the "face of Amazon" to our most mission-critical customers. You will engage across a broad variety of complex technical challenges that directly impact national security outcomes. This is a high-visibility role where you collaborate with and influence both external stakeholders and internal AWS teams, including sales, platform engineering, and AI/ML service teams.

National Security Solutions Architects (SAs) are recognized as technical thought leaders within the Intelligence Community who evangelize emerging technologies—including agentic AI, machine learning, and computer vision —not only on a conceptual level, but on a practical, architectural level. You will design and deliver AI-powered solutions that enable agencies to extract actionable intelligence from complex data at scale.

title: Inventory Control Tech II (Monroe)
description:
Job Description

The Inventory Control Tech II provides intermediate-level support and guidance to the inventory team. This role bridges daily execution with leadership by mentoring junior staff, assisting with vendor coordination, and supporting warehouse organization. The Inventory Control Tech II is expected to operate independently with minimal supervision and contribute to ongoing operational improvements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Receive and unload items from delivery trucks in a timely and organized manner.
  • Document received items using inventory platforms such as Monday Boards.
  • Store finished goods and packaging material in a clean, orderly fashion.
  • Deliver materials to workstations and storage points both physically and via digital systems.
  • Pull and stage packaging material for Resupply Requests or Jobs with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Perform regular cycle counts and assist with inventory reconciliation.
  • Relocate inventory and assist with cleanups and general warehouse maintenance.
  • Safely operate material handling equipment (MHE), including forklifts and pallet jacks (manual/electric).
  • Maintain transaction rigor to minimize inventory discrepancies (target: ≤1 error/day).
  • Adhere to compliance procedures as required by state regulations.
  • Follow all SOPs, operational guidelines, and verbal directives.
  • Maintain professionalism and a positive team-oriented attitude.
  • Seek guidance from senior team members and escalate discrepancies as needed.
  • Guide and mentor junior team members in task execution and warehouse best practices.
  • Train new inventory staff and serve as a resource for troubleshooting.
  • Act as liaison during on-site supplier visits, assisting with deliveries and pickups.
  • Assist in leading day-to-day warehouse operations.
  • Be eligible and maintain qualifications to be insured as a driver for company vehicles.
  • Conduct local deliveries and pickups using company-owned box trucks or freightliners.
  • Help enforce safety procedures, inventory handling policies, and transaction integrity standards.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and communicate suggestions to the Inventory Manager.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor, modeling company values and expectations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be able to obtain a state medical marijuana badge and pass a background check.
  • Ability to work independently and maintain focus.
  • Comfortable using and learning new software tools.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines.
  • Effective interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong ethics, reliability, and a positive attitude.
  • Willingness to work weekends and holidays as needed.
  • Reliable transportation.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and other inventory software platforms (e.g., Monday Boards).
  • Forklift operation (certification preferred).
  • Skilled in use of pallet jacks (standard and electric).
  • Strong computer skills and basic math skills.
  • High attention to detail and organization.
  • Valid driver’s license with clean driving record.
  • Eligible to be insured as a driver for company vehicles (box truck/freightliner).
  • Experience guiding or leading small teams or training coworkers.
  • Strong organizational and leadership skills.
  • Comfortable interacting professionally with external vendors and suppliers.


Education and Experience Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 3+ years of inventory experience
  • Experience using data entry software (i.e., Excel)


Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 35 pounds.
  • Ability to move safely over uneven terrain or in confined spaces.
  • Ability to work in various environmental conditions (hot, humid, low light).
  • Ability to stand, walk, sit, bend, reach, and perform repetitive tasks for extended periods.
  • Must wear personal protective gear as required.
  • Ability to operate and drive box trucks or similar delivery vehicles.
  • Must meet physical requirements to safely load and unload deliveries.


At Good Day Farm, we are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment for all. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer; all hiring decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please notify us by replying to your application confirmation email or contacting your recruiter directly.

title: Bli med og forme framtidens steder og samfunn
description:
Er du nyutdannet eller har noen års erfaring innen areal-/samfunnsplanlegging eller landskapsarkitektur?

Hos Norconsult Vestfold får du muligheten til å jobbe med prosjekter som utvikler lokalsamfunn, styrker naturverdier og skaper gode steder for mennesker. Vi søker engasjerte medarbeidere som ønsker å utvikle seg i et sterkt tverrfaglig fagmiljø.

Derfor skal du velge Norconsult Vestfold

Her blir du del av et sterkt lokalt fagmiljø og tilgang til et av Norges største nettverk av rådgivere og spesialister. Med rundt 90 medarbeidere fordelt på kontorene i Larvik, Tønsberg og Kongsberg utvikler vi bærekraftige løsninger innen blant annet arealplanlegging, arkitektur, landskapsarkitektur, samferdsel, bygg, miljø og teknisk infrastruktur.

Hos oss får du arbeide med spennende og varierte prosjekter gjennom hele utviklingsløpet, i tett samarbeid med kolleger på tvers av fag og kontorer. Vi legger til rette for både faglig og personlig utvikling gjennom sterke fagnettverk, kompetansedeling og gode utviklingsmuligheter.

Samtidig tilbyr vi stor fleksibilitet, konkurransedyktige betingelser, overskuddsdeling og mulighet for eierskap i selskapet, samt fri i påske- og romjulsuken. Arbeidshverdagen preges av tillit, samarbeid og faglig stolthet i et inkluderende og uformelt arbeidsmiljø.

Arbeidssted: Larvik eller Tønsberg

Vi søker:

Areal-/Samfunnsplanlegger:

I samfunnsplangruppa blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø med 10 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere. Vi arbeider med hele bredden av planfaget og bistår både offentlige og private kunder i komplekse og samfunnsviktige prosjekter.

Hos oss vil du blant annet jobbe med:

  • Planprosessen fra ide til ferdig vedtak.

  • Prosjekter innen samferdsels- og infrastruktur, by- og tettstedsutvikling, industri og prosjekter innen det grønne skiftet og bygg- og eiendomsutvikling

  • Utarbeidelse av arealplaner og reguleringsplaner

  • Planprosessledelse og prosjektarbeid

  • Konsekvensutredninger og planfaglige analyser

  • Mulighetsstudier og utviklingskonsepter

  • Medvirknings- og innbyggerinvolveringsprosesser

  • GIS-analyser og kartproduksjon

  • Illustrasjoner og presentasjonsmateriale

  • Tilbudsarbeid og oppdragsledelse

Du blir også en del av Norconsults landsdekkende fagnettverk innen planlegging, hvor samarbeid, kompetanseutvikling og kunnskapsdeling står sentralt.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Mastergrad innen arealplanlegging, samfunnsplanlegging, by- og regionplanlegging eller annen relevant fagretning

  • Interesse for planfaget og motivasjon for faglig utvikling

  • Evner å utfordre rammebetingelser for å finne de beste løsningene for våre kunder

  • Kjennskap til plan- og bygningsloven og relevante forskrifter

  • Erfaring med relevante verktøy som Fokus Arealplan, ArcGIS og Adobe-produkter

Landskapsarkitekt:

Bli en del av en kreativ faggruppe på ni landskapsarkitekter som brenner for å skape gode steder gjennom samspill mellom mennesker, fag og natur. Vårt fokus på VARIG arkitektur, VARIG skjønnhet og VARIG liv er grunnlaget for hvordan vi utvikler prosjekter og samarbeider med kunder og kolleger.

Hos oss vil du blant annet jobbe med:

  • Spennende og samfunnsviktige prosjekter innen helse og omsorg, skoler, by- og stedsutvikling, samferdsel, industri, næringsbygg og boligområder.

  • Oppgaver gjennom hele utviklingsløpet, fra mulighetsstudier og konseptutvikling til detaljprosjektering og byggeoppfølging

  • Utarbeidelse av anbudsdokumenter og kostnadsoverslag

  • Bærekraftige og fremtidsrettede løsninger med fokus på klimatilpasning, overvannshåndtering, naturmangfold, inkludering og universell utforming.

  • Prosjektering og BIM i små og store oppdrag

  • Bidra til videreutvikling av digitale arbeidsmetoder og BIM i faggruppen

  • Utarbeidelse av anbudsdokumenter og kostnadsoverslag

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Har mastergrad eller tilsvarende utdannelse innen landskapsarkitektur

  • Har interesse for, og gjerne erfaring og kompetanse innen, landskapsarkitektfaget, digitale arbeidsmetoder og BIM.

  • Erfaring og behersker prosjekteringsverktøy - fortrinnsvis Autocad Civil med Focus software.

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er åpen, nysgjerrig og faglig engasjert

  • Tar initiativ og bidrar til å finne gode løsninger sammen med andre

  • Trives i tverrfaglige team og bygger gode relasjoner

  • Kommuniserer godt på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Har god gjennomføringsevne og tar ansvar for egne oppgaver

  • Bidrar til et positivt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

Slik søker du:

Motivasjonstekst fylles ut i vårt elektroniske søknadssystem. CV og vitnemål/karakterutskrift lastes opp sammen med søknaden.

Søknadsfrist 10. oktober, og gjør oppmerksom på at kun elektroniske søknader vil bli vurdert.

Om Norconsult

Norconsult er et ledende nordisk rådgiverselskap med omtrent 7 200 medarbeidere fordelt på over 140 kontorer i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Island, Polen og Finland. Med utgangspunkt i lokal tilstedeværelse og tverrfaglig kompetanse innen ingeniørfag, arkitektur og digitalisering, bistår Norconsult private og offentlige kunder med oppdrag innen infrastruktur, energi og industri, bygg, eiendom og arkitektur. Hovedkontoret ligger i Sandvika.

For Norconsult er det en grunnleggende forutsetning at alle mennesker er likeverdige. Målet er at våre medarbeidere skal ha de samme mulighetene til å nå sitt fulle potensial uavhengig av hvem de er eller hvordan de identifiserer seg. Et bredere spekter av perspektiver hjelper oss å forstå alle deler av samfunnet, utfordrer oss i våre oppdrag og fører til en høyere grad av innovasjon. Vi ønsker derfor medarbeidere med ulik bakgrunn og erfaring velkommen.

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad!

title: Head of Risk and Resilience
description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

Super Technologies is looking for a Head of Risk and Resilience to build and lead our organisational resilience capability from the ground up, making sure the business can withstand, adapt to, and recover from disruption, whatever form it takes. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role, focused on embedding resilience thinking into how every part of the business operates rather than policing it from the sidelines. Reporting to the Group Risk and Audit Director and supported by a small team of risk specialists, you will mature the function and help shape the wider risk strategy.

What the role involves

  • Lead operational risk identification and control assessment across business units, providing specialist and technical risk advice to executive committees
  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery planning, running regular testing, tabletop exercises and simulations, and translating results into action
  • Build resilience playbooks for critical business services, including third-party and vendor dependency risk
  • Act as incident lead or escalation point during major operational disruptions, staying calm and decisive under pressure
  • Embed resilience thinking into how business, product and technology teams plan, ship and operate, partnering directly with leaders to close identified gaps and working with Technology on IT disaster recovery, system redundancy and recovery objectives for critical systems
  • Build a network of resilience owners across key business areas, running workshops and training so teams can identify and fix their own single points of failure
  • Manage a team of 2 direct reports, supporting the wider risk team, and grow a small, hands-on resilience team as the function scales
  • Make the business case for resilience investment in terms leadership cares about, and represent resilience in new market launches, major product changes and technology decisions from the outset

Please note you may be required to travel to various offices across Europe and will also be required to work in the Μadrid office twice a week.

What we are looking for

  • Minimum 8+ years' experience in operational resilience, including at least 3 years in a senior or leadership capacity
  • A track record of building a resilience or continuity programme from scratch, or significantly maturing an existing one
  • Practical experience designing and running resilience tests, such as tabletops, simulations and failover exercises, and translating results into action
  • Strong working knowledge of resilience and continuity frameworks and standards (e.g. ISO 22301, BCI Good Practice Guidelines, or equivalent)
  • Experience managing third-party and vendor dependency risk for critical services
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to get business and technology leaders to own and run their part of resilience
  • Comfortable acting as incident commander during live disruptions, staying calm and decisive under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to executives and the Board

Nice to have

  • Experience in a fast-growing, tech-driven, or regulated consumer business
  • Familiarity with technology/cyber resilience and IT disaster recovery
  • Relevant professional certification (e.g. CBCP, CRM, or equivalent)
  • Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions/regulatory regimes

What we offer

  • Medical / Health Insurance
  • Open Annual Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Training & Learning Development

Additional benefits vary by country and will be shared during the hiring process.

About Super

We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

Shaping the Future of Play

Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page:

Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA).

At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance.

Designs, develops, troubleshoots and debugs software programs for software enhancements and new products. Develops software including operating systems, compilers, routers, networks, utilities, databases and Internet-related tools. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design.

Management Level Definition:

Contributions have visible technical impact on a product or major subcomponent. Applies in-depth professional knowledge and innovative ideas to solve complex problems. This role combines strong software testing fundamentals with AI evaluation expertise. The successful candidate will design automated quality frameworks, test deterministic and probabilistic behaviour, uncover complex cross-layer defects, influence architecture for testability, and help engineering teams deliver secure, reliable, accessible, high-performance products at speed.

Responsibilities:

  • Define risk-based test strategies, quality gates, release criteria, traceability, and measurable objectives across AI, UI, API, cloud, and network layers.

  • Test AWS deployments, distributed systems, traffic behavior, scaling, failover, disaster recovery, and adverse network conditions.

  • Build reusable Python and pytest frameworks and execute performance, scale, reliability, and end-to-end testing with CI/CD integration.

  • Use telemetry, incidents, and user feedback to detect regressions, strengthen coverage, and improve preventive controls.

  • Partner across disciplines, use AI-assisted testing responsibly, mentor engineers, and promote shared ownership of quality.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline.

  • 12+ years’ experience with at least 3 years of experience in a lead role

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Quality Engineering: Enterprise test strategy, automation, quality governance

  • Automation: Python, pytest, UI/API testing, mocking, diagnostics, CI/CD

  • Web Testing: React, responsive design, accessibility, cross-browser, web security,

  • API testing: JMeter, SoapUI, Postman

  • GenAI Evaluation: LLM testing, groundedness, hallucination, safety, regression, metrics, human review, LangSmith, LangGraph, Langfuse, MCP

  • Networking & Protocols: IP clos fabric, EVPN, VXLAN, BGP, MPLS, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gRPC, SNMP, LLDP, traffic simulators such as Ixia, Spirent etc…

  • Performance Engineering: Performance, scale, functional, integration, E2E, regression, security, accessibility, reliability, compatibility

  • Problem-Solving: Architecture analysis, cross-layer debugging, risk assessment, root-cause communication

  • AI quality and observability: Experience with agent evaluation, prompt regression, model comparison, tracing, and production monitoring.

  • Performance and resilience: Proficiency in API and browser performance testing, cloud-scale resilience, and chaos testing.

  • Security and complex platforms: Knowledge of OWASP risks, threat modelling, adversarial validation, and testing multi-tenant or distributed enterprise architectures.

  • AWS and monitoring: Familiarity with AI services, container platforms, and observability tools such as Datadog.

  • Credentials and leadership: Relevant networking certifications and demonstrated leadership across automation, cloud quality, performance, security, or responsible AI.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

title: Construction Superintendent - Controls/Automation
description:
Job Type: Full-Time | Location: Childress, TX | Department: Construction | Reporting to: Associate Director, Construction | Work Location Type: #remote

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

We are seeking a Construction Superintendent - Controls/Automation to lead the installation, integration, and commissioning of advanced building management systems (BMS), programmable logic controllers (PLCs), direct digital controls (DDC), and automated mechanical/electrical interfaces in high-performance data center environments. This role requires hands-on site supervision, cross-trade coordination, and a strong focus on safety, quality, and schedule adherence.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in. in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and supervise controls technicians, integration specialists, subcontractors, and vendor engineers performing automation work across the project.
  • Plan daily activities, assign crews, coordinate access with other trades, and monitor productivity to achieve project milestones safely and on schedule.
  • Oversee the installation, wiring, termination, and mounting of control panels, PLCs, DDC controllers, sensors, meters, valves, actuators, and network hardware.
  • Review control schematics, network architectures, point lists, sequences of operations, and submittals before field work begins.
  • Verify that mechanical and electrical systems have passed required preliminary tests, flushing, and inspections before initiating point-to-point checkout.
  • Oversee comprehensive point-to-point checks, calibration, loop tuning, and functional testing of all hardware and software control loops.
  • Ensure neat and organized cable routing, proper wire labeling, shielding continuity, grounding standards, and panel tidiness.
  • Coordinate automation sequencing and physical interfaces with mechanical, piping, HVAC, liquid-cooling, electrical, fire-protection, and structural teams.
  • Collaborate with controls engineers, software vendors, and commissioning authorities to resolve integration bottlenecks, network conflicts, and logic anomalies.
  • Support first-work inspections, mockups, Inspection and Test Plans, quality hold points, and routine field inspections to confirm compliance with sequence of operations.
  • Identify, document, and correct wiring errors, faulty hardware, communication drops, or non-conforming installation practices; manage punch-list items and verify closure before turnover.
  • Support final commissioning, integrated systems testing (IST), and data center black-site testing by troubleshooting active loops and monitoring real-time data trends.
  • Manage controls material and hardware deliveries, secure storage, handling, and inventory to prevent damage, theft, or moisture exposure.
  • Track installed quantities, manpower, productivity, network completion status, and forecasted milestones; provide accurate daily and weekly updates to construction management.
  • Enforce OSHA regulations, NFPA 70E safety requirements, and safe practices for working around live electrical panels, control loops, scaffolds, ladders, and aerial lifts.
  • Lead pre-task planning, Job Hazard Analyses, toolbox talks, and field safety observations; investigate incidents or near misses and implement corrective actions.
  • Maintain daily reports, calibration logs, network as-builts, redlines, and software backup documentation required for system turnover and facility handover.
  • Train site personnel and operations teams on basic panel troubleshooting, hardware layout, and immediate override procedures.
  • Promote energy-efficient automation strategies that optimize system performance, minimize power usage effectiveness (PUE), and support the reliable operation of high-density data center cooling infrastructure.

Requirements

  • Journeyman Electrician License.
  • High school diploma or equivalent; Associate or Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Construction Management, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in commercial or industrial building automation and controls, including at least 3 years in a foreman, lead, or supervisory role.
  • Demonstrated experience supervising controls and automation deployment on mission-critical facilities, data centers, complex HVAC systems, liquid cooling loops, power distribution units, and central utility plants.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial control systems, communication protocols (e.g., BACnet, Modbus, Lon Works, Profibus, Ethernet/IP), network architecture, and field instrumentation (sensors, transmitters, actuators, VFDs).
  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting electrical schematics, P&IDs, control drawings, sequence of operations (SOO), input/output (I/O) point lists, and manufacturer specifications.
  • Working knowledge of applicable industry codes and standards, including NEC, UL, ASHRAE, ISA, and NFPA.
  • Strong understanding of loop tuning, signal calibration, point-to-point verification, network troubleshooting, and automated system integration.
  • Ability to plan manpower, coordinate access and sequencing with mechanical and electrical trades, and manage daily and weekly production targets.
  • OSHA 30 certification required; First Aid/CPR, competent-person, fall-protection, or electrical safety (NFPA 70E) certifications are a plus.
  • Relevant controls certifications (e.g., Niagara AX/4 Certified, PLC programming certificates, or equivalent trade qualifications) preferred.
  • Strong leadership, communication, documentation, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to manage multiple specialty contractors and priorities in a fast-paced construction environment.
  • High attention to detail with a practical, solutions-oriented approach to field quality, software/hardware integration, and constructability issues.

Other Important Requirements:
  • Pre-employment screening, including background check and substance testing may be required according to company policies.
  • Must provide own steel-toed work boots; other PPE will be supplied.
  • Must be able to reliably commute to the work site daily or have plans to relocate before starting work.
  • Must be comfortable working a rotational schedule, which includes day and night shifts as well as weekend work, based on project needs.
  • Employees working night shifts will receive a 15% premium added to their hourly rate only for hours worked during night shifts.

Job Title

Experienced embedded software engineer in Linköping

Job Description

At Axis Communications we are all about creating a smarter and safer world! We have delivered groundbreaking products for many years and will continue to do so for years to come. Join our team as an embedded software engineer, and together we will create smart products for a greater future!

Who is your future team?

You will be part of the hardware development team in Linköping which consists of both experienced and young talented engineers in electronics, mechanics and embedded software. We work together across the disciplines in projects to create world-class products.

We foster an inclusive and supportive environment where it is safe to ask questions, try new ideas, and learn from mistakes. Together, we take shared responsibility for our deliveries while making sure we enjoy the journey by celebrating successes, supporting each other, and continuously growing as professionals.

Who are we looking for?

Axis success is built by the people working here and we strongly believe that by having the right people anything is possible. We are looking for someone who:

  • Has a positive mindset and strong communication skills
  • Loves to solve problems with a team
  • Uses a systematic approach and likes to work with the big picture
  • Has the user in focus when developing products

In addition, you have worked for at least 5 years in a relevant field and have a university degree in computer science, engineering physics or a similar relevant area.

What you’ll do as an Experienced Embedded Software Engineer:

As an experienced embedded software engineer in our team, you collaborate and communicate a lot with other stakeholders within Axis, both in Linköping and on other sites to deliver products. You'll act as a bridge between software, hardware, and product management, translating complex technical challenges into clear requirements and solutions for different stakeholders.

Your main software objective will be to build functional, scalable and high-quality solutions in a common code base. Our software responsibilities span all the way from hardware via drivers, system services, API:s to web-based interfaces, with the main work being:

  • Developing software in C, C++ or Rust for embedded Linux systems.
  • Developing software in C or Rust for MCU
  • Using Git, Gerrit and GitHub for revision handling and review.
  • Writing unit and system test cases.

We also expect AI-assisted development to be a natural part of your daily workflow. You are already using tools such as GitHub Copilot, or similar AI assistants to accelerate development, improve code quality, solve problems, and learn new technologies.

In addition to the experience within the above-mentioned areas, the following would be meriting:

  • Experience in network protocols and firmware/software development for network switches or other networking equipment. Especially for Linux platforms.
  • Experience of roles with responsibilities such as, code ownership, system design, work planning.
  • Experience working with Yocto and embedded Linux systems.
  • Experience of programming languages as Python, Shell and Typescript

What Axis has to offer:

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.

Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

This position is based in Linköping, primarily on-site at our office in Ebbepark. Our work environment fosters teamwork and innovation, with plenty of room for fun! Together, we enjoy activities like table tennis, Mario Kart, or a game of pickleball at Campushallen

Do you want to join us? Apply now!

If you want to know more or have any questions do not hesitate to get in touch with Sebastian Andrén on telephone +46 46 2721800.

Applications will be processed continuously, so don’t wait to apply.

Type of Employment

Permanent Employment

2026-09-27

We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. With around 6000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. title: Data Center Technician - Night Shift
description:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

This is a night shift/overnight role: It will require working overnight hours between approximately 6pm-8am. Work schedule may not be a standard 40hr work week. Specific days and hours may vary depending on specific site and/or schedule needs.


NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
-Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
-Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
-Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
-Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
-Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:

-Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
-Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
-Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
-Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
-Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
-Work in a noisy environment
-Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

-Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
-Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
-Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:
-Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
-Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
-Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

About the team
Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion of events fosters stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS WorkSpaces, AWS WorkSpaces Control Plane Backend
description:
Are you excited about building cloud desktop experiences used by organizations worldwide? Amazon WorkSpaces delivers fully managed Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) solutions from the AWS Cloud, enabling customers to provision secure, high-quality cloud desktops accessible from any device. Our team tackles complex distributed systems challenges to bring a native desktop experience to modern form factors while making provisioning and management simple and cost-effective for IT administrators.

As a Software Development Engineer on the WorkSpaces team, you will own features end-to-end, from design through development, testing, deployment, and operations. You will work closely with senior technical leaders within the team and across AWS, contributing to platform services, system-level components, and the layers in between. If you enjoy solving meaningful technical problems in scalable systems and care about the real-world impact your software has on customers, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, test, and deploy software features across the full development lifecycle for Amazon WorkSpaces, producing high-quality, maintainable code that others on the team can extend.
- Collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and cross-functional partners across AWS to define technical solutions that address customer needs and align with long-term architectural strategy.
- Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes that continuously improve system reliability and performance.
- Coach other engineers through code reviews and design discussions, sharing knowledge that raises the technical bar across the team.
- Evaluate new technologies and approaches, recommending adoption where appropriate to improve scalability, security, or developer productivity within the WorkSpaces platform.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics from a feature you shipped earlier in the week, then join a design discussion with teammates about a new provisioning workflow. After lunch, you pair with a colleague on a tricky integration test, provide feedback on a code review, and wrap up by documenting an architectural decision for the team wiki. Your work spans the full stack, and you regularly interact with product managers and partner teams to ensure what you build solves real customer problems.

About the team
The AWS WorkSpaces team builds and operates Amazon's cloud desktop platform, serving IT administrators and end users who need secure, scalable virtual desktops across devices. We are a group of engineers, product managers, and operations specialists who collaborate closely to ship features that simplify desktop provisioning and management at scale. Our inclusive team culture values continuous learning and thoughtful experimentation, and you will play a direct role in expanding our platform capabilities and improving the customer experience.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer

About Dili

Dili builds software that helps construction and clean-energy companies manage complex prevailing wage, apprenticeship, and labor compliance requirements.

We started Dili because labor compliance is still handled through a mix of spreadsheets, PDFs, manual review, and institutional knowledge, despite determining whether some of the largest construction projects in the country are compliant.

Today, we’re a team of roughly 30, including a small engineering team working closely with our in-house Compliance team. We’re building the infrastructure to turn complex regulatory requirements into software that can be evaluated consistently, explained clearly, and audited.

About the role

Our compliance engine evaluates payroll, timekeeping, worker classifications, prevailing wage rates, apprenticeship requirements, and documentation across frameworks including federal Davis-Bacon, IRA requirements, state prevailing wage laws, and programs such as NYSERDA and Illinois Shines.

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own automated product quality, with a particular focus on formally validating our compliance engine and preventing regressions.

This is not primarily a manual QA role. You’ll build the systems that let us enumerate the compliance scenarios we support, tie them to the underlying regulations, automate their validation, and confidently determine whether a release is correct.

You’ll work directly with engineers and our Compliance team to turn regulations and interpretations into deterministic, executable tests.

What you'll own

  • Build and maintain a registry of compliance scenarios across supported frameworks
  • Translate regulations, agency guidance, and internal compliance interpretations into structured, testable cases
  • Include citations to the authoritative regulatory or program sources behind expected behavior
  • Develop automated tests that formally verify our compliance engine
  • Test interactions between overlapping federal, state, and program-specific requirements
  • Cover edge cases, exceptions, remediation flows, and previously identified production issues
  • Make scenarios easy for our Compliance team to review, update, and extend
  • Expand automated coverage across high-risk product workflows
  • Build and improve integration, API, end-to-end, and regression test suites
  • Establish automated quality gates and release-readiness criteria
  • Improve visibility into scenario coverage, failures, and known gaps

What we're trying to build

We want our test infrastructure to become an executable specification of the Dili compliance engine.

For each scenario, we should be able to define:

  • the applicable regulation or program requirement, with citation
  • the relevant project, payroll, worker, wage, and apprenticeship inputs
  • the expected compliance determination
  • the expected calculations, issues, remediation, and reporting behavior

These scenarios should be understandable by Compliance, version-controlled, automatically executable, and tied directly to release readiness.

Your first 90 days

First 30 days

  • Learn the architecture of the compliance engine and how our engineering and Compliance teams currently validate changes
  • Map at least one major compliance framework into a structured set of scenarios
  • Identify the highest-risk gaps in our existing automated coverage

By 60 days

  • Build the initial version of the compliance scenario registry
  • Automate a meaningful set of high-priority scenarios, including regulatory citations and expected outcomes
  • Establish a repeatable process for turning production defects into regression tests

By 90 days

  • Have critical compliance scenarios running automatically in CI
  • Give Engineering and Compliance clear visibility into coverage, failures, and known gaps
  • Establish release-readiness criteria that provide concrete evidence that changes to the compliance engine are safe to ship

Must have

  • Strong experience in software QA, quality engineering, or test automation
  • Strong Python skills
  • Experience building automated integration and end-to-end test suites
  • Experience integrating testing into CI/CD and release processes
  • Ability to test a Python/React application in an AWS environment
  • Ability to systematically reason about complex combinations of rules, inputs, and expected outcomes
  • Ability to turn written requirements into precise, deterministic test cases
  • Strong attention to traceability: not just “did this test pass?”, but “why is this the expected behavior, and what requirement supports it?”
  • Ability to work closely with engineers and domain experts to resolve ambiguity

Nice to have

  • Recent hands-on experience with Playwright

title: Vikarierande lokalvårdare till städenheten
description:
I Lycksele kommun är vi övertygade om att ett välkomnande förhållningssätt och gemensamma värderingar stärker kommunen och dess attraktionskraft. Kommunen vill utvecklas till en välkomnande kommun med högt attraktionsvärde, där talanger tas om hand och utvecklas och kommunmedborgare, kunder, leverantörer och andra som en kommun har kontakt med får ett professionellt bemötande och god service. Lycksele kommun har en framtidstro, drivkraft och engagemang som för oss framåt. Vår värdegrund bygger på Medkänsla, Tillsammans och Drivkraft.

OM JOBBET

Vi söker timvikarier till städenheten.

Städenheten ingår i verksamhetsområdet Samhällsbyggnad och vi utför städuppdrag åt Fastighetsenheten. Vi strävar efter att erbjuda en kvalitativ lokalvård till rimlig kostnad för våra kunder. Som lokalvårdare har du en viktig roll i att skapa rena, trivsamma och välskötta miljöer för både medarbetare, besökare och kommunens verksamheter.

Arbetsuppgifterna består främst av sedvanlig lokalvård, men även av exempelvis maskinell rengöring i samband med storstädning. Arbetet är varierat och du arbetar både tillsammans med kollegor och självständigt. Tunga lyft kan förekomma.

Arbetstiden är förlagd måndag till fredag, dagtid.

Som timvikarie får du möjlighet att lära känna olika delar av kommunens verksamhet och bli en viktig del av vårt team. Vi söker dig som kan hoppa in vid behov och som trivs med ett arbete där du får ta ansvar och se konkreta resultat av ditt arbete.

DIN PROFIL

Vi tror på rätt kompetens på rätt plats.

Det är meriterande om du har utbildning eller erfarenhet inom lokalvård, men det är inget krav. Det viktigaste är att du är noggrann, ansvarsfull och har en vilja att ge god service.

Du behöver ha goda kunskaper i svenska, framför allt god läsförståelse (motsvarande lägst SFI D-nivå om du har svenska som andraspråk). Du behöver även ha B-körkort och körvana av bilar med såväl manuell som automatisk växellåda. Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra och har lätt för att anpassa dig när förutsättningarna förändras. Eftersom du möter både kunder och kollegor i ditt arbete är du serviceinriktad, har ett positivt förhållningssätt och bidrar till ett gott samarbete.

Som lokalvårdare är du en viktig representant för städenheten och kommunen. Därför värdesätter vi att du tar ansvar för ditt arbete, är noggrann med detaljerna och känner stolthet över att leverera ett arbete med god kvalitet.

Vi är en värderingsstyrd organisation och vill att ditt bemötande och dina handlingar samspelar med vår värdegrund – Medkänsla, Tillsammans och Drivkraft. Vi lägger därför stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

VI ERBJUDER DIG

I Lycksele kommun är människor den främsta resursen. Det är personalresurserna som genererar värde, kvalitet och innehåll i våra verksamheter. Vi eftersträvar att vara en attraktiv arbetsgivare där varje medarbetares förmågor får komma till uttryck och utvecklas genom ett arbetsklimat som är baserat på öppenhet, tillit och dialog. Medarbetare i Lycksele kommun ska ha möjlighet till balans i arbetslivet, vara delaktig och få möjligheten att stärkas och utvecklas i sin yrkesroll.

Som anställd i Lycksele kommun följer ett antal personalförmåner. För mer information om personalförmåner, se länk:

https://www.lycksele.se/kommun/naringsliv-och-arbete/jobba-hos-oss/lycksele-kommun-som-arbetsgivare/vart-erbjudande/

För mer information om hur det är att leva, bo och arbeta i Lycksele, se länk:

http://www.lycksele.se/levailycksele

OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN

Varaktighet: Timvikariat

Omfattning: 75-100%

Tillträde: Omgående eller efter överenskommelse

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuella löner, vänligen ange löneanspråk i din ansökan.

Är du intresserad av att veta löneintervall för tjänsten kan du ta kontakt med våra löneadministratörer på tel. 0950-162 00.

Vissa tjänster i Lycksele kommun omfattas av registerkontroll och du kommer då behöva lämna ett registerutdrag från Polisens misstanke- och/eller belastningsregister inför anställning.

I Lycksele kommun arbetar alla tillsammans och den mångfald som kommunen representerar är en drivkraft i utvecklingen framåt. Vi arbetar aktivt för en arbetsmiljö med jämställda förhållanden och värdesätter de kvaliteter som mångfald tillför organisationen.

Eftersom Lycksele kommun är ett samiskt förvaltningsområde kan kunskaper i samiska vara meriterande i vissa fall.

I Lycksele kommun kan du inom ramen för din ordinarie tjänst arbeta med vår värdegrund som värdskapare. För mer information prata med rekryterande chef.

I Lycksele kan du kombinera ditt vanliga arbete med en deltidsanställning som brandman-/kvinna. Kontakta räddningstjänsten, 0950-162 06, om du är intresserad av att arbeta som deltidsbrandman.

Känner du, utifrån vad du läst om oss – att du skulle passa in hos oss på städenheten? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan märkt med ref nr 1425, senast 2026-12-31. Rekrytering sker löpande. Du ansöker via knappen nedan eller via brev till Lycksele kommun, Kommunstyrelsens förvaltning, 921 81 Lycksele.

title: Construction Safety Site Supervisor (Field Based)
description:
ERM is hiring a Construction Safety Site Supervisor in Allentown, PA to provide on-site support for our key manufacturing client. In this critical role, you will be responsible for leading a safety team for construction activities, engaging with project and construction leaders, and ensuring health and safety compliance with applicable regulations and existing company standards. You will be present during all site activities and responsible for all health and safety activities, and the delegation of duties to other project team members. This is full-time (40 hours per week), limited-term role with a duration of 1 year, extendable.

Responsibilities:

The Construction Safety Site Supervisor will be responsible for overseeing all safety aspects of the construction site during the installation of heavy equipment and machinery.

Core Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and Enforce Safety Plans: Create, implement, and enforce site-specific safety plans, programs, and procedures.

  • Conduct Inspections and Risk Assessments: Perform regular, documented site inspections and ongoing risk assessments to identify potential hazards associated with heavy machinery operation, lifting/rigging, and general construction activities.

  • Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Monitor the site to ensure full compliance with all applicable health and safety regulations and standards (e.g., OSHA), maintaining all required records and documentation.

  • Provide Training and Orientation: Conduct safety orientations for new workers and subcontractors, lead daily safety briefings/toolbox talks, and provide specific training on safety procedures such as lockout/tag-out (LOTO), confined space entry, and fall protection.

  • Manage Equipment Safety: Ensure all heavy equipment and machinery undergo regular inspections by qualified personnel or engineers, are properly maintained, and are operated only by trained and authorized workers.

  • Oversee Personnel Safety: Verify that all personnel are using and wearing appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) correctly and following established safe work practices for their tasks.

  • Incident Management: Document, investigate, and report all workplace incidents, near-misses, and injuries to determine root causes and implement effective corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

  • Coordinate with Stakeholders: Serve as the primary point of contact for safety-related inquiries, collaborating with project managers, subcontractors, and safety inspectors to address concerns and promote a strong safety culture.

  • Manage Emergency Preparedness: Identify foreseeable emergency scenarios (e.g., fires, spills, machinery accidents) and develop, communicate, and drill emergency response plans.

Requirements:

  • A minimum of 7 years of experience in construction, with a focus on sites involving heavy equipment and machinery, including prior supervisory or leadership experience.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Occupational Health and Safety or related degree preferred.

  • Relevant industry certifications are essential. Common examples in the U.S. include those from the Board of Certified Safety Professionals (BCSP) (e.g., CSP or CHST) or OSHA Safety Certificate/Degree Programs (e.g., OSHA 30-hour Construction).

  • Thorough knowledge of Federal and State OSHA regulations (specifically 29 CFR 1926 for construction) and industry best practices for heavy equipment, rigging, and electrical safety.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills; the ability to read blueprints and technical documents; and strong leadership abilities to manage and motivate diverse teams.

Pay Transparency:

For the Construction Safety Site Supervisor (Field Based) position, we anticipate the yearly salary of $134,370- $159,499 (hourly $64.60– $76.68), limited-term, non-exempt. An employee’s pay position within this range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, and business or organizational needs. We also may have instances where employee’s fall outside of the range based on the factors noted above. This job may be eligible for bonus pay (casual and fixed term/Flexforce employees are NOT bonus eligible).

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical, dental, vision, 401(k), life & disability insurance to benefits eligible* employees.

*Benefits Eligibility is limited to Regular employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week. Fixed-Term employees (including Flexforce) who are regularly scheduled to work 20 hours a week or more are eligible for a limited benefits package. Casual employees are NOT benefits eligible. See your recruiter for more details.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, determinable, and payable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

Who We Are:

As the largest global pure play sustainability consultancy, we partner with the world’s leading organizations, creating innovative solutions to sustainability challenges and unlocking commercial opportunities that meet the needs of today while preserving opportunity for future generations.

At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career. We also see our diversity as a strength that helps us create better solutions for our clients. Our diverse team of world-class experts supports clients across the breadth of their organizations to operationalize sustainability, underpinned by our deep technical expertise in addressing their environmental, health, safety, risk and social issues. We call this capability our “boots to boardroom” approach for its comprehensive service model that allows ERM to develop strategic and technical solutions that advance objectives on the ground or at the executive level.

Please submit your resume and brief cover letter. Based on review of these responses, shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews.

ERM does not accept recruiting agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ERM employees or any other company location. ERM is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

ERM is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Thank you for your interest in ERM!

We offer an extremely generous package including:

Hourly Rate: $28.00 - $30.00/Per Hour (Based on Documented Experience, Qualifications and Market Data)

  • Fantastic employee benefit package
  • Employer contribution to H.S.A.
  • F.S.A. tax savings benefits
  • A 4% dollar-for-dollar company match to the 401k plan with immediate vesting
  • A generous PTO accrual program
  • A PTO cash-out provision
  • Tuition reimbursement program
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Robust employee recognition and appreciation program
  • Quality employee training and development programs
  • Several holidays paid at time and a half
  • Comprehensive Medical Benefits
  • Vision
  • Dental
  • STD/LTD/Voluntary Life
  • Accident, Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity Plans
  • Pet Insurance
  • Discounted auto and home insurance
  • Discounted legal services program
  • Employer-paid life insurance for 1x employee salary
  • Employer-paid assistance program with complimentary counseling, wellness, and legal sessions for employees and household members
  • Complimentary year-long weight loss program
  • Health & Wellness Program with gift card giveaways

What You’ll Do

  • As a Certified Clinical Hemodialysis Technician (CCHT), you will be utilizing your technical, and critical thinking skills daily.
  • You will be responsible for performing and monitoring the actual dialysis treatment under the supervision of the Registered Nurse within the correctional community.

This dialysis unit is located in:

  • Jessup, Maryland within Jessup Correctional Institute

This dialysis unit operates:

  • 3 Days per week, Monday/Wednesday/Friday

As in any setting, this involves teamwork and coordinating care with the healthcare team. In addition to the healthcare team, you are also required to maintain strong relationships, regular communication, and visibility with clients (site Managed Healthcare, DOC/BOP, etc.)

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • Nationally recognized Certified Clinical Hemodialysis Technician certification (CCHT) or equivalent
  • Current CPR certification
  • One year of clinical dialysis experience required

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Ability to read, write, speak, understand, and satisfactorily communicate in English.
  • Strong technical/computer proficiency with laptops, tablets, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, SharePoint, etc.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Understands basic renal function and the consequences of renal failure.
  • Demonstrates basic knowledge of treatment modalities available to ESRD patients.
  • Understands and performs the hemodialysis procedure according to Rendevor Dialysis policies and procedures.
  • Ensures that all safety checks are completed before dialysis is initiated.
  • Monitors and records dialysis treatment parameters such as vital signs, weight changes, etc. and communicates information to licensed personnel.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of sterile technique.
  • Knows and follows all Rendevor Dialysis policies and procedures for infection control and understands the hazards associated with failing to follow those procedures.
  • Performs thorough patient assessments, as evidenced by documentation and feedback to the licensed personnel.
  • Promotes the education of patients and their understanding of their disease and its treatment.
  • Obtains blood samples and culture specimens as ordered and performs routine tests.
  • Administers oxygen as necessary by cannula or mask under direction of the nurse.
  • Participates in CPR as needed.
  • Washes machines, station area and chairs according to established procedures after each patient treatment.
  • Prepares daily dialysis logs and set-ups for each shift of patients as directed.
  • Prepares, records and files laboratory reports as directed.
  • Stocks and orders necessary blood work supplies, e.g., blood tubes, requisitions and envelopes as directed.
  • Helps to maintain a neat and clean environment.
  • Performs all tasks necessary for the safe, smooth, and efficient operation of the unit – this may include, but is not limited to, water checks, opening and closing of the unit, mixing bicarbonate and acid, bath distribution, maintenance of the water treatment system and assisting with stocking of supplies.
  • Participates in the IDT and QAPI committee and attend meetings as needed and/or requested.
  • Identifies and reports concerns, issues, and opportunities for improvement when identified.
  • Participates in performance improvement projects within licensure, certification, and scope of practice.
  • Participates in annual QAPI training and other continuing education, as assigned, and required.
  • Provides suggestions for alternate strategies for indicators not improving.
  • Assists in building and maintaining a facility/clinic culture of safety and quality.
  • Reports errors and near misses so that steps can be taken to prevent recurrence.
  • Reports any negative feedback, complaints, grievances from other staff members, patients, and families.
  • Uses evidence-based guidelines and proper infection control practices.
  • Contributes to harmonious and constructive working relationships with all staff members to promote a positive and productive atmosphere.
  • Ensures the confidentiality of patient, employee, and company information.
  • Participates in self and/or peer evaluations.
  • Promotes a teamwork approach by offering information, advice, and assistance to all unit staff members in a positive, courteous, and cooperative manner.
  • Communicates significant information to appropriate team members and documents in a clear, concise, and accurate manner.
  • Checks email at least weekly and responds appropriately and timely; uses company-provided email for all work-related email communications.
  • Maintains regular and predictable attendance and punctuality.
  • Adheres to all company policies and procedures.
  • Performs other duties as required and/or assigned.

Supervision

This position will report to the Unit Leader.

Background Check

The [California/New York Department of Corrections/Federal Bureau of Prisons] and all applicable law require a comprehensive background check for all employees working in this position. This background check will be conducted after an offer, if any, is made.

Work Environment:

This role exists in a hospital or in the medical unit of a post-acute or correctional facility. This role may include exposure to chemicals and blood-borne pathogens. This role routinely involves the use of both medical and standard office equipment.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, use hands to handle or feel, and reach with hands and arms. This position requires the ability to push, pull, or lift up to 50 pounds. Specific visual abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. The employee is required to work the full schedule which may range from five to fifteen hours per day, based on the unit requirements (i.e. patient census, staffing needs, etc.).

Rendevor Dialysis is an Equal-Opportunity Employer.

title: Senior Associate 1
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.

Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.

That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

Role Overview

The role is responsible for end-to-end fund accounting and NAV oversight for AIF Category II (GIFT/IFSC funds). This position ensures accurate NAV calculation, compliance with IFSCA/SEBI regulations, strong client communication, and smooth day-to-day service delivery. The role also includes team leadership, process improvement, audit support, and participation in automation and migration initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Fund Accounting & NAV Management

  • Plan, schedule, and manage daily workflows for all client deliverables within the team.
  • Review, prepare, and reconcile Daily / Monthly / Quarterly NAVs for AIF Category II funds.
  • Finalize Month-end NAVs and prepare Investor-Level Allocation Reports.
  • Ensure accurate performance fee and management fee calculations, including:
    • Series accounting
    • Equalization accounting
    • Waterfall model calculations
  • Oversee and review:
    • Daily journal entries
    • Management fee calculations
    • Investment valuation
    • Financial and investor reporting
    • Ad-hoc client reporting

Valuation & Pricing Oversight

  • Review and analyze portfolio pricing in accordance with IFSCA / SEBI valuation guidelines.
  • Investigate and resolve pricing exceptions, ensuring proper documentation and approval.
  • Ensure accurate valuation of:
    • Listed & unlisted equity
    • Derivatives
    • Debt instruments, bonds, and debentures

Fees, Accruals & Capital Activities

  • Accrue and amortize non-security-related fees (daily/monthly), including:
    • Management fees
    • Financing and other operational accruals
  • Review and book capital activities such as:
    • Capital calls
    • Distributions
    • Transfers

Compliance & Regulatory Support

  • Ensure compliance with IFSCA / SEBI regulations, particularly for close-ended AIF funds.
  • Support preparation, review, and completion of regulatory filings as per IFSCA guidelines.
  • Ensure adherence to all daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly SLAs.
  • Create and maintain detailed process checklists to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as a primary point of contact for clients on:
    • Daily estimates and NAVs
    • Queries and escalations
    • Reporting discussions
  • Build trusted client relationships through clear, timely, and professional communication.

Audit, Projects & Process Improvement

  • Provide active support during fund audits, including preparation of financial statements.
  • Partner with operations and technology teams on:
    • Automation initiatives
    • Work migrations
    • System conversions and enhancements
  • Drive continuous process improvement and operational excellence.

People & Team Management

  • Manage, mentor, and develop team members.
  • Conduct performance appraisals and provide structured feedback.
  • Support people growth, skill development, and succession planning.
  • Be willing to work additional hours during critical reporting cycles.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Strong experience in AIF Category II structures and GIFT City / IFSC funds.
  • In-depth understanding of:
    • Fund accounting
    • General ledger accounting
    • NAV processes
  • Expertise in valuation of diverse asset classes per SEBI / IFSCA guidelines.
  • Strong knowledge of performance fee, management fee, equalization, and waterfall calculations.

Tools & Systems

  • Hands-on experience or familiarity with Efront / Allvue / Paxus (strong advantage).
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (complex formulas, models, reconciliations).

Education

  • M.Com / CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA

Soft Skills

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and time management capabilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills due to direct client interaction.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

title: Online Notary Public (Remote)
description:
