Join one of the fastest growing companies in Canada! LawDepot is proud to be a seven-time Growth 500 ranked organization and a major player in the Global legal solutions industry. Our mission is to modernize the legal document creation experience by empowering people with fast, easy-to-use, and professional solutions. At LawDepot, we foster a collaborative and inclusive learning culture that values excellence and diversity. Apply today and become a part of our exciting journey!

Position Overview:

LawDepot is currently expanding and looking to recruit an Online Notary Public. You will be responsible for completing remote, online notarizations for our United States–based website users and providing feedback to help improve our platform. While we also serve Canadian customers, this position is dedicated to supporting our U.S. users. This is an independent contractor role, performed remotely. We are primarily looking for candidates with daytime availability during the week, with weekday shifts running from 1–6 p.m. Weekend shifts run from 9 a.m.–6 p.m. and may be a good fit for someone looking for more casual or part-time weekend work. Compensation ranges from $5.00–8.00 for the first notarial act and $2.00–4.00 for each additional act. We also offer Notaries the opportunity to serve as witnesses, earning them $5.00 for each completed session.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Complete the notarization of customer documents

  • Verify the authenticity of important documents while working remotely

  • Explain the notarization process to customers and provide a professional, responsive experience

  • Review and verify signer identity per the commissioning state's requirements

  • Confirm the signer understands the document and is signing willingly

  • Review documents for completeness and correct certificate wording

  • Administer acknowledgement and jurat notarial acts

  • Record each notarization in a digital notary journal as required by state law

  • Certify the authenticity of signatures on important legal documents

  • Serve as a witness for other notaries' sessions when required and available

  • Support product quality by testing features and reporting bugs and improvement ideas to the notary team

  • Manage customer communication through our internal account portal

  • Maintaining certification as mandated by state

  • Assist with testing and quality assurance, when needed

Knowledge and Skill Requirements:

  • More than 6 months of experience in a Remote Online Notary Public role, handling confidential and private customer documents

  • Valid Electronic Notary Public certification in Virginia

  • Commissioned Notary Public in Virginia

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills

  • Technically savvy – ability to learn internal tools and new software

  • Dependable attendance and punctuality.

  • Well-developed interpersonal and organizational skills

  • Ability to resolve standard document issues with minimal assistance

  • Must have minimum $25,000 error and omission insurance coverage (E&O)

  • Must have a working desktop computer/ laptop, webcam, microphone, and high-speed internet connection

title: Centralized Study Analyst

  • Generate Study Reports and perform analysis.

  • CTMS compliance management.
  • Manage project communications.

  • To follow all applicable departmental Standard Operating Procedures and Work Instructions:
  • To complete required trainings according to required timelines.
  • To complete day-to-day tasks ensuring quality and productivity.
  • To manage project and technical documentation in an appropriate manner.
  • To provide administrative and technical support to internal departments and teams as needed.
  • To perform checks to ensure quality of work completed.
  • To ensure timely escalation and issue resolution as needed.
  • To track and report metrics as determined by management according to required timelines.

  • To assist in the preparation of new investigator submission packages for site/regulatory submission.

  • To assist the study start up teams with tasks required for site start up activities.
  • To review, Support, Manage or assist in Managing the site clinical trial contracts in accordance with defined processes and timelines.
  • All other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • University/College Degree (Life Science preferred), or certification in an allied health profession from an appropriate accredited institution (Ex. Nursing certification, Medical or laboratory technology).
  • 03-05 years of work experience in clinical research, including a strong working knowledge of the ICH-GCP guidelines and all other applicable guidelines and regulations.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • At least 2 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Other required work-related experiences:
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and communicate effectively.
  • Demonstrated ability to pay attention to detail.

I rollen som testtekniker arbetar du med tester innan leverans till kund men även med material- och processkvalifikationer för utvecklingsprojekt och framtida produkter. Du kommer arbeta i en renrumsproduktion och ingå i ett team med hög kompetens där ni samarbetar för att nå de gemensamma målen. Ditt huvudfokus är att testa och verifiera digitala- och mikrovågsprodukter för att säkerställa att de uppfyller kraven från kund.

Du kommer exempelvis att:

  • Testa och verifiera hårdvara, både digital och elektrisk samt RF-provning av kort och enheter.
  • Analysera och rapportera testresultat.
  • Arbeta för att kontinuerligt förbättra och effektivisera processerna.
  • Supportera vid felutredning och avvikelsehantering.

VI SÖKER DIG SOM:
  • Har en YH-utbildning som elektronikingenjör, alternativt:
  • Har motsvarande erfarenhet av att arbeta med testning av kretskort.
  • Är teknisk och uppskattar att arbeta hands-on med exempelvis lödning eller att plocka ihop och isär tekniska produkter.
  • Talar och skriver flytande svenska samt engelska då båda språken används i det dagliga arbetet.

Det är meriterande om du:

  • Tidigare har arbetat inom en liknande roll.
  • Tidigare har arbetat i och har kunskap om SAP.
  • Har kunskap inom Lean Production.
  • Har hobbyprojekt inom elektronik med inslag av lödning och testning.

Vidare kommer stor vikt läggas vid personlig lämplighet och vi tror att du som söker är en person med en hög teknisk förmåga som trivs att arbeta med många kontaktytor. Du är driven och engagerad med förmågan att dels vara självgående och ta stort ansvar för ditt arbete samtidigt som du gärna arbetar i ett nära samarbete med dina kollegor. Vidare är du flexibel, noggrann och nyfiken där du ständigt vill lära dig mer och utvecklas.

OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN:

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer vara anställd av Friday.

Denna befattning kräver att du genomgår och blir godkänd vid var tids gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där vår kund har krav på säkerhetsklassplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

ÖVRIG INFORMATION:
  • Omfattning: Heltid.
  • Placering: Göteborg.
  • Start: Omgående, med hänsyn till eventuell uppsägningstid som högst 1-2 månader.
  • Rekryteringsansvarig: Hanna Lejon.
  • Lön: Fast månadslön.

Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urval- och intervjufasen.

OM FRIDAY:

Genom att vara en partner både till våra kandidater och kunder strävar vi efter att hitta den bästa matchningen. Det gör vi genom att lära känna våra kunder och kandidater på riktigt! Vi ser självklart till att kunskaps- och erfarenhetskrav matchar, men framför allt lägger vi vikt vid samsyn kring värderingar och företagskultur som båda parter värdesätter.

Vår passion är att hjälpa människor till rätt roll, arbetsplats och sammanhang inom IT och teknik. Därför grundade vi Friday med ambition att hjälpa dig till jobbet som ger dig fredagskänslan – varje dag! Vi riktar oss främst till dig som är i början av din karriär eller studerar vid högskola/universitet inom IT och Teknik. Vår övertygelse är att människor uppnår sin fulla potential när man ser fram emot att gå till jobbet varje morgon. ”Friday – everyday”, hur låter det?

title: Repair Assessment Technician - Etobicoke ON
description:
The repair assessment technician is responsible for the inspection, assessment, and documentation of customer centrifuge components and rotating assemblies received for repair. This position performs detailed cleaning, visual inspection, non destructive testing, and dimensional inspection to determine the condition of the components and establish the appropriate repair scope

Responsibilities / Tasks

  • Disassemble centrifuge components and rotating assemblies when required
  • Clean, degrease, and decontaminate centrifuge components and assemblies before inspection.
  • Remove process residues, oils, greases, product build up, and surface contaminants from stainless steel parts.
  • Use approved cleaning agents, solvents, tools, and equipment in accordance with established procedures and safety guidelines.
  • Perform visual checks to confirm cleanliness and identify remaining contamination, damage or irregularities.
  • Perform complete visual inspections of centrifuge components and rotating assemblies. Identify cracks, corrosion, erosion, wear, deformation, impact damage, surface defects, and other abnormalities.
  • Perform dye penetrant testing in accordance with applicable procedures and requirements.
  • Handle, move, and stage components safely to prevent damage or recontamination.
  • Escalate critical or unusual findings to the appropriate engineering or management personnel.
  • Perform detailed dimensional inspections of components and assemblies using appropriate precision measuring equipment.
  • Measure critical fits, diameters, lengths, guiding surfaces, sealing surfaces, gasket grooves, bores , shafts, and other critical features.
  • Establish and maintain accurate measurement records and inspection data.
  • Prepare comprehensive inspection reports documenting the condition of customer components.
  • Establish inspection findings as a technical baseline for repair activities and subsequent verification.
  • Maintain accurate and traceable inspection documentation in accordance with company procedures.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area in compliance with company and regulatory standards.
  • Properly store, handle and dispose of cleaning chemicals and waste materials.
  • Use required personal protective equipment at all times.
  • Report equipment issues, safety concerns, or abnormal contamination to supervisors or quality personnel.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to cleanliness, safety, and workflow efficiency.
  • Further duties as assigned by supervisors.

Education and Experience:

  • Technical education in mechanical engineering, industrial mechanics, or equivalent vocational qualification.
  • Additional training in precision measurement and mechanical inspection
  • Training or certification in non destructive testing is preferred.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in mechanical inspection, maintenance, or repair of industrial machinery.
  • Experience with rotating equipment, pumps, centrifuges, turbines, or similar high precision mechanical systems is highly preferred.
  • Proven experience using precision measuring instruments
  • Experience interpreting technical drawings and tolerances.
  • Experience in disassembly and assembly of complex mechanical systems.
  • Experience in industrial repair environments, service workshops, or OEM service organizations is an advantage.

Your Profile / Qualifications

  • Technical/ mechanical background, preferably in industrial machinery , rotating equipment, centrifuges, or similar equipment.
  • Experience with mechanical inspection and precision measurement.
  • Ability to interpret mechanical drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and technical specifications.
  • Experience with precision measuring equipment (metric) such as micrometers, calipers, bore gauges, depth gauges, dial indicators, and other inspection tools.
  • Experience with dye penetrant testing or other non destructive testing method is preferred.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and ability to understand the function and interaction of complex rotating equipment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify subtle defects or dimensional deviations.
  • Ability to accurately document technical findings in written reports.
  • Basic computer skills and ability to work with inspection documentations, photographs, spreadsheets, and company systems.
  • Ability to safely disassemble, handle, and inspect large and precision machined mechanical components.
  • Understanding of cleanliness requirements for precision or industrial equipment.
  • Ability to follow detailed work instructions, safety procedures, and inspection feedback.
  • Ability to safely handle chemicals and use PPE as required.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work as part of a production team.
  • Experience and knowledge rigging, operating cranes, and handling heavy equipment.

title: Coating Wrapper
description:

The purpose of the Coating Wrapper is to be responsible for wrapping finished rolls with plastic and inspecting for backing defects.

title: Graduate Reconciliation Specialist - Automations
description:
LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.


Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.


What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.


With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

About the role

LemFi moves money across borders for people the traditional financial system has underserved. Behind every successful transfer is a reconciliation function that proves every dollar, pound and naira ended up exactly where it was supposed to. This role sits inside the Finance/Reconciliations team and is based in Oslo, working daily with reconciliation colleagues across LemFi's other locations.


You will own the end-to-end daily and monthly reconciliation of an assigned set of processor and bank accounts - investigating breaks to find the cause, not just the amount - and you will spend roughly 30% of your time writing Python and building AI-assisted automations that make the whole cycle faster and more robust. That second half grows as the internal reconciliation tool matures. This is an early-career role and reconciliation experience is not required; the quantitative foundation and the technical instinct are.

What you'll build and own

  • Own the daily and monthly reconciliation of an assigned set of processor and bank accounts end to end - timing differences, reversals, fee legs, FX and trade differences, duplicates and genuinely unsettled transactions.

  • Investigate breaks to find the cause, not only the amount, and chase unsettled money with payment partners and banks until it is recovered.

  • Produce month-end reporting and supporting evidence to audit standard, and keep reconciliation documentation up to date so someone else can run the portfolio.

  • Work with Customer Service, Engineering and Product to resolve customer disputes within SLA.

  • Write Python to automate the repetitive parts of the reconciliation cycle: ingestion, normalisation, matching passes and exception reporting.

  • Use AI coding tools to build automations quickly, get them reviewed, and help build the internal reconciliation tool - writing matching rules, testing against known-good output and documenting the logic.

  • Raise recurring breaks that should be fixed upstream with the relevant owner, rather than clearing the same issue every month.

Your experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in business economics, industrial economics, finance, statistics, applied mathematics, data science or a comparable quantitative subject.

  • Writes Python - able to read, write and debug scripts for data work (pandas or equivalent).

  • Has used AI coding tools to build something that works and can walk us through how it works.

  • Strong numerical reasoning, comfortable with large datasets, and able to explain clearly why a figure is what it is.

  • Advanced Excel and accurate under month-end deadlines, with the judgement to raise something uncertain rather than resolve it quietly.

  • Fluent written and spoken English (Norwegian not required), and the legal right to work in Norway.

Nice to have

  • An internship, thesis or personal project involving real data end to end: sourcing, cleaning, analysing and presenting it.

  • Any exposure to payments, banking, accounting or audit.

  • Understanding of how a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement connect.


Why Join LemFi?

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.

At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions.

You can connect with us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.

title: SAP EWM  Functional Architect, AWS SAP Team

title: junior accountspecialist
description:
Klaar voor een vliegende start van je carrière? Word accountspecialist in Den Haag (o.a. PostNL & Dynalogic)!

Ben jij een geboren regelaar, net afgestudeerd en zoek je een uitdagende eerste of tweede stap met volop doorgroeimogelijkheden? Als accountspecialist ben jij de onmisbare schakel binnen een dynamische, grootschalige logistieke operatie. Je werkt voor toonaangevende namen als PostNL én Dynalogic. Geen dag is hetzelfde, de impact is direct en je bouwt aan een ijzersterke basis voor je verdere carrière!

dit krijg je van ons

Bij ons combineer je de slagkracht van een marktleider met de vrijheid van ondernemership. Geen vastomlijnde kaders, maar de ruimte om je eigen koers te varen en je werkweek flexibel in te richten. Samen met ambitieuze collega’s ga je voor het hoogst haalbare. Heb jij de drive om het verschil te maken? Dan bieden wij je uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden die passen bij jouw inzet en lef.

  • salaris & benefit budget: Je start met een bruto basissalaris tussen €2.850 - €3.300 passend bij je ervaring. Dit wordt aangevuld met een maandelijks Benefit Budget van 12,347% (€351,- tot €407,- bruto). Je bepaalt zelf hoe je dit budget inzet: laat het maandelijks uitbetalen, spaar het op, of gebruik het voor extra vakantiedagen en fiscale voordelen zoals je sportabonnement of de aflossing van je studieschuld;

  • contractvorm: Je stapt in met een jaarcontract, met een wederzijdse proeftijd van één maand om elkaar goed te leren kennen;

  • onkostenvergoeding: Maandelijks ontvang je een onkostenvergoeding à €61,- netto bovenop je bruto salaris;

  • aandelenprogramma: Doe mee aan onze aandelenregeling en profiteer direct: jouw inleg tot 5% van je salaris wordt door ons met 100% verdubbeld. Een mooie manier om samen met ons mee te groei;

  • bonusregeling: Hard werken wordt beloond. Je kunt rekenen op een bonusregeling waarbij je een extraatje ontvangt op basis van de resultaten van de organisatie;

  • talentontwikkeling: Jouw ontwikkeling staat voorop. Dankzij onze trainingen en doorgroeikansen bouwen we samen aan jouw toekomst binnen ons bedrijf.

dit ben jij

Als startende professional schakel je moeiteloos tussen verschillende taken en behoud je het overzicht wanneer de planning verandert. Met jouw energie en communicatiekracht los je problemen op voor ze ontstaan en maak je makkelijk verbinding met zowel medewerkers als de klant. Wat we verder zoeken:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding (ideaal voor starters);

  • Beschikbaarheid voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;

  • Woonachtig in (de regio) Den Haag/ Zoetermeer.

wat ga je doen?

Je werkt op de Inhouse vestiging van Randstad in Den Haag, midden in het centrum van de actie. Hier ben je verantwoordelijk voor de personele bezetting van grote logistieke spelers: marktleider PostNL en gespecialiseerde logistieke partners zoals Dynalogic. Jij zorgt ervoor dat de planning altijd strak staat en perfect aansluit op de dagelijkse stroom van pakketten. Gehuld in Randstad-uniform ben je regelmatig op de vloer te vinden tussen de teamleiders en medewerkers.

  • Slim plannen: Je stelt de personeelsplanningen op voor meerdere accounts, speelt in op piekmomenten en verwerkt wijzigingen ad-hoc.

  • Coachen en begeleiden: Je bent de vertrouwenspersoon voor flexmedewerkers, voert verzuim- en functioneringsgesprekken en helpt hen in hun ontwikkeling.

  • Schakelen met de klanten: Je neemt deel aan de dagstarts met teamleiders (van onder meer PostNL en Dynalogic), evalueert prestaties en denkt proactief mee over procesverbeteringen.

  • Instroom regelen: Je geeft recruiters duidelijke input voor de werving van nieuw talent en verzorgt een warm welkom op locatie.

het team

Je komt terecht in een warm, hecht en ervaren team op locatie in Den Haag. De sfeer is informeel, de lijnen zijn kort en er is altijd ruimte om succes te vieren. Omdat je voor verschillende accounts werkt, is je rol extra divers. Je wisselt werken op kantoor af met aanwezigheid op de werkvloer, wat zorgt voor een dynamische werkweek met veel afwisseling en werkplezier!

over ons

Bij Randstad Groep Nederland werk je bij de wereldwijde marktleider in HR-dienstverlening. Wij geloven in de kracht van talent en helpen professionals bij elke stap in hun loopbaan. Onze werkomgeving is ondernemend en vol energie: je krijgt alle ruimte om initiatief te tonen en te blijven groeien.

solliciteer direct

Zie jij jezelf al aan de slag gaan als Accountspecialist in Den Haag? Reageer dan direct via de sollicitatieknop!

Heb je eerst nog vragen over de rol, de accounts of de werksfeer? Neem gerust contact op met onze Talent Acquisition Specialist Kelvin Silvius via +31 (0)6 27 45 42 02 (bellen of WhatsApp) of mail naar kelvin.silvius@randstadgroep.nl.

title: Senior Consultant IT Governance (m/f/d)
description:

You will act as the central orchestrator, connecting all governance domains, ensuring compliance, transparency, and harmonized execution, and enabling the OneIT Governance Model to function end‑to‑end. This position serves as a point of integration for governance activities, lifecycle management of policy documentation, escalation routing, KPI tracking, and cross‑segment collaboration.

Ensure consistent policy interpretation and governance alignment across all functions (Enterprise Architecture, ITSM, Risk, Security, Finance, Infrastructure, Portfolio Management). Steer and coordinate IT governance activities across the organization, ensuring structured oversight and strategic alignment.

  • Governance Coordination & Decision Support: Organize and facilitate strategic governance boards and forums to ensure consistent decision-making and alignment across segments. Prepare decision papers, agendas, and reports (suitable for executive leadership) for governance bodies to support decision-making.

  • Cross-Segment Engagement & Harmonization: Act as the integrator and facilitator across segments for governance domain activities, harmonize domain-specific governance requirements and drive convergence of operating models (OneIT).

  • Governance KPIs Oversight: Track, analyze, and report on governance-related KPIs, providing insights into policy adoption, compliance levels, and governance maturity. Facilitate cross-domain remediation plans and ensure timely closure of governance-related actions.

Your qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in IT governance, IT management, compliance, audit, enterprise architecture, or service management

  • Strong understanding of IT governance frameworks (COBIT, ITIL, ISO standards, TOGAF)

description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



The Legal Solution Consultant (LATAM) partners with the regional field sales team to uncover complex legal workflows, regulatory challenges, and enterprise compliance needs across Latin American markets—with a core emphasis on Mexico. In this role, you will act as a trusted legal and technical advisor, translating intricate contract lifecycle management (CLM), e-signature regulations, and compliance requirements into high-impact digital solutions. Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • Juris Doctor (JD), LL.B., or Bachelor’s Degree in Law (Licenciatura en Derecho)

  • 8+ years of total professional experience, combining legal practice, legal technology consulting, or enterprise SaaS technical Pre-Sales (Solution Engineering / Solution Consulting)

Preferred

  • Experience navigating public sector (Federal/State government) procurement processes and regulatory landscapes in Mexico and LATAM

  • Familiarity with enterprise software integration (CRM, ERP, ECM), REST/SOAP APIs, and basic web standards (HTML, XML, structured data)

  • Formal training in value-selling methodologies (e.g., Solution Selling, Command of the Message, Challenger)


Life at Docusign



Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

title: Detention Classification Specialist
description:
Minimum Requirements

  1. Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Sociology, Psychology, Behavioral Science or related field.
  2. A minimum of two (2) years previous experience in the criminal justice/social service system.
  3. Demonstrated experience must include interviewing clients to assess mental and physical status, using data and other objective criteria to develop client-based decisions, crisis intervention and assessment.
  4. An equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered. Such experience must be clearly documented for consideration.

Nature of Work

Under administrative direction, employees in this classification function in an assigned area relevant to the inmate population of the Sheriff’s Office Department of Detention. Assignments include, but are not limited to, the assessment of inmates to determine risk, reviewing criminal history information and past incarceration records, evaluating the threat level of to self or others, and recommending housing placement and the continued reassessment of inmates during their incarceration. The assessment may include appropriate referrals to the medical/mental health unit. Work may include an assessment of an inmate’s needs concerning referrals to detention programs. Position performs liaison work between inmates and internal departments, judges, state attorney, public and private defense and other external agencies. Employees in this classification exercise considerable independent judgment within the framework of approved classification criteria, existing laws and departmental policies. Performs related work as directed.

Essential Functions/Physical Requirements

The list of essential functions, as outlined herein, is intended to be representative of the tasks performed within this classification. It is not necessarily descriptive of any one position in the class. The omission of an essential function does not preclude management from assigning duties not listed herein if such functions are a logical assignment to the position.

Interviews inmates after admission to the facility for the purpose of analyzing risk factors, reviewing criminal history, evaluating potential threat to self/others and recommending housing placement; assigns custody levels on established parameters.

Conducts inmate orientation with respect to facility policies and procedures and program availability in the various facilities.

Makes recommendations concerning inmates’ needs, e.g., medical care, mental health needs, protective custody, work assignments.

Performs periodic review/reassessment of inmate status; modifies housing recommendations as needed; responsible for documenting all inmate movement/transfer.

Processes inmates for transfer to other facilities or outside institutions by coordinating the transfer with medical, property, housing and transport; may include preparing status reports for the receiving institution.

Reviews inmate requests for relocation to participate in programs and makes recommendations as to appropriateness for participation.

Responds to inmates’ general information requests in both written and verbal contexts, i.e. court system, court dates, referrals.

Communicates with internal departments, and external social and professional entities on behalf of inmates.

Develops status reports on inmates as required through departmental requests for the court; prepares statistical reports as required.

Maintains complete and accurate documentation concerning activities conducted during the course of daily classification duties.

Ensures compliance with department policies and procedures and established regulatory standards.

Performs related duties as directed.


Tasks involve the ability to exert light physical effort in sedentary to light work, but which may involve some lifting, carrying, pushing and/or pulling of objects and materials of light weight (5-10 pounds). Tasks may involve extended periods of time at a keyboard or workstation. May require occasional lifting, carrying, pushing, and/or pulling of heavier objects. Tasks are performed in a corrections environment where proper provisions are in place in terms of employee security and protection. Due to the nature and location of the work environment, tasks include potential for intermittent exposure to disagreeable elements consistent with routine conditions in a corrections detainment environment.

Broward Sheriff’s Office is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, Broward Sheriff’s Office will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages both prospective and current employees to discuss potential accommodations with the employer.

Recruitment Information

Applicants who qualify will be subject to an extensive selection process and screening program, which may include, but not be limited to evaluation of training and experience; written test; computer based test; interview; polygraph examination; psychological evaluation; employment record, fingerprint and background check; medical examination; and drug screen. The expected duration of the selection process varies by position and could last 10 to 12 weeks. Reapplication will be determined on a case-by-case basis.

BSO is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, citizenship status, color, disability, marital status, national origin, race, religion, sex, or sexual orientation. Veterans' preference per Florida law.

Once you successfully submit your application, you will receive a confirmation e-mail. If you do not receive this e-mail, please contact Applicant Support for any inquiries.

title: Senior Firmware Engineer, Industrial Robotics Group
description:
Amazon Industrial Robotics is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction.

If you’re passionate about actuation and robotics systems, and have a strong interest in safety and performance, then we’d like to talk to you about becoming part of an organization with global impact on millions of customers.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the architectural design of complex control systems end to end, partnering with peers and adjacent teams to drive innovative solutions to the hardest problems.
• Take full, uncompromising ownership of the firmware development lifecycle, from concept through field deployment, and stand behind the results you ship.
• Lead functional and safety requirements elicitation, moving quickly and decisively to unlock maximum system performance for our customers.
• Drive system bring-up, root cause analysis, and systematic troubleshooting with a bias for action, resolving issues at the source rather than the symptom.
• Deliver high-impact feedback in peer reviews and communicate crisply and candidly with technical leadership.
• Engineer solutions that strike an uncompromising balance between top-tier performance and reliability, and relentlessly raise the bar on both.
• Own stakeholder communication and technical reporting, keeping the right people informed and aligned.
• Drive system commissioning and field deployment, taking accountability for results in real-world conditions.

A day in the life
As a Senior Firmware Engineer, you will partner with cross-functional teams to design, build, test, and debug complex, cutting-edge robotic systems, and you will own the outcome from the first design sketch to live field deployment. No two days look the same, and every one moves fast. You lead and shape design discussions, brainstorm bold new approaches to the hardest problems in robotics, and turn ambitious product concepts into firmware that ships. You act with urgency and sound judgment, making the calls that keep the team moving without ever compromising quality or safety. When it is time to prove the work, you write automated tests that validate new features and run live testing to debug and root cause issues at the source, staying accountable until the system performs, holds up under real-world conditions, and delivers for our customers. You do not wait to be asked, you see what needs to happen and you make it happen.

title: Sr. Program Manager, RTI
description:
The Recruiting Technology Integration (RTI) organization is seeking a Sr. Program Manager to define and drive the delivery of product features and process improvements that enable recruitment at scale. This role functions as the business owner and strategic lead for one or more features within the Talent Acquisition product ecosystem, partnering closely with business customers and technical teams to translate operational needs into measurable solutions.
You are responsible for the planning, execution, and delivery of one or more features related to existing Talent Acquisition products. You may be embedded within a single team, focused on the vision for their product features, or you may work across teams. You know how to delight customers. Your work impacts a product's customer experience (CX), feature usability, success metrics (e.g., customer delight, adoption, quality, ROI), team goals, and may impact organization-level goals. You work independently, seeking direction when needed.

What We're Looking For
Success in this role requires exceptional written and verbal communication skills, strong influence, and structured thinking. You must be able to craft compelling narratives for senior leadership, facilitate complex discussions across diverse stakeholder groups, and drive clarity across multiple product teams without direct authority. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity, translating complex business needs into actionable requirements, maintaining momentum across interdependent workstreams, and balancing competing priorities while keeping customer needs at the center of decision-making.
You are data-driven and understand a broad range of analytics techniques. Your verbal and written style is clear and concise — you are able to transform raw thoughts into clear documentation and direction.


Key job responsibilities
Product Strategy & Customer Obsession
• Act as the Voice of the Customer, articulating recruiter, candidate, and stakeholder needs and translating them into clear business use cases, prioritizing technical requirements with product managers, and compelling narratives for senior leadership
• Follow Amazon program management best-practices and work backward from the customer; participate in in-person customer research and user studies
• Identify interesting use cases and clarify how they differ from existing solutions; provide stakeholders with insights into market opportunities
• Refine business use cases and justifications to support prioritization decisions and demonstrate return on investment
• Ensure usability studies include diverse customer sets and perspectives
Requirements & Delivery
• Act as the programmatic business owner for Amazon Talent Acquisition product or process domains, working with subject-matter experts to design ideal-state workflows, identifying where to improve process and technology, and standardizing processes to remove operational complexity and enable effective product outcomes
• Translate customer pain-points and operational needs into clear functional requirements or UX designs in partnership with technical teams for strategic documentation (e.g., PR/FAQs, BRD, LRD)
• Partner with UX designers to mockup and prototype features (when appropriate), confirming the design meets customer and business needs.
• Ensure plans account for compliance requirements (e.g., legal, financial, data privacy/security), localization (e.g., language, regional requirements), and accessibility (e.g., people with disabilities)
Stakeholder Communication & Alignment
• Communicate clearly and directly with customers and end users, ensuring the right information reaches the right people at the right time.
• Establish and maintain mechanisms to keep all stakeholders aligned on expectations, progress, and delivery timelines, proactively escalating impasses to maintain momentum
• Identify "Go to Market (GTM)" stakeholders and clearly articulate feature scope, timeline, owners, risks, and mitigation steps
• Accelerate progress by driving crisp and timely decisions, clearing blockers (e.g., "Path to Green"), and escalating appropriately
• Drive constructive discussions that help users, designers, developers, legal, compliance, and sales teams reach consensus
Data & Performance
• Be data-driven; understand the risk of acting on a vocal minority and apply a broad range of analytics techniques appropriately
• Define, monitor, and build solutions that improve key success metrics (KPIs); identify and research anomalies in performance and escalate findings or drive resolution
• Analyze product feature launches and perform post-mortem analysis on efficacy, issues experienced, and lessons learned
• Develop and deliver operational reporting for updated processes to drive standards across multiple business segments at launch.
Change Management & Launch
• Develop and execute change management strategies to support the successful rollout and sustained adoption of new features
• Apply process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, DMAIC, or equivalent frameworks) to map current-state and future-state workflows, identify inefficiencies, and define scalable processes and mechanisms for recruiting or PXT-related operations
• Develop and deliver Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and operational readiness materials to ensure teams are equipped and prepared at launch
• Oversee the launch process, including deployment to Beta/Production; review features to ensure they meet acceptance criteria and escalating when needed if features do not meet user expectations
• Manage post-launch support plans (e.g., triage, issue/ticket management), run retrospectives, and hold post-mortems
• Drive adoption by helping users understand the reasons and benefits for product and process changes with documentation and resources, and ensuring users have proper training to use new capabilities
People & Culture
• Help recruit, interview, mentor, and develop others



A day in the life
In this role, you will work across technical, programmatic, and recruitment teams, serving as the connective tissue between Talent Acquisition business needs and technical solution delivery. On a typical day, you may partner with technical product managers to define business requirements and clarify use cases, review designs and workflows to ensure business needs are fully represented, analyze performance metrics to identify optimization opportunities, and coordinate and action launch readiness efforts and change management.

description:

Location: United States (Remote) | Reports to: Head of CX & CRM / Technology Leadership | Employment Type: Full-time, Exempt

About Howden

Howden is a global, employee-owned insurance group built on entrepreneurial spirit, collaboration, and a people-first culture. With 20,000 colleagues across 100+ countries, we empower talented specialists to make a meaningful difference for clients, colleagues, and the business.

The role acts as the senior solution design authority for Salesforce and the broader platform ecosystem, including Applied EPIC, Document Management, SharePoint, AI native platforms, Zywave MiEdge, client and colleague portals, and future enterprise applications.

This person bridges business strategy and technical execution by partnering with business leaders, product managers, architects, engineering teams, vendors, and operations stakeholders to define scalable designs, future-state experiences, integration patterns, data standards, and adoption-focused solutions.

  • Connected solution designs that unify Salesforce and core business platforms into seamless client and colleague experiences.

  • Clear solution architecture, process, integration, and data documentation adopted by delivery teams.

  • Consistent enterprise standards for integrations, data exchange, workflow orchestration, and user experience.

  • Strong business, product, architecture, and engineering partnership leading to measurable delivery outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end business and technology solutions across Howden’s strategic platforms, translating objectives, journey maps, and product requirements into scalable designs.

Enterprise Integration, Data & Ecosystem Design

  • Define logical data models, data quality standards, governance expectations, and consistent management of accounts, prospects, clients, policies, opportunities, activities, documents, and relationships.

  • Partner with architecture, engineering, analytics, and data teams to ensure secure, scalable, maintainable solutions that support reporting, insights, AI, and operational decision-making.

Vendor Evaluation, Delivery Partnership & Governance

  • Evaluate new technologies, vendor solutions, proof-of-concepts, and capability assessments against business objectives, integration needs, operational impacts, and enterprise standards.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, QA, Operations, and vendors throughout discovery, design, build, testing, release, and post-launch optimization.

  • Review requirements, user stories, process designs, technical specifications, and delivered solutions to ensure alignment to business outcomes and experience goals.

  • Establish reusable design standards, reference architectures, solution playbooks, governance artifacts, and documentation for processes, integrations, data flows, and solution decisions.

  • Work collaboratively with global engineering teams to ensure continuous delivery is aligned with the design principles.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or related field.

  • 8+ years in solution architecture, business architecture, CRM platforms, enterprise technology delivery, or related roles.

  • Deep Salesforce experience, including Financial Services Cloud, Service Cloud, platform automation, reporting, integrations, data models, and AI-enabled capabilities.

  • Experience integrating Salesforce with agency management systems, document platforms, marketing technologies, telephony, and operational applications.

  • Strong understanding of APIs, middleware, event-based architectures, workflow orchestration, data modeling, master data management, governance, and enterprise information architecture.

  • Proven ability to lead workshops, requirements analysis, design sessions, agile planning, backlog refinement, and stakeholder alignment.

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, or System Architect.

  • Experience with Applied EPIC, insurance brokerage platforms, enterprise architecture frameworks, modern integration platforms, AI-enabled workflows, automation, or intelligent document processing.

  • Experience in Insurance Brokerage, Employee Benefits, Property & Casualty, Private Client, or Financial Services.

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

  • We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

  • We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

title: Medico-legal clinical analyst
description:

  • Candidates should possess a background in Medicine or a clinically related field, with the ability to understand diagnoses, treatments, and care pathways in detail.
  • Candidates should possess Project Management skills to prioritize tasks, manage multiple cases, and meet deadlines in a structured, reliable manner.
  • Relevant qualifications such as a medical degree, nursing degree, patient safety or other clinical training are highly beneficial; experience in medico-legal, clinical audit, or healthcare quality improvement is an advantage.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

About the Role

This is a great opportunity for a data analyst to join the Howden UK&I data team to assist with a large-scale policy admin system migration project on an 18-month fixed term contract. The role will support the project by helping the business prepare for the migration by providing an understanding of the data and processes needed to successfully migrate our client base across to the new system, as well as monitoring any changes in our key business KPIs before and after migration to assess the impact to the business and flag any potential issues. We are a remote team; however, we do like to meet up from time to time to collaborate in person.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the migration delivers the expected business outcomes by providing data-driven insight, monitoring customer and business impacts, proactively identifying risks, and supporting stakeholders in making informed decisions throughout the migration lifecycle

Key Responsibilities

  • Manipulate, analyse, and interpret large datasets to uncover insights and support commercial and operational decision‑making relating to the project
  • Communicate insights clearly to colleagues across the organisation, turning complex findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Proactively identify, investigate and escalate data quality issues, migration risks and performance impacts that could affect customers, trading performance, operational processes or regulatory outcomes.

title: Fish Hatchery Specialist 3 - Sol Duc Hatchery - Permanent - 2026-07401
description:
Description



Classification- Fish Hatchery Specialist 3

Job Status- Full-Time/Permanent
WDFW Program- Fish Program – Hatcheries Division
Duty Station- Sol Duc Hatchery – Beaver, Washington – Pacific County

Housing- Housing is provided

*Standby- Standby is currently assigned


Learn more about being a member of Team WDFW!


Photo Caption: Hatchery steelhead broodstock – Photo Credit: WDFW


Support salmon and steelhead conservation efforts while providing sustainable recreational, tribal, and commercial opportunities in the state of Washington.


As part of the Sol Duc Hatchery team, you will perform scientific, technical, and related maintenance duties within the hatchery facilities and trap sites.


Serve as a leader and role model for staff and volunteers by fostering an environment that ensures fish population goals are met while prioritizing safety, identifying areas for improvement, and creating educational opportunities.



What to Expect:

Among the varied range of responsibilities held within this role, the Fish Hatchery Specialist 3 will,


Perform Fish Culture:

  • Carry out sound fish culture practices to meet program goals.
  • Project and monitor fish growth and feed requirements.
  • Perform fish inventories, splits, grading, marking trailer inventories, weight samples, and plants.
  • Lead crew members in feeding, cleaning, and transferring fish, determining the proper rearing densities for ponding and planting fish.
  • Collect genetic samples (opercula punches, dorsal ray samples) for genetic population analysis.
  • Collect various types of biological and environmental samples such as fish tissue, fish scales, ovarian fluid, water and feed for transport to laboratories; sample preparation includes dissection, vacuum filtration, and aseptic technique.
  • Coordinate on-station and off-site fish planting activities.
  • Independently implement on-site biological research projects to collect genetic samples, train lower-level staff in proper procedures in research protocols, as well as provide input into design changes driven by findings at the facility.


Crew Leader:

  • Monitor projects/activities to ensure completion in a timely manner.
  • Ensure that the staff is productive and well informed on activities.
  • Serve as a leader and role model for staff, temporary workers, and volunteers.
  • Demonstrate, instruct, and train others in methods on how to complete tasks.
  • Demonstrate an ongoing commitment to learning and self-improvement.
  • Plan daily and cyclic hatchery work schedules.
  • Act as agency liaison and project manager of the contracted crews during fish marking programs.


Physical Operation and Maintenance of Facility:

  • Ensure that working components of the fish hatchery are kept in good condition such as pumps and motors, vehicles, alarms, generators, and flashlights.
  • Maintain the grounds in appearance and upkeep during seasonal events using lawn mowers, weed eaters, chainsaws, pressure washers, forklifts, tractors, generators, and carpentry power tools.
  • Monitor water quality and quality rearing environments.
  • Manage the operation of fish traps and ladders.
  • Order tools and supplies to meet facility needs.


Communications:

  • Keep supervisor and management well informed on production issues that may lead to fish health concerns or program shortfalls.
  • Communicate with outside entities to implement agency-approved projects, as the facility subject matter expert.
  • Communicate with Fish Health Pathologists and Epidemiologists to ensure appropriate fish culture activities.
  • Perform outreach and education duties through community presentations and the preparation of materials for educational purposes on the hatchery operations and species information.


Data Collection, Entry, Reporting, and Budgeting:

  • Maintain a facility filing system that is well organized and user-friendly.
  • Ensure that staff are well informed on where and how to collect and record data.
  • Organize and maintain the budget tracking system for all hatchery expenditures.



Working Conditions:


Work Setting, including hazards: Work outside in all weather conditions, which may include working independently or in inclement weather, for approximately 250 days per year. Perform frequent strenuous physical activities such as daily, repetitive lifting of 50 pounds (fish feed bags, adult/juvenile fish, pumps and other equipment). This position may involve working in or near water, including tasks that require navigating, negotiating, and performing duties related to water environments.


Schedule: Typically, Monday – Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Work hours may vary at different times of the year, depending on the work schedule and weather conditions, and may sometimes include working evenings or weekends.


*Standby: Standby duties are currently assigned – standby entails the employee being responsible for overseeing the facility for the remaining 16 hours of the day after the regular 8-hour shift, with a response time of 15–30 minutes. The standby schedule consists of working ten (10) consecutive days, including seven (7) days of standby duty, followed by four (4) days off.


Housing: Housing is provided for this position.


Travel Requirements: Travel may be required for short periods of time to accomplish agency goals and required training.


Tools and Equipment: Hand and power tools, lawn care equipment, tractors, forklifts, welding equipment, egg picking machines, water sampling instruments, transport trucks, passenger vehicles, adult fish pumps and counters, coded wire tag (CWT) identification equipment, trash pumps, pressure washers, diesel generators, small gas engines, and computers.


Customer Interactions: Regularly interact with small community groups, individual members of the public, and volunteers. Will respond to questions from visitors to the facility and conduct organized tours as needed.



Qualifications:

Required Qualifications:


Option 1: Six (6) years of experience performing a variety of fish culture duties in a hatchery.


Option 2: One (1) year of experience as a Fish Hatchery Specialist 2.


Option 3: An Associate’s degree in fisheries technology, biology, or closely allied field and two (2) years of experience performing fish culture duties in a hatchery.


Option 4: A Bachelor’s degree in fisheries, biology, or closely allied field and two (2) years of experience performing fish culture duties in a hatchery.


Option 5: Successful completion of a fish culture program from a vocational school and two (2) years of experience performing fish culture duties in a hatchery.


Certifications/Licenses:

Valid Driver’s License.



Preferred Qualifications:

In addition to the required qualifications, our ideal applicant will possess some or all the following:


A four (4) year degree in Fisheries or closely associated field.



Your application must include the following:

  • A completed online application showcasing how your qualifications align with the job requirements.
  • An up-to-date resume.
  • At least three professional references with current contact information.

Supplemental Information

Region Västerbotten arbetar för att god hälsa och hållbar utveckling ska stärka varandra. Vi tar ansvar för en jämlik välfärd och för att forskning och innovation ger resultat.

Geriatriskt centrum är en specialistklinik för patienter med behov av både akut och planerad geriatrisk vård och rehabilitering. En bred bedömning av den äldre patientens medicinska, fysiska, psykiska och sociala funktionsförmåga vid sjukdom utförs av interprofessionella team. Diagnostik, behandling och rehabilitering bedrivs i sluten- och öppenvård med patientens individuella behov i fokus.

Ortopedgeriatriken, avdelning 4, har 20 vårdplatser med inriktning mot subakut ortopedgeriatrisk vård och rehabilitering.

Nu söker vi ny sjuksköterskekollegafrämst för arbete dag/kväll/helg och eventuellt natt vid behov och överenskommelse enligt ett  AB-schema. Är det dig vi söker?

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande så välkommen med din ansökan så snart du kan!

1 plats(er).

Som sjuksköterska hos oss bidrar du med kunskap och engagemang som får människor att känna sig trygga.

I arbetet som sjuksköterska ingår omvårdnadsansvar och omvårdnadsarbete tillsammans med undersköterska, medicinska åtgärder utifrån patientens tillstånd och ordination, samt kontakter med övriga professioner i vårdteamet, andra vårdgivare och patientens närstående.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Du är legitimerad sjuksköterska, gärna med specialistutbildning för sjuksköterskor inom ortopedi och/eller geriatrik.

För att du ska vara den vi söker ser vi att du har god samarbetsförmåga, där du lyssnar och kommunicerar med både patienter och kollegor. Det är viktigt att du känner dig bekväm med att hantera administrativa arbetsuppgifter. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av teamarbete och geriatrisk omvårdnad.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

title: Production Distribution Sort Operator
description:
Overview
Performs work as part of a team in an industrial laundry facility. Responsible for the safe, expeditious, and accurate handling of merchandise into and/or out of the laundry facility.
Responsibilities/Essential Functions

Becomes familiar with the garment numbering system (GID) and shipping schedule board
Follows a shipping schedule and knows the initial step to separate garments into routes for specific sort area (first, second, or third)
Removes garments from supply rail, places on the appropriate conveyor or placard hook by route (first sort), by last man numbered (second sort), or by customer number (third sort)
Hangs all shirts of the same route then hangs all pants before proceeding to the next batch/bar
Removes odd garments and places them in the correct space on the odd numbered garment bar
Informs the supervisor of any quality, mechanical, or shipping schedule problems
Watches the end of the supply bars for falling garments and re-hangs fallen garments on appropriate bar
Stops the line when jams or other problems occur further down the line and for breaks
Monitors garments for wrinkles and removes garments not meeting specified quality standards in terms of ink stains, tears, holes, missing buttons, or loose tags
Maintains safe and clean work environment, and observes best practices in all production activities
Other duties as assigned

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

Ability to understand all required training, written, and verbal instructions
Working knowledge of basic math skills
Good verbal and/or written communication skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Ability to meet attendance schedule

Working Environment/Safety Requirements

Work is performed in a warehouse setting and regularly exposed to outside weather conditions, extreme heat and cold conditions as well as dust and noise
Work is based on a shift schedule, and may include weekends
Overtime required as needed

Physical Requirements

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions
Position involves repetitive motions over the duration of an entire shift
Requires continuous reaching at shoulder and/or overhead level
Requires the use of hands for grasping and other manipulations
Requires standing and walking for long periods of time

Education
High school degree or equivalent preferred
Location: Salt Lake City, UT

title: IT – Risk & Governance Specialist
description:
Siamo la Tech Company leader in Europa che da oltre 45 anni supporta l’innovazione digitale.

Portare il digitale in ogni impresa è la nostra missione. Come? Mettendo al centro il cliente e diventando il partner di riferimento di professionisti, piccole, medie e grandi aziende offrendo soluzioni e servizi personalizzati per ottimizzare i processi aziendali, che si tratti di gestire le risorse umane, le relazioni con i clienti, la fatturazione elettronica o i pagamenti digitali.

Nel team Group Technology coordiniamo l'area tecnologica del Gruppo per svilupparne la strategia in linea con gli obiettivi generali di business e di prodotto. Stimoliamo l’innovazione tecnologica, garantendo uno sviluppo coerente delle architetture e la scalabilità e l'efficienza, orientando lo sviluppo in ottica di piattaforma. Assicuriamo i servizi di Cloud Operations, Cybersecurity e la qualità del Software. Ci impegniamo a fornire soluzioni tecnologiche all'avanguardia, sicure e sostenibili, che supportino la crescita e il successo del Gruppo.

Unisciti al nostro team, qui potrai affinare le tue competenze, partecipando a progetti stimolanti e crescendo in ambito IT Risk & Compliance, con l’obiettivo di analizzare le esigenze tecnologiche del cliente e configurare soluzioni adeguate.

In particolare, ti occuperai di:

  • Partecipare a livello gestionale alla governance dei rischi di Gruppo e coordinare eventuali risorse esterne
  • Coordinare piani di trattamento e mitigazione del rischio ed essere il punto di riferimento verso le Direzioni, con focus su pagamenti e fintech.
  • Presidiare l'implementazione del Regolamento DORA e monitorare i rischi legati a fornitori e supply chain ICT.
  • Identificare e valutare Rischio Operativo e ICT, definendo framework e metodologie a livello di Gruppo.
  • Redigere report periodici e analizzare indicatori di rischio per rafforzare il sistema dei controlli.
  • Garantire l'allineamento continuo agli standard di settore (es. ISO, NIST, eIDAs e/o delle altre certificazioni in ambito audit/risk.)

Il profilo che cerchiamo ha:

  • Laurea in discipline informatiche o equivalenti, almeno 3 anni in ruoli di IT Risk/Governance in ambito pagamenti/fintech e almeno 5 anni complessivi in controllo, auditing o IT Risk Management.
  • Familiarità con standard internazionali di rischio e sicurezza (es. NIST CSF 2.0, COBIT, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, CSA STAR); gradite certificazioni di settore (es. ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Lead Implementer, CRISC, CISA, COBIT, CSA STAR)
  • Esperienza in cyber security assessment (vulnerability assessment, penetration test, gap analysis), IT Audit e conoscenza del Regolamento DORA e normative correlate.
  • Solida esperienza nella gestione di progetti (scope, milestone, rischi) e nell'implementazione/revisione di strategie e programmi di governance della sicurezza.
  • Ottime capacità relazionali, analitiche e di leadership, forte attitudine al lavoro in team, flessibilità, problem solving e disponibilità a trasferte.
  • Conoscenza dell'inglese scritto e parlato (livello B1).

Ti rivedi nelle competenze che cerchiamo? Ottimo inizio! Ma vogliamo anche persone che, grazie al loro growth mindset, vedano ogni sfida come un'opportunità straordinaria di crescita e che riflettano le soft skills che ci distinguono, dando vita ai nostri valori.

  • IMPRENDITORIALITÀ - è il motore che ci spinge a eccellere, a innovare e sfidare noi stessi per il successo nostro e dell'azienda. Siamo proattivi, responsabili e focalizzati sul cliente, sempre pronti a mettere in discussione lo status quo e a raggiungere risultati straordinari.
  • INNOVAZIONE - è il faro che illumina il nostro percorso muovendoci in un’ambiente ricco di esperienze, conoscenze e prospettive differenti. Non temiamo l’errore, lavoriamo in un ambiente fertile per lo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative.
  • INCLUSIONE - è il sentimento che guida il nostro rapporto tra individui, ognuno portatore di una storia e di un’esperienza differente. Siamo custodi di un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo che possa valorizzare le caratteristiche di ciascuno.

Cosa ti offriamo:

title: Chief Mining Engineer
description:
Position Overview:

The Chief Engineer is responsible for leading mine engineering, planning, and technical governance for a large-scale open-pit operation. This role oversees the development and execution of short-, medium-, and long-range mine plans aligned with the Life of Mine (LoM) strategy, annual budgets, production targets, and ore-delivery requirements. The position provides technical leadership to the mine engineering team and supports the advancement of a digitally enabled, autonomous mining environment through integrated planning, data-driven decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration.

Job Responsibilities:

· Mine Planning

o Lead the development and execution of mid- and short-term mine plans.

o Oversee sequencing, haulage, equipment requirements, stockpiles, waste placement, and drill-and-blast planning.

o Review forecasts and mine-to-plan performance, identifying risks and corrective actions.

o Ensure plans are practical, aligned with production requirements, and clearly communicated.

· Team Leadership

o Lead and develop five direct reports within a broader technical team of eleven.

o Direct Senior Mine Engineers and Mine Engineers responsible for short-range planning.

o Set priorities and performance expectations while supporting employee development and succession planning.

· Survey and Drill-and-Blast

o Oversee survey and drill-and-blast functions, ensuring accurate and timely planning inputs.

o Coordinate activities with operations, geology, and other technical teams.

o Monitor performance and improve safety, productivity, fragmentation, and cost.

· Cross-Functional Collaboration

o Partner with operations, geology, processing, maintenance, hydrogeology, and other site teams.

o Incorporate dewatering and other technical requirements into mine plans.

o Communicate plans, risks, and changes to support coordinated operational execution.

· Systems, Improvement, and Compliance

o Maintain effective planning standards, data, documentation, and approval processes.

o Optimize the use of Vulcan, MinePlan, operational data, and related planning systems.

o Support autonomous and digitally enabled mining initiatives.

o Ensure engineering, survey, and drill-and-blast activities comply with MSHA, regulatory, and company requirements.

Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree in Mining Engineering or a related discipline.

· 8+ years of progressive experience in an open-pit hard-rock mining environment; gold or copper experience is applicable.

· Minimum 3-5 years of experience leading mine engineer or technical services teams.

· Strong experience developing and executing mid- and short-term mine plans.

· Demonstrated leadership and people-management experience.

· Experience overseeing or coordinating survey and drill-and-blast functions.

· Proficiency with Vulcan and MinePlan is required.

· Strong cross-department relationship-building and communication skills.

· Experience with dewatering programs is preferred.

· Experience in an autonomous or digitally enabled mining environment is preferred.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.

· Professional Engineer registration or eligibility for registration is preferred.

title: Head of Risk and Resilience
description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

Super Technologies is looking for a Head of Risk and Resilience to build and lead our organisational resilience capability from the ground up, making sure the business can withstand, adapt to, and recover from disruption, whatever form it takes. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role, focused on embedding resilience thinking into how every part of the business operates rather than policing it from the sidelines. Reporting to the Group Risk and Audit Director and supported by a small team of risk specialists, you will mature the function and help shape the wider risk strategy.

What the role involves

  • Lead operational risk identification and control assessment across business units, providing specialist and technical risk advice to executive committees
  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery planning, running regular testing, tabletop exercises and simulations, and translating results into action
  • Build resilience playbooks for critical business services, including third-party and vendor dependency risk
  • Act as incident lead or escalation point during major operational disruptions, staying calm and decisive under pressure
  • Embed resilience thinking into how business, product and technology teams plan, ship and operate, partnering directly with leaders to close identified gaps and working with Technology on IT disaster recovery, system redundancy and recovery objectives for critical systems
  • Build a network of resilience owners across key business areas, running workshops and training so teams can identify and fix their own single points of failure
  • Manage a team of 2 direct reports, supporting the wider risk team, and grow a small, hands-on resilience team as the function scales
  • Make the business case for resilience investment in terms leadership cares about, and represent resilience in new market launches, major product changes and technology decisions from the outset

Please note you may be required to travel to various offices across Europe and will also be required to work in the Bucharest office twice a week.

What we are looking for

  • Minimum 8+ years' experience in operational resilience, including at least 3 years in a senior or leadership capacity
  • A track record of building a resilience or continuity programme from scratch, or significantly maturing an existing one
  • Practical experience designing and running resilience tests, such as tabletops, simulations and failover exercises, and translating results into action
  • Strong working knowledge of resilience and continuity frameworks and standards (e.g. ISO 22301, BCI Good Practice Guidelines, or equivalent)
  • Experience managing third-party and vendor dependency risk for critical services
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to get business and technology leaders to own and run their part of resilience
  • Comfortable acting as incident commander during live disruptions, staying calm and decisive under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to executives and the Board

Nice to have

  • Experience in a fast-growing, tech-driven, or regulated consumer business
  • Familiarity with technology/cyber resilience and IT disaster recovery
  • Relevant professional certification (e.g. CBCP, CRM, or equivalent)
  • Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions/regulatory regimes

What we offer

  • Medical / Health Insurance
  • Open Annual Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Training & Learning Development

Additional benefits vary by country and will be shared during the hiring process.

About Super

We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

Shaping the Future of Play

Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page:

Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA).

At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance.
