title: Student Assistant
description:
Are you ready to join the Commercial Data & Software Engineering team?

As one of the premier coating companies in the world, Hempel contributes to the decarbonization of the shipping industry and, increasingly, to the sustainable transformation of the energy and infrastructure sectors through a combination of premium products and innovative digital solutions. Hempel’s Commercial Data & Software Engineering team utilizes data gathered from the entire world fleet alongside inhouse models, to help shipowners make more economically sound and environmentally friendly decisions when managing their fleet.

We are now extending the same data driven approach into the energy & infrastructure sector through a new platform currently in development. With an ever-increasing demand for easily accessible insights, we are looking to expand our team with two talented student assistants - one with a primary focus on frontend development, and one with a primary focus on backend development.

Want to help decarbonize shipping and strengthen critical energy and infrastructure assets through data and digitalization?

As part of the Commercial Data & Software Engineering team, you will have the opportunity to be part of the modernization of the Energy and Infrastructure (E&I) industry by contributing to the development of a new data platform over a 1½-year period.

You will work with cutting edge digital tools to optimize and mature our data handling and loading processes, build user-facing functionalities for both platforms, and help shape how data is delivered to internal and external users. The two roles are distinct, but will work closely together. Whichever role you join, there will be opportunities to step across the line between frontend and backend depending on your interest, the project’s needs, as well as your evolving skill set.

What will your main responsibilities be?

Your primary focus will be the user facing side of our platforms, building, refining, and maintaining the interfaces our users interact with every day.

  • Develop and maintain frontend functionality across both platforms, working with TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks.

  • Develop and maintain frontend functionality for the E&I data platform, primarily using TypeScript/JavaScript

  • Draft up design ideas for the platform in Figma or other design applications

  • Translate design and product requirements into clean and responsive interfaces

  • Connect frontend components to backend APIs and ensure data is presented clearly and reliably

  • Contribute to image annotation work support our ML models

  • Collaborate closely with the backend developer in the team, with the option to take on backend tasks as your skills and interest develop

What will your day-to-day look like?

  • Being given a meaningful level of responsibility and the opportunity to make a real, lasting impact

  • Working with a modern stack and a wide range of digital tools

  • Contributing to image annotation work that feeds our machine learning training data, alongside your development tasks.

  • Being based in Hempel’s headquarters in Kgs. Lyngby, where the Commercial Data & Software Engineering team sits. Our team is part of the broader Commercial Transformation & Technology department.

What do we look for in you?

We are looking for a student assistant with a genuine passion for working with data, code and digital tools – ideally with strong logical reasoning skills and a curiosity about how systems actually work end-to-end. As a person, you enjoy learning new skills and the process of figuring out how things fit together.

  • Demonstrable skills in any programming language, preferably >2 years of experience picked up through education, work, hobbies and/or personal projects, but exceptional candidates from other backgrounds will also be considered

  • Demonstrable experience with TypeScript and/or JavaScript, and with at least one modern frontend framework

  • A solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and how modern web applications are structured

  • An eye for usability and an interest in how design decisions affect the end user

  • Nice to have: exposure to Node.js, Python, SQL, and/or having worked with REST APIs

  • Curious by nature, and able to combine structured logic with creativity when facing new problems and tasks.

  • The ability to work independently, but with a clear sense of your own limits – and not being afraid to ask for clarification or assistance when needed.

  • Enrolment in a university or other educational institution related to STEM or programming, preferably with at least 1 years study completed and at least 1 year or more left.

  • Fluency in English

Ready to apply?

To apply for this position, please submit your application letter together with a CV in English via our recruitment system by clicking the link 'Apply' at the top of this post.

For further information about the job, please contact Thomas Kragelund, Commercial Data and Software Engineering Lead at TKRA@hempel.com.

Application due

2026-09-22

Seniority Level

Internship

Job Functions

Industry

Chemicals

At Hempel, you’re welcomed to a global community of +7000 colleagues around the world. A workplace built on shared trust, mutual respect and support for each other.

We’re on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed, but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact.

At Hempel, we are committed to everyone feeling safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work. We believe that inclusion is key to innovation and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents, we can achieve great things, together.

title: Senior Kravanalytiker
description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i en central roll hos en samhällsviktig verksamhet inom rättsväsendet, där du hjälper verksamhet och IT att fånga rätt behov och omsätta dem till tydliga, genomförbara lösningar. Du blir en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team inom produktområdet Lagföring, med ansvar för både nyutveckling och förvaltning i en miljö som präglas av samarbete, högt engagemang och stort eget ansvar.

Just nu pågår bland annat modernisering av systemstöd inom ATK, där en befintlig lösning flyttas till webbgränssnitt samtidigt som ny funktionalitet och nya arbetsprocesser utvecklas för att effektivisera utredningsprocessen. Parallellt drivs flera andra utvecklings- och förvaltningsinitiativ. Du får en nyckelroll i att skapa struktur, framdrift och förankring genom hela utvecklingskedjan. Det här är en spännande möjlighet för dig som vill påverka både arbetssätt och lösningar i en komplex miljö med tydlig samhällsnytta.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Du driver kravarbetet genom hela utvecklingsprocessen, från behovsinsamling och verksamhetsanalys till prioritering, utveckling, verifiering och färdig lösning.
  • Du planerar, leder och samordnar kravaktiviteter, exempelvis workshops samt behovs- och analysmöten.
  • Du samarbetar nära med verksamhetsrepresentanter, utvecklare, testare och uppdragsledare för att skapa gemensam förståelse och förankrade vägval.
  • Du analyserar och strukturerar verksamhetens behov och översätter dem till tydliga, genomförbara och verifierbara krav.
  • Du bidrar aktivt i lösningsdiskussioner och säkerställer att verksamhetsbehov omsätts till ändamålsenliga systemlösningar.
  • Du leder och samordnar framtagning av både funktionella och icke-funktionella krav.
  • Du dokumenterar analyser, beslut och behov samt hanterar ärenden, frågor och beroenden i Jira.
  • Du stöttar teamet i att utveckla arbetssätt, effektivisera leveranser och skapa framdrift i komplexa utvecklingsinitiativ.
  • Du coachar vid behov mindre erfarna kollegor och bidrar som mentor inom kravområdet.
Krav
  • Du har minst 10 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete som kravanalytiker eller motsvarande roll, varav erfarenheten ska ha förvärvats under de senaste 15 åren.
  • Du har minst 6 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av att självständigt driva och samordna kravarbete, från behovsinsamling och analys till utveckling, verifiering och färdig lösning.
  • Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att självständigt planera, leda och samordna kravaktiviteter samt driva frågor och aktiviteter framåt i komplexa utvecklingsuppdrag.
  • Du har mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.
  • Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av kravarbete i agila utvecklingsmiljöer.

Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll samt tecknande av säkerhetsskyddsavtal enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan komma att genomföras av konsult respektive konsults arbetsgivare innan Uppdragsavtalet kan göras gällande. I vissa fall krävs svenskt medborgarskap.

Meriterande
  • Erfarenhet av UX och användarcentrerad utveckling.
  • Erfarenhet av IT-relaterat arbete inom större statlig myndighet.
  • Erfarenhet av att coacha eller vara mentor åt mindre erfarna medarbetare inom kravområdet.
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med Jira och Confluence i utvecklings- och kravarbete.
Vi erbjuder
  • Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
  • Tjänstepension
  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

The Junior Analytics Engineer will play a pivotal role in establishing data-driven decision-making and supporting operational evaluations in support of the US Army Operational Evaluation Command. This position focuses on translating complex data into actional insights that enable a diverse set of stakeholders to maintain awareness, ensure quality, gain insights, and provide direction during all phases during the evaluation of US Army equipment. The Analytics Engineer will design, build, and maintain the analytical tools, dashboards, and data pipelines necessary to support all aspects of the evaluation process.

As a core member of the data and analytics team, you will be responsible for creating real-time decision support systems that provide granular visibility into the design, planning, preparation, execution, and assessment of US Army equipment to ensure that the equipment meets the needs of warfighters. You will work closely with other data scientists, operations research analysts, and engineers to ensure that all data is traceable from source to solution. This role is essential for equipping multiple stakeholders with the tools necessary to conduct operational tests and evaluations. This role is located in Huntsville, AL.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Develop and maintain executive- to engineering-level decision support products, including operational dashboards and artificial intelligence (AI) pipelines.
  • Build data pipelines and visualizations within enterprise platforms (such as Army Vantage) to provide real-time oversight of operational tests and evaluations.
  • Ensure strict data traceability from source data and assumptions through analyses to final evaluation.
  • Work closely with customers and mission partners to define requirements and shape solutions.
  • Identify data sources, engineer data pipelines, and develop data storage solutions to meet customer requirements.
  • Communicate technical findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Less than 25% travel may be required.

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited school in a technical discipline (data science, engineering, mathematics, science, computer science).
  • Position requires two or more years of related professional experience.
  • Active DoD Secret Clearance or U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain/maintain a DoD Secret Clearance is required.
  • Strong data science, data analytics, and/or data engineering background and thorough knowledge of statistics and mathematics.
  • Expertise in data analysis and visualization using languages like Python, R, and SQL.
  • Experience with data visualization software like Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik.
  • Experience with data management platforms like ADVANA, Palantir Foundry, Databricks, Snowflake, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve technical and operational problems independently within a team setting.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Familiarity with DoD systems and processes.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree from an accredited school in a technical discipline (data science, engineering, mathematics, science, computer science).
  • Background in developmental or operational testing.
  • Experience with data modeling, ETL, and similar data engineering processes.
  • Experience with Agile processes and solutions like GitLab or Jira.
  • Experience with version control software like Git.
  • Experience in project management and team leadership.
  • Experience using cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS) for data analytics and reporting.
  • Knowledge of military or defense data systems (e.g., DAVE, PRMT, GFEBS, and ARES).

We Take Care of Our People

Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Trideum is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life because we believe that taking care of our people is the right thing to do. Trideum offers:

  • And much more.

description:

With over 120 childcare centres across Canada and continued growth, there's never been a better time to build your career with Kids & Company.

Schedule

Responsibilities

  • Provide 1:1 support to a child with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) within the classroom environment.
  • Implement individualized strategies and supports to encourage participation, engagement, and independence.
  • Support the child's social, emotional, behavioural, and developmental needs.
  • Collaborate with families, Centre Directors, educators, and outside professionals such as Speech-Language Pathologists, Occupational Therapists, and Early Interventionists.

Qualifications

  • Alberta Early Childhood Educator Certification (Level 1, 2, or 3).
  • Previous experience supporting children with exceptionalities, including Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), is required.
  • Current Criminal Record Check and Vulnerable Sector Check.
  • Valid Standard Child Care First Aid and CPR Level B certification.
  • Ability to push, pull, and lift up to 45 pounds.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience working with children with diverse learning, developmental, and behavioural needs.
  • Knowledge of ASD and strategies to support self-regulation, communication, and positive behaviour guidance.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to build trusting relationships with children, families, and colleagues.
  • Strong observational, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
  • A caring, patient, reliable, and positive attitude.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive benefits package, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage (where applicable).
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
  • Supportive, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
  • Employee child care discount.
  • Complimentary backup child care days annually.
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the life of a child and their family every day.

At Kids & Company, we believe that when educators thrive, children thrive. We are committed to creating exceptional experiences for children, families, and employees through a culture of collaboration, respect, and continuous learning.

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Low Voltage Security Technician
description:

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES AND EXPECTATIONS

  • Communicates with Customer Service Representative regarding status, progress, and resolution of all assigned tasks. Updates tickets in service and project tracking system.

  • Performs system Preventive Maintenance inspections according to policy and procedures.
  • Assists with other technical support issues, as needed.
  • Attends to other matters and duties necessitated as assigned by the Regional Manager or executive staff of Tech Systems.

SAFETY SENSITIVE POSITION

This position has been designated as a safety-sensitive position under Company policy. Employees in this role perform duties where impaired performance could result in a significant risk of harm to themselves, coworkers, clients, or the public. This position is subject to the Company's Drug-Free Workplace Policy, including drug and alcohol testing, as permitted by applicable law.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
A. EDUCATION
  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
B. EXPERIENCE
  • At least two (2) years prior work experience in commercial security systems installation or service.
  • Must have networking skills and 1-year experience programming access and video systems.
C. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & COMPETENCY
  • Possess minimum factory and/or internal security system certifications to work independently.
  • Must have basic computer skills, including, but not limited to, working knowledge of Microsoft based products (such as MS Word, Excel, and Outlook), Smartsheet and IT skillset with understanding of best practices when it comes to IP systems.
  • Excellent customer service skills, including a sense of urgency when attending to customer needs.
  • Strong ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem resolution skills.
  • Must be detail-oriented and have excellent organizational skills.
  • Ability to work accurately, efficiently, and independently; showing proficiency in all systems installed in service area, demonstrating little need for guidance and support.

  • Excellent communication skills, including, but not limited to, the ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing.
  • Strong time management skills, including ability to meet deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including, but not limited to, the ability to manage and interact effectively and in a supportive manner with Tech Systems’ staff, vendors, and customers and ability to work with and build teams of employees.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to safe work practices by complying with all Company safety policies and procedures and performing work in a manner that protects employees, customers, and the public.
D. DRIVER’S LICENSE
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must have a clean driving record, satisfactory to Tech Systems’ automobile insurance carrier.
E. PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS
Job duties are performed at client sites. The job does require regular physical activity, including, but not limited to, walking, standing, sitting, climbing, stooping, lifting objects weighing up to 50 pounds, occasionally lifting objects weighing more than 50 pounds, and using hands to manipulate, install, or disassemble objects. Job duties may involve exposure to some hazards, such as electricity, electrical wiring, and other similar conditions. The job requires driving and other travel.

title: Anslutningsingenjör till Upplands Energi
description:
Det här är möjligheten för dig som vill bygga din kompetens inom elnät och som vill vara med på en spännande utvecklingsresa i en bransch som är i ständig förändring. Vi söker dig som har ett genuint teknikintresse, är nyfiken och vill ta ansvar för att utveckla både dig själv och verksamheten. Som anslutningsingenjör hos Upplands Energi får du en bred och långsiktig roll där du successivt får ta dig an mer avancerade arbetsuppgifter, samtidigt som du har erfarna kollegor omkring dig att lära av. Här får du möjlighet att vara med och påverka hur framtidens elnät och arbetssätt utvecklas hos ett företag med stark lokal förankring och ett tydligt samhällsuppdrag. VI ser fram emot din ansökan!

Om tjänsten

Upplands Energi är ett lokalt energiföretag med en historia som sträcker sig tillbaka till 1918. Företaget äger och driver elnät och arbetar med eldistribution, elhandel och energiprodukter på den uppländska marknaden. Upplands Energi erbjuder bland annat fossilfria elavtal samt lösningar inom solceller, batterier, laddboxar och värmepumpar. Företagets vision är att vara upplänningens självklara energipartner, med fokus på närhet, tillgänglighet och hållbara energilösningar.

Nu söker Upplands Energi en Anslutningsingenjör till elnätsorganisationen, där du blir en del av Anläggning. I rollen får du en central funktion i hanteringen av anslutningsärenden och blir en viktig kontakt mellan kunder, installatörer, myndigheter och interna tekniska funktioner. Du kommer bland annat att ta emot och bedöma förfrågningar om nya eller förändrade anslutningar, exempelvis när en kund vill bygga nytt, utöka sin elanvändning eller installera solceller och batterier. Du hanterar ärendena genom anslutningsprocessen, från förfrågan och underlag till offert, och arbetar med bland annat föranmälningar, färdiganmälningar, installationsmedgivanden samt kontakt med kunder och myndigheter. Rollen innebär därför att du behöver kunna växla mellan tekniska frågeställningar, systemarbete, dokumentation och kontakt med olika typer av människor.

Rollen är långsiktig och du kommer successivt att växa in i ett större ansvar. Till en början får du arbeta med enklare ärenden och följa mer seniora kollegor för att bygga förståelse för elnätet och anslutningsprocessen. Med tiden får du ta dig an mer komplexa ärenden och utvecklas mot teknisk projektering, beräkning och planering i nätberäkningssystem. Du får även vara delaktig i Upplands Energis digitaliserings- och utvecklingsarbete, där du kan bidra med idéer kring nya arbetssätt, system och processer. Det gör rollen särskilt intressant för dig som inte bara vill förvalta befintliga arbetssätt, utan vill vara med och utveckla hur verksamheten arbetar framåt.

Du blir en del av ett team inom elnätsorganisationen som består av sex personer med olika kompetenser inom bland annat mätning, dokumentation, beredning och projektledning. Teamet arbetar tätt tillsammans och präglas av en prestigelös kultur där man hjälper varandra, delar kunskap och löser problem tillsammans. Här finns mycket senior kompetens att lära av, samtidigt som det finns utrymme för nya perspektiv och egna idéer.

Upplands Energi befinner sig i en förändringsresa där elnätsverksamheten går från ett mer förvaltande till ett mer utvecklingsorienterat arbetssätt. Energibranschen förändras snabbt, bland annat genom elektrifieringen, ökad nyproduktion och förändrade kundbehov. Det gör att även rollen som anslutningsingenjör kan utvecklas över tid. För dig som är nyfiken, driven och vill bygga långsiktig kompetens inom energibranschen finns goda möjligheter att växa med både rollen och verksamheten. Som ett mellanstort företag får du dessutom en bred förståelse för verksamheten och hur olika delar av elnätsorganisationen hänger ihop.

Det här är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer vara anställd av Academic Work och arbeta som konsult hos Upplands Energi. Uppdraget kommer att vara på heltid och är långsiktigt. Det finns mycket goda chanser till överrekrytering, förutsatt att alla parter är nöjda med samarbetet.

Du erbjuds

  • En bred roll i ett mellanstort företag där du får insyn i många delar av verksamheten
  • Möjlighet att växa från enklare anslutningsärenden till mer teknisk projektering, beräkning och nätplanering
  • Möjlighet att påverka och bidra till digitalisering och utveckling av nya arbetssätt
  • Frihet under ansvar och goda möjligheter att ta mer ansvar över tid
  • Möjlighet att vara med på en viktig förändringsresa inom en samhällskritisk bransch

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som anslutningsingenjör kommer du bland annat att:

  • Hantera och planera inkommande anslutningsförfrågningar från kunder
  • Hantera ärenden kring nya anslutningar och förändrade abonnemang
  • Ha kontakt med kunder, elinstallatörer, myndigheter och andra externa aktörer
  • Hantera enklare anslutningsärenden och ta fram offerter till kunder

title: Innovation Engineer, WW AMZL Innovation and Design Engineering
description:
Amazon opened its virtual doors in 1995 and strives to be the world’s most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online. Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is looking to hire an experienced, innovative, hands-on, and customer-obsessed Hardware Development Engineer to lead the development of new mechatronic products to integrate into our Delivery Station of the future. The successful candidate will be a member of the Amazon Logistics Innovation Engineering team and will be responsible to strategize, define and manage the lifecycle of new mechatronic technologies for the AMZL Delivery Stations.
This role requires experienced and entrepreneurial minded individuals with combined robotics, engineering, planning and analytical skills. This individual will directly influence the Amazon last mile automation roadmap by partnering with Robotics, SW Tech Teams, Process Engineering teams, Operations, Facilities and Engineering teams to improve our final customer shopping experience.


Key job responsibilities
As a HDE, you will be a part of the team of experts working on the development of complex mechatronics products. You will own or contribute to the following:

- Lead overall end-to-end equipment technology development to move through ideation, development, conceptual design, detail design, testing and on-site implementation.
- Write requirements, functional specifications, design verification plans, and functional test procedures
- Collect customer needs and feedback from the technologies deployed in the field to propose new solutions and enhancements,
- Influence technical and business decisions working through data-driven contributions based on technology tests and validation plans,
- Define and track clear project timelines, and manage project budget
- Conduct regular progress reviews and reporting
- Partner with simulation team for validating new ideas and concepts to optimize current workflows and automate manual process paths
- Lead the discussion for scalability strategy of new technologies working with various teams like Engineering, vendors, Supply Chain, Corp Dev, etc.

A day in the life
You will ideate and bring to life new technologies for AMZL. Your day could include activities ranging from working with new vendors on developing concepts for AMZL with automation and robotics technology, to being in the field and learning the challenges that associates face. You would build and validate prototypes in our Innovation Center to enable fast-design iterations. You will demonstrate through simulation and data the actual benefits of the new technologies integration in the field bringing your entrepreneurial and innovative spirit at disposal of the team. You would write a business case and work with stakeholders to build a case for piloting new technology. You could dive deep into understanding how the tech influences AMZL processes and the associate’s lives.

About the team
We are a set of diverse individuals who work coherently to solve customer problems with the most innovative solutions. We put heavy emphasis on empowering our employees to maintain work/life harmony. The team works with innovative technologies in the market to bring into AMZL to solve complex technical problems. It’s a fine balance between working on writing strategic business cases and understanding the deep human-machine interfaces.

title: CIVIL/STRUCTURAL ENGINEERING INTERN
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Civil/Structural Engineering Intern participates in the Wells Engineering Development Program (EDP), gaining hands-on experience across quality control, field services, and engineering design. This role provides exposure to precast manufacturing, construction operations, and structural design while working directly with Professional Engineers and field leaders. Interns rotate through multiple functional areas to build technical skills and identify a long-term career path in engineering.

Compensation $25/hr. Based on location and experience.

SAFETY IS OUR HIGHEST PRIORITY. Safety is our highest priority. We believe a safe workplace is built on mutual respect, care, and accountability. Every team member is empowered and expected to follow safety practices, look out for one another, and speak up about potential risks. Together, we create an environment where everyone goes home safely each day.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?

At Wells, you’re part of a team that takes pride in building something that lasts. Whether you’re in operations, a manufacturing facility, or out in the field, your work plays a direct role in creating quality structures that support our communities. We value hard work, reliability, and teamwork because getting the job done right requires teamwork. With a strong focus on safety, collaboration, and ingenuity, we create an environment where you can build your experience, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

WHAT WE OFFER
Wells provides a competitive benefits package designed to support employees’ health, financial well-being, and work-life balance. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, company-paid disability and life insurance, wellness incentives, paid holidays, PTO, flexible spending accounts, HSA options, a 401(k) with profit sharing, access to Nice Healthcare, employee assistance resources, pet insurance, and additional voluntary coverage such as critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity plans.

  • Health and family care leave is available to both union and non-union employees.
  • Union employee benefits are provided through separate collective bargaining agreements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Shadow Quality Control technicians and support plant inspection activities
  • Perform and assist with concrete testing in laboratory environments
  • Learn and use Concrete Vision (CV) or similar production tracking systems
  • Conduct pre-pour inspections including formwork checks and readiness verification
  • Gain exposure to mix designs, finishes, NCRs, and quality metrics
  • Pour and evaluate concrete samples for testing and documentation
  • Support root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives using NCR data
  • Shadow field supervisors and assist with layout and jobsite coordination
  • Interpret blueprints and communicate work plans to field crews
  • Assist with survey and layout equipment to verify alignment and installation accuracy
  • Coordinate with dispatch on scheduling, sequencing, and logistics planning
  • Support field operations including crew coordination and jobsite problem-solving
  • Assist with reporting, documentation, and weekly progress updates
  • Follow safety procedures including bracing plans and job-specific requirements
  • Work with design engineers on precast product design including beams, double tees, and wall panels

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate is an engineering student who is eager to gain broad, hands-on experience across quality control, field operations, and structural design. They are curious, detail-oriented, and motivated to learn how engineering decisions directly impact manufacturing and construction outcomes. This individual is adaptable, team-oriented, and excited to develop technical and professional skills through real-world exposure in the precast industry.

IDEAL CANDIDATES WILL HAVE

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in civil/structuralengineering
  • Strong interest in precast concrete, structural design, and construction operations
  • Basic understanding of engineering principles and construction drawings
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to learn technical systems and field processes quickly
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety
  • Ability to work in both office, plant, and field environments
  • Valid driver’s license with ability to operate a motor vehicle
  • Self-motivated with desire to learn and grow within engineering field
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities
  • Strong organizational skills and willingness to follow structured training
  • Interest in pursuing long-term engineering career development

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Occasional visits to active plant and field locations are required based on operational needs.
  • Ability to wear all required PPE, including but not limited to safety boots, safety glasses, hearing protection, high visibility vest, hard hat, and other PPE as required while in the plant and field.
  • Must be able to stand, walk, and navigate active plant and field environments as needed.
  • Must be able to climb stairs, walk on uneven surfaces, and safely move through industrial work areas.
  • May be exposed to moving equipment, machinery, and other standard industrial hazards.
  • May be exposed to outdoor weather conditions, including heat, cold, wind, rain, as well as noise, dust, and vibration.

title: Life & Career Housing Graduate Assistant
description:
Residence Hall Graduate Assistant

Life & Career Studies Program | Calvin University

Reports to: Life & Career Studies Program Coordinator
Position: Part-time, live-in | Average of 16 hours per week | 34-week contract (August–May)

Position Overview

Calvin University’s Life & Career Studies (LCS) Program is seeking a caring, dependable, and enthusiastic Residence Hall Graduate Assistant to join our team. This is a unique opportunity to build meaningful relationships with college students while gaining valuable experience in mentoring, student support, and inclusive postsecondary education.

The Residence Hall Graduate Assistant serves as a friendly and supportive presence for LCS students living on campus. The role combines relationship-building, mentoring, social coaching, and occasional problem-solving to help students feel connected, confident, and successful in their residential experience.

This is a structured, flexible, and highly relational position. Rather than managing a large residential community, you will work closely with a small group of LCS students and the LCS team. Much of the role involves being present, getting to know students, encouraging participation, helping students navigate everyday situations, and creating opportunities for connection.

The ideal candidate enjoys working with college students, values inclusion, communicates well, and is comfortable being a positive and dependable presence in a residence hall community.

About the Life & Career Studies Program

Calvin University’s Life & Career Studies Program is committed to supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities as they develop the skills, confidence, and experiences needed to live meaningful, increasingly independent lives.

Our work centers on belonging, independence, employment preparation, personal growth, and meaningful relationships. We are looking for someone who shares our belief that every student deserves opportunities to grow, contribute, and be an active part of their college community.

What You’ll Do

As a Residence Hall Graduate Assistant, you will:

  • Serve as a positive role model and supportive presence for LCS students living on campus.
  • Conduct periodic in-person check-ins with students to promote safety, connection, and overall well-being.
  • Be available on assigned days to respond to occasional emergency or student-support calls, including evenings and rotating weekends.
  • Meet individually with students as needed to help them navigate common challenges associated with living in a residence hall.
  • Help students identify campus activities, events, and social opportunities that match their interests.
  • Encourage students to build friendships and connections with peers across campus.
  • Provide informal social coaching and support as students develop greater independence.
  • Encourage and help facilitate LCS student participation in residence hall activities and campus life.
  • Assist students with roommate communication and problem-solving when challenges arise.
  • Help coordinate safe transportation when needed.
  • Collaborate with the LCS Resident Director and Program Coordinator to support student success, engagement, and retention.
  • Attend regular meetings with the LCS Resident Director and Program Coordinator.
  • Participate in relevant meetings with Residence Life, Student Conduct, and LCS staff as schedules permit.
  • Take part in professional development and learning opportunities with Graduate Assistants and colleagues.

The Experience

This position offers a great balance of responsibility, flexibility, and meaningful interaction. You will have the opportunity to make a genuine difference in students’ college experiences while also developing skills that can benefit your future career.

Because you will work primarily with LCS students and a small program team, the position allows you to develop strong individual relationships rather than managing a large caseload or extensive residential program. Hours are flexible within assigned responsibilities, making this an excellent opportunity for a graduate student looking for meaningful campus employment that can complement their academic experience.

The position requires assigned evening availability and approximately two to three weekends per month, but the overall schedule averages approximately 16 hours per week.

Compensation & Benefits

This is a 34-week, part-time, live-in position beginning in August.

The position includes:

  • Private suite in the staff residence hall at no cost
  • Meal allowance
  • Shared office space in the assigned residence hall
  • Flexible scheduling within assigned responsibilities
  • Valuable experience in student development, mentoring, inclusive education, and residential life
  • Opportunities for professional development and collaboration with campus colleagues

FAITH and EDUCATIONAL COMMITMENT

1. Commitment to the educational mission of Calvin as a Christian liberal arts University affiliated with the Christian Reformed Church.

2. A commitment to the Christian faith and to the integration of faith, learning, and student development.

DIVERSITY COMMITMENT

Demonstrated awareness and commitment to effectively establishing relationships and positive communication across multiple dimensions of diversity including, but not limited to, race, gender, physical limitations, class, or religious perspectives.

title: Underhållsmekaniker till Kahls Kaffe AB
description:
Kahls Kaffe AB är ett familjeföretag med hjärtat i Göteborg och anor sedan 1911. Med kunden i fokus är vår vision att bli Sveriges bästa leverantör av kaffe och te.

Nu söker vi en underhållsmekaniker till vår underhållsavdelning. Hos oss får du en varierad och praktisk roll där du arbetar med både förebyggande underhåll, felsökning, reparationer och utvecklingsprojekt.

Tjänsten är ett vikariat under 1 år, med goda möjligheter till förlängning.

Vad rollen innebär

Underhållsavdelningen består idag av tre medarbetare som tillsammans bland annat ansvarar för:

  • Den dagliga driften av kafferosteriet.
  • Förebyggande underhåll av maskinparken och fastigheten.
  • Maskininställningar samt ombyggnationer och installationer.
  • Akuta reparationer och felsökning vid driftstörningar och haverier.
  • Att driva och genomföra förbättringsprojekt av varierande omfattning.

Vår kaffefabrik består av både äldre och nyare utrustning, och vi gör mycket av underhållsarbetet själva. Därför söker vi dig som har en bred teknisk kompetens och trivs med att lösa problem i vardagen.

För rollen är kunskaper inom mekanik, pneumatik och elektronik värdefulla. Verkstadsvana, god samarbetsförmåga och ett starkt säkerhetstänk är också viktigt.

Vi befinner oss i ständig utveckling och har många pågående projekt. Därför behöver du vara bekväm med att ta dig an utmaningar där vägen framåt inte alltid är given och där tydliga instruktioner ibland saknas.

Vem vi söker

Vi tror att du:

  • Har en eftergymnasial teknisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
  • Har tidigare erfarenhet från livsmedels- eller processindustrin.
  • Har ett starkt teknikintresse och en bred teknisk kompetens.
  • Är välorganiserad och har förmåga att omsätta planer till verklighet.
  • Är noggrann och ansvarstagande.
  • Tar egna initiativ och trivs med att lösa problem.
  • Är en lagspelare som bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat.
  • Har ett naturligt säkerhetstänk i ditt arbete.

Vad vi erbjuder dig

Hos oss får du:

  • Möjlighet att utvecklas och lära dig nya saker – vi stöttar och lär av varandra.
  • En inkluderande och familjär arbetsmiljö.
  • En varierad roll med både praktiskt arbete och möjlighet att driva förbättringar.
  • Möjlighet att vara med och utveckla verksamheten.
  • En arbetsplats som arbetar aktivt med hållbarhet och kvalitet.

Ansökan

Låter det intressant? Skicka din ansökan med CV och gärna löneanspråk till jobb@kahls.se så snart som möjligt.

Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Mer om oss

Kahls Kaffe AB är Sveriges femte största kafferostare och landets största teblandare. Hos oss förädlar och säljer vi kaffe, te och relaterade produkter till kunder inom flera olika branscher, både i Sverige och utomlands.

Vår verksamhet har sin bas i Frölunda, där vi har både kontor och fabrik. Kahls Kaffe AB är certifierat enligt ISO 9001 och ISO 14001 samt livsmedelssäkerhetsstandarden FSSC 22000.

Allt kaffe vi säljer under vårt eget varumärke är hållbarhetscertifierat – Fairtrade, ekologiskt, KRAV- eller UTZ-märkt.

Vårt systerbolag Kahls The & Kaffehandel är franchisegivare till 23 butiker runt om i Sverige, där konsumenter får möjlighet att möta vårt varumärke och smaka på våra produkter.

Välkommen till en rökfri arbetsplats med, enligt vår åsikt, Sveriges godaste kaffe och te!

title: Transportation Specialist ROC, Network Resilience and Control
description:
The transportation network behind Amazon’s operations spreads over hundreds of countries, reaching millions of customers. It’s our Amazon Transportation Services team that ensures products are efficiently transported where they need to be before their final delivery. As a Transportation Specialist, you’ll be working closely with teams across Amazon and external logistics partners to ensure enough delivery vans are available, processing new cases and acting quickly on escalations where necessary.

This position involves working in a rotating three-shift system, which may include Saturdays, night shifts and on-call duty.

Key job responsibilities
- Facilitate communication between stakeholders to find root causes and resolve issues quickly
- Produce and deliver reports on key delivery metrics
- Mentor or coach team members to help them develop new skills
- Maintain high standards of work by following policies and procedures
- Continually review processes to find areas for innovation

A day in the life
This position is office-based.

As a Transportation Specialist, you’ll be responsible for resolving delivery performance issues that could negatively affect our customers. You’ll understand the unique challenges of the transportation team and manage them collaboratively with other cross-functional teams. Your motivation and commitment to our customers will ensure that our response to delivery issues is timely and efficient. You will be required to make real-time decisions effectively, by doing your research, weighing up your options and learning as you progress. The result of your work will be the timely delivery of Amazon packages to millions of customers around the world.

About the team
Amazon couldn’t deliver at pace without the Amazon Transportation Service (ATS) team. As part of ATS, you’ll be welcomed into a diverse team that plays a central role in our success. Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centres equipped with the latest technology, you’ll help Amazon’s transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.
We put safety first as our people are our priority. And we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

title: Team Lead, Client Advisor
description:
Summary:

The Team Lead, Client Advisor is an experienced, licensed insurance professional responsible for providing day-to-day insurance expertise, coaching, and sales support to a team of Client Advisors. This role serves as a hands-on resource to help Client Advisors strengthen their insurance knowledge, navigate quoting and coverage questions, and deliver accurate, consultative recommendations to customers.Working closely with the Manager, Client Advisor, the Team Lead helps bridge insurance knowledge and experience gaps across the sales team through real-time guidance, training, coaching, and support with complex customer or carrier situations. The Team Lead promotes consistent execution of quoting, advising, binding, cross-selling, and compliance standards while helping Client Advisors develop the skills and confidence necessary to succeed.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a day-to-day insurance subject-matter resource for an assigned team of Client Advisors, providing guidance on quoting, coverage options, carrier requirements, underwriting guidelines, and insurance best practices.

  • Coach and mentor Client Advisors to strengthen insurance knowledge, sales effectiveness, product understanding, and confidence in advising customers.

  • Assist Client Advisors with complex or challenging quotes and customer scenarios, helping identify appropriate coverage solutions and next steps.

  • Support Client Advisors in evaluating customer needs and recommending appropriate home, auto, and other personal lines insurance products.

  • Reinforce consultative sales practices, including identifying and presenting appropriate cross-sell and bundled insurance opportunities.

  • Provide real-time support and guidance throughout the quoting, application, binding, and policy issuance process.

  • Conduct call reviews, quote reviews, and pipeline reviews as needed to identify coaching opportunities and reinforce quality and compliance expectations.

  • Deliver individual and team-based training on insurance products, carrier guidelines, quoting processes, coverage concepts, systems, sales practices, and related topics.

  • Help ensure insurance applications and policy submissions are accurate, complete, timely, and consistent with carrier and company requirements.

  • Serve as an initial escalation resource for insurance-related questions and more complex client situations, partnering with the Manager, Client Advisor when additional support or escalation is required.

  • Reinforce standard operating procedures for quoting, advising, binding, cross-selling, documentation, and customer communication.

  • Support a client-first culture focused on accurate advice, responsiveness, trust, relationship building, and an exceptional customer experience.

  • Partner with the Manager, Client Advisor to identify recurring knowledge or skill gaps and recommend training or coaching opportunities for the team.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Working across Java, Angular and associated technologies, you'll turn architectural direction and business requirements into secure, accessible and production-ready solutions, while improving the integration and onboarding experience for consuming teams.

•Collaborate & Influence: Work with Technical Leads, Architects, Product, Delivery, QA, DevOps and other suppliers to manage dependencies and deliver successful outcomes.
•Innovate & Improve: Use CGI-approved AI-assisted development tools where appropriate to enhance coding, testing, documentation and troubleshooting, with appropriate human oversight.
•Own & Resolve: Identify technical blockers and risks early, recommend pragmatic solutions and drive issues through to resolution.
•Guide & Support: Mentor developers, contribute to code reviews and technical discussions, and share reusable approaches across the engineering community.




Required qualifications to be successful in this role


You'll be an experienced hands-on Full Stack Developer with strong Java and Angular skills and a track record of delivering production-quality solutions within complex environments. You should be comfortable working across application development, APIs, cloud platforms, automated delivery and live-service support, while communicating technical decisions and trade-offs clearly across multidisciplinary teams.
•Full stack engineering: Strong hands-on software development experience, including Java, Angular, Node.js and Express.js.
•Distributed architecture: Proven experience developing microservices, RESTful APIs, integrations and distributed systems.
•Data: Experience working with SQL databases, particularly PostgreSQL.
•Azure & Kubernetes: Experience with Azure cloud technologies, ideally including AKS, Azure Service Bus and Application Insights.
•DevOps & automation: Strong experience with CI/CD and tools such as Git, Jenkins and Terraform.
•Engineering quality: Demonstrable experience of automated testing, secure development and building maintainable, production-quality software.
•Technical ownership: Proven ability to translate architecture and requirements into practical solutions and make pragmatic engineering decisions.
•Collaborative delivery: Ability to operate effectively across multidisciplinary and multi-supplier teams while communicating risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly.
•AI-assisted engineering - desirable: Experience using tools such as Codex or GitHub Copilot to improve software engineering productivity and quality.

title: AOI/AXI Operator (Second Shift)
description:
Second Shift - 2:30PM-11:00PM

As an AOI/AXI Operator at Rocket EMS, you will play a critical role in verifying that our PCB assemblies meet the highest quality and reliability standards. You’ll be responsible for operating, programming, and maintaining automated optical and X-ray inspection systems, performing first article verifications, and ensuring defects are accurately identified and escalated. This position requires strong attention to detail, knowledge of IPC standards, and the ability to make confident quality decisions in a fast-paced production environment.

Responsibilities

  • Review job documentation (MPI, Deviations, ECOs, and Customer Requirements) prior to inspection.

  • Operate and set up AOI and AXI equipment to perform inspections on PCB assemblies.

  • Perform First Article Inspections and verify compliance with IPC-A-610 (Class 2 and 3) and customer standards.

  • Analyze inspection data and images to accurately identify, classify, and disposition defects.

  • Verify solder joint quality, component alignment, polarity, and hidden solder connections (e.g., BGAs, QFNs) through AOI/AXI systems.

  • Stop production and escalate immediately if major defects or systemic issues are identified.

  • Document inspection results, generate daily quality pass-downs, and communicate findings to leads/supervisors.

  • Raise and review Technical Inquiries for discrepancies; ensure no jobs proceed without proper authorization.

  • Support bottleneck areas or other inspection needs as directed by Supervisor, Engineer, or Manager.

  • Follow and enforce all procedures related to ESD, MSD handling, housekeeping, safety, and equipment maintenance.

  • Suggest and support continuous process and quality improvements.

Qualifications

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent (required).

Experience

  • Minimum 2 years in electronics inspection, AOI, or AXI operations within a contract manufacturing or similar environment.

  • IPC-A-610 and/or J-STD-001 certification (required).

Skills

  • Strong understanding of IPC workmanship standards (Class 2 and 3).

  • Hands-on experience with AOI/AXI equipment (e.g., Koh Young, YXLON, Orbotech, or similar systems).

  • Ability to interpret inspection images, read blueprints, assembly drawings, and BOMs.

  • Basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Outlook).

  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

  • Highly detail-oriented with the ability to detect subtle and hidden defects.

title: Head of School / Principal AY 27
description:
Job Description

Expressions of Interest | Academic Year 2027/28

Lead, Inspire. Make an impact

International Schools Partnership (ISP) is seeking expressions of interest from exceptional educational leaders who are considering their next international school leadership opportunity for the 2027/28 academic year.

ISP is a continually growing global schools group, with 120+ schools across 25+ countries and a growing community of students, teachers and educational leaders around the world. As we continue to expand, we are building relationships with talented Principals, Heads of School, Deputy Heads and senior educational leaders who could lead one of our schools into its next phase of development.

If you are an ambitious, values-led leader who is passionate about learning, people, community and school improvement, we would like to hear from you.

About ISP

ISP is a growing global community of international schools, united by a shared belief that Amazing Learning happens when we begin with our children and students.

Our schools are diverse in their locations, communities, curricula and cultures, but are connected by a common purpose and set of principles. We put students first, treat everyone with care and respect, operate effectively, act with financial responsibility and learn continuously.

Our continued global growth creates exciting opportunities for educational leaders to join ISP at a time of significant development and to contribute not only to the success of their own school, but to the wider ISP community.

As a Principal / Head of School, you will have the opportunity to lead a school within this international network, while working closely with your Regional Managing Director and colleagues across ISP.

The opportunity

Our Principals / Heads of School lead with vision, empathy and integrity, creating safe, inclusive and supportive environments where students and adults can thrive.

You will provide strategic and inspirational leadership across the school, driving exceptional learning outcomes while developing a strong school community and ensuring the school operates successfully.

The role encompasses four key areas of leadership:

People Development & Wellbeing
Build a high-performing, engaged and empowered school community where students and colleagues feel safe, valued and supported to achieve their potential. Develop leadership capacity, succession and a culture of continuous professional learning.

Student Learning Outcomes
Lead the relentless pursuit of high-quality teaching, learning, progress and achievement. Embed ISP's Learning.First approach and use evidence, data and professional development to drive sustained improvement and exceptional outcomes for students.

Community & Exceptional Customer Experience
Position the school as a School of Choice within its local community. Build strong and trusted relationships with students, parents, carers and stakeholders, while strengthening the school's reputation, engagement, retention and enrolment.

Commercial Success
Take ownership of the school's overall operational and commercial performance. Ensure resources are used effectively, support sustainable enrolment and income growth, and deliver financial and organisational targets while maintaining the highest standards of education, safeguarding and student experience.

Who are we looking for?

We are interested in hearing from leaders who can demonstrate a strong track record of educational leadership and school improvement.

You may currently be a:

  • Principal / Head of School
  • Deputy Head / Vice Principal
  • Head of Primary or Head of Secondary
  • Senior educational leader preparing for your first Principal / Head of School position
  • Experienced school leader currently working in the UK or internationally

We are particularly interested in leaders who demonstrate:

  • Inspirational and strategic educational leadership.
  • A strong commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and inclusion.
  • A proven ability to improve teaching, learning and student outcomes.
  • The ability to develop high-performing teams and future leaders.
  • Strong emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder and community engagement.
  • Commercial and financial awareness.
  • A data-informed and evidence-based approach to decision-making.
  • The ability to lead change effectively.
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to share and learn across an international network.
  • The ambition to create a school that is recognised by its community as a School of Choice.

International school experience is highly valued, although we are also keen to hear from exceptional UK-based educational leaders who are ready to make the move into international education.

Your next leadership opportunity

With 120+ schools and continued expansion across the globe, opportunities within ISP are continually evolving.

Our schools operate in a wide range of educational and cultural contexts, meaning that every leadership opportunity is different. By registering your interest with ISP, you will have the opportunity to be considered for future Principal / Head of School positions for Academic Year 2027/28 and beyond, where your experience, leadership style and aspirations align with the needs of a particular school.

We are interested in building relationships with outstanding leaders before specific opportunities arise, so if you are thinking about your next move, we would encourage you to get in touch.


ISP Principles


Begin with our children and students. Our children and students are at the heart of what we do. Simply, their success is our success. Wellbeing and safety are both essential for learners and learning. Therefore, we are consistent in identifying potential safeguarding

and Health & Safety issues and acting and following up on all concerns appropriately.


Treat everyone with care and respect. We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the well-being of self and others.


Operate effectively. We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference. We apply school policies and procedures and embody the shared ideas of our community.


Are financially responsible. We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of the children, students and our schools.


Learn continuously. Getting better is what drives us. We positively engage with personal and professional development and school improvement.

ISP Commitment to Safeguarding Principles

ISP is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures, including an online due diligence search, references and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.

ISP Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

ISP is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of ISP through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Software Engineer Co-op
description:
About the role

Steelhead Technologies is hiring a Software Engineer Co-op. The co-op will be full-time 40 hours/week at our office in Calumet, Michigan. Candidates can apply for a 4-month single semester co-op or an 8-month spring/summer or summer/fall co-op.


You’ll be working on the ERP that runs metal finishing and fabrication shops across the country. Our customers depend on Steelhead to run every part of their business — quoting, work orders, part tracking, inventory, job costing, invoicing. It isn't one tool among many for them; it's the system their entire operation runs on. That raises the stakes and it shortens the feedback loop considerably. Ship something good and you hear about it from the people using it. If something is off you’ll hear about it even faster. Few engineering roles offer that kind of directness.


Our developers sit in the same room, which means questions get answered face-to-face. You’ll join a team of five engineers with a tech lead to help you grow in your role. You'll own features rather than tickets, and you won't wait for permission to take on hard problems. You act as the product manager for what you build. You’ll get requirements from shops using the software through deployment specialists, support, and sales. From there you have a big say in how the feature will work and will direct AI across the whole cycle to get it done.


The stack is React, Node.js, TypeScript, Postgres, and GraphQL. We're based in Calumet, in Michigan's Upper Peninsula.

Responsibilities

  • Collect requirements from multiple sources and assist in development of features
  • AI-native development using Claude Code or Cursor
  • Work with tech leads on architecture and data model design
  • Support the development of larger efforts through loops and multiple agents
  • Develop test plans for your feature and thoroughly test different workflows
  • Collaborate with QA to work through testing feedback
  • Collect feedback through operational logs and product metrics

What We're Looking For

  • Currently pursuing a B.S. in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Available for a full-time co-op term (please note desired dates/duration when applying)
  • Coursework or project experience with SQL and data model design
  • Interest in or experience with AI-native development
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Action-oriented and self-directed

title: Cobol-utvecklare till framtida uppdrag inom banksektorn i Stockholm
description:
Vill du vara en del av en spännande miljö där traditionell stordator möter modern AI-teknik? Vi på Academic Work söker nu erfarna Cobol-utvecklare för framtida konsultuppdrag hos en av Sveriges ledande storbanker i Stockholm. Här får du chansen att optimera kritiska system och utforska framtidens utvecklingsmetoder i en miljö som värdesätter kontinuerligt lärande och teknisk spetskompetens. Detta är en öppen intresseanmälan för dig som vill ingå i vårt nätverk för kommande möjligheter – ta chansen och skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Om tjänsten

Som Cobol-utvecklare hos vår kund blir du en nyckelperson i ett agilt team med fokus på systemutveckling, förvaltning och optimering inom bankens utlåningsverksamhet. Rollen kombinerar djupt tekniskt kunnande inom stordator med ett starkt intresse för nya metoder och AI-assisterad utveckling för att skapa moderna och effektiva lösningar.

I det dagliga arbetet kommer du att analysera komplexa dataflöden, hantera filleveranser och arbeta nära bankens databaser för att säkerställa hög prestanda och stabilitet. Du nyttjar moderna verktygskedjor såsom IBM Developer for z/OS (IDz) och Visual Studio, och har ett nära samarbete med såväl utvecklarkollegor som produktägare, kravställare och verksamhetsexperter inom utlåningsområdet. Då banken ligger i framkanten av teknikutvecklingen förväntas du även utforska hur AI-verktyg som Claude Code kan integreras för att effektivisera det dagliga utvecklingsarbetet.

Du erbjuds

  • Möjlighet att arbeta i en innovativ miljö där Mainframe möter AI.
  • En roll med stort fokus på kompetensutveckling och samarbete.
  • Möjligheten att bygga nätverk och arbeta med komplexa, affärskritiska system

Arbetsuppgifter

Rollen innebär utveckling i stordatormiljö med fokus på Cobol och DB2, där du analyserar dataflöden och implementerar moderna utvecklingsmetoder.

  • Utveckla, underhålla och optimera affärskritiska system i Mainframe-miljö med Cobol, DB2 och SQL.
  • Analysera och optimera DB2-databaser för maximal prestanda
  • Arbeta med moderna verktyg som IBM Developer for z/OS (IDz) och Visual Studio
  • Hantera leveranser av filer och arbeta nära komplexa datastrukturer
  • Utforska och implementera AI-lösningar för att förbättra produktiviteten i utvecklingsarbetet
  • Samarbeta med olika intressenter för att lösa tekniska utmaningar inom utlåningsområdet
  • Strukturera och planera arbete i en agil utvecklingsmiljö för att möta projektmål

Vi söker dig som

  • Har god erfarenhet av systemutveckling i Mainframe-miljö samt starka programmeringskunskaper i Cobol, DB2 och SQL.
  • Har vana av att arbeta i moderna utvecklingsverktyg som IBM Developer for z/OS (IDz) eller Visual Studio.
  • Har grundläggande kunskaper inom IMS.
  • Har god förståelse för att arbeta nära data, databaser och filleveranser.
  • Har ett starkt intresse för att utforska och använda AI-verktyg för att effektivisera utvecklingsprocesser.
  • Kommunikation obehindrat på både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har

  • Praktisk erfarenhet av AI-assisterade verktyg som exempelvis Claude Code.
  • Tidigare erfarenhet från banksektorn, finansiella system eller utlåningsområdet.
  • Erfarenhet av agilt arbete samt förståelse för Full Stack-utveckling eller systemarkitektur.

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:

  • Ordningsam
  • Ansvarstagande
  • Målmedveten

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Inventory Control Lead
description:
Onsite:

Join the Maverick Power Team!

At Maverick Power, we don’t just build power distribution solutions—we redefine industry standards. Recognized on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list as #16 in the U.S., #2 in Manufacturing, and #1 in Texas, we are committed to driving innovation, quality, and speed. With multiple manufacturing facilities across North Texas and Phoenix, we are expanding rapidly and looking for top talent to grow with us

If you are ready to be part of a high-energy, solutions-driven team where your work makes an impact, Maverick Power is the place for you.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Compensation + Bonus Potential!
  • Paid Time Off, 401K Matching, Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits!
  • High-growth organization with advancement opportunities!
  • Diverse, Collaborative, & Fun Work Environment!

About the Role:

Maverick Power is looking for a detail-orientated individual to join our team as an Inventory Control Lead. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate inventory levels by performing counts, verifying materials, updating system records, and resolving discrepancies. Supports warehouse operations by ensuring all items are properly received, stored, and issued according to established procedures.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead daily inventory control activities, including cycle counts, inventory reconciliation, and material verification.
  • Assign, prioritize, and monitor daily workload for Inventory Control personnel.
  • Investigate inventory discrepancies and perform root cause analysis to identify and implement corrective actions.
  • Review and approve inventory transactions, adjustments, transfers, and system corrections within Epicor.
  • Partner with Receiving, Production, Shipping, Planning, and Purchasing to resolve inventory and material flow issues.
  • Ensure inventory accuracy through regular audits, location verification, and adherence to inventory control procedures.
  • Develop, maintain, and enforce inventory control SOPs and standard work instructions.
  • Monitor inventory KPIs, prepare reports, and communicate inventory performance and risks to leadership.
  • Train, coach, and mentor Inventory Control team members while promoting accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Support physical inventories, internal audits, process improvement projects, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Communicate inventory findings and updates to leadership in a timely manner.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of warehouse inventory control experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
  • Previous leadership or lead experience supervising inventory operations.
  • Advanced knowledge of inventory control principles, cycle counting, and inventory reconciliation.
  • Strong proficiency with ERP systems (Epicor Kinetic preferred).
  • Experience investigating inventory discrepancies using root cause analysis.
  • Strong understanding of warehouse processes, material flow, and inventory transactions.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and inventory reporting tools.nt.
  • Basic math and computer skills (Excel, scanning devices, reporting tools).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Epicor Kinetic experience.
  • Experience leading annual physical inventories.
  • Lean Manufacturing or Continuous Improvement experience.
  • Experience developing inventory procedures, KPIs, and training materials.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods sitting, standing, and performing repetitive tasks
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at a time
  • Must be able to navigate warehouse and reach items both high and low
  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Must be able to stand, walk, climb, bend, stoop, and work at heights for extended periods.
  • Must have vision correctable to 20/20 and be able to wear required PPE (hard hat, safety glasses, boots, gloves, etc.).
  • Duties are performed in a loud production setting subject to extreme temperatures. Some duties may be required to be

performed outside. Comfortable with repetitive movement, kneeling,

Work Environment:
May work in various settings at the Maverick Power facilities, in offices, in multiple shops, and commercial buildings. Maintaining the same position or posture while performing tasks and sitting for prolonged periods. The above-noted job description is not intended to describe, in detail, the multitude of tasks that may be assigned but rather to give the applicant a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations of this position. As the nature of business demands change, so, too, may the essential functions of the position.

EEO/AAP Statement

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: PROBATION AND PAROLE SPECIALIST - ADULT
description:
About this Job


Louisiana Department of

Public Safety & Corrections –

Corrections Services


Division of Probation & Parole – Adult

Lafayette, Louisiana


At the Louisiana Department of Corrections, our mission is to promote public safety and strengthen communities through fair, professional, and responsive corrections services. We are committed to protecting the people of Louisiana with integrity, accountability, and a deep respect for the rights and dignity of all.

This is a promotional opportunity for current LA Department of Corrections employees who have permanent status and are ready to advance in their career.

This position is responsible for supervising and investigating adult criminal offenders who have been determined to need specialized intensive supervision or require special investigative efforts and are on or seeking release to probation, parole, work releases, a community residential center or grant of pardon. Public safety is the utmost concern in the execution of all duties.

An ideal candidate should possess the following competencies:

  • Driving Results: The ability to set and pursue goals, maintain focus amid competing demands, and deliver results.

  • Following Policies and Procedures: The ability to follow, reinforce, adapt, or develop policies and procedures to maintain compliance with federal and state legal requirements, State Civil Service rules, and organizational policies.

  • Making Accurate Judgments: The ability to assess options, weigh risks, and make sound decisions using available information and logical reasoning.

Minimum Qualifications

Two years of experience as a probation or parole officer, or in counseling, psychology, social work, education, criminal justice, or administrative services plus one of the following:

1. Three years of experience in corrections or law enforcement
2. Three years of continuous active military duty (all Military Occupational Specialties apply)
3. Six years of full-time experience in any field
4. A bachelor's degree

OR

One year of experience as a probation or parole officer, or in counseling, psychology, social work, education, criminal justice, or administrative services plus a master’s degree in counseling, psychology, social work, education, business administration, public administration, or a criminal justice field.

EXPERIENCE SUBSTITUTION:
Every 30 semester hours earned from an accredited college or university will be credited as one year of experience towards the six years of full-time work experience in any field. The maximum substitution allowed is 120 semester hours which substitutes for a maximum of four years of experience in any field.

NECESSARY SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:
An applicant who has been convicted of a misdemeanor crime of domestic violence or a felony, or who is under indictment on a felony charge will be disqualified until relief from the disabilities imposed by state and federal laws is granted.

Possession of a current Louisiana driver's license.

This position requires the incumbent to handle and carry firearms.

Possession of an active Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST) certification.

Job Specification

The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here.

Job Duties and Other Information

  • Conducts high-risk offender investigations and intensive supervision, including violent offenders, sex offenders, gang members, and medically contagious offenders, while ensuring legal compliance, administering drug tests, and coordinating community service activities.
  • Provides leadership and functional supervision to Probation and Parole Officers, guiding field operations, crisis interventions, arrests, transportation, training, and unit oversight in the supervisor’s absence.
  • Supports and monitors correctional and community-based programs, including sheriff’s maintenance, work release, residential facilities, IMPACT programs, and CRC operations through audits, disciplinary hearings, and contract-compliance reviews.
  • Delivers and coordinates specialized tactical and defensive training, including PPCT decisions, firearms instruction, pre-academy requirements, POST academy classes, and collaboration with external agencies for advanced tactical preparation.
  • Ensures agency-wide compliance with ACA standards, conducting audits of jail facilities, performing structured evaluations, and maintaining required procedures, timelines, and documentation across major activities.
  • Provides programmatic leadership and statewide support, helping develop objectives, evaluate strategies, recommend policy changes, assist private providers, and collaborate closely with officers, supervisors, program managers, and administrative leaders.



Position-Specific Details:

Appointment Type: Promotion of a permanent, classified employee of LA DPS&C - CORRECTIONS SERVICES (Adult DOC)

  • The selected employee may be required to serve a trial detail prior to being permanently promoted or may be required to accept a probational appointment.

Compensation: This position has a Special Entrance Rate (SER) of $30.57 per hour.

The Louisiana Department of Public Safety and Corrections - Corrections Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on any non-merit factor including disability.

Other Important Information:

Any degree, certificate, special license, or DD-214 must be verified by official documentation prior to hire.
Any qualifying experience that is based on college credit/college hours should have an accompanying transcript for verification.
  • This is a 24 hour facility.
  • Applicants may be required to work shift work.
  • This Agency is a Drug-Free Workplace.


How to Apply:

No Civil Service test score is required in order to be considered for this vacancy.

To apply for this vacancy, click on the “Apply” link above and complete an electronic application, which can be used for this vacancy as well as future job opportunities. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. Further status message information is located under the Information section of the Current Job Opportunities page.

*Information to support your eligibility for this job title must be included in the application (i.e., relevant, detailed experience/education). Resumes will not be accepted in lieu of completed education and experience sections on your application. Applications may be rejected if incomplete.

Laura Guillory
