title: Staff Software / AI Engineer
description:
About the role

Pathos is building the first AI native biotech platform, one that turns massive multimodal datasets into foundation models, and those models into live agents that materially change how drug development is done. Instead of bolting AI onto legacy pharma systems, we are designing a new stack from the ground up.


We are hiring an engineer to architect and ship the first generation of Pathos AI and data infrastructure. Your work will power our core products and run the agents that support BD, clinical development, computational biology, and lab teams. This is an early role with broad technical scope and full ownership.


If you want to build the technical infrastructure that rewires the R&D workflow, this is the place to do your career's best work. It is one of the most direct applications of your engineering skill to advances in cancer research.

What You’ll Build

  • Build AI agents and copilots for internal teams across BD, clinical, computational biology, and lab.
  • Build robust data pipelines into a governed warehouse and knowledge graph.
  • Build MCP style servers and tooling so agents can safely talk to internal systems.
  • Work across the full product lifecycle: prototype, iterate, ship, and maintain.

Who You Are

You have architected and owned a production system end to end, from design through observability, that real users depend on. You have shipped LLM powered workflows in production, not just prototyped them. You know how technologies like LangGraph work and not just use it as a library. You make high judgment technical calls at the system level, not just execute well-scoped tasks. You move quickly, take initiative, and operate with a strong sense of ownership. You like working closely with end users and shaping products from zero to one.

Must-haves:

  • Roughly 8 or more years of professional software, ML, or product engineering experience building systems that real users depend on. We read this as a signal of demonstrated scope, not a hard gate.
  • Fluent in Python and TypeScript in production, and comfortable building full stack applications.
  • Experience with production grade APIs, eventing, and data engineering, ideally cloud native on GCP, BigQuery, or similar.
  • You own services end to end: architecture, implementation, testing, and observability.

Bonus:

  • Prior work on agentic systems at scale, retrieval systems, or ML infrastructure.
  • Experience operating in highly regulated environments that use patient and clinical trial data.

Location

This is a hybrid role, requiring 4 days per week onsite, in our NYC Headquarters.

title: IT-tekniker skrivare
description:
Vi är specialister på bemanning och konsulttjänster inom IT och teknik – från lovande talanger och konsulter med bred kompetens till erfarna specialister med djup expertis.

För dig som kandidat innebär vi en trygg partner som erbjuder spännande uppdrag, personlig utveckling och nära kontakt med våra rådgivare. Vi ser till att du får rätt uppdrag för din kompetens och dina ambitioner – alltid med människan i centrum.

För våra kunder betyder det att vi är en pålitlig leverantör som snabbt kan matcha rätt kompetens med rätt behov. Utöver vår egen starka konsultorganisation har vi även ett utökat partnernätverk, vilket gör att vi kan erbjuda ännu större flexibilitet och bredd i leveransen.

Samarbete och kvalitet präglar allt vi gör, och våra kärnvärden sammanfattas i vårt löfte: Empowering the Nordics through people.

Eccera har 300 anställda och kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö och Linköping. Vi är medlem i Almega Kompetensföretagen och följer deras tecknade kollektivavtal med Unionen.

Vi söker nu en serviceinriktad och lösningsorienterad IT-tekniker med inriktning mot skrivare till ett spännande uppdrag hos en av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom försvars- och säkerhetsindustrin. Kunden utvecklar avancerade tekniska lösningar och system inom bland annat försvar, säkerhet och flyg, och du får möjlighet att arbeta i en tekniskt avancerad och komplex IT-miljö. I rollen får du arbeta med drift, underhåll, installation och support av skrivare och blir en viktig kontaktperson för verksamhetens användare. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera ditt tekniska kunnande med ett starkt kund- och servicefokus.

Som konsult på Eccera får du en trygg anställning och samlar på dig värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet på uppdrag hos våra kunder. Din konsultchef stöttar dig i din utveckling där du hela tiden fyller på med nya erfarenheter och kunskaper. En utmärkt möjlighet att göra karriär.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som IT-tekniker med inriktning mot skrivare kommer du bland annat att:

  • Konfigurera och installera olika typer av skrivare.
  • Drifta och underhålla skrivarmiljöer.
  • Ge support och utföra felsökning samt felavhjälpning.
  • Arbeta proaktivt för att identifiera och förebygga problem.
  • Hantera och administrera IT-utrustning i olika system för assethantering.
  • Ha nära kontakt med användare och säkerställa en hög servicenivå.
  • Resa inom Sverige vid behov.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är tekniskt intresserad, serviceinriktad och har ett starkt kundfokus. Du trivs med att lösa problem, arbeta praktiskt och hjälpa användare i deras vardag.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Erfarenhet av installation, konfiguration och support av skrivare.
  • Erfarenhet av ledande skrivarmärken, exempelvis Ricoh, HP, Canon och Xerox.
  • Erfarenhet av assethantering och arbete i olika system.
  • God problemlösningsförmåga och ett strukturerat arbetssätt.
  • B-körkort då resor inom Sverige förekommer i tjänsten.

Som person är du ansvarstagande, lösningsorienterad och kommunikativ. Du trivs både med att arbeta självständigt och tillsammans med andra och har en naturlig förmåga att skapa goda relationer med användare och kollegor.

Vad vi erbjuder

På Eccera får du de verktyg du behöver för att nå dina mål. Vi erbjuder alla våra konsulter kvalificerade utbildningar och certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken. Vi sätter stort värde på att våra medarbetare hela tiden ska fortsätta att utvecklas. Därför erbjuder vi dig möjligheten att lägga upp en individuell utbildningsplan, där vi bekostar såväl studiematerial som själva certifieringarna. Under din utveckling kommer vi matcha din kompetens mot rätt uppdrag i takt med att du avancerar.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, AWS National Security Solutions Architecture Team
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to support our National Security Space and Sensor Customers.

As a Solutions Architect on AWS National Security Team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to AWS customers in the Intelligence Community – you are the “face of Amazon” to our customers; you will engage on a broad variety of technical challenges which are not just complex, but mission-critical.

This is a high visibility role where you collaborate with, and influence, both external stakeholders and internal AWS teams including sales and platform engineering. National Security Solutions Architects (SAs) are regarded as technical “thought leaders” within the Intelligence Community who evangelize emerging technologies not only on a conceptual level, but also on a practical, architectural level.

As a National Security SA, you’ll solve problems at both the business and technical levels – you'll work backwards from our customers’ requirements, envisioning new solutions and strategies we can leverage that would enable agencies to operate more efficiently and better execute on their mission objectives. You'll make the puzzle pieces fit together from the technical side and deliver the offering to the customer at scale. Frequently, you will be responsible for mission-critical solutions with National Security implications.

Often, the best way to innovate around a customer challenge is to create a new product altogether. This position offers you the unique opportunity to enhance existing AWS service features and even create entirely new tools to adapt to our customers’ requirements within the complex technical constraints of the cleared environment.

Amazon Web Services is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who align with our Leadership Principles and possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills.

The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record in software/technology sales or consulting. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance.

Key job responsibilities
• Architect cloud-based solutions in response to complex technical challenges
• In partnership with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS
• As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
• Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
• Design and implement generative AI, machine learning, and agentic AI architectures using AWS services (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, Amazon Q) tailored to IC mission requirements
• Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
• Capture and share best-practice knowledge among the AWS solutions architect community
• Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers and other reusable content
• Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
• Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

About the team
About AWS
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Svetsare Till GKN Aerospace
description:
Om jobbet

Vi söker drivna och passionerade personer som vill göra en skillnad! Vara med och påverka den hållbara omvandlingen av flygindustrin. Vill du vara med och bygga ett vinnande team i Rymdverkstaden? Vi behöver utöka vårt team med en svetsare.

Om företaget

Varje gång du flyger, nästan var som helst i världen, är det troligt att GKN Aerospace hjälper dig på vägen. Vår teknologi och våra komponenter används i 90% av världens flygplan, i allt från små och stora passagerarflygplan, affärsjets samt i världens mest avancerade stridsflygplan. Vi designar och tillverkar även innovativa komponenter till rymdsystem. Vi utvecklas ständigt, banar väg för ny teknik och utmanar oss själva för att bli bättre i allt vi gör. Vi söker drivna och passionerade medarbetare som vill göra en skillnad! Var med och påverka den hållbara omvandlingen av flygindustrin och hitta en plats där din karriär tar fart i en värld av enorma möjligheter att lära och utvecklas.

Tjänstebeskrivning

Rollen innebär att arbeta med svetsning av munstycken. Det innebär att svetsa manuellt, men också maskinsvetsning samt i förlängningen även lasersvetsning i våra två robotceller. Avdelningen ansvarar för SWAN-rymdmunstycket samt framtida rymdmunstycken. Merparten av tillverkningen sker inom avdelningen och omfattar bearbetning, lasersvetsning, manuell svetsning, förmontering inför dessa operationer, gradning, penetrantprovning, GOM-mätning samt kontroll. Verksamheten bedrivs i en lågvolymsverkstad som för närvarande befinner sig i en upptrappningsfas. Inom området har vi ett tätt samarbete med tekniker, vilket är nyckeln till att vara ett starkt team och klara de ökande volymerna.

Kvalifikationer

* Industriteknisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet. * Erfarenhet av svetsning. * Önskvärt med erfarenhet av svetsning med robot. * Svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Vem är du?

Vi söker en engagerad och flexibel teamspelare som är kvalitetsmedveten, kommunikativ, serviceinriktad och nyfiken. Du har en positiv inställning, samarbetar lätt med andra och bidrar till en stark teamkänsla. Du är ansvarstagande och arbetar med säkerhet, kvalitet, leverans och utveckling som ledord. Dessutom deltar du aktivt i förbättringsarbete och driver dina uppgifter i mål. Du trivs i en flexibel miljö där arbetsuppgifterna kan utvecklas över tid.

Övrig information

Skiftformen är idag GKN-skift. Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd.

Låter detta intressant?

Har du frågor, så tveka inte att kontakta Rekryteringskonsult Nathalie Stenman Nyberg . Din ansökan skickar du in via NearYous hemsida, www.nearyou.se snarast. Vi jobbar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna din ansökan idag. Med anledning av nya dataskyddsförordningen GDPR, ber vi dig att utesluta de sista fyra siffrorna i ditt personnummer samt eventuella referenskontakter i din ansökan/CV. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om NearYou

NearYou är ett rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag med kontor i 17 städer. Vi har gått från att vara ett bolag bland andra i branschen till att också bli en samhällsaktör. Med oss som partner och arbetsgivare lovar vi att ge mer av det vi är bäst på. Vi är bäst på att vara nära, mänskliga och en motpol till stress, människor som statistik och en alltför opersonlig digitalisering. Vi är hos dig, ett handslag, ett löfte. För dig som kandidat innebär det en aktör som backar dig, oavsett var i karriären du är och vill vara. Vi vill vara tryggheten i en snabb värld. Vi stöttar, utmanar och frågar hur det går. Helt naturligt, tycker vi. Läs gärna mer om oss på www.nearyou.se

Att arbeta som konsult på NearYou

Som konsult hos NearYou är du anställd hos oss och arbetar ute hos någon av våra kunder. För oss är det viktigt att erbjuda en trygg och hållbar anställning för alla våra anställda. Du har samma fördelar och trygghet som hos en traditionell arbetsgivare och du omfattas av kollektivavtalens villkor för till exempel lön, försäkringar, pension och semester. Som konsult hos oss får du en konsultchef som hjälper dig i ditt val av uppdrag och ger dig tips och råd hur du kan utvecklas i arbetslivet. Du får även möta olika företagskulturer och får erfarenhet från olika branscher, vilket gör att du utvecklar din kompetens och ditt nätverk och gör dig till en mer attraktiv medarbetare

title: Groundsperson - Craven Cottage
description:

Desirable

Experience:

  • Take responsibility of tasks.

Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:

  • Understanding of health and safety.

Personal Qualities:

  • Hard working
  • Works to a high standard

  • Good problem solver
  • Keen eye for presentation

title: HSE consultant (France)
description:
ERM is seeking a motivated Health and Safety, Environmental & Sustainability Consultant with a passion for sustainability to join our growing team based in Paris.

ERM has strong network of EHS experts who come together globally to innovate our service offering for clients on regular basis through our internal technical community.

Joining us would mean that you work in a company that is innovative and committed to sustainability where EHS practices play an important role. Our clients operate in sectors with complex regulatory environments, and the global nature also sees them having challenging issues around EHS and relevant performance management requirements. Our team works with clients in energy, technology, mining companies, through to multinational corporate companies. And the services provided by the EHS/OP Team include EHS strategy, designing and implementing EHS management systems, compliance management support and delivering audit programmes; and cover the breadth of environmental through to health and safety disciplines.

And we continue to provide subject matter expertise alongside our digital services colleagues – helping our clients get better value from their EHS and operational data to make better more informed decisions.

Our office is in Paris, and we offer flexible working arrangements.

Job Responsibilities

  • Support on the design and implementation of corporate Environmental, Health & Safety strategies and programs for HSE and Sustainability including diagnostics, compliance and technical audits, awareness raising, training programs, and hazard and risks identification and assessment.
  • Conduct on-site, risk-based assessments to identify critical operational health and safety risks and support clients in implementing practical and effective risk control measures.
  • Support on the design and implementation of activities related to H&S Training and field coaching, including competency assessment, training programs for behavioral change, human factor analysis and assessment.
  • Support on design and implementation of HSE and Sustainability governance processes aimed to drive Operational performance improvement of Organizations, including deployment of risk and opportunities assessment, development of management systems, planning and delivery of auditing activities, design and delivery of training programs.
  • Support on specific sustainability activities (e.g. Low Carbon Economy Transition projects, Carbon neutrality and climate change projects, Life-Cycle Assessments, circular economy, etc.

About you

  • Substantial, relevant experience across HSE and sustainability disciplines as a consultant or in industry.
  • Master's degree in environmental/Safety Engineering, Environmental/Natural resources Management or other relevant disciplines.
  • Working knowledge of English (C1) is required, knowledge of other languages will be considered as a plus (preferred French and/or Spanish).
  • Good knowledge of French HSE legislation and international HSE & Sustainability Guidelines/Standards (e.g. SDGs, TCFD, ISO 14001, ISO45001, ISO 50001, ISO 26000, SA8000).

⠀

ERM is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive, it’s an essential part of what makes ERM a great place to build a career and helps us create better solutions for our clients.

We welcome talent from all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities for every candidate. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or need accommodations during the selection process, we’re here to support you. Our commitment doesn’t stop at hiring. Once you join us, we’ll ensure you have the tools, support, and adjustments needed to succeed and feel a true sense of belonging. Learn more about our Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging (DIB) efforts by visiting our website or exploring our 2025 Sustainability Report..

title: Head O2C & TCM GCC
description:
Job Description Summary

The Head O2C & TCM – GCC is responsible for leading end-to-end Order to Cash and Treasury & Cash Management service delivery across the Global Capability Centre, ensuring accurate, timely, compliant, and customer-focused operations across countries and regions in scope.
The role owns global O2C and TCM delivery across cash application, collections, credit, reporting, deductions, receivables management, payments, cash forecasting, cash accounting, liquidity support, bank administration, treasury controls, and related month-end close activities. The role is accountable for driving operational excellence, governance, compliance, transformation, automation, stakeholder partnership, and scalable service delivery across the O2C and TCM organisation.
The role also plays a key leadership role in transitions, Centre of Excellence development, process standardisation, risk management, audit readiness, and capability building across the GCC.

Job Description

Position Purpose:

The Head O2C & TCM – GCC is responsible for leading end-to-end Order to Cash and Treasury & Cash Management service delivery across the Global Capability Centre, ensuring accurate, timely, compliant, and customer-focused operations across countries and regions in scope.

The role owns global O2C and TCM delivery across cash application, collections, credit, reporting, deductions, receivables management, payments, cash forecasting, cash accounting, liquidity support, bank administration, treasury controls, and related month-end close activities. The role is accountable for driving operational excellence, governance, compliance, transformation, automation, stakeholder partnership, and scalable service delivery across the O2C and TCM organisation.

The role also plays a key leadership role in transitions, Centre of Excellence development, process standardisation, risk management, audit readiness, and capability building across the GCC.

Your Key Responsibilities:

Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:

1. O2C & TCM Service Delivery Leadership

  • Own and oversee global O2C and TCM delivery across cash, payments, forecasting, treasury operations, collections, credit, reporting, reconciliations, factoring, deductions, disputes, and month-end close activities.
  • Ensure all operational deliverables are completed accurately, on time, and in line with defined service levels, controls, SOPs, and business requirements.
  • Provide strategic and operational direction to O2C and TCM process leads, managers, and teams across the GCC.
  • Ensure consistent delivery quality across countries, entities, and process towers.
  • Monitor key operational metrics, dashboards, ageing, cash flow, payment execution, open items, reconciliations, and exception cases.
  • Drive structured governance around issue resolution, escalation management, risk mitigation, and service delivery performance.

2. Treasury & Cash Management Oversight

  • Lead GCC TCM operations covering payments, cash forecasting, cash accounting, bank administration, liquidity support, intercompany netting, loan management, cash pool activities, and treasury-related reporting.
  • Ensure payment processes are executed accurately, securely, and in compliance with internal policies and control requirements.
  • Oversee cash forecasting and liquidity management support to enable effective working capital and funding decisions.
  • Ensure timely completion of bank reconciliations, payment controls, e-banking access reviews, bank signatory reviews, and manual payment governance.
  • Partner with Group Treasury, Country FRA, CFO teams, and business stakeholders to address treasury operational requirements.
  • Ensure TCM teams maintain strong documentation, process discipline, and audit readiness.

3. Order to Cash Oversight

  • Lead O2C operations across cash application, collections support, deductions and disputes, credit support, AR reporting, receivables reconciliations, factoring support, and month-end close support.
  • Drive timely resolution of unapplied cash, unidentified cash, missing remittances, aged receivables, customer disputes, refunds, credit issues, and exception items.
  • Ensure AR reports, ageing analysis, credit insights, reconciliations, and operational dashboards are accurate, complete, and delivered within timelines.
  • Support effective cash flow and receivables management through disciplined follow-up, stakeholder collaboration, and performance tracking.
  • Strengthen O2C process controls, documentation, operational governance, and reporting quality.

4. Governance, Controls & Compliance

  • Drive governance and compliance across SFCF, ICFR, audit, risk, and process control requirements.
  • Ensure appropriate control frameworks are maintained across O2C and TCM processes.
  • Oversee audit readiness, control evidence, compliance testing, risk reviews, and timely remediation of gaps.
  • Ensure teams perform assigned activities in compliance with company SOPs, GxP regulations where applicable, data integrity requirements, and internal policies.
  • Partner with internal and external auditors, FRA leadership, and control owners to support audits, reviews, and regulatory requirements.
  • Promote a strong risk-aware and compliance-focused culture across the team.

5. Transformation, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead transformation and automation initiatives to improve efficiency, standardisation, quality, and scalability across O2C and TCM.
  • Identify and implement productivity improvements, process simplification, harmonisation, and best practices across countries and process areas.
  • Drive Centre of Excellence development for O2C and TCM capabilities within the GCC.
  • Use operational insights, KPI trends, RCA, and stakeholder feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Sponsor and oversee projects that improve service delivery, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and enhance customer experience.
  • Promote digital mindset, continuous improvement, and innovation across the organisation.

6. Transition & Stabilisation Leadership

  • Lead and support transitions of O2C and TCM activities into the GCC, ensuring effective planning, knowledge transfer, documentation, training, risk mitigation, and operational readiness.
  • Partner with sending and receiving teams to ensure seamless transition execution and post-go-live stabilisation.
  • Ensure transition milestones, onboarding, access readiness, process documentation, training, and hypercare activities are managed effectively.
  • Build scalable operating models to support expanding scope across regions, countries, and process towers.
  • Maintain structured communication and governance with stakeholders during transition and stabilisation phases.

7. Stakeholder Management

  • Act as a senior point of contact for O2C and TCM service delivery across GCC-supported countries and stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships with Global FRA, Country FRA, Group Treasury, CFOs, commercial teams, process owners, auditors, and GCC leadership.
  • Provide timely updates on performance, risks, issues, transitions, control matters, and improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure stakeholder expectations are proactively managed and service delivery remains business-focused.
  • Represent GCC O2C and TCM in governance forums, operational reviews, leadership discussions, and transition meetings.

8. People Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, coach, and develop O2C and TCM managers, process leads, specialists, and team members.
  • Build a high-performing, collaborative, accountable, inclusive, and customer-focused team culture.
  • Define clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for the team.
  • Ensure effective workforce planning, onboarding, cross-training, knowledge management, and succession planning.
  • Strengthen team capabilities in process knowledge, stakeholder management, controls, analytics, automation, and leadership.
  • Promote Sandoz values and behaviours through inclusive, proactive, respectful, and results-driven leadership.

What you’ll bring to the role:

Essential Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or related field.
  • MBA Finance, CA, CMA, CPA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
  • Lean Six Sigma, PMP, Treasury, Finance Operations, or process excellence certifications would be an advantage.
  • Extensive experience in Finance Operations, Shared Services, GCC, or Global Business Services environments.
  • Strong functional experience in Order to Cash and Treasury & Cash Management.
  • Proven leadership experience in managing large teams, multi-country operations, and complex stakeholder environments.
  • Experience in cash application, collections, credit, AR reporting, reconciliations, disputes, payments, cash forecasting, cash accounting, bank administration, treasury controls, and month-end close.
  • Strong experience in transitions, operational stabilisation, process transformation, standardisation, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, compliance, audit, SFCF/ICFR requirements, and risk management.

Why Sandoz?

Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of access to good healthcare.

With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.

Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!

Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Skills Desired

Ability To Influence Key Stakeholders, Building Effective Teams, Compliance And Controls, Critical Thinking, E2E Process View, Financial Accounting, Financial And Management Reporting, Resilience, Tax, Understanding Value Drivers

title: Assembler
description:
Assembler

Operations | Anaheim, CA | Full-Time

About Korrus

Korrus is transforming the way people interact with light. We are the leader in human-centric lighting, built on more than 500 patents in spectral and circadian technology, and pioneers in Human Light Interaction, the next frontier in human health and wellness.

That work runs on three fronts:

• Ecosense. A globally known and respected leader in architectural and commercial lighting, and the business now bringing circadian technology into the spaces where people work, heal, learn, and gather.

• OIO. Our consumer brand, bringing circadian lighting into the home: biologically aligned light, the right spectrum at the right time of day, to support how people wake, focus, and rest.

• Everything else in Human Light Interaction. We are pushing the limits of what light can do for human health and performance, and we own the intellectual property to do it.

The Role

The Assembler is responsible for assembling lighting products and components according to established work instructions, quality standards, and production schedules. This position plays a critical role in supporting manufacturing operations by producing high-quality products safely, accurately, and efficiently.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Assemble components, subassemblies, and finished products according to work instructions, engineering drawings, and visual aids.

· Use hand tools, power tools, fixtures, and other assembly equipment safely and effectively.

· Inspect completed assemblies to ensure products meet quality standards and specifications.

· Identify, report, and help resolve defective materials, equipment issues, or assembly discrepancies.

· Perform basic testing or verification procedures as required.

· Maintain accurate production records and complete required documentation.

· Keep workstations clean, organized, and compliant with 5S and safety standards.

· Meet daily production goals while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.

· Follow all company safety policies, quality procedures, and standard operating procedures.

· Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, quality personnel, and fellow production team members.

· Assist with other manufacturing or warehouse duties as assigned.

Requirements

· High school diploma or GED preferred.

· Previous manufacturing or assembly experience preferred but not required.

· Ability to read and follow written work instructions and diagrams.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.

· Good hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity.

· Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

· Dependable attendance and punctuality.

Physical Requirements

· Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and perform repetitive motions throughout the workday.

· Ability to regularly lift and carry up to 35 pounds and occasionally up to 50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.

· Ability to use hands and fingers for repetitive assembly tasks requiring fine motor skills.

· Ability to distinguish colors and small components when assembling products.

Work Environment

· Manufacturing and production floor environment.

· Regular exposure to mechanical equipment, hand tools, and production machinery.

· Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) may be required depending on the work area.

· Overtime and occasional weekend work may be required to meet production demands.

Compensation

We offer competitive hourly compensation based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Korrus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

This position is not eligible for current or future visa sponsorship.

title: Täby vårdcentral söker legitimerad läkare
company: Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde, Primärvård, Täby vårdenhet, Vårdcentral
description:
Vi söker nu en legitimerad läkare till vårt team.

Täby vårdcentral är en regionsdriven vårdcentral med ca 12 800 listade patienter som ligger mitt i centrala Täby, ca 20 minuter från T-centralen, med goda kommunikationsmöjligheter.

Vi är en etablerad och stabil vårdcentral med 9 allmänspecialister, 5 ST-läkare, AT-läkare, DSK, SSK och USK, Fysioterapeut samt ett psykosocialt team och Rehabkoordinator. Hos oss erbjuds patienter god tillgänglighet och kvalitet och vi arbetar i välfungerande team runt många diagnosgrupper såsom diabetes, psykisk ohälsa, sjukskrivningar, sköra äldre, smärta, astma/KOL, demens. Våra hemsjukvårdspatienter tas om hand av ett team bestående en geriatriker, dsk, ssk och usk.

Mottagningen präglas av bra bemanning, arbetsglädje, engagemang och korta beslutsvägar. Det finns ett brett samarbete mellan yrkeskategorier vilket säkrar en god arbetsmiljö och hög patientnöjdhet. Du kan läsa mer om oss på Täby vårdcentral (regionstockholm.se)

Vi erbjuder:

Inom SLSO finns goda möjligheter för att du som medarbetare ska utvecklas och bli riktigt bra inom din profession. På vårt intranät finns information för dig som nyanställd som stöd i din introduktion när du börjar hos oss. Vi har ett antal obligatoriska utbildningar och utöver detta finns ytterligare möjligheter till kompetensutveckling.

Hos oss har du stor möjlighet att påverka, utveckla och utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Vi erbjuder också våra medarbetare förmåner såsom flexibla arbetstider, friskvårdsersättning, fri öppen hälso- och sjukvård samt tjänstepension mm. Du kan läsa mer om det på Förmåner hos Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde (regionstockholm.se)

Arbetsuppgifter:

Alla förekommande arbetsuppgifter som läkare inom primärvården. Vi erbjuder ett omväxlande arbete kring akuta och kroniska sjukdomar, förebyggande insatser kring levnadsvanor samt patienter i alla åldrar. Patienterna har en mängd olika typer av sjukdomar och problem.

Arbetet ställer krav på bred kompetens och självständighet. Som läkare hos oss arbetar du både individuellt med dina patienter och i team tillsammans med alla våra olika yrkeskategorier. Vi värnar om en rimlig arbetsmiljö och en god patientsäkerhet.

Vi arbetar aktivt med digitala kommunikationsmedel och delar av arbetet kan ske på distans.

Kvalifikationer:

Legitimerad läkare med behörighet att verka inom svensk sjukvård. Erfarenhet som läkare och av att ha arbetat i svensk sjukvård, gärna primärvård är meriterande. Erfarenhet av journalsystemet TakeCare är meriterande.

Anställningsform:

Tidsbegränsad anställning. Heltid 100%. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Personliga egenskaper:

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för arbetet på vårdcentral.

Du tycker om att arbeta i primärvården och har god samarbetsförmåga. Du är lösningsorienterad och har en vilja att utveckla och utvecklas tillsammans med oss. Ett gott och respektfullt bemötande av patienter, närstående och kollegor samt förmåga att dela med sig av kunskap och information är av yttersta vikt. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och att du passar in i arbetsgruppen.

Övrig information:

Vi kommer löpande att gå igenom ansökningar och kan kalla till intervju innan sista ansökningsdag.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver tas i anspråk för intern omplacering, enligt gällande regelverk.

Vid patientnära arbete inom Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde:

- tillämpas registerkontroll före beslut om anställning enligt SLSO:s övergripande anvisning för registerkontroll vid anställning.

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.

ETAP's expertise has emerged from more than 35 years of global experience, and more recently in 2023 by expanding into new integrated offerings with IGE, a leading electrical engineering software company renowned for its SEE software portfolio for the creation, maintenance, and calculation of electrical installation projects.

Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!

ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Job title: Technical Sales Engineer
Reports to: Sales Manager
Position location: Poland

Contract: full-time

The job

We are looking for a motivated and technically skilled Technical Sales Engineer to support the sales and business development of advanced electrical power system analysis software, including ETAP/SEE/CANECO.

The ideal candidate combines a strong technical background in electrical power systems with excellent communication and customer-facing skills. This role involves supporting customers throughout the sales process, understanding their technical requirements, delivering software demonstrations, and helping them identify the best solutions for their engineering challenges.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and execute business development strategies to expand ETAP’s footprint in the CEE region
  • Understand customer requirements and identify appropriate technical solutions.
  • Prepare technical and commercial proposals relating to solution concepts.
  • Deliver professional presentations of ETAP solutions for customers and prospects
  • Explain the technical and business benefits of the proposed solutions.
  • Participate in customer meetings, workshops, webinars, conferences, and industry events.
  • Assist customers during software evaluation and selection processes.
  • Support the development of new markets and customer segments.

Essential requirements

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Knowledge of electrical power systems and power system analysis.
  • Experience with ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, or similar engineering software is highly desirable.
  • Understanding of electrical network modelling and simulation.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts in a clear and understandable way.
  • Customer-oriented and proactive approach.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of an international team.
  • Very good command of English.
  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings and industry events.

ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.

Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.

Om tjänsten

Som arborist hos oss får du ett varierande, ansvarsfullt och praktiskt arbete där du dagligen arbetar med träd i många olika miljöer. Våra uppdrag utförs främst åt kommuner, fastighetsbolag och företag, men även åt privatpersoner, vilket innebär stor variation i både arbetsplatser och arbetsuppgifter.

Arbetet kan omfatta allt från löpande trädvård i offentliga miljöer och bostadsområden till mer avancerade uppdrag i tätbebyggda områden med höga krav på säkerhet och precision.

title: Shipping/Receiving Associate
description:
Shipping & Receiving Associate

Operations | Anaheim, CA | Full-Time

About Korrus

Korrus is transforming the way people interact with light. We are the leader in human-centric lighting, built on more than 500 patents in spectral and circadian technology, and pioneers in Human Light Interaction, the next frontier in human health and wellness.

That work runs on three fronts:

• Ecosense. A globally known and respected leader in architectural and commercial lighting, and the business now bringing circadian technology into the spaces where people work, heal, learn, and gather.

• OIO. Our consumer brand, bringing circadian lighting into the home: biologically aligned light, the right spectrum at the right time of day, to support how people wake, focus, and rest.

• Everything else in Human Light Interaction. We are pushing the limits of what light can do for human health and performance, and we own the intellectual property to do it.

The Role

The Shipping & Receiving Associate is responsible for receiving incoming materials and shipping outbound orders accurately, safely, and on schedule. This position plays a critical role in supporting manufacturing and fulfillment operations by keeping material moving — from the dock to stock, and from the floor to the customer — accurately and efficiently.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Receive inbound shipments; unload trucks and verify contents against packing lists and purchase orders.

· Inspect incoming materials for damage, shortages, or discrepancies and record receipts accurately in the inventory system.

· Move received materials to stock, staging, or production areas promptly and safely (dock-to-stock).

· Pick, pack, and stage outbound orders according to pick lists, shipping instructions, and customer requirements.

· Prepare shipping documentation — packing slips, carrier labels, and bills of lading — accurately and completely.

· Coordinate with carriers and freight providers on pickups and ensure shipments leave on time.

· Operate pallet jacks, forklifts, and other material-handling equipment safely and effectively.

· Perform cycle counts and support inventory accuracy and reconciliation.

· Keep dock, staging, and warehouse areas clean, organized, and compliant with 5S and safety standards. Follow all company safety policies, quality procedures, and standard operating procedures.

· Work collaboratively with supervisors, production, quality, and logistics team members.

· Assist with other warehouse or manufacturing duties as assigned.

Requirements

· High school diploma or GED preferred.

· Previous shipping/receiving, warehouse, or inventory experience preferred but not required.

· Ability to read and follow written work instructions, packing lists, and shipping documents.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate counts, records, and documentation.

· Forklift certification (or ability to obtain) and experience with RF scanners or ERP/WMS systems a plus.

· Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

· Dependable attendance and punctuality.

Physical Requirements

· Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and perform repetitive motions throughout the workday.

· Ability to regularly lift and carry up to 35 pounds and occasionally up to 50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.

· Ability to safely operate material-handling equipment, including pallet jacks and forklifts.

· Ability to read labels, part numbers, and shipping documents accurately.

Work Environment

· Warehouse, dock, and production floor environment.

· Regular exposure to material-handling equipment, carrier trucks, and moving pallets.

· Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) may be required depending on the work area.

· Overtime and occasional weekend work may be required to meet shipping demands.

Compensation

We offer competitive hourly compensation based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Korrus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

This position is not eligible for current or future visa sponsorship.

title: Foreman
description:

title: Clinical Team Lead, FSP - Invitro Diagnostics - US
description:
Fortrea is seeking Clinical Team Leads to join our FSP team! We are seeking experienced CTLs with 2+ years of experience. Prior monitoring experience desired. Remote US based.

Job Overview:

Clinical Team Leads (CTL) own the clinical delivery of clinical research trials. CTLs function as the Clinical Project Manager (CPM) within the core project team. CTLs partner with the Project Manager and other functional leads to ensure successful delivery of the clinical aspects of a trial within contractual and budgetary requirements. The CTL oversees the clinical and site management aspects of the trial. The CTL represents clinical delivery with the given customer.

Summary of Responsibilities:

  • Take accountability for proactively driving clinical project performance toward contracted deliverables while meeting customer needs and maintaining operational excellence.

  • Drive communication and collaboration with the client and project team across a matrixed, multicultural, environment.

  • Lead the development of the clinical project strategy and ensures prioritization with the clinical project team and key stakeholders in the creation of clear, data driven strategies and proactive management of project scope, timelines, quality and budget. In collaboration with relevant departments, prepare and deliver presentations for new business as required.

  • Manage the operational aspects of projects to support subject recruitment and retention, clinical vendor delivery and oversee the monitoring visit strategy.

  • Identify clinical project, financial and quality risks leveraging end to end risk management practices and quality by design principles.

  • Appropriately utilize data sources, dashboards and risk management strategies to drive innovation and proactive problem solving with the project and client teams.

  • Adhere to project governance and issue escalation pathways, ensuring that clinical project plans are in place to address identified risk while adhering to professional standards, SOPs, client and regulatory requirements

  • Partner with project team members and key stakeholders to oversee and manage clinical project budgets, resources and scope.

  • Ensure adherence to established budget and financial milestones. Accountable for accurately forecasting clinical project revenue and managing project costs in adherence to the budget.

  • Leading the timely management of changes to scope and the change order process. Ensures project team awareness and tracking of KPIs for any client specific metrics.

  • Provide inspiring leadership and play a key role in the creation of high performing clinical project teams. Facilitating communication and teamwork while driving delivery, ensuring that clinical team members understand contracted scope, timelines and budget.

  • Ensures that clinical resource projections are accurate and visible to resourcing teams, proactively escalating resource constraints and challenges.

  • Develops and mentors team members in multiple areas of expertise and provide feedback as needed to respective line managers

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Bachelor's degree

  • 3+ year of experience of experience leading project teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, analysis, close out and report writing of clinical studies.

  • Experience providing oversight to external vendors (e.g. CRO, central labs, call centers, DCT providers).

  • Working knowledge of ICH Guidelines and GCP including international regulatory requirements for the conduct of clinical development programs.

  • Advanced computer skills (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Project, Access and Power Point).

  • Experience managing projects in a matrix and virtual environment.

  • Excellent communication, planning and organizational skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead by example and to encourage team members to seek solutions independently Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities and to utilize resources effectively.

  • Demonstrated ability to inspire effective teamwork and motivate staff within a matrix system.

  • Financial awareness and ability to actively and effectively utilize financial tracking systems.

  • Ability to work independently and mentor junior project team members.

  • Ability to negotiate and liaise with clients in a professional manner.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Device Experience

Pay Range: $135,000-143,000 USD annually

title: Senior Engineer, Full Stack
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About the Role

Support Fanatics Collect's Unified Experience initiative, building seamless collector journeys across Fanatics Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, Topps, and future experiences.

Today a collector can win a card in a live show, rip a pack, buy on the marketplace, and store it all in a vault — but those moments still feel like separate products. Your job is to make them feel like one. That means building the shared surfaces, APIs, and front-end systems that connect experiences that were each built independently, and doing it without slowing any of them down.

This is a hands-on senior role. You'll own meaningful slices of the unified experience end to end — schema to API to UI — and you'll do it alongside a Staff Backend Engineer, mobile engineers, product, and design.

Why Join Us

Fanatics Collect is growing fast, and the unification work is the highest-leverage engineering investment we have: every new app, drop, and live format gets easier once the shared foundation exists. You'll work across mobile, web, and internal tools, with real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. Your teammates are passionate about the space and most of them are collectors themselves.

Product Context and Scale

Our surfaces reach millions of collectors across iOS, Android, and web, with live, high-traffic moments (breaks, drops, auctions closing) that make performance and reliability non-negotiable. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft.

First 90 Days

- Ship a meaningful, user-facing piece of the unified experience end to end.
- Build a working map of how Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, and Topps actually fit together today — data models, identity, entitlements, and the seams between them.
- Establish working relationships with the backend, mobile, product, and design partners you'll depend on.
- Identify one piece of duplicated or divergent logic across surfaces and make the case for consolidating it.

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain fullstack features using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
- Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel.
- Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post-launch metrics.
- Build and maintain reusable front-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on — and treat other engineers as first-class consumers of what you build.
- Contribute to cross-surface concerns like shared identity, entitlements, inventory, and navigation between collector experiences.
- Ship behind feature flags with instrumentation in place, and use the resulting data to decide what to keep, fix, or cut.
- Prototype quickly with Product and Design when a working demo will settle a debate faster than a document.
- Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, LLM-backed workflows) to raise your own throughput, and share what works with the team.
- Write meaningful tests across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E — using Playwright, Jest, React Testing Library, and Pytest, and keep CI/CD pipelines trustworthy.
- Maintain component documentation and interaction specs via Storybook.
- Participate in sprint planning, retros, and product strategy sessions; raise scope and sequencing concerns early rather than at the end.
- Mentor engineers through code review and pairing, and raise the bar on code structure, testing, and documentation.

Requirements

- 5+ years of professional fullstack development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Python, plus hands-on cloud experience (AWS preferred).
- Strong grasp of architectural patterns, API design, and application performance tuning — and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the right one.
- Track record of owning features end to end in production, including the parts after launch: monitoring, debugging, and iterating on real user behavior.
- Solid front-end fundamentals: responsive UI development, accessibility (a11y), and front-end performance practices.
- Experience with state management patterns and tools such as React Context, Zustand, Redux, or XState, and a thoughtful approach to complexity in large apps.
- Strong testing discipline with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Pytest.
- Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices.
- Comfortable working across domains — backend APIs, customer-facing web, mobile web, and internal tools — and context switching without dropping threads.
- Clear written and verbal communication; able to work directly with Product, Design, and other engineering teams and drive alignment on your own work.
- Experience using or a genuine appetite for AI developer tooling to improve velocity.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

- Experience integrating or consolidating multiple existing products, including data migrations against live users.
- Experience with high-traffic, real-time, or live-event product surfaces.
- Background in growth engineering or rapid experimentation frameworks.
- Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or gaming live ops.
- Design system or shared component library ownership.
- Passion for collecting, trading, sports, or gaming — and an interest in being a user of what you build.

If you like owning problems end to end, care about how software feels and not just whether it works, and want your work used daily by millions of collectors — we'd love to talk.

Wildlife Damage Management Technician

Agency

Texas A&M Agrilife Extension Service

Department

Wildlife Services

Proposed Minimum Salary

$2,620.50 monthly

Job Location

Sonora, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

Job Description Summary

The Wildlife Damage Management Technician conducts wildlife damage management services and activities using traps, snares, chemicals, tools, firearms and related equipment.

Responsibilities

  • Obtains agreements from landowners, ranchers, or administrators prior to conducting wildlife damage management services on private lands. May be required to contact adjacent landowners or residents to advise of impending wildlife damage management activities. Maintains rapport and makes regular contact with cooperators.

  • Uses a variety of control devices, chemicals, tools, firearms, and related equipment utilized in wildlife and avian damage management operations. Prepares baits and lures and sets control devices such as snares, traps, etc. in accordance with standard operating procedures.

  • Participates as a gunner or ground crew member in aerial hunting activities as authorized by cooperative agreements and in accordance with state and federal regulations.

  • Maintains weekly contact with the District Supervisor to report wildlife damage management activities in assigned area.

  • Uses GPS to identify the location of set traps, snares and M-44s.

  • Must demonstrate a respect for safety in all operations, including the operation of motor vehicles, firearms, control devices, and toxicants. Expected to conduct duties in a safe and orderly manner, so as not to endanger self, fellow workers, the general public or property.

  • Prepares routine and basic records of daily activities, observations, field conditions, or contacts made for purposes of exchanging factual information. Prepares management information system (MIS) documents weekly or as required. Documents must be prepared accurately and submitted timely.

  • Other related duties as required.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Farm or ranch background.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Good computer skills.

  • Knowledge of biological sciences and local, state and federal laws regarding wildlife damage management activities.

  • Knowledge of various control devices, chemicals and tools required to manage damage caused by predators

  • Ability to drive and travel as needed to perform duties.

  • Ability to multi task and work cooperatively with others.

Required Registrations, Certifications and Licenses:

  • Valid driver's license.


Other Requirements:

  • May require attendance at night and/or weekend meetings, participation in out-of-county events.

  • Must have access to personal vehicle and obtain/maintain valid driver's license and appropriate liability insurance.

  • Must have willingness to work necessary hours to fulfill job responsibilities (some evenings and weekends).

title: Senior Electromechanical Engineer
description:
Senior Electromechanical Engineer
Location: Sterling, VA
Position: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Electromechanical Engineer to design and develop enclosures, power cabinets, control panels, and mechanical assemblies for electronic and power-electronic systems. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with SolidWorks, sheet-metal design, injection-molded parts, thermal analysis, and the mechanical integration of electrical and power-system components.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design electrical enclosures, power cabinets, control panels, chassis, racks, and related mechanical assemblies.
  • Develop electromechanical packaging solutions for electronic and power-electronic products.
  • Integrate PCBs, busbars, breakers, contactors, transformers, power supplies, connectors, cooling components, wiring, and grounding into mechanical designs.
  • Create 3D models, production drawings, assemblies, and bills of materials using SolidWorks.
  • Perform thermal calculations and simulations, including airflow analysis, fan sizing, heat-sink selection, and natural or forced-air cooling.
  • Design sheet-metal parts, welded structures, brackets, doors, covers, mounting systems, and injection-molded plastic components.
  • Define mechanical and electrical interfaces, cable routing, strain relief, service access, assembly requirements, and component mounting.
  • Ensure appropriate electrical clearances, creepage distances, insulation, ventilation, EMI shielding, grounding, vibration resistance, and thermal separation.
  • Apply GD&T, tolerance analysis, material selection, and design-for-manufacturing and assembly principles.
  • Support prototype builds, thermal and mechanical testing, design validation, troubleshooting, and product certification.
  • Work closely with Electrical, Power Electronics, PCB, Manufacturing, and Product Engineering teams.
  • Coordinate with sheet-metal, machining, molding, and manufacturing suppliers from concept through production.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 7 years of mechanical product-design experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks, including Sheet Metal, Weldments, assemblies, and detailed drawings.
  • Experience designing electrical enclosures, cabinets, electronic equipment, or power-electronic products.
  • Strong knowledge of sheet-metal fabrication and injection-molded plastic design.
  • Experience with thermal modeling, airflow analysis, and cooling of electronic or power-electronic systems.
  • Practical understanding of electrical components, wiring, connectors, cable management, grounding, and electromechanical packaging.
  • Working knowledge of power systems, including high-voltage equipment, busbars, breakers, contactors, transformers, and electrical safety.
  • Knowledge of GD&T, tolerance analysis, and design for manufacturing and assembly.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with SolidWorks Flow Simulation, ANSYS Icepak, FloEFD, or similar thermal-analysis software.
  • Experience with power converters, power-distribution equipment, UPS systems, battery systems, or data-center power products.
  • Familiarity with NEMA, UL, IEC, IP-rating, thermal, vibration, and environmental requirements.
  • Experience developing products from initial concept through prototype, testing, certification, and production.


Benefits
  • Competitive salary and performance bonus
  • Paid time off
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Collaborative, high-energy workplace

Our Core Values
  • Safety – We proactively protect our people and environment
  • Inclusion – We respect and appreciate diverse perspectives and backgrounds
  • Speed – We move fast, act decisively, and stay agile
  • Innovation – We challenge assumptions and simplify processes
  • Judgment – We make sound decisions with the business in mind
  • Accountability – We take ownership and deliver results
Physical Demands and Work Environment
Employees must be able to hear, speak, and communicate effectively. Work occurs in data center environments with potential exposure to electrical hazards, noise, and varying temperatures. Flexible hours, including nights and weekends, may be required. Physical requirements include bending, stooping, squatting, crawling, climbing, kneeling, balancing, pushing, pulling, and reaching overhead. Must lift at least 50 lbs and work at heights up to 90 ft using ladders, scaffolds, or lifts.

title: Head of Customer Implementation
description:
Getting implementation right has a lasting impact on our customers. It helps them see value sooner, build confidence with Gearset, and creates stronger foundations for renewal and growth.

As our enterprise and mid-market customer base grows, we’re investing in implementation as a distinct part of our Customer Growth organisation. We’re looking for a Head of Customer Implementation to lead that work, bringing greater structure and consistency to delivery while developing the team responsible for helping customers get started successfully.

This is a newly created role within our Customer Growth leadership team, sitting alongside Customer Success and Account Management. You’ll lead our Customer Onboarding and DevOps Architecture teams, own implementation performance across enterprise and mid-market customers, and shape how we work with Sales, Solutions Engineering and our delivery partners.

There are strong foundations to build from, alongside plenty of opportunity to improve how we work. You’ll have the autonomy to evolve our implementation approach, strengthen how teams work together from pre-sales through to Customer Success, and build a function that supports our customers as Gearset continues to grow.

What’s the opportunity for a Head of Customer Implementation at Gearset?

  • Own implementation performance across our enterprise and mid-market customers, with responsibility for delivery quality, time to value, on-time go-lives and customer satisfaction.

  • Evolve our implementation methodology, creating a clear and repeatable approach that gives customers a consistent experience while allowing us to adapt for genuinely complex requirements.

  • Maintain clear visibility across active implementations, using delivery data to understand capacity, identify trends and keep the Customer Growth leadership team informed.

  • Support complex or at-risk implementations as the senior escalation point, working directly with customer stakeholders when your experience can help move delivery forward.

  • Build a close partnership with Sales and Solutions Engineering, improving how we gather requirements, set expectations and move customers from deal close into implementation.

  • Represent implementation during complex enterprise sales conversations, helping customers understand realistic scope, timelines and what successful delivery requires.

  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders at strategic customers and partner with Customer Success and Account Management where implementation quality, risk or growth opportunities need cross-functional attention.

  • Work with our Alliances team to provide implementation guidance and quality oversight for key global partners.

  • Lead and develop our Customer Onboarding and DevOps Architecture teams, building the technical expertise, coaching and career pathways each group needs to progress.

What you’ll achieve

  • Build a consistent implementation experience that helps enterprise and mid-market customers reach value sooner and go live successfully.

  • Improve delivery quality and predictability across the implementation portfolio, with clear reporting on performance, capacity and risk.

  • Strengthen the handover between Sales, Solutions Engineering and Implementation so engagements start with clear requirements, realistic expectations and well-defined scope.

  • Improve the transition from implementation into Customer Success, helping customers enter their ongoing relationship with Gearset with the knowledge and support they need to succeed.

  • Develop a strong implementation leadership team, with clear progression opportunities and consistent coaching for both technical and customer-facing roles.

  • Strengthen the connection between implementation performance and the commercial health of our customer relationships, supporting long-term retention and growth.

About you

  • You have experience leading Implementation, Professional Services or a related customer delivery function, ideally within B2B SaaS, including experience leading and developing managers.

  • You’ve evolved an implementation or delivery methodology across customers with different levels of complexity, and can show the impact your changes had on areas such as time to go-live, customer satisfaction, delivery quality or team efficiency.

  • You have experience working with professional services or delivery partners and know how to create the structure, support and oversight needed for consistent, high-quality delivery.

  • You’re comfortable working alongside Sales in complex pre-sales conversations and building relationships with senior customer stakeholders, including when navigating challenging conversations.

  • You understand how implementation influences adoption, retention and growth, and bring that commercial understanding to how you lead the function and make decisions.

  • You care about developing people across technical and customer-facing roles, with experience helping managers become stronger coaches and building leadership capability within a team.

  • You work collaboratively across teams and can build alignment with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and other stakeholders, communicating clearly with different audiences.

Nice to haves

  • Experience working within the Salesforce ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce DevOps, release management, or the challenges teams face when managing complex Salesforce environments.

Benefits (the stuff you'd expect!)

  • This is a full-time role, working Monday to Friday, with flexible home working. For this role, you’ll spend around 4 days a month in the office.

  • Generous personal development budget for courses, conferences, or whatever is useful to your professional development in the role of up to £1500 per year

  • Top end hardware provided

  • Opportunity to join our Long Term Incentive Plan

  • Free lunch in the office

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays (with the option to buy an extra 5 each year)

  • Company Pension Plan (matching up to 5%)

  • Bupa health care

  • Enhanced family leave from day 1, including 26 weeks full maternity/adoption pay, OTE-inclusive

  • Bupa Menopause Plan offering specialist consultations and support

  • Life Insurance & critical illness cover

Since 1956, WJE has been a global leader in engineering, architecture, and materials science, dedicated to solving, repairing, and preventing problems in the built environment. The Doylestown office specializes in the evaluation, testing, design, and rehabilitation of heavy movable structures (including bridges, locks, and dams) working across structural, mechanical, and electrical systems to ensure the safety, reliability, and longevity of critical infrastructure.

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
description:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.
