title: Projektmedarbetare till arbete inom kommunalt aktivitetsansvar (KAA)
description:
Du har nu möjlighet att bli en av oss som Projektmedarbetare till arbete med ungdomar inom kommunalt aktivitetsansvar (KAA). Varmt välkommen!

Kungshögaskolan, som tjänsten är knuten till, är är en av två gymnasieskolor i kommunen med drygt 400 elever och cirka 50 medarbetare. På skolan finns studieförberedande program, yrkesförberedande program och introduktionsprogram. Du kommer att arbeta i team med projektets projektledare, i nära samarbete med skolans elevhälsoteam och lärarna på introduktionsprogrammet.

Tjänsten är placerad på Utbildningsförvaltningen som är en av Mjölby kommuns sex förvaltningar och ansvarar för förskola, grundskola, gymnasieskola, anpassad grund- och gymnasieskola och vuxenutbildning. Med cirka 1000 medarbetare erbjuder vi utbildning som främjar alla barn och elever i ett livslångt lärande och arbetar efter riktningen "höga kunskapsresultat i en skola där alla kan och vill vara". Vi lägger stor vikt vid att arbeta nära verksamheten genom regelbunden dialog och stöd till skolledare och lärare utifrån styrkedjan.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som projektmedarbetare blir du en nyckelperson i teamet kring projektets dagliga arbete. Du kommer att arbeta nära ungdomarna och fungera som ett stöd, en coach och en samordnande kontaktperson genom deras väg mot studier, praktik eller arbete. Tjänsten innebär ett varierat arbete där individuellt stöd kombineras med utveckling av nya arbetssätt och samverkan mellan olika verksamheter.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

	• kartlägga deltagarnas behov
	• planera och genomföra individuella stödinsatser samt insatser för mindre grupper
	• kontinuerligt följa upp och dokumentera arbetet
	• samordna praktikplatser och skapa kontakter med arbetsgivare 

Inom ramen för projektet kommer du även att bidra till utveckling och utvärdering av projektets metoder och arbetssätt samt medverka i projektets rapportering och spridning av resultat. Regionala projektträffar, utbildningar och erfarenhetsutbyten blir en del av ditt arbete.

Du blir en del av ett arbete där du kan göra verklig skillnad för unga människors framtid. Du kommer tillhöra ett utvecklingsinriktat och engagerat team  som tillsammans arbetar i ett spännande EU-finansierat projekt med stort fokus på samverkan, innovation och lärande.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har:

	• en högskole-/universitetsutbildning om minst 180 hp inom socialt arbete, beteendevetenskap, pedagogik, arbetsterapi eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren finner likvärdig.
	• tidigare erfarenhet av att ha arbetat coachande och nätverkande för människor som står långt ifrån arbetsmarknaden
	• B-körkort är ett krav

Det är meriterande om du har: 

	• erfarenhet av Kommunala aktivitetsansvaret (KAA), introduktionsprogram eller gymnasieskola samtarbetsmarknadsinsatser
	• erfarenhet av samverkan mellan olika myndigheter och verksamheter
	• erfarenhet av metoder såsom Supported Education, Supported Employment eller liknande

Som person söker vi dig som är trygg, engagerad och relationsskapande. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroende hos unga människor samtidigt som du är strukturerad och kan driva ditt arbete framåt på ett självständigt sätt. Du är flexibel, ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder och uppskattar att arbeta tillsammans med andra professioner. Du har god förmåga att samordna, dokumentera och följa upp ditt arbete. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Du har ett intresse av att arbeta motiverande och med ett coachande förhållningssätt samt en vilja att bygga upp och samordna samverkan med kommunens verksamheter, myndigheter och externa aktörer. 

Varför ska du jobba i Mjölby Kommun?

Vi är stora nog att erbjuda medarbetare goda arbetsvillkor och spännande utvecklingsmöjligheter. Liten nog för nära samarbeten, delaktighet och inflytande. Alldeles lagom, helt enkelt.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: 2027-01-04  eller enligt överenskommelse, upphör: 2029-06-03  .

Intervjuer kan komma ske löpande under annoseringsperioden.

I din ansökan bifogar du relevanta utbildningsintyg och examensbevis som styrker ditt CV. Om du kommer vidare till intervju kommer vi kontrollera din ID-handling. Läs mer om vår rekryteringsprocess på www.mjolby.se/ledigajobb.

Vår kommun är expansiv med cirka 28 900 invånare. Vi har nära till varandra och nära till resten av världen, kommunikationerna är utmärkta. 

Mjölby kommuns vision sammanfattas i en slogan: Världsvan och hemkär. Världsvan står för öppenhet, nytänkande, vilja att växa och tro på framtiden. Hemkär står för stolthet och glädje över hembygden. Hos oss är det enkelt att leva ett gott liv.

title: Government Shipping and Logistics Technician (property specialist III)
description:
Job Description: Government Shipping and Logistics Technician (Property Specialist III)
A seasoned shipping and receiving logistics tech to work in the exhibit and events department at Marshall Space Flight Center. The successful candidate will also manage, track and care for NASA artifacts and exhibit items such as outreach displays, banners, flight hardware in our warehouse in support of the NASA Communication Services (NCS) Contract at Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama. This job will be 100% on-site.
Position Outline: The candidate will use experience and judgement to plan, account for, control, care for, maintain and manage via shipping and receiving and maintaining both Government furnished, and Contractor acquired government property in accordance with the Federal Acquisition Regulations, FAR 52.245-1 and the NASA FAR Supplement 1852.245-71. Management of items includes shipping and receiving, equipment readiness checks, data entry in property management software, keeping detailed lists of collateral. NSC property includes but is not limited to: exhibits, space hardware, artifacts, artwork, models, electronics, shop tools, machinery, furniture, and materials. The successful candidate may also be asked occasionally to deploy those items at events or on-site. This position requires shipping and receiving of items on a daily basis, including following all compliance procedures.
The candidate will assist with warehouse activities such as assistance with production of large format printing, inventory, assembly and disassembly of visual effects and artifacts, and following procedures to properly document inventory in and out of the facility. The successful candidate will also attend meetings, communicate with customers and assist the shop manager and staff with estimates, shop upkeep, event preparation and execution as needed. Must be able to drive a fork truck and work in an active warehouse around machinery and chemicals/paints.
Primary/Major Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Functions):
  • Responsible for performing property self-assessments and ensuring the Property Management System remains in an approved status
  • Responsible for operations related to Government Property administration covering the FAR property outcomes
  • Responsible for daily shipping and receiving and associated paperwork
  • Responsible for care, control, storage, maintenance of artifacts
  • Responsible for maintenance planning, repair and damage mitigation plans for collection.
  • Responsible for documentation and tracking of property out on loan
  • Develop metrics related to internal control goals and objectives for program/project/event audited
  • Implement program control documents to ensure Property Custodians and end users have the property knowledge needed to operate government property
  • Responsible for all aspects related to Property Survey Reports, ensuring sufficient information is provided to support a clear understanding of the circumstances surrounding the loss, damage, or destruction of Government property, developing, implementing, and monitoring corrective actions
  • Develop, maintain, and implement property procedures covering the property outcomes.
  • Responsible for ensuring adherence to applicable regulations, policies, and procedures
  • Responsible for generating routine and/or ad-hoc reports for management and customers
  • Will directly interface with management, customers and the public
  • This is an on site position with outreach tasks at public or community events.
  • Movement of items on/off shelves, set up and tear down of items at events will be required
  • Some travel may be required.
Required Education and Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in appropriate area of specialization from an accredited college or university;
  • Ten (10) years of relevant experience
  • Forklift Certified preferred
Proficient in:
  • Oral and written communications.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
  • Advanced problem solving
  • Ability to work independently and on a team

title: Associate Solutions Architect, Frontier AI Startups
description:
The companies defining the future of AI are a small number of startups training, tuning, and operating models at scale. They are run by ambitious founders, who solve the hardest problems across a variety of different industries. They are moving fast, operating at the edge of what technology can do, and defining the possibilities of computing for years to come.

This role requires someone who is equally comfortable in deep architectural conversations and advisory discussions. For someone who understands that for a startup, the right technical decision and the right business decision are rarely separate.

In this position, you will work directly with a portfolio of frontier AI startups, helping them architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy AI systems at scale. Your conversations will range from low-level discussions about chip types to high-level explorations of advanced prompt engineering.

Your work will extend beyond individual customer relationships. You will serve as a direct feedback channel to product teams, translating patterns you observe across your portfolio into concrete input on what should be built and improved. A day in the life of a Frontier AI Solutions Architect is rarely the same. Expect to have a variety of different types of technical conversations revolving around applied AI and infrastructure, meetings with VCs and incubators, and opportunities to build and present AI content and projects.

About the team
Frontier AI is a team of builders. We work with our customers, peers, and cross-functional teams to build out what is possible with AI. Learning by doing, collaborating, and scaling knowledge is the culture of the team.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-functional programs within OTS Service Desk, operating across a global ecosystem of Operations, Product, TPM, and Field Engineering teams. title: Fintech Financial Controls Reporting Analyst
description:
ABOUT US

Coastal is at the forefront of modern banking, combining strong financial infrastructure with cutting-edge Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) and fintech enablement strategies. We support not only individuals with their personal banking needs; we also empower businesses by integrating modern banking technology that drives growth, flexibility, and innovation.

At Coastal, we think and move like entrepreneurs; focused on impact, speed, and continuous improvement. We believe in working smart, collaborating deeply, and building solutions that unlock real potential. If you're someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, loves solving complex problems, and wants to help shape the future of banking, we’d love to meet you.

Check out our video here!

OVERVIEW

The Partner ICFR Analyst will support Coastal’s Partner Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR) Program by documenting partner controls relevant to Coastal’s financial reporting requirements and performing targeted alternative control testing when gaps in independent assurance have been identified. You will understand the specific control or control objective associated with an identified gap, develop and execute testing procedures under Coastal’s approved alternative testing methodology, evaluate supporting evidence, document exceptions and preliminary conclusions, and support the Fintech Financial Controls Manager in determining whether the identified gap has been adequately addressed. Coastal’s partner risk function is responsible for evaluating SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2/ITGC, and Complementary User Entity Control (CUEC) coverage for fourth-party providers, while the Internal Control Testing Manager III and Analyst team perform routine transaction testing. This role performs targeted testing of control gaps identified through those processes.

****The hiring range for this role is $82,678 to $89,568*****

The salary range of $82,678-96,457 is posted for compliance reasons. However, we will not be hiring above $89,568.

RESPONSIBILITIES TO INCLUDE

  • Obtain and document partner controls relevant to Coastal’s ICFR requirements and map those controls to Coastal’s Partner ICFR Framework.

  • Maintain partner ICFR control inventories, alternative control testing documentation, gap tracking, and supporting evidence.

  • Receive identified control or assurance gaps from Financial Controls, Coastal’s partner risk function, or other responsible teams and determine the specific partner control or control objective requiring targeted testing.

  • Develop and perform targeted alternative testing procedures consistent with Coastal’s approved methodology and the specific financial reporting risk identified.

  • Perform targeted testing of identified CUEC gaps; this role does not independently determine CUEC applicability or identify CUEC coverage gaps.

  • Perform walkthroughs of specific controls subject to testing, as needed, to understand control design and how the control operates in practice.

  • Obtain and evaluate evidence supporting the design and operating effectiveness of the specific controls being tested, including validating testing populations and sample selections when required.

  • Prepare testing workpapers documenting the control tested, period and population covered, evidence reviewed, testing attributes, results, exceptions, resolution of exceptions, and preliminary conclusions.

  • Identify control deficiencies, missing evidence, testing exceptions, or insufficient support encountered during testing and escalate concerns to the Fintech Financial Controls Manager.

  • Track remediation of testing exceptions and perform follow-up testing as assigned.

  • Support the Fintech Financial Controls Manager in evaluating whether targeted testing adequately addresses the identified control or assurance gap.

  • Coordinate with Coastal’s Partner Risk and Internal Control testing team when SOC, ITGC, CUEC, transaction, or account-level testing matters require additional assessment or support.

  • Communicate testing status, exceptions, remediation progress, and potential financial reporting impacts to the Fintech Financial Controls Manager and assist with management and audit reporting as requested.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong understanding of internal controls over financial reporting and control testing concepts.

  • Working knowledge of SOX, ICFR, and the COSO framework.

  • Working knowledge of SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports, Complementary User Entity Controls (CUECs), IT General Controls (ITGCs), and business process controls sufficient to understand and test identified assurance gaps.

  • Ability to translate an identified control or assurance gap into practical, risk-based testing procedures.

  • Experience performing internal control testing, including evidence evaluation, sample-based testing where applicable, exception analysis, and workpaper documentation.

  • Ability to distinguish between missing controls, missing evidence, missing testing, and missing audit coverage.

title: Technical Home Claims Handler
description:
About us

Trinity Claims delivers a dedicated, end-to-end claims management service exclusively for our sister company, Policy Expert. Combining cutting-edge proprietary technology with the highest standards of customer care, we provide seamless support from the very first point of contact through to final resolution, ensuring customers feel supported every step of the way.

Our team of experts have earned the trust and confidence of thousands of customers by consistently delivering results. With a 4.5-star Trustpilot rating, we’re proud to be recognised for our commitment, expertise, and determination to go above and beyond when it matters most.

Useful links:

Trustpilot ¦ Glassdoor

About the role:

We are looking for an enthusiastic and customer-focused Claims Advisor to manage a portfolio of fast-moving household claims. This role involves advising policyholders, verifying coverage, gathering documentation, handling general and buildings-related claim queries, and ensuring smooth claim progression from start to settlement. Strong communication, organisation, and problem-solving skills are essential, along with the ability to prioritise tasks in a high-volume environment.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who is motivated, empathetic, and passionate about delivering excellent customer service.

Key Responsibilities:

Claims Handling & Customer Service

  • Advise policyholders on general queries and insurance claims issues, buildings-related queries for relevant or related peril
  • Respond to policyholder portal messages professionally and within agreed SLAs.
  • Build policyholder confidence by developing rapport and listening to each customer’s specific needs.
  • Check policy coverage, gather documentation (receipts, photographs, accident reports), and ensure claims are processed methodically.
  • Arrange for payments within authority levels and negotiate settlements both verbally and in writing.
  • Manage a high-volume portfolio of claims, prioritising by individual circumstances from set-up to settlement.
  • Perform basic fraud checks and escalate suspicious circumstances to the Counter Fraud team.
  • Assist with overflow calls during peak times as necessary.
  • Constantly seek improvements in customer service delivery.
  • Assist with audit and oversight of the Surveyor and Contractor Network, working with Regional Technical Surveyors and the Supply Chain Manager.
  • Review surveyor reports for accuracy and compliance.
  • Validate contractor estimates against pricing models, estimating software, and policy conditions.
  • Monitor and update claim reserves, authorise cash settlements, and close claims.
  • Measure and cost building works, identifying the financial impact of changes.
  • Apply knowledge of contracts and policy terms when delivering claim decisions.
  • Instruct, liaise with, and oversee contractors and suppliers.
  • Support audits and performance monitoring of the surveyor and contractor network.
  • Provide technical advice to the claims team on construction techniques, repair methods, and materials.
  • Review and resolve policyholder scope disputes and declined claims in line with policy terms.
  • Ensure health, safety, and sustainability considerations are addressed in decisions.
  • Customer and Stakeholder Communication
  • Deliver clear, concise, and accurate claim decisions to policyholders and suppliers.
  • Manage policyholder queries and disputes in a professional and empathetic manner.
  • Maintain accurate records to support conflict avoidance and resolution.

Customer Communication & Complaint Management

  • Deliver professional, empathetic and proactive service throughout the customer journey, recognising the impact of property damage on customers.
  • Respond to policyholder portal messages, telephone enquiries and correspondence within agreed service levels.
  • Build customer confidence through clear communication, effective expectation setting and regular updates.
  • Select the most appropriate communication method for each interaction, proactively contacting customers by telephone where discussions are complex, sensitive, likely to require detailed explanation or involve delivering difficult news, ensuring customers receive a clear and personalised service.
  • Take ownership of complaints relating to your claim portfolio, seeking to resolve concerns promptly, fairly and at the earliest opportunity.
  • Aim to resolve a minimum of 50% of complaints informally within 3 working days, using effective communication and sound judgement to restore customer confidence and avoid unnecessary escalation.
  • Where informal resolution is not possible, ensure complaints are fully investigated, accurately documented and progressed promptly to support the issue of a Final Response Letter within the regulatory 8-week timeframe.
  • Identify recurring complaint themes and contribute to improvements in customer experience and operational processes.

Supplier Liaison & Relationship Management

  • Liaise with internal teams, third-party suppliers, contractors, and surveyors to ensure all parties are updated and claims progress smoothly.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with suppliers, ensuring clear and concise communication.
  • Demonstrate tact and assertiveness when dealing with the Supplier/Surveyor Network.
  • Support the audit and performance management of suppliers and contractors.

General

  • Ensure SLAs and KPIs are consistently met and maintained.
  • Undertake any individual or team task or activity reasonably requested and in line with company values.

Key Requirements:

  • Previous experience handling household claims
  • Working knowledge of household insurance policies, terms, exclusions, and claim lifecycles.
  • Ability to interpret and apply policy wording accurately to determine liability and coverage.
  • Strong analytical ability to assess technical reports, estimates, invoices, and photographic evidence.
  • Capable of identifying inconsistencies or exaggerations in claims and escalating where necessary (e.g, potential fraud).
  • Skilled at making accurate and fair settlement decisions.
  • Ability to manage content claims
  • Ability to manage individual file ownership, follow actions through to completion and escalate appropriately where support or authority is required.
  • Ability to understand and progress basic buildings claim queries, including repair scopes, supplier recommendations and claim-related variations.
  • Confidence in asking appropriate questions and escalating technical matters when further review is required

In return, we can offer you:

Basic Salary £26-28,000 (DOE) as well as market leading benefits.

25 days Annual leave plus statutory holidays.

Just some of the great benefits we offer:

  • On-site gym
  • Free on-site parking
  • Free on-site breakfast bar
  • Complimentary on-site snacks and soft drinks
  • Discretionary performance related bonus
  • An extra day’s holiday for your birthday

Application deadline: this position will remain open until we have found the right person for the job.

We kindly request that no agencies contact us regarding this position. Speculative CVs will not be accepted.

Trinity Claims is an equal opportunities employer and we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of your gender, age, race, disability, ethnic background, religion or belief, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.

title: Winter Ski Trail Groomer
description:
Position: Winter Ski Trail Groomer

Status: Temporary/ Seasonal, Non-exempt, ON CALL

Department: Visitor’s Interpretive Center (VIC)

Reports to: Trails and Facilities Manager

Salary: $22.00/hour

Description:

The Winter Trail Groomer position maintains and grooms 25 miles of trails for various winter activities, including recreational and competitive skiing and snowshoeing. The primary duties are operating and maintaining grooming equipment (snowmobiles, snow cats, etc.). Work hours will include weekends and night shifts. Flexibility in scheduling is essential, as work hours will vary depending on weather conditions and event needs.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Prepare groomed trail surfaces for a variety of configurations and uses including recreational and competitive events for skate, classic cross-country skiing and snowshoeing.

  • Operate grooming equipment safely and efficiently including tracked ATV’s and UTV’s, snowmobiles, drag and roller equipment, and a snow cat (Piston Bully 100) with dual track setters and a 12-way blade.

  • Perform routine, daily maintenance checks on equipment prior to utilization.

  • Conduct necessary repairs to equipment as needed to ensure safe and reliable equipment, and a well-maintained trail system.

  • Operate power saw and hand tools to improve trails including the use of chainsaws, pole saws, and snow shovels.

  • Collaborate with college staff and others to plan and implement winter trail races and events

  • Implement daily, seasonal, short and long-term maintenance plans in coordination with supervisor for equipment, tools, snow cat barn, and trail infrastructure.

  • Coordinate with supervisor for budgeting and purchasing tools, equipment, fluids, and maintenance items for equipment.

  • Daily inspection of trail system mitigating safety and comfort concerns including trail surface and tree management. Assessment and repair including shoveling trailside benches and stocking trailside outhouses. Installation and monitoring of trail wayfinding signage and race signage as needed.

  • Manage the on-site needs of the grooming operation including general upkeep of workspace, fuel and fluids, signage, and providing a published daily grooming report.

Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience in operating heavy equipment.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of Nordic skiing, its various disciplines, and the varieties of groomed terrain that support it.

  • Desire and ability to operate power saw and hand tools to improve trails including the use of chainsaws, pole saws, and snow shovels.

  • Knowledge of and desire to maintain safety at the workplace regarding power tools, heavy equipment, and risk in the outdoor winter environment.

  • Ability to work weekends, holidays, irregular hours, and evening work a must.

  • Ability to work with a broad range of diverse individuals and groups to form a safe and inclusive workplace.

Preferred:

  • 2-years’ experience operating and maintaining Nordic ski grooming equipment including a Piston Bully 100, snowmobiles, ATV, and UTV’s.

  • Proficiency in preparation of groomed trail surfaces for a variety of configurations and uses including recreational and competitive events for skate, classic cross-country skiing and snowshoeing.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of event preparation including placement of appropriate signage, V-Boards, flagging and grooming to produce desired race configurations.

  • Preferably certified in, or willing to obtain the following certifications: Wilderness First Responder, CPR and First Aid, valid driver’s license, chainsaw safety certifications, heavy equipment operator certifications.

Physical Requirements:

Environmental Conditions?

  • The Work of this position is primarily performed outdoors. Seasonal temperatures should be expected and various noise levels dependent on equipment being used to perform job duties should be expected.

Lifting and Carrying

  • Occasionally lifting and carrying of equipment weighing 50 lbs.

  • Equipment and related debris are of various shapes and sizes so may require unusual gripping points.

Mobility

  • Occasional standing and walking across snow covered surfaces potentially utilizing snowshoes.

  • Ability to bend, stoop, and kneel to pick up items, as necessary.

  • May have to climb some moderately challenging steep hills and hike up to two miles.

  • Frequent need to reach overhead or below waist level to perform work duties.

Dexterity and Hand-Eye Coordination

  • Manual dexterity for handling tools and equipment used in the performance of duties.

Sensory Requirements

  • Good vision, including color vision, with corrective lenses as necessary. ??

  • Good hearing with assistive devices as necessary. ??

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Amazon Customer Service
description:
Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience across all of our CS channels in every interaction.

Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network - building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences, and continuously improve service quality. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.

We are seeking a Sr. Software Development Engineer to lead the Customer Journey engineering team, building the next generation of customer service channel experiences — giving customers visibility, choice, and control over how and when they connect, and eliminating the wait entirely. Today, when customers need a human, their only option is to enter a queue and wait, with no commitment on when they will be helped, leading to broken journeys where customers abandon, retry, and many silently disengage for good. This leader will design and build the AI-native systems that turn customer service from a queue you wait in into a promise Amazon keeps — orchestrating the journey across every channel to guide each customer to the optimal resolution path, all operating in real-time at massive scale.

The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, can translate a bold vision into a concrete system architecture, and is passionate about building high-performing teams. You will partner closely with science, product, and operations leaders to deliver AI-powered capabilities that let customers pick when help arrives, proactively solve their problems without waiting in queues, and turn service failures into loyalty-building moments. This is an exciting opportunity to build transformative technology that directly impacts the experience of millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design, architecture, and delivery of AI-native systems that orchestrate the customer journey across Amazon's global Customer Service network
- Architect real-time journey orchestration systems that continuously guide each customer to the optimal resolution path, ensuring the least amount of effort and highest likelihood of success.
- Build and develop a high-performing engineering team by assisting in hiring and mentoring software development engineers

- Partner with Applied Science teams to develop and integrate AI-native intelligent solutions that shape demand patterns across channels and time, maximizing CSA productivity and network efficiency.

- Drive technical roadmap execution from proof-of-concept through production, balancing speed of delivery with long-term architectural quality
- Collaborate cross-functionally across Network Solutions and partner teams to integrate platform capabilities into the broader CS ecosystem
- Establish operational excellence practices for production services, including on-call, incident response, and continuous improvement mechanisms

About the team
Network Solutions is on a mission to transform Amazon Customer Service from a cost center into a growth driver by building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences, and continuously improve service quality. The Customer Journey team is a new initiative within Network Solutions focused on orchestrating the customer journey across all channels, ensuring each customer is guided to the optimal resolution path with the least effort and highest likelihood of success, including new capabilities that perfectly match customers with the best resource to resolve their issue fast and friction-free.

title: Head of Digital, Data & Technology for the Disused Tips Authority
location: Merthyr Tydfil / Merthyr Tudful, United Kingdom
description:
Help build the digital, data and technology capability behind one of Wales' newest public bodies.

Interested in learning more about this job Scroll down and find out what skills, experience and educational qualifications are needed.
The Disused Tips Authority for Wales is being established as the national public body responsible for overseeing the safety, management and regulation of disused tips across Wales. Operating in a high-profile, safety-critical environment, our success will depend on reliable digital services, trusted information and technology that enables confident, evidence-based decision making.
As Head of Digital, Data & Technology , you will play a critical leadership role in delivering the Authority's digital, data and technology capability. You will ensure colleagues have the systems, information and digital services they need to deliver the Authority's statutory responsibilities while creating modern, secure and efficient ways of working.
This is a broad strategic delivery role. Working closely with the Director of Data & Assurance, you will lead the implementation of the Authority's Digital, Data & Technology Strategy, overseeing enterprise systems, digital services, national registers, information management, analytics and technology services. You will also manage the Authority's technology suppliers and service providers, ensuring services are resilient, innovative, cost-effective and aligned to organisational priorities.
Beyond the organisation itself, you will work collaboratively with government, local authorities, technology providers, academia and other partners to strengthen digital capability, improve information sharing and support the Authority's ambition to become a recognised centre of excellence in the intelligent use of data and technology.
The role is both inward and outward facing:
Internally , you will create a digitally enabled organisation where colleagues have access to reliable systems, trusted information and intuitive digital services that support effective operational delivery and evidence-based decision making.
Externally , you will build productive relationships with technology suppliers, delivery partners and public sector organisations to promote collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
This is a unique opportunity to establish the digital foundations of a new national organisation, helping create an Authority that is modern, digitally enabled and recognised for the quality of its information, technology and operational excellence.
Important: The Disused Tips Authority for Wales will be established as an independent Welsh Public Body and separate legal entity on 1 April 2027 . Until then, these roles will be hosted by the Welsh Government, providing a unique opportunity to help create and shape a new national organisation from the outset.
Successful candidates will initially be employed by the Welsh Government before transferring to the Disused Tips Authority when it becomes operational on 1 April 2027 , with continuity of employment maintained throughout.
The Disused Tips Authority is a separate organisation from the Welsh Government. Please disregard any Welsh Government guidance, policies or recruitment information linked within this advert and refer to the accompanying Candidate Information Pack for information relevant to this vacancy.
Key Tasks
Delivering digital services and technology
You'll lead the delivery of the Authority's Digital, Data & Technology Strategy, ensuring digital services, enterprise systems and technology platforms support organisational priorities and enable the effective delivery of statutory responsibilities.
You'll oversee the development, implementation and continual improvement of digital services, ensuring systems are reliable, integrated, secure and designed around the needs of users.
Managing enterprise systems
You'll be responsible for the performance, resilience and continuous improvement of the Authority's enterprise technology estate, including business applications, collaboration platforms, operational systems and digital tools.
You'll ensure technology supports efficient business processes, improves user experience and enables effective organisational performance.
Managing technology suppliers and contracts
You'll lead the procurement, mobilisation and day-to-day management of technology suppliers, managed service providers and digital contracts.
You'll ensure suppliers deliver high-quality services, meet agreed service levels, represent value for money and continually improve performance while maintaining effective commercial relationships.
Managing data and information
You'll lead the operational management of the Authority's information assets, ensuring national registers, operational systems and organisational data are accurate, secure, integrated and maintained as trusted sources of information.
You'll oversee data quality, information governance and system integrity, working closely with the Data Protection Officer and other colleagues to ensure compliance with legislative and organisational requirements.
Developing analytics and business intelligence
You'll develop the Authority's reporting, analytics and business intelligence capability, ensuring operational teams and senior leaders have timely, meaningful and reliable information to support operational delivery, organisational performance and evidence-based decision making.
Delivering digital transformation
You'll identify opportunities to improve organisational effectiveness through digital technologies, automation and process improvement.
Working collaboratively across the Authority, you'll lead digital change initiatives that simplify processes, improve customer experience and enhance organisational capability.
Supporting innovation
You'll work with technology providers, academia and public sector partners to identify emerging technologies and digital solutions that improve monitoring, information management and operational delivery.
You'll support the Authority's ambition to become a recognised centre of excellence through the practical application of digital innovation and continuous improvement.
Leading a high-performing function
You'll build and lead a modern, customer-focused Digital, Data & Technology function, creating an environment where specialists are supported to develop professionally, collaborate effectively and deliver outstanding services across the organisation.
Successful candidates will hold a degree in Digital, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Management, Data Science, GIS or a related discipline, or be able to demonstrate significant relevant experience leading digital, technology, information or data services within complex organisations. Technical Capabilities
Important: The technical capabilities listed below will be assessed throughout the selection process. Please refer to these capabilities when preparing your application and provide evidence of how you meet them through your qualifications, skills and experience.
Digital Service Leadership
Delivering organisation-wide digital, data and technology services that support organisational priorities and statutory responsibilities.
Translating strategic direction into practical digital solutions that improve organisational capability and service delivery.
Enterprise Systems & Technology Management
Leading the implementation, management and continuous improvement of enterprise systems, digital platforms and business applications.
Ensuring technology services are secure, resilient, integrated and aligned to organisational needs.
Developing technology roadmaps and delivery plans that support organisational growth and continuous improvement.
Supplier & Contract Management
Procuring, mobilising and managing technology suppliers, managed service providers and digital contracts.
Managing service level agreements, supplier performance and commercial relationships to ensure high-quality, secure and cost-effective services.
Driving continuous improvement through effective supplier and contract management.
Data Management & Business Intelligence
Leading the operational management of organisational data, national registers and information assets.
Developing reporting, analytics and business intelligence that support operational delivery and organisational performance.
Promoting high standards of data quality, integrity and accessibility.
Information Governance & Digital Security
Ensuring digital services and information assets comply with information governance, data protection and security requirements.
Working with specialist providers to maintain cyber resilience, business continuity and disaster recovery arrangements.
Digital Transformation & Continuous Improvement
Leading digital transformation initiatives that modernise business processes and improve organisational effectiveness.
Identifying opportunities to apply technology, automation and innovation to enhance operational delivery and user experience.
Leadership & Professional Judgement
Providing professional advice and challenge on digital services, technology, supplier management and information management.
Exercising sound judgement when balancing organisational priorities, technology investment, operational risk and public accountability.
Location
The Authority's headquarters will be located at Rhydycar Business Park, Merthyr Tydfil, CF48 1UZ . This will be the principal place of work and where most colleagues will come together to collaborate with one another and with stakeholders.
The successful candidate will be expected to attend the office in Merthyr Tydfil regularly to support collaboration and stakeholder engagement. For full-time employees, this will typically be 23 days per week, with attendance requirements adjusted on a pro-rata basis for part-time employees.
As a national organisation serving communities across Wales, the DTA will also establish a number of regional hubs and collaboration spaces. Details of these locations are currently being developed and will be confirmed ahead of the Authority becoming operational. Merthyr Tydfil will remain the Authority's headquarters.
Starting salary: £61,098 per annum. The role sits within a pay range that extends to £78,449 with progression subject to the Authority's pay arrangements.
For candidates who can demonstrate exceptional experience, expertise and market value, a higher starting salary within the approved pay range may be considered.
The Disused Tips Authority has its own pay and reward arrangements, which are separate from Welsh Government pay structures. xwwtmva The salary quoted above reflects the Authority's pay framework and not Welsh Government pay bands or terms.

Job Title

Imaging Engineer, Fixed Domes – R&D, Lund

Job Description

Do you want to be where creativity and new ideas are appreciated? Now you have the opportunity to work as Product Imaging Engineer and develop the world's best surveillance cameras. Join our team in Lund!

Your future team – Fixed Domes Imaging
We are a product development team that develops the imaging system in Axis fixed dome cameras. The work takes place in small project teams where you collaborate closely with many different disciplines such as firmware, mechanics, electronics and production technology.

Your role

As imaging engineer, you will work cross-functionally with product development from idea to volume production and product maintenance. Your main responsibilities are all aspects of image quality of a network camera. This cover implementing and adapting software for the camera, developing production tuning and testing functionality as well as analyzing test data to optimize performance. One day you find yourself working closely with mechanical engineers to secure optimum conditions for high precision optics and the next day you discuss an embedded SW module with the firmware engineers. Later that week you might be in a meeting with a sensor supplier to discuss some artefacts you saw while testing the camera in the image lab. The work involves an exciting combination of theoretical and practical problem solving where you often find yourself in the center of action, having a direct impact on the current and on the future generations of the product.

Who are you?

We are looking for you who are interested in developing new products and want to work with image technology in a cross-functional team. We think you have a master or bachelor's degree in physics, mathematics, computer science or electronics. As an imaging engineer, it is important that you enjoy and are good at working with a wide range of tasks where you constantly collaborate with others to achieve our common goals. You are triggered by challenges and are comfortable with often being the one who enthusiastically pushes forward to put together a good overall solution.

You will work in an environment where you are continuously supported to gradually develop the breadth of your skills. It is a merit if you have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Programming in C++/C or Python in Linux environment
  • Optical components such as lenses and image sensors
  • Data/Image analysis and processing
  • Photography and image enhancement techniques
  • Practical experimental work with technical hobby-, school- or work projects.

What Axis has to offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal “fika” chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle.

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site

Position Overview

PCI‑P is seeking a Strategic Communications Specialist II to serve as a communications liaison supporting NASA Armstrong’s role as the agency’s Flight Test & Aircraft Operations Center of Excellence. This position delivers operationally aligned communications expertise for aircraft capabilities, research flight operations, developmental programs, airborne science missions, and specialized aviation facilities.

The role also provides surge capacity for high‑visibility missions, media engagement, and emergency or contingency communications.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise & Mission Coordination

• Serve as a liaison between Armstrong’s communications and aircraft operations teams and NASA HQ’s Office of Communications, mission directorates, projects, and partner centers.

• Provide scalable communications support during peak mission periods, major events, VIP visits, or high‑visibility milestones.

5. Cross‑Mission Integration & Emerging Projects

• Support early-stage or emerging aviation-related projects, including new aircraft modifications, research campaigns, and specialized flight demonstrations.
• Collaborate with pilots, flight operations personnel, engineers, and project managers to develop accurate communication plans and products.

Required Skills & Competencies

• Strong understanding of aviation, flight operations, aircraft systems, or demonstrated ability to rapidly learn complex operational environments.
• Excellent writing skills (writing samples required).

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, aviation communication, or a related field.
• Experience supporting aviation, aerospace, or government programs.
• Experience providing on-site support for operational activities or field campaigns.

About PCI Productions (PCI‑P)

PCI‑P is part of the PCI Federal Services group of companies and delivers high‑quality communications support to NASA and other federal customers. We are committed to supporting our team members through competitive benefits, professional development, and meaningful mission-focused work.

PCI Federal (PCIF) and its subsidiaries are an equal-opportunity employer. PCIF does not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, race, national origin, religion, marital status, sexual orientation or identity, Veterans or Disability status.

This role is responsible for overseeing daily inside technical support operations while ensuring responsiveness to customer needs, thorough resolution of technical issues, and a consistently high level of customer satisfaction.

The Supervisor, POC Support will manage the technical support escalation process, ensure accurate documentation of customer interactions, and oversee appropriate follow-up activities. This position will also manage after-hours connectivity support and coordinate required NovaNet software and firmware updates at customer locations.

In addition to providing technical and operational leadership, the Supervisor will develop departmental training materials, establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators, and regularly report performance metrics to Service and Support management.

Responsibilities:

  • Supervise the day-to-day activities of the Technical Support Hotline.
  • Lead and support a team of Customer Support Specialists and Point-of-Care Support Specialists supporting the StatStrip and StatSensor product lines.
  • Ensure a high level of responsiveness to customer needs and maintain a strong focus on customer satisfaction.
  • Oversee daily inside technical support activities and ensure customer interactions are resolved completely and thoroughly.
  • Manage the technical support call escalation process and coordinate additional assistance when needed.
  • Support Field Support Specialists, Hotline Specialists, and Field Applications Specialists by telephone to determine the root cause of hardware, firmware, and software issues involving products in the field.
  • Communicate directly with end users of Nova Biomedical products to ensure consistent and accurate technical information is exchanged between customers and internal teams.
  • Collaborate closely with Technical Product Connectivity Managers, Field Service Engineers, and management to address customer concerns and escalate issues as appropriate.
  • Ensure customer calls, technical issues, troubleshooting activities, and service actions are documented accurately and completely.
  • Ensure appropriate follow-up is completed for customer interactions and unresolved technical issues.
  • Manage after-hours connectivity technical support activities.
  • Coordinate NovaNet product updates at customer locations, including the installation and documentation of required software and firmware upgrades.
  • Develop and maintain departmental training documentation.
  • Develop departmental Key Performance Indicators and regularly submit performance reports to Service and Support management.
  • Drive achievement of departmental KPIs, service standards, and performance expectations.
  • Write Customer Information Bulletins and Technical Information Bulletins.
  • Recruit, hire, and onboard new employees.
  • Provide ongoing employee training, coaching, and professional development.
  • Conduct biweekly one-on-one meetings with direct reports.
  • Complete employee performance reviews and annual compensation reviews.
  • Promote strong interpersonal communication, collaboration, accountability, and problem-solving across the support organization.

Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in a technical discipline preferred; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
  • Two to five years of experience in point-of-care, clinical laboratory, biotechnology, or research laboratory settings.
  • Experience managing or supervising a technical call center or support organization is a plus.
  • Experience with Windows 10 and Windows 11 operating systems.
  • Experience with Microsoft Server 2019, 2022, or 2025.
  • Experience using remote-access software and platforms such as Cisco VPN, SecureLink, Citrix, or comparable technologies.
  • Working knowledge of relational databases, PHP, and scripted interfaces.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP and wireless networking.
  • Strong understanding of web-based servers such as Microsoft Internet Information Services.
  • Strong connectivity, data-management, and Laboratory Information System or Hospital Information System background preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Nova Biomedical products and core technologies, including hardware, firmware, and software, or the ability to develop this knowledge through training.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting, diagnostic, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Strong interpersonal, leadership, and people-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical information clearly.
  • Ability to oversee customer escalations and coordinate effective problem resolution across multiple technical teams.
  • Experience developing employee training materials, technical documentation, or customer-facing technical bulletins.
  • Ability to establish, monitor, and report departmental KPIs and performance metrics.
  • Ability to coach employees, conduct performance reviews, and support employee development.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple customer and operational priorities.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Comfort with working at a computer for extended periods.
  • Occasional need to move about the office to access meetings or resources.
  • Able to communicate effectively via phone, video, and written communication.
  • Capacity to lift and carry up to [25–50] pounds as required

Why Work for Nova Biomedical

  • Flexible Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
  • Competitive 401k company match
  • Bonus Program, Generous PTO and paid holidays
  • Generous Tuition reimbursement
  • Hybrid and flexible work arrangements

At Nova Biomedical, we’re not just building instruments, we’re powering breakthroughs that improve lives. Our smart, science-driven solutions are trusted in over 100 countries to speed drug development and enhance patient care.

None

title: Senior Specialist Cyber Security Awareness / SRQ155118
description:
Jouw energie in de plus

Als senior specialist cybersecurity awareness versterk je de cyberweerbaarheid van ruim 7.000 collega’s en geef je richting aan veilig digitaal gedrag binnen Stedin.


Werk om trots op te zijn

Als senior specialist cybersecurity awareness speel je een belangrijke rol in het versterken van de cyberweerbaarheid van Stedin. Je ontwikkelt en verbetert het awarenessprogramma, adviseert over organisatiebrede vraagstukken en vertaalt cyberrisico’s naar effectieve interventies. Daarbij verbind je communicatie, gedrag en cybersecurity, zodat digitaal veilig werken steeds meer onderdeel wordt van de dagelijkse praktijk van ruim 7.000 collega’s.

Een dag als senior specialist cybersecurity awareness:

  • Je start de dag met een gesprek met een team dat te maken heeft met nieuwe cyberdreigingen en vertaalt de belangrijkste inzichten naar verbeteracties.

  • Je stemt met het hoofd cybersecurity awareness af welke organisatiebrede thema’s en risico’s extra aandacht vragen.

  • Je ontwikkelt een nieuwe campagne, e-learning of communicatiemiddel waarmee collega’s hun kennis en bewustzijn vergroten.

  • Je verzorgt een workshop of presentatie en gaat in gesprek met collega’s over veilig digitaal gedrag in de praktijk.

  • Je werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het awarenessprogramma en nieuwe initiatieven.


Hier laad jij van op

Alle financiële arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rij, weet je meteen waar je aan toe bent:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.106,43 en € 7.124,60 (bij 40 uur), 24,5 vakantiedagen en pensioenopbouw bij ABP waarbij wij 70% van de premie betalen.

  • Bovenop je salaris ontvang je een persoonlijk budget van 24% (inclusief 8% vakantiegeld). Jij kiest wat je met het budget doet: bijvoorbeeld extra salaris of extra verlof.

  • Jaarlijks € 700,- (bruto) om te besteden aan je eigen energie, bijvoorbeeld voor je sportabonnement of nieuwe sportkleding.

  • Daar komt dit nog bovenop:

  • Moderne thuiswerkfaciliteiten en een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,40 per dag. Bij Stedin werken we 50% thuis en 50% op kantoor.

  • Reizen naar kantoor doe je met de ov-vrijregeling of de flexibele reisregeling, inclusief extra vergoeding als je met de fiets reist.

  • Jouw ontwikkeling staat centraal met trainingen, workshops, events en opleidingen.


Vol energie vooruit met team Cybersecurity Awareness

Je wordt onderdeel van team Cybersecurity Awareness, binnen Corporate Cybersecurity (circa 70 collega’s). Het team bestaat uit zes professionals met uiteenlopende achtergronden en expertises. Samen bouwen jullie aan een awarenessprogramma dat zichtbaar impact maakt op de cyberweerbaarheid van Stedin. We dagen elkaar uit, delen kennis en combineren inhoudelijke scherpte met een gezonde dosis humor. Je standplaats is Rotterdam Blaak.


Met deze kwaliteiten groei jij hier verder

Je weet mensen in beweging te krijgen en begrijpt hoe gedrag, communicatie en cybersecurity elkaar beïnvloeden. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen strategie en uitvoering, neemt initiatief en bent een stevige sparringpartner voor collega's en stakeholders. Daarbij weet je complexe onderwerpen te vertalen naar heldere en aansprekende boodschappen voor verschillende doelgroepen.

Verder heb je:

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen cybersecurity, bij voorkeur met awareness-, kennis- of cultuurprogramma’s.

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een richting zoals Crisis and Security Management, Cybersecurity, Criminologie of Organisatiepsychologie.

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van content, campagnes en communicatie-interventies voor verschillende doelgroepen.


Zet de stap naar jouw volgende uitdaging

We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten.

Dit is nog goed om te weten:

  • De vacature sluit op 22 september.

  • Je werkt in principe 36 tot 40 uur per week; 4×9 is bespreekbaar.

  • Een assessment en uitgebreide screening maken onderdeel uit van de procedure.

Vragen over de vacature? Neem contact op met Saïda van Kalsbeek (manager) of Lisa Ciesielski (recruiter) via lisa.ciesielski@stedin.net of 06 2138 7807.

Är du noggrann, tekniskt intresserad och trivs med att arbeta inom tillverkningsindustrin? Lernia söker nu CNC-operatörer till uppdrag hos vår kund i Malmöområdet.

Om tjänsten

Som CNC-operatör arbetar du med att tillverka detaljer i metall med hjälp av CNC-styrda maskiner. Du blir en viktig del av produktionen och ansvarar för att maskinerna körs på ett säkert, effektivt och kvalitetsmedvetet sätt.

Arbetet kan innebära både självständiga och teamorienterade uppgifter. Du arbetar utifrån ritningar, arbetsinstruktioner och produktionsplaner och följer upp att tillverkade detaljer håller rätt kvalitet och mått.

Uppdraget kan vara förlagda till olika arbetstider, exempelvis kontinuerligt 2-skift (ink helger), 3-skift och ev ständig natt. Tjänsten är placerad i Malmö med omnejd.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som CNC-operatör kommer du bland annat att arbeta med:

  • Köra CNC-styrda svarvar och fräsmaskiner

  • Läsa och tolka tekniska ritningar och arbetsinstruktioner

  • Utföra verktygsbyten och enklare justeringar i maskiner

  • Mäta och kontrollera detaljer med olika mätverktyg

  • Arbeta med kvalitetskontroller och dokumentation

  • Övervaka maskiner och produktionsprocesser

  • Hantera material och färdiga produkter

  • Identifiera och rapportera avvikelser eller produktionsstörningar

  • Utföra enklare underhåll och rengöring av maskinutrustning

  • Följa säkerhetsrutiner, arbetsmiljökrav och kvalitetsstandarder

Tjänsten passar dig som tycker om praktiskt arbete, teknik och problemlösning och som vill utvecklas inom CNC och industriell tillverkning.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är noggrann, ansvarstagande och har ett tekniskt intresse. Du behöver trivas i produktionsmiljö och ha förmåga att arbeta strukturerat även när tempot är högt.

Som person är du:

  • Noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten

  • Tekniskt intresserad och lösningsorienterad

  • Självständig och ansvarstagande

  • Strukturerad och engagerad

  • Samarbetsinriktad och kommunikativ

  • Flexibel och van vid att arbeta mot uppsatta mål

Det är viktigt att du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter, följer instruktioner och bidrar till en säker och effektiv arbetsmiljö.

Krav för tjänsten

  • Gymnasieutbildning med industriell eller teknisk inriktning, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet

  • Erfarenhet av några års erfarenhet som CNC-operatör eller inom verkstadsindustri

  • Kunskap i ritningsläsning och mätteknik

  • Förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift

  • Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och i team

  • Hanterat stora detaljer.

  • Traverskort

  • Truckkort

Det är även meriterande om du har körkort.

Vi erbjuder

Som konsult hos Lernia får du möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens och bygga erfarenhet hos välkända företag inom industrin. Du får en anställning med kollektivavtal, konkurrenskraftiga villkor och en konsultchef som följer dig under uppdraget.

Genom olika uppdrag får du möjlighet att bredda din erfarenhet inom CNC, produktion och tillverkning. För rätt person kan uppdraget även leda till fortsatt anställning hos kund.

Om Lernia

Lernia är ett av Sveriges ledande bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och finns över hela landet. Med vårt omfattande nätverk erbjuder vi spännande jobb hos attraktiva arbetsgivare och varumärken som hjälper dig att utveckla din kompetens och karriär, både på lång och kort sikt.

Hur du söker tjänsten

För att söka tjänsten, scrolla ner till ansökningsformuläret nedan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Om du har några frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare. Med anledning av GDPR tar vi inte emot CV via mail utan hänvisar till Lernias hemsida.

Vid frågor: kontakta rekryterare Olivia Gunnarsson på olivia.gunnarsson@lernia.se

title: Personlig assistent sökes till uppdragsgivare i Lund (ALS)
description:
Vill du förgylla mitt liv – och känna dig som hemma på jobbet? Vill du vara mina händer och min röst? Är du en ansvarsfull, noggrann och lyhörd person som tycker om att göra skillnad i en annan människas vardag? Jag är en kvinna i Lund som lever med ALS. Med rätt stöd och lyhörda assistenter känner jag mig mindre sjuk och kan fortsätta leva det liv jag vill – ett aktivt liv tillsammans med familj och vänner. Nu söker jag dig som vill bli en viktig del av mitt team och finnas med i min vardag. För mig är det viktigt med assistenter som är trygga, engagerade och kan läsa av situationer utan att ta över. Du behöver kunna vara professionell när det behövs, men också kunna skratta och ha det trevligt tillsammans med mig. Om tjänsten
  • Assistans: Dubbelbemanning dygnet runt
  • Arbetstider: Dag, kväll och vaken natt
  • Anställningsform: Fast tjänst eller vikarie
  • Omfattning: Heltid eller deltid
  • Plats: Lund
  • Husdjur: Katt finns i hemmet
Arbetstider
  • Dag: 09:00–16:00
  • Kväll: 16:00–22:00
  • Vaken natt: 22:00–09:00
Vem söker jag? Du är ansvarsfull, noggrann och lyhörd. Du har gärna utbildning inom vård och omsorg eller tidigare erfarenhet av personlig assistans eller liknande arbete. Det viktigaste är att du har ett genuint intresse för människor och vill skapa trygghet och livskvalitet. Jag ser gärna att du är intresserad av en långvarig anställning och vill bli en del av vårt team. Krav
  • Utbildning inom vård och omsorg eller relevant erfarenhet
  • Ansvarsfull och noggrann
  • Lyhörd och trygg
  • Intresserad av en långvarig anställning
Meriterande erfarenhet
  • Sondmatning
  • Ventilator
  • Sugmaskin
  • Hostmaskin
  • Trakeostomi
Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – det viktigaste är din inställning, ditt engagemang och din vilja att lära dig. Känner du att det här skulle kunna vara något för dig? Välkommen att söka och bli en del av vårt team. Tillsammans skapar vi en trygg och meningsfull vardag där jag kan fortsätta leva mitt liv på mitt sätt. En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss på SAAND Assistans är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige. För att kunna jobba som personlig assistent måste du vara minst 18 år. Utifrån lagstiftning krävs att vi som arbetsgivare begär ett registerutdrag från alla anställda som ska arbeta som personlig assistent åt ett barn under 18 år. För att trygga våra uppdragsgivare på SAAND Assistans inhämtar vi utdrag ifrån belastningsregister på samtliga vi anställer. Därav behöver du uppvisa ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister inför en eventuell anställning. Vi ser gärna att du ansöker snarast då vi går igenom urvalet löpande och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdagen. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem i enlighet med GDPR. Utdrag ur belastningsregister kommer att frågas vid intervju. Registerutdraget kan du beställa digitalt via denna länk HVB-hem, e-tjänst | Polismyndigheten

description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. OVERVIEW:

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop Category Assortments

    • Assist the buyers in the in-depth development of merchandise assortments by category, collaborating on every aspect of the process. Sit with the buyer to go through the Merchandise Assortment Process and apply financials.

    • Participate in vendor pre-line meetings to review product offerings and gain insight into vendor initiatives and strategies. Communicate effectively with vendors post pre-line to secure item level data required for seasonal setup.

    • Update or create hindsight recaps for previous season to analyze results. Make recommendations on what worked/what didn't

    • Research economic, financial, market, competitive and industry data to explain current business trends and anticipate new trends or big ideas

    • Assist with preparation of all line review deliverables, including reporting, decks and sample management. Attend pre-season line reviews with leaders and Chief Merchant.

  • Manage In-Season Business

    • Update and analyze department reporting. Provide actionable recommendations to Buyer based on findings

    • Assess opportunities and react to trends within the business, including identifying the underlying cause. This includes updates to advertising, pricing, assortment needs and digital strategies.

    • Track vendor shipping on incoming orders, including resolving late or incomplete shipments. Communicate shifts in receipts to business partners to ensure accurate reflection in the OTB and anticipated stock levels Execute Operational Needs of the Category

    • Build partnerships with Planning, AR, Marketing, Store Operations and Pricing teams. Communicate changes to assortments, pricing, receipt flow and advertising as updates are made.

    • Train and mentor new hires by sharing experience, knowledge and best practices.

    • Demonstrate passionate curiosity. Seek opportunities to learn, challenge thinking and expand category point of view through asking questions, seeking mentorship and independent research.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in marketing, merchandising or business related field OR equivalent retail experience

Job Description

Propósito del Puesto

El propósito principal del rol es asegurar aprendizajes significativos y coherentes en la asignatura, mediante la adecuada implementación curricular, seguimiento de resultados y fortalecimiento de prácticas pedagógicas.

Asimismo, se espera liderar al equipo desde una mirada colaborativa, impulsando la mejora continua y el foco en los estudiantes.

Principios ISP


Comenzamos con nuestros niños y estudiantes
Nuestros niños y estudiantes son el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Simplemente, su éxito es nuestro éxito. El bienestar y la seguridad son esenciales tanto para los estudiantes como para el aprendizaje. Por ello, somos constantes en la identificación de posibles riesgos relacionados con la protección infantil (Safeguarding) y la Salud y Seguridad, actuando y dando seguimiento adecuado a cualquier situación o preocupación detectada.

Tratamos a todos con cuidado y respeto
Nos cuidamos mutuamente, valoramos nuestras similitudes y diferencias, y promovemos el bienestar propio y el de los demás.

Operamos de manera efectiva
Nos enfocamos continuamente en aquello que es más importante y que generará el mayor impacto. Aplicamos las políticas y procedimientos de la escuela y representamos los valores compartidos de nuestra comunidad.

Somos financieramente responsables
Tomamos decisiones financieras cuidadosamente, considerando las necesidades de los niños, los estudiantes y nuestras escuelas.

Aprendemos continuamente
La mejora constante es lo que nos impulsa. Participamos activamente en nuestro desarrollo personal y profesional, así como en la mejora continua de la escuela.

Responsabilidades ISP


Funciones principales:

  • Liderar la gestión académica del área de Inglés, resguardando la calidad del proceso educativo.
  • Acompañar y orientar al equipo docente a través de observaciones de aula, retroalimentación y espacios de coordinación.
  • Supervisar procesos de planificación, evaluación y cumplimiento de programas de estudio.
  • Apoyar en procesos de reclutamiento, selección y coordinación de reemplazos del área.
  • Gestionar aspectos administrativos, recursos e insumos del departamento.
  • Mantener una comunicación fluida con equipo directivo, docentes y familias.
  • Participar activamente en instancias institucionales definidas en el calendario escolar.


Habilidades, Calificaciones y Experiencia


Formación Académica:

  • Título profesional de Profesor/a de Ciencias


Experiencia:

  • Experiencia en enseñanza estudiantes de 7 a 16 años.
  • Manejo de estrategias didácticas diversificadas.


Competencias:

  • Manejo de Ingles intermedio (deseable no excluyente)
  • Compromiso con el desarrollo integral de los estudiantes.
  • Capacidad de trabajo colaborativo y adaptación al contexto institucional.
  • Deseable especialización en Currículum y Evaluación.
  • Competencias en liderazgo, organización, planificación y comunicación efectiva.

ISP Principles


Begin with our children and students. Our children and students are at the heart of what we do. Simply, their success is our success. Wellbeing and safety are both essential for learners and learning. Therefore, we are consistent in identifying potential safeguarding

and Health & Safety issues and acting and following up on all concerns appropriately.


Treat everyone with care and respect. We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the well-being of self and others.


Operate effectively. We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference. We apply school policies and procedures and embody the shared ideas of our community.


Are financially responsible. We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of the children, students and our schools.


Learn continuously. Getting better is what drives us. We positively engage with personal and professional development and school improvement.

ISP Commitment to Safeguarding Principles

ISP is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures, including an online due diligence search, references and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.

ISP Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

ISP is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of ISP through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Industrial Maintenance Reliability Technician III
description:
Position: Industrial Maintenance and Reliability Technician III (IMRT III)
Location: Waco, TX
Shift: Monday–Friday, 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM; overtime as needed
Pay Rate: $44.43/hour

Summary Description

The Industrial Maintenance and Reliability Technician III (IMRT III) is an advanced maintenance position responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and improving manufacturing and facility equipment to maximize reliability, safety, and production uptime.

Reporting to the Maintenance Supervisor, the IMRT III performs complex preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance across mechanical and electrical systems. This position requires advanced troubleshooting capabilities, strong technical knowledge, and the ability to identify root causes and implement effective solutions while also providing guidance and support to less experienced technicians.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Follow all plant safety policies and procedures, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), PPE requirements, and safe machine operation.
  • Read and interpret electrical blueprints, wiring diagrams, schematics, equipment specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Troubleshoot motors, contactors, relays, and other electrical components using multimeters and other diagnostic equipment.
  • Troubleshoot and repair electrical controls, PLCs, industrial controls, and motor-control systems.
  • Diagnose complex mechanical and electrical equipment failures and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on manufacturing and facility equipment.
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair chillers, process pumps, compressors, ink pumps, glue pumps, and related industrial equipment.
  • Operate and work with shop equipment, including bandsaws, mills, and lathes.
  • Perform equipment repairs and calibrations while minimizing production downtime.
  • Identify root causes of recurring equipment issues and implement effective, sustainable repairs.
  • Ensure production and related equipment remain in safe and reliable operating condition.
  • Document completed repairs, parts used, equipment conditions, and maintenance activities within the CMMS.
  • Assist with maintaining appropriate spare-parts inventory and an organized parts room.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and support to less experienced maintenance technicians.
  • Communicate equipment conditions, maintenance concerns, and recommended corrective actions clearly to appropriate team members.
  • Participate in Global Performance System (GPS) activities, including 5Star, Pillar Teams, audits, Near Miss reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain an organized and methodical approach when managing multiple maintenance priorities.
  • Demonstrate accountability, accuracy, adaptability, effective communication, problem-solving, and strong safety awareness.
  • Maintain regular and consistent attendance and respond to overtime or weekend maintenance needs as required.
  • Perform additional maintenance duties and projects as assigned.

We’d Love to Hear From You If

  • You have a technical degree and 8+ years of significant industrial or military maintenance experience troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining manufacturing equipment.
  • You have strong leadership skills and can mentor or provide technical guidance to less experienced technicians.
  • You have advanced mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
  • You have experience programming and troubleshooting PLCs.
  • You have experience troubleshooting electrical controls, motors, contactors, relays, and industrial motor-control systems.
  • You can read and interpret electrical blueprints, schematics, wiring diagrams, equipment specifications, and technical documentation.
  • You have hands-on experience performing preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance.
  • You have experience diagnosing equipment failures, performing root-cause analysis, and implementing effective repairs.
  • You have experience working with industrial equipment such as chillers, pumps, compressors, motors, and related systems.
  • Experience with blown film, sheet extrusion, flexographic printing, lamination, slitting, or ancillary flexible-packaging equipment is preferred.
  • You have experience using a CMMS to document maintenance activities, repairs, parts usage, and equipment history.
  • You can safely operate a forklift.
  • You are comfortable using mechanical lifts and ladders and performing work that requires kneeling, bending, twisting, and lifting up to 50 pounds.
  • You can work independently, prioritize multiple maintenance needs, and solve complex problems in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • You are available to work overtime and weekends when production or maintenance needs require it.

Benefits

At TOPPAN Packaging Americas, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support overall wellbeing. Benefits may vary based on location, employment classification, or collective bargaining agreement and may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, including FSA and HSA options
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing resources
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Company-paid and voluntary insurance plans including life, accident, and disability coverage
  • Tuition reimbursement

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.
