title: Advance Practice Practitioner Lead
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Why Join Grace at Home?

Grace at Home is a provider-led, community-based health and care partner dedicated to improving the health and well-being of those who need care the most, with a deep commitment to high-needs, urban and rural communities. Our local physicians, nurses, and caregivers work together to serve people and the communities they live in, beyond just treating symptoms. We remove barriers by delivering personalized care as close to home as possible, often in-home, because we know a deep understanding of our patient’s race, culture, and environment is critical to delivering improved health outcomes. By empowering patients, providers, and caregivers with the support they need, we strive to make health and care a reality—not a burden—every single day. Join us in creating a better way to care.

Overview

Reporting to the Regional Chief Medical Officer, the APP Lead is responsible for training and day to day management of Nurse Practitioners (NPs), Physician Assistants (PAs), and RN’s, ensuring effective collaboration, proper clinical management, documentation of visits, and high-quality patient care delivery to Grace at Home family members. This role involves team leadership, performance monitoring, overseeing an interdisciplinary team to meet organizational goals, improve member outcomes, and provide exceptional patient care. The assistant manager will also manage processes to ensure members, and their families, receive timely and effective navigation support, both telephonically and in the field. This position is accountable for ensuring Grace at Home is positioned to innovatively deliver on its promise. They should embody Care at Home’s core values, including, Trusted, Empathetic, Committed, Humble, Creative and Community-Minded.

The APP Leads will have a strong knowledge base in providing care in the home, Value Based Care, HEDIS and Stars, documentation and coding, and medical practice principles. They will stay informed about advancements in healthcare practices and disseminate relevant knowledge.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Mentor clinical team members, providing clinical guidance, regular performance evaluations, constructive feedback, and supporting professional development. Administrative time accounts for 0.4 FTE of the APP Lead’s time
  • Implement evidence-based practices and clinical protocols.
  • Monitor and evaluate patient care delivery to maintain high standards of quality and safety.
  • Ensure staff schedules optimize productivity, meeting patient care needs, maintaining high standards of care and safety in compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Address and resolve patient or staff concerns promptly and professionally.
  • Coordinate orientation and continuing education for clinical staff, promoting opportunities for professional growth.
  • Serve as a liaison between clinical staff and administrative leadership.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings to enhance patient care coordination.
  • Ensure all staff adhere to regulatory standards, including HIPAA and OSHA requirements.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of clinical activities, training, and compliance records.
  • Conduct patient visits in-person in the patients' homes and/or via telehealth maintaining a patient panel equivalent to 0.6 FTE
  • Address and resolve patient concerns promptly and professionally.
  • Collaborate with business partners such as Home Health and Hospice agencies, assisted living facilities, Primary Care providers, Specialists, hospital staff and other preferred partners.
  • Collaborate with multiple care disciplines such as RN's, and cross functional team-members to provide high-quality care.
  • Will participate in after hours on-call coverage rotation and rotating evening a weekend patient care coverage.

Qualifications

  • Education/Experience: Master’s degree in nursing or related science field required
    • Certification/Licensure: Active and unrestricted NP license required
  • Clinical: Must have 2+ years of strong leadership and management experience in a clinical setting; community-based care experience preferred. Experience with Medicare/Medicaid is a must.
  • Must have 2+ years of clinical experience treating complex chronic conditions and high-needs patients, Medicare and LTSS experience preferred
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and group facilitation skills.
  • Must have strong critical analytic, thinking and communication skills necessary to evaluate and respond to team progress, anticipate needs and other related team dynamics.
  • Computer Knowledge: Excellent computer skills required particularly Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Willingness to explore and learn new or unfamiliar applications that may benefit the clinical team
  • Culture: Good judgement, impeccable ethics, and a strong team player; desire to succeed and grow in a fast-paced organization.

The working environment and physical requirements of the job include:

In-office work is performed indoors in a traditional office setting with air conditioning, artificial light, and an open workspace.

In this position you will need to communicate with customers, vendors, management, and other co-workers in person and/or via phone or telehealth. Regular use of the telephone and e-mail for communication is essential. Sitting for extended periods is common. Must be able to receive ordinary information and to prepare or inspect documents. Lifting of up to 10 lbs. occasionally may be required. Good manual dexterity for the use of common office equipment such as computer terminals, calculator, copiers, and FAX machines. Good reasoning ability is important. Able to understand and utilize management reports, memos, and other documents to conduct business.

title: Research Assistant, 3D Imaging and Science Communication
description:
Position: Research Assistant, 3D Imaging and Science Communication

FLSA Status: Non-exempt

Department: Negaunee Integrative Research Center

Our Mission: Since the 1893 World Columbian Exposition, our organization has aimed to connect people to the natural environment and human history.


This position will support a team developing a Tiny Animal Scavenger Hunt for visitors in several Field Museum galleries, including Mammals, What Is an Animal?, Birds, and Africa. The activity will encourage visitors to discover and learn about small animals that can be easily overlooked within exhibits and dioramas.

Through interactive 3D models and interpretive content, the project will highlight how the anatomy and physical characteristics of small animals provide insight into evolutionary adaptations and life at a small scale.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Use provided CT Scans from biological specimens to create and/or prepare interactive 3D models for visitor access through QR codes.

  • Develop clear, engaging interpretive text for each model that explains characteristics related to the animal’s small size.

  • Create a visitor-friendly map showing where to find each 3D model QR code across the galleries, to be posted online for visitor access.

  • Collaborate with team members and exhibit personnel to plan the deployment of the Tiny Animal Scavenger Hunt.

Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled as an undergraduate student; coursework or training in biology and/or visual science communication is preferred.

  • Experience with 3D imaging and/or modeling using Blender or similar software.

  • Foundational knowledge of vertebrate skeletal and skull anatomy.

  • Ability to work independently and meet established project timelines.

  • Natural history illustration experience preferred.

Application should include:

  • A resume or CV demonstrating your relevant education, experience, and skills

  • A cover letter describing your interest in the project and how your experience, skills, or academic interests relate to the work

  • Examples of 3D modeling and/or visual science communication work that demonstrate your relevant skills

Supervision Received:

Supervision Exercised:

The position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

title: Director of Video Storytelling
description:
About Eve

Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.
Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.
Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.
AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.
Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

The Role

We’re hiring our first Director of Video Storytelling to own every frame Eve puts into the world; from our biggest brand campaigns, to the ad that stops a plaintiff attorney mid-scroll, to the product film that makes a launch feel like an event.

This is a maker’s role at the top of the craft. You’re a full-stack video creator: dangerous in After Effects, fluent in motion graphics, confident behind the camera, a magician in the editing bay. You’ve directed the shoot, lit the room, and saved the story in the edit when the footage didn’t cooperate. You’ve been an ambitious adopter of generative AI tools for video, and know when and how to use them — and when not to. You’ll set the creative bar for video at Eve.

You’ll build our in-office content studio at our San Francisco office from the ground up; the space, the gear, the workflows, and the production motion that lets us concept, shoot, and ship high-quality content quickly. Company announcements, brand stories, ads, product releases, and social campaigns, produced in-house at a level that makes people ask which agency we use.

You won’t do it alone. You’ll build a roster of contractors, agencies, and external partners who extend your reach on our biggest campaigns, and over time you’ll hire the in-house team that makes video a competitive advantage across every one of Eve’s go-to-market motions; brand, demand, product marketing, events, and social. You’ll partner closely with the leader of our social channels; they own where the work lives, you own the craft that fills it.

If you have a portfolio of world-class work, if you think in frames and cuts, if you’ve ever rebuilt a set at midnight because the shot wasn’t right yet, this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own video at Eve end-to-end. Brand campaigns, video ads, product releases, company announcements, event films, and organic social video; from treatment to color grade.
  • Create our biggest brand campaigns. Develop the concepts and treatments, direct the shoots, and deliver films that make plaintiff attorneys feel something about Eve.
  • Make video ads that perform. Produce the ad creative behind our paid motions; think in hooks and variants, iterate with the growth team, and let the data argue with your taste.
  • Oversee organic social video. Set the quality bar, build the formats and templates that let social ship daily, and jump behind the camera when the moment deserves it.
  • Build Eve’s in-office content studio. Design the space in our San Francisco office, spec the gear, and build the workflows that make high-quality production an everyday capability, not a quarterly event.
  • Produce the work yourself, not just brief it. Write, direct, shoot, animate, and edit. You are the production motion until you build the one that replaces you.
  • Build our motion graphics system. Create the After Effects toolkits, templates, and animation language that make everything Eve ships unmistakably Eve.
  • Build the roster. Find and manage the contractors, agencies, and external partners who execute alongside you; write briefs that make outside work look in-house, and hold every deliverable to your standard.
  • Hire and lead an in-house video team. Start hands-on with a budget to build, and grow the function into a durable competitive advantage.
  • Run the budget. Real money for gear, contractors, and productions. Decide where it goes, place bets that won’t pay off evenly, and be honest about which ones worked.
  • Partner across go-to-market. Give sales, demand gen, product marketing, events, and recruiting the video firepower their motions deserve.
  • Own the numbers. Watch-time, completion, creative performance; build the measurement that separates a video that looked great from a video that worked, and be the one who says which is which.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years in video production and creative, including time owning video for a brand people recognize.
  • A portfolio of world-class work; we will watch every frame. Show us range: brand films, ads, motion graphics, and short-form that broke out.
  • A genuine full-stack maker; you personally write, direct, shoot, animate, and edit, and you’re dangerous in After Effects.
  • Deep motion graphics and animation craft; type, timing, and transitions that hold up next to the best work in tech.
  • Real, demonstrated expertise with cutting-edge AI video tools and workflows. You have examples in your portfolio that demonstrate your ability here.
  • Camera skills; directing talent (including executives and real people, not just actors), lighting, sound, and the on-set judgment to get the shot with the time you have.
  • Editing chops; story structure, pacing, sound design, and color that elevate raw footage into something people finish.
  • Experience building production infrastructure; you’ve set up a studio, a gear package, or a production pipeline from scratch and know what it takes to run one.
  • Proven ability to manage contractors, agencies, and freelance crews; you know how to buy great work, not just make it.
  • Range across formats; the same week can demand a 90-second brand film, a 15-second vertical cut, and a looping product animation.
  • Excellent taste and story instincts. Our audience is attorneys and top-tier operators; they notice everything.
  • Comfort building from zero and leading a team as it grows.

Bonus Points

  • You’ve built an in-house studio or video team at a startup, gear specs and all.
  • Documentary experience; you know how to get real people to say true things on camera.
  • Experience marketing to attorneys, professional services buyers, or another skeptical, high-expertise audience.
  • Color grading and sound design skills strong enough to finish work without outside help.
  • Experience producing AI-assisted video workflows and pushing new production tools into daily use.
  • You’ve worked at a company going through hypergrowth and thrived in the chaos.

title: Director, Regulatory Compliance Management, Advisory and Privacy Office
description:
About KOHO

We’re on a mission to make financial services better for every Canadian. That means no hidden fees, no predatory interest rates - just financial products designed to help our users spend smart, save more, and build real wealth. We’re a performance organization with a strong heart: we care deeply about outcomes, and everything ties back to our mission - to financially empower a generation of Canadians.

At KOHO, we’re not your average 9-5. We believe real impact comes from people who are trusted, empowered, and supported to do their best work - without sacrificing their lives to do it. We prioritize work-life integration, not just work-life balance. That means asynchronous collaboration, flexible hours, and a remote-first setup built around autonomy and high trust.

KOHO is entering its next chapter - leaner, smarter, more AI-integrated. We’re building for impact, not bureaucracy. If you thrive in environments that value clarity, ownership, and bold thinking, you’ll fit right in.

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned Director, Regulatory Compliance Management, Advisory and Privacy Office to lead the advisory heart of KOHO’s Compliance function and to own our Privacy Office end to end. Reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer, you will be the trusted advisor to our business partners, such as product (lending, core banking, growth & onboarding), marketing, and user success, and before they build — translating a dense regulatory landscape into clear and useful guidance. You will also own KOHO’s privacy program, from Privacy Impact Assessments and consent design through to breach response.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is energized by ambiguity, comfortable being the decision-maker in the room, and motivated by building durable programs rather than inheriting them. If you believe compliance should make good products possible rather than merely permissible, you’ll do your best work here.

What You’ll Be Doing

Compliance Advisory

  • Act as the primary compliance advisor to business partners such as Product (lending, core banking, growth & onboarding), Marketing, Technology, Payments, Partnerships, and User Success, providing timely, practical, risk-based guidance on new products, features, campaigns, and business arrangements.

  • Own the regulatory advisory and interpretation function, resolving novel questions with clear written positions and a defensible rationale that stands up to regulatory and audit scrutiny.

  • Lead compliance review and sign-off of marketing materials, disclosures, and customer communications, and embed obligations into product development early.

  • Own the Whistleblower and Ethics programs, including intake, investigation oversight, non-retaliation, and ethics reporting to the Board.

Regulatory Compliance Management

  • In collaboration with Legal, own the regulatory compliance management program: horizon scanning, impact assessment, and coordinated implementation of new and amended regulatory requirements.

  • Maintain KOHO’s regulatory obligations inventory and the mapping of obligations to responsible business owners, policies, and controls.

  • Lead the development, refresh, and governance of compliance policies, standards, and procedures, including annual approval cycles.

Privacy Office (Deputy Chief Privacy Officer)

  • Own and mature KOHO’s enterprise privacy program, aligned to privacy legislation, and act as KOHO’s designated privacy lead.

  • Establish and run the Privacy Impact Assessment process for new products, vendors, data uses, and technology changes, and govern consent, collection, use, disclosure, retention, and cross-border transfer of personal information on a privacy-by-design basis.

  • Lead privacy incident and breach response, including containment coordination, real-risk-of-significant-harm assessments, regulatory and individual notification, and root cause remediation.

  • Own privacy complaints and access and correction requests, the data inventory and privacy notices, and privacy training and awareness across the organization.

Team Leadership and Industry Engagement

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of compliance and privacy professionals, setting clear priorities and raising the technical bar of the function.

  • Partner closely with Financial Crime, Compliance Testing, Operational Risk, Internal Audit, Legal, and Tech/Cyber to ensure integrated coverage and no gaps between mandates.

  • Represent KOHO externally with industry associations, peer forums, and regulator outreach, staying ahead of emerging compliance, privacy, and conduct risk trends.

  • Prepare and present clear, decision-ready materials for senior management and applicable Board-level committees.

AI, Automation and Innovation

  • Apply AI, automation, and data analytics to advisory intake, regulatory horizon scanning, marketing review, and privacy assessments.

  • Advise the business on the responsible use of AI, including model transparency, fairness, explainability, and personal information use.

  • Evaluate and implement RegTech and privacy technology that improves speed and consistency without diluting rigour.

Who You Are

  • You have 10+ years of progressive compliance, privacy, or regulatory legal experience in financial services, with meaningful time spent in an advisory capacity.

  • You have deep working knowledge of Canadian consumer protection, retail banking or payments, and privacy legislation.

  • You have built or substantially matured a privacy program or regulatory change program, not just operated one someone else designed.

  • You are a strong people leader and a clear writer — you can give a straight answer to a hard question and explain the reasoning behind it.

  • You’ve worked in regulated fintech, neobank, or direct-to-consumer financial institutions, you’re passionate about empowering financial wellness, and a relevant designation (CIPP/C, CAMS, CRCM, LL.B/JD, or equivalent) is an asset.

The budgeted salary range for this role is $190,000-230,000 CAD / year.

At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members.

Description de poste en français

À propos du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne chevronnée pour diriger les services-conseils — le cœur de la fonction Conformité de KOHO — et prendre en charge l’ensemble de notre Bureau de la protection des renseignements personnels. Relevant de la cheffe ou du chef de la conformité, vous serez la personne-ressource de confiance de nos partenaires d’affaires, notamment les équipes Produits (prêts, services bancaires de base, croissance et intégration), Marketing et Expérience utilisateur. Votre rôle consistera à traduire un environnement réglementaire complexe en conseils clairs et utiles, en amont de la conception de leurs produits et initiatives.

Vous serez également responsable du programme de protection des renseignements personnels de KOHO, de bout en bout : évaluations des facteurs relatifs à la vie privée, conception des mécanismes de consentement, gestion des incidents et intervention en cas d’atteinte à la protection des renseignements personnels.

Il s’agit d’un rôle de leadership très concret, pour une personne qui aime évoluer dans l’ambiguïté, qui est à l’aise de prendre des décisions et qui souhaite bâtir des programmes durables plutôt que de simplement assurer le maintien de programmes existants. Si vous croyez que la conformité doit rendre possibles de bons produits — et pas seulement les rendre permis —, vous pourrez vous épanouir pleinement dans ce rôle.

Ce que vous ferez

Services-conseils en conformité

  • Agir comme principale personne-conseil en conformité auprès des partenaires d’affaires, notamment les équipes Produits (prêts, services bancaires de base, croissance et intégration), Marketing, Technologie, Paiements, Partenariats et Expérience utilisateur, en fournissant des conseils rapides, pratiques et fondés sur les risques pour les nouveaux produits, les fonctionnalités, les campagnes et les ententes commerciales.

  • Diriger la fonction de conseil et d’interprétation réglementaires, résoudre les questions inédites et formuler des positions claires, écrites et appuyées par une analyse défendable qui résiste à l’examen des organismes de réglementation et de l’audit.

  • Diriger l’examen et l’approbation de conformité des documents marketing, des communications aux clients et des informations à fournir, et intégrer les exigences réglementaires dès les premières étapes du développement des produits.

  • Être responsable des programmes de dénonciation et d’éthique, notamment la réception des signalements, la supervision des enquêtes, la protection contre les représailles et la présentation de rapports sur l’éthique au conseil d’administration.

Gestion de la conformité réglementaire

  • En collaboration avec le service juridique, être responsable du programme de gestion de la conformité réglementaire : veille réglementaire, évaluation des répercussions et mise en œuvre coordonnée des exigences nouvelles ou modifiées.

  • Tenir à jour l’inventaire des obligations réglementaires de KOHO et établir la correspondance entre ces obligations, les responsables d’affaires, les politiques et les contrôles en place.

  • Diriger l’élaboration, la mise à jour et la gouvernance des politiques, normes et procédures de conformité, y compris les cycles annuels d’approbation.

Bureau de la protection des renseignements personnels

  • Prendre en charge et faire évoluer le programme d’entreprise de protection des renseignements personnels de KOHO, conformément aux lois applicables, et agir à titre de personne responsable de la protection des renseignements personnels désignée par KOHO.

  • Mettre en place et administrer le processus d’évaluation des facteurs relatifs à la vie privée (EFVP) pour les nouveaux produits, les fournisseurs, les utilisations de données et les changements technologiques. Encadrer le consentement ainsi que la collecte, l’utilisation, la communication, la conservation et le transfert transfrontalier de renseignements personnels selon une approche de protection de la vie privée dès la conception.

  • Diriger la réponse aux incidents et aux atteintes à la protection des renseignements personnels, notamment la coordination du confinement, l’évaluation du risque de préjudice sérieux, les avis aux organismes de réglementation et aux personnes concernées, ainsi que la mise en œuvre des mesures correctives visant à éliminer les causes profondes.

  • Être responsable des plaintes en matière de protection des renseignements personnels, des demandes d’accès et de rectification, de l’inventaire des données, des avis de confidentialité ainsi que de la formation et de la sensibilisation à l’échelle de l’organisation.

Leadership d’équipe et rayonnement dans le secteur

  • Diriger, accompagner et faire progresser une équipe de spécialistes de la conformité et de la protection des renseignements personnels, en établissant des priorités claires et en rehaussant le niveau d’expertise technique de la fonction.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Crimes financiers, Tests de conformité, Risques opérationnels, Audit interne, Affaires juridiques et Technologie/Cybersécurité afin d’assurer une couverture intégrée et d’éviter les angles morts entre les différents mandats.

  • Représenter KOHO auprès d’associations sectorielles, de groupes de pairs et d’organismes de réglementation, et demeurer au fait des tendances émergentes en matière de conformité, de protection des renseignements personnels et de risques liés aux pratiques commerciales.

  • Préparer et présenter des documents clairs, axés sur la prise de décision, à la haute direction et aux comités pertinents du conseil d’administration.

Intelligence artificielle, automatisation et innovation

  • Utiliser l’intelligence artificielle, l’automatisation et l’analytique des données pour améliorer la gestion des demandes de conseil, la veille réglementaire, l’examen du matériel marketing et les évaluations des facteurs relatifs à la vie privée.

  • Conseiller l’entreprise sur l’utilisation responsable de l’intelligence artificielle, notamment en matière de transparence des modèles, d’équité, d’explicabilité et d’utilisation des renseignements personnels.

  • Évaluer et mettre en œuvre des solutions de technologie réglementaire et de protection des renseignements personnels qui améliorent la rapidité et la cohérence des processus sans en réduire la rigueur.

Profil recherché

  • Vous possédez au moins 10 ans d’expérience progressive en conformité, en protection des renseignements personnels ou en droit réglementaire dans le secteur des services financiers, dont une expérience substantielle en services-conseils.

  • Vous avez une connaissance approfondie de la protection des consommateurs au Canada, des services bancaires de détail ou des paiements, ainsi que des lois relatives à la protection des renseignements personnels.

  • Vous avez bâti ou fait évoluer de façon importante un programme de protection des renseignements personnels ou de gestion des changements réglementaires — vous n’avez pas uniquement assuré l’exploitation d’un programme conçu par quelqu’un d’autre.

  • Vous êtes une personne gestionnaire solide et une excellente rédactrice ou un excellent rédacteur : vous savez donner une réponse claire à une question difficile et en expliquer le raisonnement.

  • Vous avez travaillé dans une entreprise de technologie financière réglementée, une néobanque ou une institution financière s’adressant directement aux consommateurs. Vous avez à cœur de favoriser la santé financière et une certification pertinente — CIPP/C, CAMS, CRCM, LL. B./J.D. ou équivalent — constitue un atout.

KOHO is for builders.

If you’re energized by challenge, motivated by mission, and want to be part of a team that punches above its weight - we want to hear from you.

The KOHO culture is one of collaboration, creativity, and diverse perspectives. We are committed to building and fostering an inclusive, accessible environment for everyone. title: Tak- och tätskiktsmontör Sökes
description:

Göte Tak söker nu en erfaren och engagerad takläggare som vill bli en del av vårt team.

Vi arbetar huvudsakligen med takrenoveringar och takomläggningar på villor och fastigheter. Våra projekt omfattar bland annat tegel- och betongtak, underlagstak, råspont, takavvattning, taksäkerhet och montering av takfönster.

Arbetsuppgifter

  • Rivning av befintliga tak

  • Montering och byte av råspont

  • Underlagspapp, strö- och bärläkt

  • Läggning av tegel- och betongpannor

  • Montering av takavvattning

  • Montering av taksäkerhet

  • Takfönster och enklare plåtarbeten

  • Övriga förekommande arbeten i samband med takrenoveringar

Vi söker framför allt dig som har tidigare erfarenhet av takläggning och känner dig trygg i yrket.

För tjänsten ser vi gärna att du:

  • Har erfarenhet av takläggning eller liknande byggnadsarbete

  • Kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten

  • Har god arbetsmoral och passar tider

  • Trivs med att arbeta i team

  • Är bekväm med arbete på höjd

  • Har B-körkort

Erfarenhet av plåtarbeten, takfönster, träarbeten eller arbetsledning är meriterande.

Göte Tak har arbetat med takrenoveringar sedan 2013. Vi utför kompletta takbyten och renoveringar och arbetar med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet och ett professionellt utförande.

Vi söker nu ytterligare en medarbetare som vill utvecklas tillsammans med företaget och bli en långsiktig del av vårt team.

Anställning

Anställningsform och lön diskuteras utifrån erfarenhet och kompetens.

Tjänsten kan tillsättas löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Ansökan

Skicka en kort presentation av dig själv tillsammans med information om din tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet. Bifoga gärna CV och referenser.

Välkommen med din ansökan till Göte Tak!

Join Nuffield Health and create the future you want, today.

title: MRI Services Operational Lead
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: MRI Services Operational Lead

Location: Cromwell Hospital, 164-178 Cromwell Road, London SW5 0TU

Contract: Permanent

Salary range: £Competitive, plus Bupa benefits.

Full time/part time: Full Time, 37.50 hours per week

Close date for applications: Monday 21st September 2026

1st stage interviews: Tuesday 29th September 2026

2nd stage interviews: Wednesday 7th October 2026

At Bupa, you can be the MRI Services Operational Lead that you want to be. With the autonomy to use your skills and strong benefits to support you, patient care can be your top priority. Building a career in radiography has never been easier, with good hours, you can live a balanced, healthy lifestyle.

Joining Bupa, you'll benefit from access to our state-of-the art Clinical Training Facility, a centre for connected learning, care and careers. This forms part of Bupa Campus, a vibrant new learning initiative which brings us together in virtual and physical spaces across the Bupa globe.

We make health happen

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced, highly motivated MRI professional with a passion for operational excellence to join the Cromwell Hospital as our MRI Services Operational Lead.

About The Cromwell Hospital

The Cromwell Hospital is a major international private hospital in West London providing care to both UK and international patients. We are committed to providing the highest quality healthcare outpatient and inpatient service care.

The hospital has 180 beds and 4 suites, outpatients, theatres, medical and surgical wards, cardiac centre (new cath lab), CDU, urgent care centre, level 2 and 3 adult intensive care facilities, paediatrics, diagnostic services – MRI/CT/GEN/Nuclear Medicine, physiotherapy, a dedicated day surgery unit, and onsite pharmacy.

Our new modern Radiography department is equipped with the latest state-of-the-art technology to include;

  • 4 MRI Philips scanners (3T, and 1.5T scanner)

  • Dedicated Extremity MRI Scanner

  • Two general X-Ray rooms

  • One fluoroscopy suite, which can also be utilised as an additional X-Ray room

  • One Cone Beam CT scanner

  • One Bone Density scanner with advanced body composition analysis capabilities

  • Two state-of-the-art mobile X-Ray units

  • Four theatre image intensifiers

How you’ll help us make health happen:

Reporting to the Head of Diagnostics you’ll be responsible for overall service performance, overseeing workforce planning, governance, quality assurance and operational delivery in our state-of-the-art MRI service within a leading acute hospital environment.

You’ll work closely with senior clinical and operational leaders, including the MRI Clinical Lead and MRI Cardiac Lead. You’ll ensure patients receive exceptional care whilst maintaining compliance with regulatory and MRI safety standards. You’re able to presentable influential figure, attending MR safety committee meetings and active in advisory and peer support.

Leading experienced multidisciplinary MRI team, you’ll ensure the delivery of safe, efficient and high-quality diagnostic services whilst championing outstanding patient experience and clinical excellence, staff engagement, quality improvement initiatives and supporting future growth within the department.

Other Responsibilities

  • Manage staffing, workforce planning and rota coordination to ensure effective service coverage.

  • Provide leadership and line management to senior MRI radiographers and clinical leads.

  • Drive service performance, efficiency and patient experience improvements.

  • Ensure compliance with MRI safety standards, MHRA regulations and hospital governance requirements.

  • Lead departmental quality assurance programmes, audits and service improvement initiatives.

  • Support CQC readiness and continuous regulatory compliance.

  • Work collaboratively with consultants, referring clinicians and international patient teams to deliver seamless patient pathways.

  • Monitor reporting KPIs and ensure appropriate escalation where required.

  • Oversee revenue integrity and ensure accurate documentation and charging of examinations.

  • Champion staff development, training, competency frameworks and annual appraisals.

Key Skills / Qualifications needed for this role:

Essential

  • B.Sc. Hons in Diagnostic Radiography or equivalent.

  • Substantial, post-graduate experience in a relevant post in MRI.

  • HCPC state registration.

  • Knowledge of AI and optimisation.

Desirable:

  • Recent MRI Safety Course certification.

  • Experience commissioning or implementing MRI scanners.

  • Experience working towards Quality Standard for Imaging (QSI) accreditation.

  • Philips MRI experience.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to make health happen for our people. Viva is our global wellbeing programme and includes all aspects of our health – from mental and physical, to financial, social and environmental wellbeing. We support flexible working and have a range of family friendly benefits. Joining Bupa in this role you will receive the following benefits and more:

  • Payment of Professional Registration fees

  • Access to Bupa Campus and our Clinical Training Facility to support your clinical career development

  • Equivalent to 25 days holiday per year, increasing through length of service, with option to buy or sell

  • Bupa health insurance as a benefit in kind

  • An enhanced pension plan and life insurance

  • Support with travel costs via a season ticket loan or cycle2work

  • Discounted access to online gym sessions through Gympass

  • Various other benefits and online discounts

  • Free onsite massages as a recognition for your hard work

  • Opportunity to participate in our annual awards ceremony

Why Bupa?

We’re a health insurer and provider. With no shareholders, our customers are our focus. Our people are all driven by the same purpose – helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. We make health happen by being brave, caring and responsible in everything we do.

We encourage all of our people to “Be you at Bupa”, we champion diversity, and we understand the importance of our people representing the communities and customers we serve. That’s why we especially encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

Bupa is a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. This means we aim to offer an interview/assessment to every disabled applicant who meets the minimum criteria for the role. We’ll make sure you are treated fairly and offer reasonable adjustments as part of our recruitment process to anyone that needs them.

If you require information regarding this role in an alternative format, please email: careers@bupa.com

At Bupa we strive to ensure all our of customers, patients and staff are safe. All employees have a duty to ensure that safeguarding children, young people and adults at risk is prioritised and acted on appropriately,

title: Product Designer, Contract Orchestration
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Your Role

As a Product Designer at Zip, you’ll work on real, customer-facing features across a wide product surface area for procurement, which at its essence is managing the process of helping companies buy what they need. You’ll be supported by experienced designers, PMs, and engineers who care deeply about craft, collaboration, and building consumer-grade experiences for complex enterprise workflows. You’ll have direct access to our users for UX Research and testing, and the features you design will be immediately used by our users. You’ll work with a tight-knit team that values open communication and cross-functional collaboration.

This role will be on our Contract Orchestration team, which continue to expand our contracts offering that spans redlining, renewals, obligation management and more. You’ll dive deep with legal and procurement teams to figure out how to enhance their workflows by building out features that use AI sensibly.

We are looking for designers who are eager to learn, take ownership early, and grow quickly by working on high-impact problems used by some of the world’s leading companies.

Please note, we are looking for someone who will be able to come into our San Francisco office on a hybrid basis (3 days / week).

You will

  • Contribute to CLM features from concept to launch

  • Partner closely with engineers, and with PM and go-to-market stakeholders to brainstorm, define, and implement new features and offerings.

  • Collaborate closely with our product and customer-facing teams to participate in UX Research and design thoughtful solutions

  • Iterate quickly on designs based on user feedback

  • Participate in regular design reviews with the broader design team.

  • Work closely with product designers across the organization to understand their specific team’s needs

Qualifications

  • 3-5+ years professional design experience working at a startup or similarly resource-restricted organization shipping great designs at a fast pace

  • Experience shipping at least one full product or significant feature end to end as the lead designer.

  • Experience iterating with engineers and other team members on both visual and UX designs to get the experience and details just right

  • Great presentation, collaboration and communication skills

  • Empathetic champion for your work’s audience and customers

  • Strong visual design skills without sacrificing usability

  • Understanding of the technical constraints of building web applications.

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

Perks & Benefits

  • 🍼 Paid parental leave

  • 🐣 Fertility benefits

  • 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. title: Milieu Therapist, PRN
description:

At ERC Pathlight, we’re on a mission to change lives—and we’re looking for people who feel called to do the same.

As one of the nation’s leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.

Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.

Why Join Us

When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You’ll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.

Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. You matter.

If you’re energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.

Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.

What you’ll be doing:

Schedule: PRN/ As Needed - Monday and Friday availability required, at least 4 shifts per month

The Milieu Therapist facilitates groups based on core curriculum, provides meal monitoring and meal support., and offers milieu support, de-escalation and behavior coaching to patients in IP/Res and PHP programs. The Milieu Therapist may be required to work on-call shifts based on business needs, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local labor laws.

Essential duties and responsibilities:

  • Facilitates curriculum-based groups.
  • Provides meal monitoring and support.

    • De-escalation and crisis management
    • Bathroom monitoring
    • Monitoring outside breaks
    • Conducts self-harm and suicide assessment
    • Support morning routine in IP/Res programs
    • Collect weights, vitals and urine in some settings
  • Implements individual behavior management plans for some patients and serves as clinical lead for the program in standalone programs in evenings and weekends. Will lead more advanced groups.
  • Coverage for Primary Therapists with support from Clinical Manager or Clinical Director

Must haves:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mental health or related degree program (required)
  • Master’s degree in mental health or related degree program (required)
  • Intern or associate license from appropriate state licensing board (required)
  • Minimum 18 months of experience in a behavioral health or related field (requirement waived with relevant master's degree)

Bonus qualities:

  • 1+ year facilitating groups (preferred)

What We Offer

At ERC Pathlight, caring for people is our mission and that begins with caring for our own team. Your well-being matters, and our benefit program is designed to support every part of your life.

We offer competitive compensation; comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; generous Paid Time Off; Parental Leave benefits; Retirement benefits; and tuition reimbursement to help you continue growing in your career.

We also recognize that mental health is part of every person’s experience. That’s why we strive to create a workplace where you feel supported, seen, and encouraged—personally, professionally, and at home.

When you thrive, you can do your best work. And your best work changes lives.

title: TPL Claims Representative
description:
Elevate Patient Financial Solutions is seeking detail-oriented and proactive professionals to join our team as a Third Party Liability (TPL) Representative. This full-time opportunity offers a consistent schedule of Monday-Friday 8AM-5PM CST (remote). If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and growing your career in a purpose-driven environment, this is your opportunity to shine!
TPL Representatives are healthcare heroes in a different way - by resolving TPL claims for patients and the hospitals who care for them
In this role, you will be responsible to responsible for investigating, facilitating, and coordinating benefits for accident claims from auto, home, or other liability insurance policies.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Resolve accounts as quickly and accurately as possible, obtaining maximum reimbursement.
  • Review and research accident claims to investigate possible leads.
  • Bill no-fault and third-party liability carriers when appropriate.
  • Request documentation from insurance representatives when no no-fault insurance exists.
  • Review and research insurance claims to determine possible payment sources.
  • Contact various sources including insurance professionals, patients, and other parties to verify relevant data.
  • Coordinate with payors to ensure appropriate filing guidelines are met for reimbursement.
  • Request appropriate information, both verbally and written, from appropriate parties to ensure proper claim disposition.
  • Maintain and update payors on denied claims.
  • Ensure that appropriate billing guidelines and standards are met based on payor and/or state.
  • Make written or verbal appeals to payers on denied claims.
  • Obtain claim status and gathering supporting documentation to submit appeals.
  • Evaluate liability cases according to a multitude of factors, including accident type, patient involvement, patient degree of fault, and available insurance coverage.
  • Make accurate determination of the correct course of action to resolve liability cases based on the above data.
  • Pursue first party payers for reimbursement of hospital claims.
  • Assess state No-Fault laws to determine the availability and extent of first party coverage, and inform uncooperative patients about the proper coordination of available insurance benefits.
  • Appeal underpayments made for any reason other than exhaustion of benefits.
  • Resolve bodily injury liability claims by asserting and enforcing liens against the liable insurance company.
  • Ensure timely and equitable disbursement of settlement funds.
  • Regular and timely attendance.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Qualifications and Requirements
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities.
  • High School Diploma or GED is preferred except where required by the client
  • 1-2 years working knowledge of computer functions including the internet and computer software such as Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn in-house computer applications.
  • 1-3 years of related experience in the field or in a related area
  • Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing
  • Thorough knowledge of the third-party claims adjudication process
  • Thorough knowledge of state lien statutes, CMS secondary payer rules, and state No-Fault laws
  • Remote and Hybrid positions require a home internet connection that meets the company’s upload and download speed criteria.
Benefits:
ElevatePFS believes in making a positive impact not only within our industry but also with our employees –the organization’s greatest asset! We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that contribute to the present and future well-being of our employees and their families.
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401K (100% match for the first 3% & 50% match for the next 2%)
  • 15 days of PTO
  • 7 paid Holidays
  • 2 Floating holidays
  • 1 Elevate Day (floating holiday)
  • Pet Insurance
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Teamwork: We believe in teamwork and having fun together
  • Career Growth: Gain great experience to promote to higher roles
The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage.
The job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and Employee and is subject to change by the employer as the needs of the employer and requirements of the job change.

title: Founding Recruiting Coordinator
description:
Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy. With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America. There are now companies operating entirely AI-first on Netic.

You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.

About the role

Netic is growing fast, and our hiring engine needs to grow just as fast. We're looking for a Founding Recruiting Coordinator who can turn a chaotic hiring process into a well-oiled machine — someone with the cognitive horsepower to hold a hundred moving pieces in their head, the attention to detail to never drop one, and the instincts to make every candidate feel like they matter. You'll sit close to the founders and the People team, own the operational backbone of how we hire, and build the exact muscle — speed, precision, judgment under pressure — that defines great operators at the best AI companies coming out of Silicon Valley. If you are a recent grad who wants a launching pad into a career in startup operations, this is the seat for you.

What you'll do

  • Own the logistics of hiring end-to-end: scheduling interviews, coordinating with candidates and interviewers, and keeping every req moving without anyone dropping the ball.

What you'll bring

  • Obsessive attention to detail. A dropped email, a double-booked interview, a wrong offer date — none of that happens on your watch.

  • Real customer service instincts. You treat every candidate like they're the most important person in the pipeline, because to us, they are.

  • Ambition beyond the role. You see this as step one of a career in operations, and you want to build that career at one of the best AI companies to come out of Silicon Valley.

title: Resident Site Performance Management (Global Equipment Engineering & Project Management Lead)
description:
Job Description

Are you ready to lead the end-to-end lifecycle of cutting-edge manufacturing equipment and shape the future of automation across global production sites?

Bring your equipment engineering expertise and project leadership to the LEGO Group, driving custom automation solutions from initial concept and FAT/SAT validation to seamless deployment at our manufacturing sites.

Note: No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

Core Responsibilities

1. Equipment Engineering & Development

  • Contribute to the development of manufacturing equipment and automation solutions to support new products and process improvements.

  • Define equipment requirements, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria based on production and quality needs.

  • Drive equipment design reviews and risk assessments to ensure robust and reliable solutions.

  • Collaborate with equipment suppliers and internal stakeholders to develop cost-effective and scalable equipment.

  • Ensure compliance with safety, ergonomics, corporate standards, and regulatory requirements.

2. Project Management

  • Drive equipment development projects from concept through production release.

  • Develop project plans, schedules, budgets, resource requirements, and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Coordinate activities across engineering, manufacturing, quality, procurement, and supplier teams.

  • Track project milestones and deliverables while ensuring timely escalation of risks and issues.

  • Provide clear communication and regular status updates to stakeholders and management.

3. Equipment Release & Deployment

  • Establish and manage equipment release processes to ensure readiness for manufacturing deployment.

  • Lead equipment qualification, validation, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and production buy-off activities.

  • Ensure all required documentation, operating procedures, maintenance plans, and training materials are completed prior to release.

  • Coordinate deployment activities across sites and ensure smooth manufacturing integration and stakeholder readiness prior to production ramp-up.

4. Equipment Performance Monitoring

  • Define equipment performance metrics, dashboards, and monitoring methodologies.

  • Monitor and analyze equipment effectiveness using KPIs including Yield, Throughput, MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures), MTTR (Mean Time To Repair), and Cost of Ownership.

  • Analyze performance data to identify opportunities for reliability and productivity improvements.

  • Drive corrective and preventive actions to improve equipment uptime and process stability.

5. Continuous Improvement & NPI

  • Lead and carry out process and equipment development to build and qualify new elements in collaboration with NPI and R&D teams.

  • Participate in structured continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and problem-solving methodologies.

  • Conduct root cause analysis for equipment failures and performance gaps.

  • Identify and implement productivity, quality, reliability, and cost reduction improvements while establishing best practices for future projects.

  • Support capacity expansion and manufacturing optimization initiatives.

6. Standardization & Governance

  • Develop and maintain global equipment engineering standards and design guidelines.

  • Drive standardization of equipment architecture, automation platforms, controls and software, safety systems, documentation formats, and validation methodologies.

  • Ensure consistency and reuse of proven equipment designs across projects and sites while maintaining engineering governance processes.

7. Change Management

  • Lead equipment-related change management activities throughout the equipment lifecycle.

  • Establish structured assessment and approval processes for equipment modifications.

  • Evaluate impacts of equipment changes on product quality, manufacturing operations, safety, maintenance, supply chain, and regulatory compliance.

  • Coordinate stakeholder reviews and approvals before implementation, ensuring all changes are properly documented, validated, and deployed.

Play Your Part in Our Team Succeeding

The Equipment Engineering & Project Management Lead contributes to the end-to-end lifecycle of manufacturing equipment—from concept development and project execution through equipment release, deployment, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement. This hybrid role combines technical equipment engineering expertise with project leadership capabilities to ensure equipment solutions meet business, operational, quality, safety, and productivity requirements. The role serves as a key link between Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Equipment Suppliers, ensuring equipment is developed, standardized, deployed, and sustained effectively across manufacturing sites.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in equipment engineering, manufacturing engineering, automation, or production systems.

  • Project Management: Demonstrated experience managing complex equipment development projects.

  • Technical Breadth: Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and industrial automation systems.

  • Release Execution: Direct experience with equipment qualification, validation, FAT/SAT, and production release.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.

  • Certifications & Methodologies: Formal project management experience and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification.

  • Industry Focus: Background in semiconductor, electronics, medical device, automotive, or high-volume manufacturing industries.

  • Advanced Tech: Working knowledge of Industry 4.0, Industrial IoT (IIoT), and data analytics solutions.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect:

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

description:

Job Description

About Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Service – EFNEP

The Expanded Food and Nutrition Education Program (EFNEP) is a flagship initiative of Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Service, funded by USDA’s National Institute of Food and Agriculture (NIFA) since 1969. EFNEP serves young families and youth with limited resources across Texas—those most at risk for hunger, food insecurity, and lacking access to community support systems. Through locally delivered, evidence-based nutrition education, EFNEP empowers families and youth to make lasting improvements in diet quality, healthy habits, and overall well-being.

EFNEP classes are taught by paraprofessional educators, many of whom are bilingual, ensuring culturally relevant, accessible instruction both in person and virtually. Adult and youth programs utilize research- and practice-tested curricula, available in English and Spanish. Adult education focuses on nutrition, physical activity, food resource management, food safety, and food security, while youth education covers MyPlate, food groups, food safety, and physical activity, all aligned with Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills (TEKS) standards.

EFNEP collaborates with schools, faith-based organizations, housing authorities, shelters, parenting programs, and a variety of local agencies to identify and reach families in need. By partnering with these organizations, EFNEP is able to build strong, lasting community relationships and deliver impactful education where it is needed most. With data showing that 21% of Texas families with children under 18 live below the poverty level, EFNEP’s mission is vital to communities across the state.

EFNEP is delivered through county extension offices located in ten urban communities: Bexar, Cameron, Dallas, El Paso, Fort Bend, Harris, Hidalgo, Nueces, Tarrant, and Travis Counties.

Working for EFNEP means joining a dedicated team committed to improving health outcomes for Texas families and youth. Staff members receive training, resources, and support to help empower participants with practical skills for healthier living. If you are passionate about nutrition education, community outreach, and creating meaningful change, consider becoming part of Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Service’s EFNEP team.

Position Information

This position works in the Expanded Food and Nutrition Education Program known as EFNEP. The Nutrition Education Associate, with training and supervision, teaches (in-person and/or virtually) about nutrition, food resource management, food safety, and physical activity in culturally sensitive and appropriate ways for adults and/or youth, for low-income audiences in various community locations.

This position is funded by a Federal grant and is therefore contingent upon availability of funds.

Note to Candidates: This position will start on or after October 19, 2026.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

The following are the functions essential to performing this job.

  • Recruits adults and/or youth who meet program guidelines.

  • Uses research-based, approved educational materials to instruct youth and/or adults either in-person and/or virtually.

  • Prepares food for recipes and instructs youth and/or adults through food demonstrations.

  • Collects and tracks program data.

  • Assists in mentoring and/or training Nutrition Education Assistants when needed.

Knowledge, Abilities, & Skills

  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.

  • Proficient computer skills – Microsoft Office programs – Word and Power Point; Excel, etc.

  • Working knowledge of Zoom and/or Microsoft Teams to conduct virtual lessons.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with adults and/or youth.

  • Ability to follow a curriculum including teaching and speaking publicly, strong communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently, be self-motivated and give attention to detail and maintain accurate records.

  • Ability to keep written logs of activities, complete reports, and organize materials.

  • Familiar with the community where the position is located.

Education & Experience

  • High School diploma or GED, additional education is not considered an advantage.

  • Six months of related experience working with youth and/or adult audiences.

  • Experience with low resource audiences and working cooperatively with support systems, networks, and agency programs available for low-income people/low resource audience.

  • Knowledge or teaching experience related to nutrition, food safety, food resource management and physical activity topics, guidelines, and best practices.

  • Experience teaching groups of people.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Must be willing to work necessary hours to fulfill job responsibilities (some evenings and weekends). Hours worked will not exceed 40 per week.

  • This position will require daily travel to multiple work sites in county. Must be willing to travel to required trainings outside of county.

  • Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Service – EFNEP does not provide transportation and the position requires access to reliable transportation. The agency will follow applicable policies if personal vehicle is used, which may include reimbursement at a pre-established rate.

  • Must be able to lift, carry, and/or otherwise move instructional materials weighing up to 40 lbs from vehicle to work site and from work site to vehicle.

Preferred Registrations, Certifications, and Licenses:

  • Valid driver’s license.

  • Current liability insurance.

What You Need to Know

Salary: $18.71/hour

Position Funding: This position is grant funded and availability is contingent on grant funding.

Why Work at Texas A&M AgriLife?

When you choose to work for Texas A&M AgriLife, you become part of an organization that is an established leader in agriculture and life sciences with a wide range of capabilities to meet the needs of our statewide, national, and international constituents.

In addition, Texas A&M AgriLife offers a comprehensive benefit package including the following:

  • Health, dental, vision, life and long-term disability insurance with Texas A&M AgriLife contributing to employee health and basic life premiums

  • 12-15 days of annual paid holidays

  • Up to eight hours of paid sick leave and at least eight hours of paid vacation each month

  • Automatic enrollment in the Teacher Retirement System of Texas

  • Employee Wellness Initiative for Texas A&M AgriLife

Applicant Instructions

Failure to provide all job application data or a complete resume could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. We encourage all applicants to upload a resume or use a LinkedIn profile to prepopulate the online application.

All positions are security-sensitive. title: Robotics Operations Engineer
description:
Role Outline

A truly unique opportunity to join a high profile humanoid robotics company working on next level human interaction.

Our robots are known worldwide and are regularly featured in the media, both traditional and social. We regularly attend trade shows to show off our tech, or offer rentals for 3rd party exhibitions, shows, ceremonies and more, many times in attractive global destinations such as Las Vegas and Dubai. Setting up robots and being on hand to ensure a consistently wow experience is key to our customers' success for these events. Customers who have purchased our robots need help before delivery, for installation and post-install training and support.

In this role you will become a subject expert on our Ameca and Mesmer humanoid robots. This will allow you to ensure customers are ready for a robot and help them ensure their robot is functioning well for its entire lifetime. You’ll intuitively understand the robots inside and out, gaining the ability to rapidly diagnose the root causes of issues which may occur during operation.

You’ll also be the proud parent of our in-house fleet of robots. Ensuring they are up to scratch, maintaining and upgrading where required and making sure they are in tip top condition for live or virtual demonstration and ready to be sent off to another of their high profile engagements.

Our internal motto is ‘Be Wow’, our robots are certainly wow but so are our team members, including you.


Main Responsibilities

Installation and/or robot rental engagements

  • Liaising with customers on requirements of the venue (such as power and network connectivity requirements)
  • Executing final check and robot packing prior to shipping, as well as return checks and maintenance
  • Travel to customer premises or rental venue for set up and installation
  • For sales, training customer stakeholders on safe usage and maintenance of robots (either at customer premises or at an EA office)
  • For rentals, being on-site to ensure robots look and work their best for the duration of the rental, then de-install, pack and ensure safe pick-up for onward shipping

Fleet operations

  • Be first point of contact on our digital helpdesk, answering customer queries and issues
  • Work with and reassure customers that we are here to help and uphold our target of high quality support
  • Own helpdesk tickets, seeking additional information from other team members and organising spare parts with the production team
  • Connect to customer robots remotely to diagnose any issues and help with remedies
  • Organise any spares which require shipping to customer and ensure there are adequate instructions for customer fixes
  • For larger issues which needs an on-site presence, organise hardware requirements and travel to customer to fix issues

Trade-shows and event execution

  • Travel to desirable worldwide destinations for trade shows we exhibit at
  • Be an EA ambassador, talking with visitors to our trade stands
  • Ensure booth services are ready before robot despatch, set up exhibit, ensure smooth operation and safe packing for return journey

EA Robot well-being

  • Own and care for the EA owned robots, make sure they are always in top condition for developers to use and when potential customers visit the office to view the tech, or are ready to be shipped off to an event at a moments notice


Challenges

  • Identifying root causes of issues from customer feedback, information and remote diagnostics, using knowledge of the robot systems personally, and from the rest of the team
    • You should be passionate about treating the cause, not the symptoms
  • Managing time between travel and office-based activities
  • Learning enough about the mechanics, electronics and software systems and keeping on top of constantly evolving developments to allow diagnosis of issues
  • Be one of the first post of call for all EA employees as well as our customers when robots don't behave as expected
  • Ensure in-house robots behave as expected as much as possible and always ready to receive potential customer visits
  • You will go through an initial training and assessment phase


Qualifications, Knowledge, Key Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Experience in customer facing roles
  • Electronics essentials, understanding how to diagnose issues with standard tools such as multimeter and oscilloscopes
  • Mechanical assembly experience, professional or hobby
  • Full UK driving licence
  • Ability to travel to most global destinations without visa application requirements (ie eligible for visa waiver programmes, visa on arrival or no visa required. Especially travel to Europe, USA and UAE)
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, and the ability to take on new information from a variety of sources

Desirable

  • Experience exhibiting at trade shows
  • Experience in supporting complex mechanical devices or machine tools
  • Computer networking knowledge and troubleshooting
  • Python scripting experience

Useful

  • Robotics knowledge, experience and interest in humanoid robots
  • Fluency in multiple languages
