title: Communications Lead
description:
Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.

We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.

Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Communications Lead to define how Orbital Industries is understood in the market - and to build the communications motion that makes that understanding stick.

This is a category-creation brief. You'll articulate what the AI Industrial is, why CurieOS matters, and how Orbital Industries' full-lifecycle approach (materials, engineering, hardware) represents something genuinely new. You'll translate deep technical work - across AI, materials science, and hardware engineering - into clear, distinctive, high-quality communication that builds authority with investors, technical buyers, talent, and the broader market.

Your job is to set the strategic direction: brand voice, messaging frameworks, content strategy, and open doors for media.

Key Responsibilities

Communications Strategy and Brand Voice

  • Define and own Orbital Industries' external communications strategy — how we are positioned, perceived, and understood in the market

  • Build and enforce consistency in brand voice across all external channels: website, social, events, collateral, press

  • Set the messaging framework for CurieOS and its three pillars (Materials, Deployment, Hardware), ensuring our full-lifecycle positioning is sharp and differentiated

  • Write strong creative and messaging briefs for design, video, and campaign work — giving the GTM team clear strategic direction to execute against

  • Ensure a clean separation between Orbital Industries (brand authority, category definition) and Orbital IT (commercial, customer-facing) in how we communicate externally

Stakeholder messaging

  • Work closely with the CFO and founders to ensure investor messaging reflects Orbital Industries' positioning as the AI Industrial category leader, not just a product company

  • Translate technical milestones (CurieOS releases, customer deployments, materials breakthroughs) into compelling narratives

Content and copy

  • Own long-form writing, thought leadership, website messaging, investor content, and campaign assets - from strategy through to production

  • Produce content that makes Orbital Industries' work in AI, materials science and hardware engineering accessible without losing credibility or nuance — you know the difference between simplifying and dumbing down

  • Develop and maintain CurieOS content across its three pillars: materials discovery, deployment engineering, and hardware product development

  • Use LLMs and modern tools to work efficiently while maintaining high editorial standards

Social Media Strategy

  • Own organic social strategy: voice, editorial calendar, content direction and output quality

  • Build Orbital Industries' social presence into a distinctive point of view, not just a broadcast channel — the GTM team handles day-to-day posting and scheduling

  • Track developments across AI infrastructure and adjacent industries to keep content timely and credible

  • Partner with the GTM Lead to align organic and paid social messaging

Website messaging

  • Own website copy and landing-page messaging, ensuring it is sharp, current and aligned to business priorities

  • Work closely with the GTM team on copy for campaign landing pages — you own the message, they own the conversion optimisation and testing cycle

Press and Media

  • Develop Orbital Industries' press function - strengthening media relationships, identifying opportunities, and positioning the company for coverage that reinforces our authority in the AI Industrial category

  • Amplify founder positioning for external audiences, interviews, speaking engagements and media appearances

  • Manage freelance press support and scale the function as the company grows

What We're Looking For

  • Significant leadership experience in communications, content, editorial or brand storytelling — ideally in a technical, deep-tech or science-adjacent environment. Experience with investor communications or fundraising narratives is a strong plus

  • An excellent writer with strong editorial taste and clear judgement; your portfolio should demonstrate range across long-form, short-form and messaging work

  • Deep curiosity about AI, science, engineering or technical products — you follow these spaces because you're genuinely interested, not because it's your job

  • The ability to make technical ideas accessible without losing credibility or nuance

  • Comfortable owning both strategy and execution — you can set the direction, produce the work, and build the systems that maintain quality without you touching every piece

  • Experience building or significantly expanding a communications function — you should find creating something from scratch exciting, not uncomfortable

  • High standards for writing, messaging, and brand consistency — you notice when things drift and you fix them before they compound

  • Strong collaborative instincts — you'll work closely with technical founders, engineers, a GTM Lead, a design function. You need to influence without owning every channel

  • Experience briefing and managing creative work: design, video, freelance writers, press agencies

  • Science degree or background is preferred

Why Join Orbital Industries?

  • Competitive salary and equity package - the ability to own part of Orbital Industries as we grow

  • Flexible and generous paid time off

  • Excellent health, dental and vision insurance plan

  • Regular company offsites to the USA and beyond

  • The chance to define the narrative for a new category — the AI Industrial — at a company where communications is a strategic function, not a support one

Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Teamchef 2:a färskvaror dagsfärskt, Willys Kungälv Komarken
description:
På Willys jobbar vi varje dag för att kunna leverera Sveriges billigaste matkasse, så att fler kan äta bra mat varje dag. Ett jobb på Willys är helt enkelt ett jobb som gör gott och som känns bra i magen för fler. Välkommen till Willys. Hos oss behövs alla.

Vi söker dig som gillar mat, människor och försäljning och vill bli en del av vårt härliga gäng på Willys Kungälv Komarken! Tjänsten innebär kort och gott att du bidrar till att våra kunder kan handla bra och hållbar mat till riktigt bra priser, samtidigt som du förbereds att ta klivet till att bli en ledare på Willys.

Tjänsten avser: Tillsvidareanställning, heltid. Provanställning tillämpas.

Tillträde: 2026-10-01 eller enligt överenskommelse.

Arbetstider: Du kommer att variera mellan att arbeta tidig morgon, dagtid, kvällar och helger.

Krav: Gymnasial utbildning, goda kunskaper i svenska (tal och skrift). Vi välkomnar sökande i alla åldrar, men med hänvisning till Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter AFS 2023:2 kapitel 8 och bilaga 2, anställer vi inte personer under 18 år beroende på arbetsuppgifternas art.

Här kommer lite mer om tjänsten:

  • Du är en lagspelare med mer ansvar än andra i ditt team, men utan att ha teamchefens fulla personalansvar.
  • Tillsammans med din teamchef leder och planerar du verksamheten i ert team. Självklart tar du aktivt del i det dagliga operativa butiksarbetet.
  • Du lär dig de kunskaper och färdigheter som krävs för att så småningom axla en roll som teamchef. Det här är en språngbräda för att ta dig vidare i din Willys-karriär med målet att bli en framtida teamchef eller kanske så småningom butikschef?
  • Du arbetar målinriktat för att utveckla butikens försäljning, lönsamhet och övriga viktiga nyckeltal.
  • Du ingår i arbetsledningen i butiken och har teamchefens arbetsbeskrivning på din utvecklingsplan. Du praktiserar de färdigheter som du har lärt dig i arbetet och genom utbildningar.
  • Du är en förebild i arbetet med att möta våra kunder med kunskap, fingertoppskänsla och ett stort leende.


Om oss

För oss är rätt inställning och vilja att utvecklas viktigare än erfarenhet och utbildning. Vi jobbar tillsammans som ett lag, då vi ser att ett riktigt bra samarbete ger det bästa resultatet – samtidigt som vi har kul på jobbet. Lite mer om oss kommer här:

  • Vi arbetar med konceptstyrning och kedjedrift – det finns tydliga rutiner och strukturer på plats, vilket frigör tid för dig att fokusera på att utveckla dig mot att bli teamchef och bistå din teamchef med att arbetsleda teamet.
  • Willys är ett av branschens mest framgångsrika företag och vi fortsätter att växa. Och eftersom vi växer, kan du också göra det. Som ett stort företag finns många möjligheter att utvecklas i din ledarroll hos oss, bland annat genom en rad olika utbildningar.
  • Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss här.


Om dig

Du gillar mat, människor och försäljning lika mycket som vi! Willys växer och utvecklas hela tiden, och det gillar du också att göra. Du vill gärna lära dig nya saker, tycker om att utmanas och drivs av att ta ett större ansvar. Det är också toppen om:

  • Du är junior i ditt ledarskap och behöver inte ha erfarenhet från en ledarroll, men ser dig som en framtida ledare och drivs av att leda andra. Alternativt har du redan erfarenheten, men inte inom dagligvaruhandeln.
  • Du är bra på att kommunicera, tycker om att engagera dina kollegor och är bra på att skapa ett positivt arbetsklimat.
  • Du gillar människor, sätter kundens behov först och är bra på att få med dig folk – såväl kunder som medarbetare.


Om du vill veta mer om vad tjänsten innebär, kontakta Mirsada Garaj, mirsada.garaj@willys.se. Vi ser gärna att du vid intresse skickar din ansökan så snart som möjligt, då tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag den 2026-09-22. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via våra jobbsidor.

För att ta reda på om just du är den vi söker så innehåller vår rekryteringsprocess både tester och intervjuer.

Vi kontrollerar ID och gör bakgrundskontroller vid samtliga rekryteringar. Läs mer: Så går det till när du söker jobb inom Axfood

Observera att vi inte under denna rekryteringsprocess kommer be dig logga in med ditt Bank-id eller scanna någon QR-kod. Vid frågor kontakta Medarbetarsupporten via kontaktformulär.

title: STNA  Marion Valley NIGHTS
description:
General Purpose
The primary purpose of your job position is to provide each of your assigned residents with routine daily nursing care and services in accordance with the resident’s assessment and care plan, and as may be directed by
your supervisors.

Essential Duties
• Use the wristband or photo card file to identify residents before administering treatments, serving meals, etc., as necessary.
• Use only authorized abbreviations established by this facility when recording information.
• Report all changes in the resident’s condition to the Nurse Supervisor/Charge Nurse as soon as practical.
• Record all entries on flow sheets, notes, charts, etc., in an informative, descriptive manner.
• Report all accidents and incidents you observe on the shift that they occur.
• Agree not to disclose resident’s protected health information and promptly report suspected or known violations of such disclosure to the Administrator.
• Report any known or suspected unauthorized attempt to access facility’s information system.
• Perform only those nursing care procedures that you have been trained to do.
• Ensure that the resident’s room is ready for receiving the resident (i.e., bed made, name tags up, admission kit available, etc.).
• Greet residents and escort them to their room.
• Introduce resident to his/her roommate, if any, and other residents and personnel as appropriate.
• Make resident comfortable.
• Inventory and mark the resident’s personal possessions as instructed.
• Store resident’s clothing.
• Assist residents with packing their personal possessions when they are being transferred to a new room, or when being discharged.
• Transport residents to new rooms or to the receiving area.
• Assist with loading/unloading residents’ to/from vehicles as necessary.
• Create and maintain an atmosphere of warmth, personal interest and positive emphasis, as well as a calm environment throughout the unit and shift.
• Meet with your shift’s nursing personnel, on a regularly scheduled basis, to assist in identifying and correcting problem areas, and/or the improvement of services.
• Report all complaints and grievances made by the resident.
• Participate in and receive the nursing report as instructed.
• Follow established policies concerning exposure to blood/body fluids.
• Make beds as instructed.
• Put extra covers on beds as requested.
• Measure and record temperatures, pulses, and respirations (TPRs) of residents, as instructed. Weigh and measure residents as instructed.
• Ensure that residents who are unable to call for help are checked frequently.
• Answer resident calls promptly.
• Check residents routinely to ensure that their personal care needs are being met.
• Assist residents with identifying food arrangements (i.e., informing resident with sight problem of foods that are on his/her tray, where it is located, if it is hot/cold, etc.).
• Record the resident’s food/fluid intake. Report changes in the resident’s eating habits to the Nurse Supervisor/Charge Nurse.
• Keep residents’ water pitchers clean and filled with fresh water (on each shift), and within easy reach of the resident.
• Perform after meal care (i.e., remove trays, clean resident’s hands, face, clothing, etc.).
• Participate in and receive the nursing report upon reporting for duty.
• Perform all assigned tasks in accordance with our established policies and procedures, and as instructed by your supervisors.
• Follow work assignments, and/or work schedules in completing and performing your assigned tasks.
• Cooperate with inter-departmental personnel, as well as other facility personnel to ensure that nursing services can be adequately maintained to meet the needs of the residents.
• Notify the facility when you will be late or absent from work.
• Report occupational exposures to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, and hazardous chemicals in accordance with the facility’s policies and procedures governing accidents and incidents.
• Assist residents with daily functions (dental and mouth care, bath functions, combing of hair, dressing and undressing as necessary).
• Keep residents dry (change gown, clothing and linens, when it becomes wet or soiled).
• Assist residents in preparing for medical tests (i.e., lab work, x-ray, therapy, dental, etc.).
• Assist with lifting, turning, moving, positioning, and transporting residents into and out of beds, chairs, bathtubs, wheelchairs, lifts, etc.
• Perform restorative and rehabilitative procedures as instructed.
• Assist in preparing the resident for a physical examination.
• Check each resident routinely to ensure that his/her personal care needs are being met in accordance with his/her wishes.
• Observe and report the presence of pressure areas and skin breakdowns to prevent decubitus ulcers (bedsores).
• Report injuries of an unknown source, including skin tears.
• Observe disoriented and comatose residents. Record and report data as instructed
• Perform special treatments as instructed.
• Immediately notify the Nurse Supervisor/Charge Nurse of any resident leaving/missing from the facility.
• Use only the equipment you have been trained to use.
• Report defective equipment to the Nurse Supervisor/Charge Nurse
• Maintain the confidentiality of all resident care information including protected health information. Report known or suspected incidents of unauthorized disclosure of such information.
• Report all allegations of resident abuse and/or misappropriation of resident property.
• Honor the resident’s refusal of treatment request. Report such requests to your supervisor.

Supervisory Requirements
This position has no supervisor responsibilities

Qualification
Education and/or Experience

Must possess, as a minimum, an 10th grade education

Language Skills

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.

Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.

Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers and employees.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios and proportions to practical situations.

Reasoning Ability

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.

Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

Must be a licensed Certified Nursing Assistant in accordance with laws of the state.
CPR Preferred

Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Prolonged use of a desktop or laptop computer. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand; walk and talk, read or hear. Frequent use of all office related equipment to include copier/scanner/fax, telephone, and calculator.
May be necessary to assist in the evacuation of residents during emergency situations.

Work Environment
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

Additional Information

Note: Nothing in this job specification restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Critical features of this job are described under various headings above. They may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons. The above statements are strictly intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as a complete list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of employees in this position.

title: DevOps Engineer eDV
description:

On behalf of a leading public sector digital transformation consultancy, Bulb Resourcing is seeking a skilled professional to drive automation, build infrastructure as code, and enable secure, scalable service delivery. Our client is a highly respected digital transformation consultancy dedicated to designing, building, and scaling secure public sector services across the UK. Role Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will play a central role in delivering secure, scalable, and highly available digital services. Pipeline Management: Design, build, and maintain deployment pipelines and automation using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins, ensuring alignment with national government digital standards.

Infrastructure as Code: Define and manage cloud environments using IaC (Terraform, Bicep, Ansible) to guarantee consistency, resilience, and scalability.

Agile Collaboration: Partner with developers, architects, and product leads to support continuous integration, secure builds, and frequent releases.

Process Automation: Embed end-to-end automation across build, test, deployment, and infrastructure management to maximize operational efficiency.

Best Practice Champion: Promote DevOps principles, conduct IaC reviews, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the broader delivery community.

System Support & Monitoring: Monitor and troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues to ensure high availability and performance, participating in second-line support and incident response where required.

CI/CD Pipelines: Proven expertise in designing and operating continuous integration and deployment pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

Cloud & IaC: Strong proficiency with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) alongside IaC tools like Terraform, Bicep, or Ansible.

Scripting & Programming: Solid hands-on coding or scripting ability in Python, Go, Bash, JavaScript, or PowerShell.

Containers & Architecture: Hands-on experience with containerisation and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes) within microservices architectures.

DevOps Methodology: Sound knowledge of version control (Git), automated testing, security-by-design, and collaborative Agile workflows.

Desirable Skills

Familiarity with monorepo tooling (NX, Turborepo) or modern PaaS platforms (Netlify, Vercel).

Demonstrated experience in mentoring team members and growing internal technical capability.

title: Superintendent I - Steel America (Job ID: 1489)
description:
Superintendent I - Commercial and Government Heavy Steel Fabrication
Purpose:
Steel America, a division of Colonna’s Shipyard, is seeking a seasoned Superintendent I with expertise in both commercial and government new heavy steel fabrication, along with the capability to manage shipboard repair projects effectively.
The Superintendent I – Commercial and Government Heavy Steel Fabrication will serve as a key leader in our shipyard operations, overseeing and managing new heavy steel fabrication projects for both commercial and government vessels. This role requires a comprehensive understanding of industry regulations, technical expertise in heavy steel fabrication processes, and exceptional project management skills to ensure the successful execution of projects on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. This position holds oversight of the project and all contractual deliverables and does not manage specific people or trade workers daily assignments.
The position is located onsite in Norfolk, VA and may require hours beyond a standard work week to support business operations, as needed. Position may require limited travel.
Job Description:
Key responsibilities include:
Project Management:
  • Lead and manage new heavy steel fabrication projects for both commercial and government clients, from planning through execution to completion.
  • Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and resource allocation strategies to ensure the efficient and effective delivery of project objectives.
  • Manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, subcontractors, and vendors to execute project activities in accordance with client requirements and industry standards.
  • Approve time charges and material expenditures, within their spending limit, unless they specifically delegate these duties to the assigned Supervisors.
  • Write/modify subcontract purchase orders. Verify subcontract purchase order values are kept current and that increases and decreases are processed quickly so that job cost can be determined.
Commercial and Government Contract Compliance:
  • Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, specifications, and regulatory requirements for both commercial and government new heavy steel fabrication projects.
  • Adhere to relevant regulations and guidelines, such as those from regulatory bodies and classification societies, to ensure adherence throughout project execution.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and records to demonstrate compliance and facilitate audits as required.
  • Compare labor expenditures against the spending plan and report any variation with explanation.
New Heavy Steel Fabrication Project Management:
  • Manage heavy steel fabrication projects, including planning and coordination of repairs, logistics, and safety protocols.
  • Coordinate with vessel owners, operators, and onboard personnel to schedule repairs, minimize downtime, and ensure minimal disruption to vessel operations.
  • Oversee the deployment of repair teams, equipment, and materials to the vessel site, ensuring timely and efficient completion of repairs.
  • Approve all requests for material and rental equipment within the spending limit.
  • Represent the company in discussions with the customer regarding schedule and support the contract group in developing support for “schedule impact” on change orders when warranted.
Quality Assurance and Safety Compliance:
  • Implement and enforce quality assurance measures to uphold the highest standards of workmanship and compliance with specifications.
  • Conduct regular inspections and audits to assess the quality of repairs and ensure adherence to safety protocols and regulatory standards.
  • Address any non-conformities or safety issues promptly, implementing corrective actions as necessary to mitigate risks and ensure the safety of personnel and vessels.
Qualifications:
  • Must have at least 8 years of experience in shipyard operations, with a focus on commercial and/or government new heavy steel fabrication projects.
  • Must have a proven track record of successfully managing complex new heavy steel fabrication projects, including shipboard repairs, within budget and schedule constraints.
  • Must have strong technical knowledge of heavy steel fabrication processes, industry regulations, and safety standards.
  • Must have excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Must have strong communication skills both written and oral with the ability to act as a spokesperson.
  • Must have experience with Microsoft applications such as Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point, and Project.
  • Must have experience in dry docks and vessel inspections.
Security Requirements:
  • Must be able to access government facilities and be DBIDS eligible.
  • Position requires you to obtain and maintain a DBIDS
  • Position requires US Citizenship.
Travel Requirements:
  • Minimal Travel; 10% or less.
Physical Requirements:
  • Must be able to lift, carry and transport heavy equipment and boxes. The exact weight requirements will be determined by the specific job, but no less than 20 lbs.
  • Must be physically agile to perform tasks in naval ships. Able to work on and climb ladders, work in extreme temperature environments, aboard ships, in shipyards, under industrial conditions and in confined spaces, including enter and moving through manholes.
  • May ride ships at sea for extended periods
  • Able to perform other duties as required which may involve high heat, humidity, noise and dirty conditions, working aloft or over the sides of vessels.
  • Frequent exposure to noise due to machinery and equipment.
  • Employee is required to operate trucks, forklifts & man-lifts.
  • While performing the duties of this job, you may frequently be required to stand, walk & sit; use hands or fingers; handle or feel; talk and hear. Occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, climb and balance, stoop, squat, kneel, twist and crawl.
  • Work in extreme temperatures and conditions. At times you will work in areas that have less adequate ventilation
  • Frequent use of respirator.
  • Protective clothing or equipment and face shields or goggles shall be worn when welding, cutting, or working with molten metal.
Respect, Pride, Truth, Family – These are our VALUES and the guidelines that make us a leader in our industry. We are pleased and confident in stating that our skilled employees are among the most respected experts in the ship repair industry.
Colonna’s Shipyard, Inc. is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Additionally, Colonna’s Shipyard provides a variety of benefits to support your best health, wellness, and future, to include medical/dental/vision options, company paid disability insurances, 401k with match, legal services, as well as company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).
Pay Range: $88,236 - $119,378
Determination of base salary considers various factors, including but not limited to scope of responsibility, candidate’s relative and specific experience, education level, key skills, as well as other business considerations. The company also provides a variety of benefits to support employees’ best health and wellness. Additionally, the company offers a 401k retirement program with match, paid holidays, and competitive paid time off (PTO)

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will help shape backend services at the heart of a large customer migration program. The assignment centers on a demanding flow where customer identification, stack determination, migration tracking, and application routing need to work together with high accuracy and low latency.

You will work in an environment where APIs, data flows, and migration logic must stay reliable while customers move between old and new application stacks. This role combines hands-on Java development with clear architectural influence, making it a strong opportunity if you enjoy solving complex backend challenges and guiding technical direction.

Job Description
  • You will design and build Java and Spring Boot REST APIs for customer identification, stack lookup, migration tracking, and routing.
  • You will create flexible identification mechanisms that can support additional identifiers as business and migration needs evolve.
  • You will develop batch processing for loading, updating, and maintaining customer migration and stack information.
  • You will enable frontend applications and UI flows with backend services for lookup, status visibility, and redirection.
  • You will design services that handle transitional migration states safely, including routing while migration is in progress.
  • You will ensure solutions are secure, scalable, observable, resilient, and built with strong validation, caching, logging, monitoring, and error handling.
  • You will create automated unit, integration, and API tests and contribute to CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments.
  • You will guide architectural decisions, evaluate trade-offs, and align services, integrations, and data flows with long-term technical goals.
  • You will collaborate closely with frontend developers, architects, DevOps engineers, product owners, and migration teams.
Requirements
  • Strong experience with Java 10+
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot and Spring Framework
  • Solid experience in REST API and microservice design
  • Experience with Spring Data JPA / Hibernate
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Experience with batch processing, preferably Spring Batch
  • Experience designing lookup and routing services
  • Experience with API security using OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect / JWT
  • Experience with unit and integration testing using JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, or equivalent
  • Experience with Maven or Gradle, Git, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Strong architectural knowledge and the ability to define target architecture, evaluate trade-offs, establish design principles, and guide the team in complex architectural matters
  • Experience with logging, monitoring, metrics, and distributed tracing
  • Fluent in Swedish and English
Nice to have
  • Experience with large-scale customer or platform migrations
  • Experience designing systems that support old and new application stacks simultaneously
  • Experience with customer identity or identifier mapping and resolution
  • Experience with migration-state management and rollback scenarios
  • Experience with event-driven architecture and messaging technologies such as Kafka
  • Experience with Redis or similar caching technologies
  • Experience with Azure or AWS cloud platforms
  • Experience with API gateways and traffic-routing solutions
  • Experience with high-volume batch data processing and reconciliation
What We Offer
  • Permanent employment at Avaron AB
  • Occupational pension
  • Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year
Application

Om Täby kommunTäby är en av Sveriges mest välskötta kommuner med stor valfrihet, välfärdstjänster av hög kvalitet, attraktivt näringslivsklimat och stabil ekonomi. Skolorna i kommunen uppvisar toppresultat, förskolorna erbjuder en trygg och stimulerande miljö och vid kommunens äldreboenden är nöjdheten stor. Läget är attraktivt med närhet till både Stockholm och Arlanda, samtidigt som tillgången till skog, hav och strövområden ger möjlighet till naturupplevelser och rekreation.Täby utvecklas med nya attraktiva och trygga miljöer och genom att befintliga områden vidareutvecklas – hållbart, med omsorg om kulturarv och där större sammanhängande grönområden värnas. Halva Täby ska vara grönt och hela Täby hållbart. Trafik och infrastruktur ska fungera i vardagen och utvecklas för framtiden.Inom utbildnings verksamhetsområde arbetar vi mot högt uppsatta verksamhetsmål och meritvärdena för Täbys kommunala grundskolor ligger i toppskiktet i landet. Täby akademi för pedagogisk professionsutveckling, i samarbete med nationella och internationella lärosäten såsom Harvard, bidrar till att kommunens pedagoger och skolledare tillhör spetsen i Sverige. Vi arbetar långsiktigt och systematiskt för att Täby ska ha Sveriges högsta utbildningskvalitet där lärandet är tillgängligt för varje elev.

title: Program Manager - Clinical Operations
description:
Sagility combines industry-leading technology and transformation-driven BPM services with decades of healthcare domain expertise to help clients draw closer to their members. The company optimizes the entire member/patient experience through service offerings for clinical, case management, member engagement, provider solutions, payment integrity, claims cost containment, and analytics. Sagility has more than 25,000 employees across 5 countries.

The Program Manager will partner closely with clinical leaders, physicians, nurses, care managers, operations teams, analytics teams, and client stakeholders to improve member outcomes, optimize healthcare utilization, and enhance operational efficiency.

Job title:

Program Manager - Clinical Operations

Job Description:

Position Summary

The Program Manager – Clinical Operations is responsible for leading strategic programs and operational initiatives supporting Care Management, Utilization Management, Care Coordination, Population Health, and Value-Based Care services. This role will drive program execution, operational excellence, quality improvement, and performance outcomes across clinical operations while ensuring alignment with organizational goals and client expectations.

The Program Manager will partner closely with clinical leaders, physicians, nurses, care managers, operations teams, analytics teams, and client stakeholders to improve member outcomes, optimize healthcare utilization, and enhance operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Execution

  • Lead end-to-end management of clinical operations programs, including planning, implementation, monitoring, and optimization.
  • Manage multiple workstreams supporting care management, utilization management, transitions of care, chronic disease management, and population health initiatives.
  • Establish program governance, project plans, milestones, and performance metrics.
  • Ensure timely delivery of strategic initiatives while meeting quality, operational, and financial objectives.

Clinical Operations Management

  • Collaborate with clinical leadership to improve care management workflows and operational processes.
  • Drive initiatives focused on reducing avoidable admissions, readmissions, emergency department utilization, and total cost of care.
  • Support implementation and enhancement of clinical programs targeting high-risk and complex populations.
  • Ensure operational readiness for new client implementations, program expansions, and process transformations.

Population Health & Value-Based Care

  • Support value-based care initiatives through performance monitoring and outcome improvement strategies.
  • Utilize healthcare analytics to identify care gaps, risk trends, utilization patterns, and intervention opportunities.
  • Partner with quality and clinical teams to improve HEDIS, STAR, and other quality performance measures.
  • Monitor key population health metrics and recommend improvement actions.

Stakeholder & Client Management

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration across clinical, operational, technology, quality, and analytics teams.
  • Present program performance, operational updates, risks, and recommendations to leadership and clients.
  • Build strong relationships with healthcare payer, provider, and care management stakeholders.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure adherence to NCQA, CMS, HIPAA, URAC, and client-specific requirements.
  • Support audit readiness and regulatory compliance activities.
  • Monitor operational quality metrics and implement corrective action plans when necessary.
  • Promote a culture of continuous quality improvement.

Performance Management & Analytics

  • Develop and monitor KPIs, operational dashboards, and program scorecards.
  • Analyze trends related to productivity, utilization, quality outcomes, and member engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for operational optimization through data-driven decision-making.
  • Provide executive-level reporting and actionable insights.

Risk & Change Management

  • Identify program risks, operational challenges, and process gaps.
  • Develop mitigation strategies and manage change initiatives across teams.
  • Ensure effective communication and stakeholder engagement throughout program implementation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in healthcare operations, care management, utilization management, population health, or clinical program management.
  • 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional programs or large-scale operational initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare payer and provider operations.
  • Experience working with clinical and operational performance metrics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree (MBA, MHA, MPH, MSN, or equivalent).
  • PMP, Lean Six Sigma, PMP, or Healthcare Quality certifications.
  • Experience with Value-Based Care, Risk Adjustment, Population Health Management, HEDIS, STAR Ratings, or Care Management programs.
  • Familiarity with EMR/EHR systems, care management platforms, and healthcare analytics tools.

Core Competencies

  • Program & Portfolio Management
  • Clinical Operations Leadership
  • Population Health Management
  • Utilization & Care Management
  • Value-Based Care Strategy
  • Healthcare Analytics & Reporting
  • Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
  • Stakeholder & Client Management
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Change Management
  • Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Program delivery within scope, timeline, and budget.
  • Improvement in care management and utilization outcomes.
  • Reduction in avoidable admissions and readmissions.
  • Enhanced quality measure performance (HEDIS, STAR, CMS metrics).
  • Client satisfaction and operational performance targets.
  • Operational efficiency and productivity improvements.
  • Compliance and audit readiness outcomes.

title: Owner's Representative - FAY
description:
Your Mandate

Maintaining consistent and impeccable quality nationwide as we scale is of vital importance to our mission. You’ll be the face of AA, representing our values and commitment to residents and the community. We’re looking for skilled, reliable, and proactive individuals who take pride in their work, uphold high standards, and are ready to make a real impact on our residents' lives.

But being the Associate owner’s Representative is more than Quality Control and Maintenance. To the team in the field, you are the owner - you don’t just hold them accountable, you help them win. You do this by representing and instilling SFR3/American Avenue's pride of ownership in the field by collaborating and fostering a team mentality. You’re a player and a coach; you set the bar high, and help the team meet it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Perform general maintenance and repairs, including Carpentry, HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical work.
    • High preference for advanced skillsets/certifications in HVAC and Plumbing
  • Travel from home to home within your metro daily
  • Conduct property inspections, secure homes, and complete vacancy/wellness checks.
  • Handle minor pre-renovation repairs, utility inspections, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Manage move-in/out meetings and property turnovers.
    • Ability to "Turn" homes (repairing/light renovation to home from one tenant to the next) a must
  • Maintain and document property conditions using handheld technology (e.g., iPad, iPhone).
  • Supervising ongoing work. You’ll spot check dozens of concurrent projects, acting as eyes and ears for our headquarters. You’ll walk homes every day to ensure SFR3 standards are being met and expectations are understood. Is the paint correct? Did the electrician install covers on junction boxes? Is that the specified light fixture? Walking jobs, making lists, mentoring and coaching the renovation managers to always be improving.
  • Certification and signoff. You will walk every home in Renovation, and be the gate-keeper - you need to know SFR3’s expectations like the back of your hand. Without your approval, an SFR3 home is not considered complete. Other people’s bonuses depend on your judgement, as does the success of SFR3. You’ll need to be supportive but fair - holding the line while helping people meet it.
  • Coaching and motivating. In this role you represent the owner, and one of the most important things an owner can do is motivate the team. Make sure your Teammates understand the “WHY” and help them develop pride in a job well done. You must build SFR3 pride into every home
  • Leverage your physical presence to be the eyes and ears of the fund. Be extremely organized, knowing how each piece of the puzzle fits together to finish in time. Spot the difference between high-quality work and a workaround that will fail in 90 day
  • Estimating and scoping - with pinpoint accuracy

Sample performance metrics

  • Budget adherence in your market. We must Estimate, Scope, and Ultimately Complete every renovation on budget.
  • Sale/appraisal value, monthly rent achieved, and move-in experience. The ultimate measures of quality.
  • Volume. You enable your team to handle more projects at once.

You’ll need

  • More than anything, an ownership mindset to all parts of the job; proactive, self-directed, and highly-motivated. You have a bias toward action.
  • At least 5-10 years of renovation/construction experience, with knowledge of plumbing, electrical, and HVAC systems, and strong working knowledge of local and national building/property management codes. Real estate or home inspection experience a plus.

title: Product Deployment Engineer
description:
As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.

You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.

The Product Deployment Engineering Team for Measurement Services, gTech Ads GCS, provides exceptional complex measurement implementation for Google’s top GCS advertising clients. This team serves as the critical bridge between GCS customer business requirements and gTech Ads’ service and engineering offerings.

The core objective of the team is to unlock data foundations, specifically driving the adoption of complex Google data strength products (e.g., ECL, GTG). Team members collaborate with high growth customers on non-standard, complex environments to unlock business growth and defend business. To achieve this, PDEs conduct comprehensive audits and deep-dive sessions to diagnose technical environments, identify customer pain points, and enable product adoption.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

  • Partner with sales and product leads, evaluate client technical maturity and first-party data strategies to guide scalable solution adoption.
  • Uncover custom technical opportunities while funneling critical product gaps and edge cases back to core Ads engineering.
  • Translate client needs into clear system architectures, author prototype-grounded requirement documents and standardized deployment playbooks.
  • Design durable, privacy-compliant data pipelines—including Google Ads API integrations—and enforce validation frameworks using real-world data subsets.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional efforts across gTech and client teams to oversee smooth implementation and successful last-mile activation.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
  • Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C++, Python).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
  • 8 years of experience managing projects and working with analytics, software coding, or customer-side web technologies.
  • Practical experience configuring, querying, or troubleshooting CRM architectures (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, or custom internal backends).
  • Ability to absorb complex technical concepts and communicate them to a non-technical audience effectively.
  • Ability to work independently and to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with effective problem-solving, analytical and project management skills.
  • Demonstrated coding ability with Java or Python, and database knowledge with the ability to construct complex SQL queries.

The Opportunity

The Assistant Director of Health Services, in alignment with the mission, vision, and strategic priorities of Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University (ERAU) and the Division of Student Affairs, provides high-quality, student-centered customer service that support student well-being and success within the Department of Health services.

The Assistant Director will coordinate closely with Student Affairs, Risk Management, Campus Safety, Health Services, and local emergency response partners to support effective emergency response and continuity of care.

The Assistant Director is also responsible for the development, implementation, and assessment of a comprehensive health promotion and outreach program through Health Services. This includes supervision of the Nutritionist, developing proactive educational initiatives, programs, and partnerships designed to increase student awareness of health and wellness resources, encourage healthy behaviors, and address emerging student health needs.

The Assistant Director serves on-call for the Student Medical Response Team (SMRT) and provides leadership and support for emergency response operations as needed.

For over 100 years, Embry-Riddle has been the world's leading aviation and aerospace university, educating more than 30,000 students across residential campuses in Daytona Beach, Florida, and Prescott, Arizona, as well as through a global network of Worldwide locations and online programs. With more than 165,000 alumni around the world, our impact reaches every corner of the aerospace, aviation, defense and technology industries.

Today, our faculty, researchers and professional staff are advancing innovation across aviation, space, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, autonomous systems and next-generation engineering. Working alongside industry leaders, government agencies and innovators, they are solving real-world challenges and shaping the technologies that will define tomorrow.

Whether you are an educator, researcher, administrator, technologist or industry professional, your work at Embry-Riddle will contribute to something bigger than a job. Join a community driven by discovery, purpose and excellence—and help shape the future of aerospace.

title: Software Engineer
description:
UserGems is the AI Command Center for outbound and ABM. Think of us as the ‘brain’ behind your go-to-market. We capture account & contact data and buying signals to help companies know who to target, when, and why. Then, take the next actions via humans or AI agents to run personalized outbound and ABM at scale.

UserGems has generated billions in pipeline and revenue for hundreds of start-ups and public companies. Companies like Hubspot, Workday, Crowdstrike, Mimecast, UserTesting, SAP, Outreach see more than 15X ROI in closed-won revenue from UserGems.

Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (php/laravel, typescript/vue)

Build scalable systems that power AI-driven sales intelligence

UserGems is an AI platform helping sales and marketing teams double their pipeline impact with the same resources. Our AI agent, Gem-E, identifies who to target, when, and why - turning signals from CRMs, buying intent, and public data into precise and timely outreach that drives revenue.

We’re building an AI-powered signal platform that automates repetitive sales and marketing tasks and connects insights across all customer-facing systems.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who combines strong engineering fundamentals with a practical mindset. You’ll join our web application team with heavy backend processing job focus. Your work will also involve frontend work to build the customer facing UI, but is typically backend (php/laravel) dominant.

UserGems is a ~60-person company with around half of them working in engineering in Europe and Brazil and the other half in sales and marketing based in the U.S. You’ll be part of a technically strong, fast-moving engineering group that collaborates closely with our go-to-market teams in the U.S.

We’re in a phase where speed and iteration matter most - we move fast, ship often, and improve continuously.

You’ll join one of our 3 webapp teams and take ownership of entire components within the first few months of starting at UserGems. The role offers a high degree of autonomy within a collaborative, high-trust environment. You’ll work closely with teammates across Europe and Brazil and frequently with our marketing and sales teams in the U.S., so you should be comfortable working in English and collaborating asynchronously across time zones.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Work comfortably with a high degree of independence and ownership.
  • Learn quickly and stay effective in a changing environment.
  • Approach complex technical problems with practical, solution-oriented thinking.
  • Value working in a dynamic company where impact matters more than process.
  • Are used to strongly leverage AI in your day to day development workflow

What You’ll Do:

  • Build user facing UIs in collaboration with a product manager and your teammates
  • Build scalable data heavy background processing jobs handling terabytes of data
  • Build new features with both humans and AI agents in mind (MCP).
  • Integrate and maintain connections with external data providers, ensuring data reliability, consistency, and quality across ingestion pipelines.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and make sound trade-off decisions
  • Design, build, and optimize relational database structures (mysql)
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists to optimize AI workflows and prompts
  • Debug, profile, and tune systems for reliability and performance at scale
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code with an eye for long-term stability
  • Continuously improve workflows, deployment, and monitoring practices

Our Tech Stack (AWS)

  • Typescript/Vue SPA as the customer facing frontend
  • PHP with laravel for our backend and data processing jobs
  • MySQL & OpenSearch
  • RabbitMQ for microservice communication
  • Datadog for logs and performance monitoring
  • GitHub + Linear for development process

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience as a PHP developer (preferably with laravel)
  • 2+ years of experience as a frontend or full stack developer (typescript)
  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks
  • You bring full-time focus and accountability - we’re a small team, and everyone’s contribution matter
  • You’re reliable, consistent, and communicate openly when priorities or availability change
  • Expertise in relational database modeling, query optimization, and high-performance tuning
  • Experience working in a startup or fast-moving environment
  • Ability to work independently and self-organize
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken (preferable with prior work experience with English as the main working language)
  • Curious mindset and willingness to explore unfamiliar systems
  • Pragmatic: you balance technical purity with delivery speed

How We Work

We’re a lean, high-impact team where everyone owns their work end-to-end and delivers with full commitment. Freedom comes with responsibility - we trust people to manage their own time, but we expect steady engagement, reliability, and proactive communication.

This is a full-time remote role - consistency and accountability are what keep our remote team effective.

Working on this team you will have:

  • Impact and ownership: You’ll ship code that directly affects revenue and product direction
  • Modern tech stack, strong peers: Work alongside experienced engineers in a team that values autonomy and quality.
  • Remote-first across Europe and Brazil: Flexible work setup and async-friendly culture.
  • High trust culture
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunities

‍



Why you should join:

  • You’ll be part of a fast-growing startup as it scales from 70 to hundreds of employees
  • Customers love us! (see our Customers & Hall of Gems pages)
  • Employees love working here (see Repvue & Glassdoor reviews) and stay a long time. Median tenure for Director+ is 5 years and median tenure for all employees is 3+ years.
  • We just had our best quarter ever (by >2X) and signed our first 7 digit contract.
  • We will be cash-flow positive by the end of the year and can create our own destiny.
  • We're a remote-first company with employees across the Americas and Europe
  • We have company & department-wide in-person off-sites around the world so that everyone stays connected
  • We believe strongly in being customer-focused and data-driven in everything we do
  • We value individual differences in the workforce and strive to make everyone feel welcomed and accepted, regardless of their skin color, gender or sexual orientation
  • Health benefits & competitive salary

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

We are looking for a Test Automation Engineer to join our team in Belgium and help to shape the future of our Hardware Security Solutions.

As Automation Test Engineer you design, develop and maintain automated and manual testing solutions for OneSpan hardware products, combining test automation with embedded software/firmware validation and a strong focus on end-user testing.

Working closely with the software and firmware teams, you build test strategies, test specifications, test harnesses, automation frameworks and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) infrastructure.

The role is hands-on with embedded devices such as STM32-based targets, using Python automation to run repeatable functional, integration, regression, stress and reliability tests, and to investigate failures across the full software and firmware stack.

Key responsibilities

• Design, develop, execute and maintain automated test cases and frameworks so products meet functional requirements and design specifications.

• Build and maintain automated test infrastructure, including Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) setups, test fixtures and harnesses for embedded devices.

• Develop Python-based automation for device control, test execution, data collection, validation and reporting.

• Execute manual and automated functional, integration, regression, performance, stress, endurance and reliability tests on physical devices and software.

• Create repeatable test cases and acceptance criteria that maximise functional and system-level coverage, and help define test strategies for new features.

• Maintain automated regression suites and integrate hardware-based testing into CI/CD pipelines where appropriate.

• Investigate failures across software, firmware and test environment, drive root-cause analysis with developers and document defects clearly.

• Monitor test results for trends and recurring failures, and act as an advocate for quality throughout the development process.

Requirements

• Degree in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering or equivalent practical experience, with a professional interest in embedded systems, hardware and firmware.

• 3-5 years of experience testing software, firmware or embedded systems, including physical devices in a development or laboratory environment.

• Experience developing automated tests in Python (or another object-oriented language); frameworks such as pytest, Appium or Behave are an asset.

• Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) or other hardware-based automated test environments is highly desirable.

• Experience with load, stress, performance, endurance and reliability testing.

• Familiarity with Git and modern software development practices.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills: able to analyse logs, test results and measurements and pinpoint hardware, firmware or software causes across multiple system layers.

• Able to work independently within a multidisciplinary engineering team and deliver to schedule, with good technical writing skills and fluency in English.

• ISTQB Level 1 certification and willingness to obtain additional ISTQB certifications.

Preferred technical skills & experience

• Python automation for physical hardware and laboratory equipment.

• HIL, SIL or system-level automated testing, integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

• Agile software/hardware development environments.

Key competencies

• Automation & hands-on testing: building reliable, maintainable automated test solutions and working directly with physical devices and fixtures.

• Troubleshooting: systematically investigating failures across multiple layers of a product.

• Quality mindset: strong focus on product quality, test coverage, reliability and customer impact.

• Curiosity & collaboration: digging into how systems really work, and communicating effectively with firmware, software, QA and support teams.

title: Senior GRC Engineer
description:
About the Role

The Senior GRC Engineer owns audit evidence collection and technical control maintenance across A-LIGN's growing portfolio of compliance frameworks, including FedRAMP Moderate Equivalency, FedRAMP 20x, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and SOC 2. This role bridges the GRC function and A-LIGN's technical teams, working hands-on in GCP, GitHub, and Microsoft 365 to collect evidence, verify controls, and keep A-LIGN continuously audit-ready. The Senior GRC Engineer works cross-functionally with every technical department in the company to reduce audit burden on engineering and IT while protecting the certifications that A-LIGN's clients and platforms depend on. The role also supports broader information security activities, including risk assessments, threat modeling, security reviews, and AI technical safeguards.

Reports to

Chief Information Security Officer

Pay Classification

Full-Time

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end audit evidence collection, validation, and organization across A-LIGN's compliance frameworks, including FedRAMP (Moderate Equivalency and FedRAMP 20x), ISO 27001, ISO 42001, SOC 2, NIST 800-53, and NIST 800-171
  • Maintain and continuously verify technical controls across A-LIGN's cloud and corporate environments, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP/GKE), GitHub, and Microsoft 365/Entra ID
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the GRC function and technical departments (IT, Engineering, DevOps) to gather evidence, validate control implementation, and reduce audit burden on those teams
  • Support FedRAMP continuous monitoring activities, including Key Security Indicator (KSI) evidence, vulnerability scan artifact collection, POA&M tracking, and assessor (3PAO) requests
  • Build and maintain evidence automation, including integrations between GRC tooling and source systems (identity provider, cloud platforms, code repositories, ticketing, endpoint management) to reduce manual collection effort
  • Support A-LIGN's ISO 42001 Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS), including AI risk register evidence, AI control monitoring, and nonconformity remediation tracking
  • Prepare audit-ready evidence packages and coordinate directly with external assessors and certification bodies during assessment windows
  • Monitor control health between audit cycles, identify control drift or failures, and drive remediation with control owners before findings occur
  • Maintain compliance documentation, including control narratives, policies, and procedures
  • Support supplier and vendor security reviews with framework-specific evidence requirements
  • Track framework changes (FedRAMP 20x requirements, ISO standard revisions, SOC 2 criteria updates) and translate them into actionable control and evidence updates
  • Conduct security risk assessments and contribute to A-LIGN's corporate risk management program and risk register
  • Participate in threat modeling for A-SCEND features, internal systems, and AI use cases, and translate findings into control improvements
  • Perform security reviews of new tools, vendors, and internal initiatives, including support for Vendor Review Board activities
  • Implement and validate AI technical controls and safeguards, including data loss prevention, AI connector and agent governance, and acceptable use enforcement, in support of A-LIGN's AI Management System
  • Report compliance posture, evidence status, and audit readiness metrics to the CISO and GRC leadership

Minimum Qualifications

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Business, or equivalent combination of education and experience

EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience in information security, GRC, IT audit, or compliance engineering roles
  • Hands-on experience with audit evidence collection and technical control validation for at least two of the following: FedRAMP, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, SOC 2, NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171
  • DevSecOps or cloud engineering experience sufficient to independently locate and extract evidence from GCP, GitHub, and Microsoft 365/Entra ID environments
  • Experience with GRC platforms and evidence automation (AuditBoard, Vanta, Drata, or similar)
  • Experience supporting external audits and assessor interactions, including 3PAO assessments
  • Working knowledge of vulnerability management, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and identity and access management concepts
  • Experience scripting or automating evidence collection (Python, PowerShell, or similar) preferred
  • Familiarity with risk assessment methodologies, threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE), and security review processes preferred

CERTIFICATIONS

  • CISA, CISSP, CCSK/CCSP, ISO Lead Auditor/Implementer, or relevant certifications preferred but not required

SKILLS

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and project management skills
  • Ability to translate framework requirements into clear, actionable requests for technical teams
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage evidence deadlines across multiple concurrent audit cycles
  • Excellent written communication for control narratives, evidence descriptions, and assessor responses
  • Self-directed with strong follow-through in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Proven experience utilizing AI tools to automate manual tasks, streamline workflows, and increase team efficiency
  • Experience operating in PE-backed or high-growth environments preferred

Benefits

  • Employer Paid Life & Health Insurance
  • Competitive Bonus Structure
  • Home Office Reimbursement
  • Technology Allowance
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • BeneficiaT Discount Loyalty Program
  • Personalized Career Coaching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Paid Office Closure December 25-January 1
  • Summer Hours

About A-LIGN

A-LIGN is the leading provider of high-quality, efficient cybersecurity compliance programs. Combining experienced auditors and audit management technology, A-LIGN provides the widest breadth and depth of services including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HITRUST, FedRAMP, and PCI. A-LIGN is the number one issuer of SOC 2 and HITRUST and a top three FedRAMP assessor. To learn more, visit a-lign.com.

Come Work for A-LIGN!

Apply online today at A-LIGN.com and learn about life at A-LIGN by following us on LinkedIn.

A-LIGN is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: System Architect — OneBlade
description:
Job Title

System Architect — OneBlade

Job Description

In this role, you have the opportunity to shape the future of Philips OneBlade: a globally recognized, consumer-focused grooming proposition at the intersection of product innovation, performance, and simplicity.

As System Architect, you will define the end-to-end technical direction for OneBlade product families. You will connect consumer needs, business strategy, product performance, technology choices, and implementation across hardware, software, connectivity, accessories, and digital experiences. You will help ensure that OneBlade continues to deliver distinctive consumer value while enabling scalable, modular, and future-ready solutions.

You are responsible for

  • Defining and communicating a shared system and technical architecture vision across OneBlade product families, platforms, and development projects, ensuring solutions are fit for purpose, scalable, and aligned with the long-term business strategy.

  • Translating long-term business, consumer, and category strategies into consumer-benefit-driven technical propositions, together with the Program Manager, Category Lead, R&D teams, and other key stakeholders.

  • Creating and maintaining the OneBlade reference architecture, including clear building blocks, system options, interfaces, design principles, technology choices, and architectural roadmaps.

  • Evaluating system scenarios and trade-offs across consumer performance, cost, quality, reliability, sustainability, time to market, manufacturability, and intellectual property—and selecting the architecture that best supports the business case.

  • Driving modularity, reuse, platform harmonization, and technology standardization across OneBlade product families, while protecting the distinctive performance and user experience of the proposition.

  • Leading end-to-end architectural integration across relevant domains, including shaving and trimming performance, mechanical design, electronics, firmware, power management, charging, accessories, packaging, manufacturing, quality, and—where relevant—connectivity and digital services.

  • Identifying critical technical risks, dependencies, and design decisions early; establishing appropriate architecture control points; and resolving key technical impediments throughout development.

  • Planning and developing the Architectural Runway to support future OneBlade features, capabilities, product variants, and platform evolution.

  • Contributing to the Grooming & Beauty Reference Architecture and Technology Roadmap, while leveraging relevant technologies, standards, and building blocks across Philips Personal Health.

  • Ensuring that the defined architecture is understood, accepted, and implemented consistently by development teams and external partners.

You are a part of

The Grooming & Beauty Architecture team within Philips Personal Health. The team enables the end-to-end development of differentiated consumer products and solutions across grooming categories.

For OneBlade, you will work closely with global category, innovation, R&D, design, quality, operations, procurement, and market teams. You will be a central technical partner in translating a strong consumer proposition into robust, manufacturable, and successful products at global scale.

To succeed in this role, you should have the following skills and experience

  • A Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline, with 5+ years of progressive experience in systems engineering, product development, or system architecture within a technology-driven consumer-product environment.

  • Demonstrated experience defining and delivering end-to-end architectures for complex physical products, preferably involving mechatronics, electronics, software, and/or connected product capabilities.

  • Strong understanding of system-level trade-offs across consumer performance, cost, quality, reliability, manufacturability, sustainability, and time to market.

  • Experience working with modular platforms, product families, reuse strategies, and technology roadmaps.

  • Proven ability to lead and influence multidisciplinary development teams and senior stakeholders in a global, multi-location organization.

  • Ability to connect consumer insights and business objectives to concrete technical choices and system requirements.

  • Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to operate effectively amid uncertainty.

  • Experience navigating the differences and tensions between development approaches, technology maturity, and short-term delivery needs versus long-term platform direction.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tailor complex technical topics to different audiences.

  • A collaborative, curious, and pragmatic mindset. You enjoy being the connecting point across disciplines and turning diverse inputs into a clear technical direction.

Compensation & benefits

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is € 78,187 –€ 130,312 . We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

This role is eligible for 3% annual bonus with your rewards linked to KPIs and the company’s performance. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision. Benefits include generous paid leave, paid parental leave, employer pension contributions, health and wellbeing programs and discounts on Philips products. Discuss in more detail with your recruiter.


How we work together
This position requires working onsite in the office for a minimum of three days per week.

About Philips
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

  • Learn more about our business.

  • Discover our rich and exciting history.

  • Learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.
